About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Cloud Infrastructure team, you ll build automation and evolve the foundational systems that support Gusto s products. This is a code-driven infrastructure role, well suited to someone with a DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering background who enjoys solving problems that help other engineers work more effectively. You ll help set the architecture, Infrastructure-as-Code patterns, and operational standards that every Gusto engineer builds on, with real autonomy over how it gets done. Key opportunities include migrating production applications into a modern AWS multi-account architecture, strengthening disaster recovery and compliance, and improving the speed and reliability of our infrastructure tooling.

About the Team:

Gusto s Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the AWS foundations that the rest of our engineering organization depends on. We manage infrastructure as code with Terraform/OpenTofu and run Spacelift, the platform hundreds of engineers use daily to deploy infrastructure changes. This experienced team partners with networking, compute, platform, and application teams to make Gusto s cloud infrastructure more reliable, resilient, and easier to use.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Build and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform/OpenTofu, with changes managed through code rather than manual configuration.
  • Improve the speed, reliability, and usability of Spacelift workflows used by engineering teams across Gusto.
  • Partner with application and infrastructure teams to migrate production services into a modern AWS multi-account architecture.
  • Strengthen disaster recovery and compliance readiness by implementing and testing infrastructure resilience.
  • Refactor infrastructure code into modular, reusable components that simplify maintenance and future development.
  • Support engineering teams with cloud infrastructure needs, troubleshooting, and vendor integrations.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate infrastructure development, improve troubleshooting, and identify automation opportunities while maintaining a high bar for security, correctness, and reliability.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation focused on internal engineering support, turning recurring issues into automation and lasting improvements.

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, platform, or site reliability engineering.
  • Deep, production-level AWS expertise across compute, networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Demonstrated mastery of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu strongly preferred; Crossplane, CloudFormation, or similar) including module design, state management, and scalable patterns for large teams.
  • Experience with multi-account AWS governance — AWS Organizations, OU design, SCPs/RCPs, and federated identity via IAM Identity Center or equivalent SSO.
  • Hands-on experience with a managed IaC orchestration platform (Spacelift, Terraform Cloud, etc.).
  • Experience operating production infrastructure for a customer-facing SaaS platform, including observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) and participating in incident response.
  • Track record of driving multi-quarter infrastructure initiatives to completion with minimal direction.

Bonus:

  • Operating Terraform/OpenTofu at large scale — managing thousands of workspaces or state files, module registries and versioning strategy, drift detection and remediation, and policy-as-code enforcement.
  • Experience in compliance-regulated environments (SOC 2, PCI, NIST).
  • Solid cloud networking foundations: VPC design, IP address management, DNS, egress control, and centralized traffic inspection.

jobs.description:
The AI organization at Asana builds the platform and products that bring AI into how the world s teams work. That includes AI Teammates that take on work alongside people, the orchestration layer that lets agents plan and act across the Work Graph, and the AI platform that every AI feature at Asana runs on. The platform covers model access, retrieval, context, evaluation, and production quality.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across this organization. You will lead the hardest cross-team problems in AI at Asana, make architectural calls that hold up as models and the industry shift underneath us, and help senior leadership shape where AI takes the product next. The scope spans multiple engineering teams across San Francisco, New York, Vancouver, and Warsaw.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Security, and Legal to take ambitious AI products from prototype to reliable, trusted enterprise features
  • Lead strategic initiatives that span multiple teams, such as agent runtime and orchestration, context and memory for agents grounded in the Work Graph, and reliable, cost-efficient LLM inference at enterprise scale
  • Set the bar for how Asana measures AI quality, including offline and online evaluation, production monitoring, and the feedback loops that turn real usage into better agents
  • Make and guide high-stakes technical decisions on model and vendor strategy, build versus buy, and shared platform abstractions, and make sure those decisions age well
  • Influence R&D-wide AI strategy by bringing a grounded view of the model and agent landscape to senior leadership

  • Hands-on fluency with the current AI landscape, including foundation models, agent frameworks, tool use, and evaluation methods, with opinions strong enough to set direction and flexible enough to change with new evidence
  • Deep experience with distributed systems and the reliability, latency, and cost challenges of running them at scale

jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



AI traffic is about to outrun API traffic the same way API traffic outran human traffic. Come lead the team that gets enterprises through that transition.

If you don't think you meet every bullet below, apply anyway. Nobody checks every box — we're looking for people who are strong in a few areas and hungry in the rest.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Kong is the connectivity layer of AI. We're a 6-time Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader and a Forrester Wave Leader, running in production at Fortune 500 scale. Every enterprise moving from “we're piloting AI” to “AI is in production” runs into the same wall: governance, security, and connectivity for a traffic pattern nobody built for. That's the opportunity in front of this team, and it's why Professional Services is one of the fastest-growing parts of this company right now.

We're hiring a Professional Services Manager to lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers across Kong's US Professional Services organization. This is a leadership role, not a delivery role: you're directly responsible for delivery outcomes, staffing, and the growth of the people who sit hands-on with customer engineering teams every day.

You own the full engagement lifecycle for your book of business — staffing the right FDE and Engagement Manager on every account, holding the team to go-live dates and technical quality, and driving resolution personally on the highest-risk or highest-value accounts. You're operating at the intersection of people leadership, technical delivery, and enterprise account management, and you're judged on outcomes, not activity.

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



About the Role

Ramp’s Reseller Channel is one of our fastest-growing motions, and as a Reseller Partner Development Representative (PDR), you’ll be at the forefront of acquiring new partners to accelerate that growth.

Your focus will be sourcing and qualifying Value Added Resellers (VARs) and distributors, engaging their leadership teams, and building the foundation for long-term, revenue-generating partnerships.

This is a builder role — you’ll help define how Ramp scales its reseller acquisition motion while working closely with Channel Partner Managers to convert qualified opportunities into signed, successful partners.

This role is perfect for someone who:

 - Thrives in outbound prospecting and partner acquisition

 - Gets energy from building new business motions from scratch

 - Is curious about the reseller ecosystem and how VARs go to market

 - Wants to help shape Ramp’s channel program at an early stage
   

What You’ll Do

 - Source and qualify new reseller partners through outbound prospecting and inbound leads

 - Identify firms that act as Value Added Resellers (VARs) or distributors and assess alignment with Ramp’s program

 - Engage senior personas (Partnership Leaders, Sales Executives, C-Suite, Vendor Managers) to introduce Ramp’s reseller program

 - Build a consistent top-of-funnel pipeline for Channel Partner Managers to convert into signed partnerships

 - Craft outbound messaging and campaigns tailored to reseller partner needs

 - Partner with Channel Partner Managers to ensure smooth, qualified hand-offs

 - Maintain accurate partner and opportunity data in Salesforce and other internal tools
   

What You Need

 - A builder’s mindset — excited to shape Ramp’s reseller partner acquisition motion

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with a consultative tone

 - Comfort engaging senior stakeholders at reseller and distribution firms

 - Experience in partnerships, channel sales, sales development, or outbound sales

 - Curiosity about reseller business models and how Ramp fits into their revenue streams

 - Organizational discipline to manage outbound motions, track metrics, and iterate quickly
   

Nice to Haves

 - Experience prospecting into or working with resellers/distributors

 - Exposure to partner ecosystems in B2B SaaS, fintech, or software resale models

 - Background in sales or partnerships at a high-growth startup

 - Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, and deploy modern, scalable AI agents and applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs). This role requires a strong focus on end-to-end agent development, including building a high-performance React frontend, designing the agentic logic in Python, integrating with backend services, and ensuring production readiness.

  • Work with middleware (Python/Node.js) to orchestrate agent calls and data flow.
  • Implement comprehensive observability and tracing for agent runs and system performance.
  • Build reusable, scalable UI components.
  • Optimise application performance, responsiveness, and scalability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to solution design.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with proper documentation.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Ownership mindset with attention to detail

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Understanding of Salesforce APIs (REST, Apex, RLM/CPQ)

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
About the role

We re looking for a Technical Lead Manager (TLM) to lead our CI/CD team, the group that owns how every Chime engineer builds, integrates, and safely ships code. Your team owns the integration and delivery surface: source and code intelligence (GitHub, Sourcegraph), continuous integration and build (CircleCI, Qlty), artifacts (Artifactory), and the release-safety layer that gets changes to production without breaking it. Your team s mission is continuous, safe, reliable, and efficient integration and delivery of features. Every merge and every deployment at Chime runs through what your team builds.

This is a player-coach role. Under Chime s Builder Operating Model, the TLM is a single accountable owner at the team level. You own both delivery and people for a small team, and you stay hands-on in the codebase. You ll spend about 40%+ of your time building, authoring PRs that land in production, with the remainder split across people management, planning, and other business processes. You ll lead a team of 4 engineers, own the roadmap for a high-leverage platform surface, and be directly accountable for the reliability of the pipelines and release systems in the critical path of every Chime team. You re expected to use AI coding agents and workflows to keep planning, operations, and delivery overhead low so you can stay in the code and operate the team.

In this role, you can expect to 

  • Build and ship, hands-on. Author and review PRs that land in production. Own the team s technical direction, architecture, and quality bar; partner with senior ICs and lead technical design discussions and technical planning.
  • Lead and grow the team. Own full people management for the team: 1:1s, career coaching, performance feedback, promotion decisions, and hiring. Build an inclusive, high-trust team and own its health and engagement. Mentor engineers toward Staff or a future TLM path.
  • Own the CI/CD platform. Set direction and delivery for the build and integration systems (GitHub, CircleCI, Artifactory, Sourcegraph, Qlty etc): fast, reliable, self-service pipelines with strong documentation and low-friction adoption so every product team ships faster with less support burden.
  • Be accountable for safe delivery at scale. Own the release-safety toolkit (Release Guard, canaries and progressive delivery, feature flagging with Tuner, and rollback) and the operational discipline behind it: incident prevention, incident response, SLAs, and blameless learning for systems in the critical path of every deploy.
  • Balance the platform-team tension. Weigh new capabilities against keep-the-lights-on work, security remediation, and dependency upgrades, and make those trade-offs legible to engineers, cross-functional partners, and leadership.
  • Champion AI-driven velocity. Use AI coding agents and tooling to scale yourself and your team across planning, coding, and ops/triage, and introduce workflows that measurably improve team velocity.
  • Own cross-functional coordination. Serve as the XFN point of contact for your platform s capabilities. Coordinate inbound requests and outbound dependencies, partner with client engineering teams and sibling platform teams (Release Enablement, Developer Foundations) on scope and delivery commitments, and tie-break technical decisions.
  • Partner across the Platform Org. Work closely with product engineering teams, security, Core Infrastructure, and other Engineering Services leaders on shared roadmaps, dependencies, and other initiatives.

To thrive in this role, you have 

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience and 2+ years leading or managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development, with the appetite and ability to stay hands-on in the codebase.
  • A track record of delivering CI/CD, build/release, or developer-productivity systems: continuous integration, build pipelines, artifact management, or progressive delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with CI systems (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or comparable), build pipelines, and artifact management in production (must-have).
  • Hands-on technical depth you can still exercise: you author and review production PRs and can lead technical design, not just delegate it. Strong development experience in Ruby, Go, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Experience with progressive and safe delivery: canaries, release gating, feature flagging, and rollback strategies.
  • Strong understanding of operating production systems at scale: reliability, observability, incident response, and the operational discipline platform ownership demands.
  • The judgment to balance delivery velocity against safety, reliability, and technical-debt realities, and the communication skills to make those trade-offs clear to engineers and executives alike.
  • Demonstrated use of AI coding agents and tooling to accelerate development and team velocity, with a concrete example of the impact on your team s output.
  • A customer-obsessed mindset toward internal developers. You measure success by the productivity and reliability experienced by the engineers who build on your platform.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and a collaborative, low-ego approach to cross-team leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Argo CD, or GitOps-based deployment

Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The shape of data work is changing rapidly, and Hex is the company pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, from the launch of the industry’s first data agent last year, to the first fully generative dashboard experience https://hex.tech/blog/introducing-generative-data-apps/ earlier this year, to building a frontier benchmark measuring analytical prowess https://hex.tech/blog/databench-agentic-analytics-benchmark/. Data teams at Cursor, Clay, Hubspot, Chime, and many more use Hex to empower everyone in their organization to use data with trust and confidence.

Behind all of these innovations is Hex’s AI engineering team: a team that blends research and technology with building incredible products that users can’t live without. We equally love diving deep into the internals of the latest research papers as we do shipping features and working closely with customers.

Our team is an eclectic melange of mathematicians, recovering marketers, Data People, poker players, and one person who communicates exclusively via Bufo emojis. We are looking for our first leader – if this sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you!




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Partner with the CEO and CTO to define and execute on research strategy across post-training, model evaluation, search and retrieval, and continuous learning

 - Manage research partnerships across a wide range of partners, from small startups to major labs

 - Drive the production of high quality technical content for sharing Hex research outcomes externally across a variety of audiences and platforms

 - Hire and manage an exceptional team of AI engineers and researchers


ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years leading applied research, AI engineering, or ML engineering teams

 - Deep expertise in modern AI technology as well as classical ML systems, including LLMs and transformer models, agentic workflows, context management, and agentic evals

 - Passion for delivering exceptional product experiences backed by AI and an obsession for driving business outcomes

 - Strong communicator and collaborator, empowering and upleveling product and engineering counterparts

 - Talent magnet, with the ability to attract and retain exceptional AI talent

 - Experience working with RL environments is not required, but is a plus
   
   

If you’re looking for more info about what we’re up to, check out our blog https://hex.tech/blog/ or some https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xyh1EqcjGME recent https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zYhc9nuYVbU podcasts https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTNVLzrxdtw.




OUR STACK

Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.



This is a full-time role based out of either our San Francisco or New York office. Employees are encouraged to come into the office at least twice a week, with Tuesdays and Thursdays being our main in-person days.

The salary range for this role is: $300,375 - $425,000



In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



As agents take on bigger jobs, the infrastructure around them matters more. Docker's answer is to give every agent a strong boundary, make its environment and authority reproducible, and let the work run where it makes sense, from a developer's laptop to the cloud. The Docker AI Substrate team brings that foundation to the enterprise: the largest companies in the world, running agents at scale, with the security, reliability, and control they expect from any critical system. We are a small, senior team at the start of that work. As a Staff Software Engineer here, you will shape the architecture, build the core systems, and run what you build.

Locations: Seattle, WA or Palo Alto, CA.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build the systems that deploy, release, and operate Docker's agentic platform for enterprise customers, in Go and on Kubernetes.

 - Make the platform run consistently across cloud providers and environments, with the security, identity, and network boundaries enterprises require.

 - Own the release and supply chain path so every deployment is reproducible, verifiable, and trusted.

 - Run what you build: production ownership, on-call, SLOs, incident response, and the operational tooling that keeps it boring.

 - Set technical direction with the team's architect and engineering leadership, and work with partner teams across runtime, developer experience, identity, and observability.

 - Raise the bar through design review, testing discipline, and mentorship as the team grows.




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - You have built and operated a cloud control and management plane. Software that provisions, upgrades, and watches infrastructure for many tenants or environments, in production, with a pager. Experience at a cloud provider, a managed-service vendor, or a platform team that stamps out environments.

 - Kubernetes beyond deployment. You have written controllers or operators, understand reconciliation and CRDs, and know why declarative beats imperative at fleet scale.

 - Deep in at least one major cloud. Hands-on with compute, networking, identity, and managed services, and able to pick up a second cloud fast.

 - Production ownership. On-call, incident response, SLOs, post-mortems. You run what you build.

 - Distributed systems design. Fault tolerance, consistency, observability, idempotent reconciliation.

 - Go. Professional proficiency. Docker's backend and all of this team's code is Go.

 - 10+ years of professional software engineering in infrastructure, platform, or cloud services, with the judgment to set direction for others.




STRONGLY PREFERRED

 - Kubernetes resource orchestration and cloud controllers, such as KRO.

 - Release engineering and software supply chain: OCI registries, digests, license compliance.

 - Private connectivity between cloud accounts: PrivateLink, VPC peering, service endpoints, egress policy.

 - OpenTelemetry pipelines with multiple destinations.

 - Building managed services.

 - Firecracker, microVMs, or other isolated execution environments for untrusted code.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

 

Compensation & Equity

 - Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

 - Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

 - Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

 - Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

As the Solutions Consultant, Enterprise Team Manager at Ramp, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Solutions Consultants supporting Enterprise prospects. You will set the operating rhythm for complex pre-sales work, coach the team on discovery, solution design, demos, technical deal strategy, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Account Management to deliver a cohesive customer experience.

You will remain close to high-impact opportunities while scaling the team’s technical ownership financial fluency, and executive presence. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will improve how the team qualifies and advances complex opportunities, create repeatable practices and assets, and use customer insight to shape Ramp’s go-to-market and product priorities.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Engage directly in the most strategic or complex customer situations, including executive conversations, technical validation, RFPs, and escalations.

 - Build scalable playbooks, technical assets, demo standards, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve quality and consistency across the team.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Services to translate recurring customer needs into actionable feedback, roadmap context, and strong handoffs.

 - Define and inspect team health metrics such as coverage, conversion, cycle efficiency, solution quality, customer outcomes, and talent development.

 - Foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture grounded in customer empathy, strong collaboration, speed, and continuous improvement.

 - Identify practical ways for the team to use AI to improve preparation, documentation, solutioning, and customer-facing work while maintaining quality and good judgment.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 8+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, or a related customer-facing technical role, including 3+ years of people management or demonstrated player-coach leadership.

 - Proven success leading teams through complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical requirements, and long decision processes.

 - Working fluency with enterprise systems and integrations, including ERP platforms such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics; APIs; SFTP; and adjacent HRIS, identity, and security systems.

jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION


As a Sales Compensation Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end design, delivery, and governance of UiPath's sales incentive programs. You will lead annual plan design and rollout, oversee monthly commission processing and payout accuracy, manage Xactly system administration and configuration roadmaps, and partner with Sales, Finance, HR, and Operations leadership to ensure compensation plans drive the right selling behaviors. Deep, hands-on experience with Xactly Incent is required.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader with strong execution skills who can translate business objectives into clear, motivating, and cost-effective incentive plans. 
You will be accountable for on-time and accurate payouts, sound plan governance and controls, and clear communication of plan mechanics to the field. Reporting to the Head of Global Sales Compensation, you will guide and mentor Sales Compensation Analysts and serve as a trusted advisor to sales leaders.

Additionally, you will partner closely with Sales Operations, Finance, and the Sales Business Intelligence & Reporting team on quota setting, territory and portfolio management, and commission expense forecasting.

Please note:

 1. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension depending on performance and business needs.

 2. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.
    


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 -  PROGRAM DESIGN AND STRATEGY:

 - Lead the annual sales compensation planning process, including, modeling, cost analysis, and executive review

 - Design incentive plans, SPIFFs, and accelerators that align with company go-to-market strategy and revenue goals

 - Conduct historical performance analysis, scenario modeling, and market benchmarking to recommend plan changes and quantify cost of sales

 - Partner with Sales Operations and Finance on quota setting, territory design, and crediting rules

 - Develop and maintain plan documents, policies, and terms and conditions in partnership with HR and Legal

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living MongoDB cultural values every day – we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

  • Contribute to shaping architecture, code reviews and development practices, developer experience as the teams and product grow 
  • Mentor fellow engineers and assume ownership and accountability of projects

Qualifications

  • Strong background in building core components for high scale compute and data distributed systems
  • 15+ years experience of building distributed systems, and/or foundational cloud services at scale and an interest in working with Python, Go and Java
  • Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, performance tuning, possessing a strong grip on the foundational materials of computer science and maintaining distributed and/or highly concurrent software systems in large, long-lived code bases
  • Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions and delivering complex projects in distributed systems or databases
  • Experience leading 15-20 people projects involving distributed systems infrastructure from conception to successful delivery or experience working through multiple staff engineers in different squads and leading the successful delivery of the projects
  • Good verbal and written technical communication skills, desire to collaborate with colleagues

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Cloud Platform Engineer at Supabase, you’ll join Cloud Engineering, part of Engineering Operations, and shape the foundations that let engineering teams build, ship, and operate infrastructure safely and independently across AWS and GCP.

This is a role spanning cloud governance, platform engineering, and hands-on operations. You’ll work across AWS and GCP account structure, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), reusable platform primitives, security boundaries, and self-service workflows for engineers.

You’ll be joining at a point where many of these foundations are being actively defined or reworked. We’re looking for someone who can take ambiguous, messy, business-critical infrastructure problems and turn them into pragmatic systems, tools, standards, and written guidance that scale with the company and empower teams to go faster.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Designing and implementing cloud governance across AWS and GCP, including identity, account organization, access controls, and guardrails.

 - Building reusable infrastructure and building blocks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to provision and manage infrastructure safely and consistently.

 - Creating self-service capabilities that reduce organizational friction and let engineers move more quickly within sensible boundaries.

 - Owning resource governance and visibility: management tagging, a trustworthy inventory of what exists and who owns it, and consistent cross-account billing data.

 - Developing reusable security primitives, including secrets storage, KMS, certificate management, token vending, direct service-to-service authentication, mTLS, and related platform services.

 - Owning cloud-level network and operational primitives: IP address management, DNS, and health signals such as service-limit and quota alerting.

 - Combining software engineering with hands-on operations and total ownership: building, deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving what you own.

 - Establishing and sharing cloud engineering best practices through documentation, internal tooling, examples, and enablement.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of experience in cloud governance, platform engineering, and/or operations, have operated production systems at scale, and carried on-call for them.

 - Have previously undertaken a significant migration, e.g. rearchitected an AWS account topology, introduced IaC for existing infrastructure, centralized identity/SSO, or brought a second cloud under governance.

 - Enjoy building internal platform and self-service experiences for other engineers.

 - Are genuinely deep in at least one—ideally two—of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity):
   
   - Tooling & ecosystem: You’re intimately familiar with the breadth of AWS services in general, and IAM/SSO in particular. You know their Well-Architected Framework, and when to reach outside. You have working knowledge of GCP. You use IaC routinely and have run it in production, whichever tool. You’ve probably collaborated with auditors on meeting compliance requirements.
   
   - Software engineering: You write real production code (Go, Rust, or a comparable systems language), and can build reliable, maintainable services. You thrive across all stages of the SDLC, set technical direction, know how to de-risk projects, and produce written artifacts such as RFCs.
   
   - Operations: You’ve run production infrastructure yourself: carried the pager, written the alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix first, and made shared systems less risky over time. You like owning systems, simplifying complex infrastructure problems, and turning best practices into reusable building blocks.

 - Are comfortable treating infrastructure as software and have relevant experience with IaC and automation.

 - Communicate clearly, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The GTM Technology team sits within GTM Operations and owns the systems, architecture, and automation that power Plaid's go-to-market motion — Salesforce administration and platform architecture, quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash data integrity, and the evaluation and rollout of new GTM tooling, including AI and agentic tooling. We partner closely with Sales, Finance, and Engineering to make sure the systems behind revenue are accurate, scalable, and increasingly automated.

We're hiring a GTM Technology Engineer to help build and maintain the technical backbone of our GTM systems. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can write production-quality Salesforce code (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL), design clean integrations across our GTM stack (Salesforce, CPQ, contract lifecycle management, sales engagement, data warehouse, and more), and bring an AI-forward, builder mentality to how we automate and scale GTM Operations workflows.

You'll work on everything from diagnosing and fixing Apex logic that drives revenue-critical fields, to building integrations that connect Salesforce with adjacent platforms, to designing and deploying AI-powered agents and automations (using LLM APIs, MCP servers, and agentic workflows) that remove manual work from the GTM org. You'll report into GTM Technology and work alongside Salesforce architects, GTM Operations partners, and Engineering.

Responsibilities

 - Salesforce development: Design, build, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Flows that support core GTM processes.

 - Data integrity & diagnostics: Investigate and resolve issues in revenue-critical Apex services, tracing root causes across triggers, flows, and integration touchpoints.

 - Cross-platform integration: Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM stack (CPQ, CLM/contract tools, sales engagement platforms, data enrichment tools, data warehouse) using middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Tray.io http://Tray.io), REST/SOAP APIs, and event-driven patterns.

 - AI & automation: Prototype and productionize AI-assisted workflows — using LLM APIs, Salesforce-hosted MCP servers, and agentic tooling — to automate manual RevOps processes (deal reviews, data QA, reporting, triage).

 - Platform architecture: Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions (data model, sharing model, integration patterns, CI/CD via tools like Copado, Gearset) that keep the org scalable as Plaid's GTM motion grows.

 - Partnership: Work directly with RevOps, Deal Desk, Sales leadership, and Engineering to translate business requirements into reliable, well-tested technical solutions.

 - Quality & governance: Write testable, documented code; participate in code review and release management; support SOX/ITGC controls relevant to revenue systems where applicable.

Requirements

 - 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience — Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP, platform events, middleware).

 - Experience with CPQ (Salesforce CPQ or similar) and a working understanding of quote-to-cash / lead-to-cash data flows.

 - Hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-powered workflows, agentic systems, or LLM-backed automations that improve operational efficiency — building with AI tools, not just using them.

 - Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills — comfortable tracing a data issue from a Salesforce field back through Apex logic, automation, and upstream integrations.

 - Experience with integration/middleware platforms (MuleSoft, Tray.io http://Tray.io, Workato, or similar) and modern API design.

 - Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), CI/CD, testing discipline, and code review practices.

 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills — comfortable working directly with GTM Operations, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance stakeholders to gather requirements and explain technical tradeoffs.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a proactive, builder-oriented mindset.

 - Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect) are a plus but not required.

  • Proficiency with Git for version control and code review; you treat automation code like production software.
  • A forward-thinking, AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools every day to automate tasks, speed up development and improve processes, and you’re energized by what AI makes possible next.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. We embrace innovation and pave the way to transform bright ideas into excellent security software solutions that help run large-scale, mission-critical software. We encourage you to prescribe defense-in-depth measures, industry security standards, enforce the principle of least privilege to  help take our Security posture to the next level. Our Security engineering team has a niche skill-set that combines Security domain expertise with  the ability to design, implement and rollout security features and functionalities without adding friction to product functionality or performance. We are responsible for the ever-growing need to improve our customer safety and privacy by providing security services that are coupled with the core Okta product.

This is a high-impact role in a security-centric, fast-paced organization that is poised for massive growth and success. You will act as a liaison between the Security org and the engineering org to build technical leverage and influence the security roadmap and direction. You will focus on engineering security and privacy aspects of the systems used across our services while working on a weekly release cadence. You will be empowered to propose  stimulating new projects for our roadmap and rewarded with projects using  emerging technologies.

Bring all the passion and dedication along and there’s no telling what you could accomplish!

  • 8+ years of development experience in designing and implementing software systems in Java, building highly reliable and mission-critical software.
  • 4+ years of work experience in designing and implementing security solutions for applications and distributed systems.

  • Work experience in using Cloud Service Providers such as AWS and GCP.
  • Work experience in using RDBMS like MySQL, good grasp of concepts such as  replication and clustering along with familiarity in data stores such as Redis and Elasticsearch.

About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto Solo is the all-in-one platform solopreneurs (and their accountants) run their whole business on. We re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help build the next chapter of Solo. You ll work in a tight, high-leverage funnel where your work maps directly to top-line revenue, and you ll help build an AI-native product.

We re looking for an owner, not just an executor: someone with a strong product mindset who spots the problem, drives the change, and sees it through end to end. We re a small, scrappy, fast-moving team, so we re looking for someone who likes wearing many hats. If you want to weigh in on product, design, or GTM along the way, there s real room for that here.

About the Team:

Self-employed businesses are one of the fastest-growing segments of small business, and Gusto is betting on making Solo the true all-in-one platform for solopreneurs. This is a fully funded, high-performing team: a small group of engineers and an Engineering Manager, plus a dedicated Data Scientist, Designer, and GTM partner with room to grow based on roadmap progress. 

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Use AI as a genuine multiplier in your own workflow, and help build AI-native experiences into the product itself (including MCP tools).
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and GTM to identify customer and business problems, prototype solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Make pragmatic architecture and data-modeling decisions for problems that mostly don t have existing precedent at Gusto yet.
  • Build and maintain full-stack features - from backend APIs to frontend UI - with an eye toward scalability and maintainability as the team and product grow.
  • Weigh in beyond the "engineer lane" when it helps the team: product framing, design tradeoffs, or GTM considerations.
  • Help define engineering practices and technical foundations for a team that s still early in its build-out.

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping full-stack features end to end.
  • Proficiency across a full-stack toolkit (e.g., Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, GraphQL) and the judgment to choose the right tool for the problem.
  • Demonstrated ownership of 0→1 or greenfield projects, not just extension of existing systems.
  • A self-driven mindset: comfortable setting direction amid ambiguity, not just executing against a spec.
  • Genuine, habitual use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of strong cross-functional partnership.

Bonus points:

  • Experience building for self-employed businesses or SMBs.
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-adjacent domain (fintech, payroll, tax, accounting).
  • Experience shipping AI-powered or AI-augmented product experiences (agents, copilots, LLM-based tooling).
  • Startup or "team of one" experience, comfortable operating with high autonomy and few guardrails.

jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Online Data organization ensures Airbnb customers are delighted in experiences backed by real-time data. We empower Airbnb’s builders to create these experiences by offering intuitive data interfaces and tools without the need to be database experts.
 

The Difference You Will Make:

We’re hiring across multiple teams within our organization. Explore the section below to learn more about each team and the opportunities available.

The KV Stores & Caching team within Airbnb s Online Data org owns and operates critical pieces of Airbnb s online serving storage systems. Specifically, the team owns and is responsible for:

  • A highly available, low-latency, distributed, multi-tenant KV store for Airbnb. This platform is used by user profiling, Search, ML, and pricing teams, supporting millions of read QPS and providing 99.9+% availability across thousands of customer tables.
  • A set of control planes and clients that manage ElasticCache clusters for hundreds of Airbnb production clusters, at million+ IOPS and million+ indexing QPS.
  • A scalable, reliable, performant distributed coordination service supporting many mission-critical systems (MySQL, Redis, Kafka, Flink, Druid, Zookeeper, etc).

The mission of the Ingestion team in the Online Database Infrastructure org is to provide a managed, reliable, performant and scalable platform for exporting data out of Airbnb’s online databases for asynchronous processing. The team currently builds and operates two managed solutions - one for near real time access to change logs (CDC) and another to provide periodic mutation and full table snapshots.

  • As a member of this team you would be working with talented engineers on cutting edge technologies to help support Airbnb’s business. You will be the resident expert on the online data exports platform and guide and collaborate with our internal product teams to effectively use the platform.
  • Lead a team of developers to deliver multi-quarter cross functional projects.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in data ingestion systems and evaluate and incorporate new technologies and methodologies to improve the existing data ingestion architecture/solution.
  • Influence the team’s and organization’s long-term roadmap and strategy.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing guidance and support to enhance their skills and technical standards in the team.
  • Raise operational standards by effectively and proactively identifying, debugging and fixing operational issues. Be part of the oncall rotation for the Ingestion team.

Your Expertise:

  • 9+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Proven track record of leading and mentoring engineering teams, setting technical direction, and growing engineers in their careers.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant storage, and infrastructure. You ve architected and scaled high-performance, business-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence across teams and organizations, building alignment on technical strategy.
  • Strong judgment on technical trade-offs and ability to drive decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
  • Experience onboarding to and navigating a broad and complex codebase, and enabling others to do the same.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Materialize is the live context layer for AI agents and applications. Materialize lets engineering teams use SQL to transform siloed operational data into up-to-the-second, trustworthy views into any element of their business — delivering fresh context to AI agents, interactive search pipelines, and enabling low-latency, event-driven architectures for microservices and core business processes. Materialize is trusted by Notion, Bilt Rewards, and Crane Worldwide Logistics to solve their most pressing operational data challenges while building a live data foundation for their AI transformation. 

Our team spans the US (NYC headquarters), Canada, and EMEA.




INVESTORS:

Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Role Overview

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Materialize, you are the commercial engine of a customer-facing team, owning pipeline generation, full-cycle deals, and expansion across a named account territory. You'll join a team of Account Executives working directly with our Head of Sales to engage engineering-led organizations building on Materialize to power AI agents, data-intensive applications, and real-time operational workflows for customers like Notion, General Mills, Bilt Rewards, and Crane Worldwide Logisitcs.

You own the deal from first call to close. In your first year, you'll build a pipeline of enterprise opportunities across inbound and outbound, close your first six-figure deals, and develop deep fluency in Materialize's technical differentiation and competitive positioning. This role is for someone who can hold a substantive conversation with Engineering leadership, thrives on complex technical sales cycles, and wants to own outcomes.

This role is based in our NYC office near Astor Place, with a minimum of 3 days per week in person.

Responsibilities

 - Generate new business pipeline through inbound fielding and outbound into named target accounts and high-intent prospects

 - Expand relationships in existing enterprise accounts, identifying and driving expansion opportunities across large organizations

 - Lead complex sales cycles end-to-end: scoping, demonstrating, negotiating, and closing six- and seven-figure deals

 - Sell mission-critical enterprise software to technical buyers — engineering executives, software architects, and development teams

 - Collaborate with Field Engineering on technical positioning, POVs, and deal strategy

 - Operate with MEDDPICC rigor and maintain strong Salesforce hygiene across your pipeline

 - Travel roughly 25–30% to build in-person relationships with prospects and customers and represent Materialize at key industry events

What We're Looking For

 - 3+ years of enterprise software sales experience with a demonstrated track record of closing complex, six-figure deals to technical buyers; seven-figure deals a strong plus

 - Currently or recently selling at a database company: you understand the buyer, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win in this category

 - You manage full-cycle enterprise sales: discovery, technical validation, negotiation, and close

 - A demonstrated outbound muscle: you've built pipeline from scratch

 - Comfortable engaging with C-suite and VP Engineering stakeholders, navigating complex procurement, and negotiating enterprise SaaS contracts

 - You've operated in lean, early-stage environments: you take initiative, move without a large support structure, and work directly with leadership

 - Proficient with Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Experience at a fast-growing startup is a plus


Location: NYC (hybrid, minimum 3 days/week at our Astor Place HQ)


Base Salary: $140,000-170,000 USD/year plus additional variable bonus and equity in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. The base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

The salary range provided in this job description should not be considered a guarantee or commitment. The actual compensation offered may vary based on individual qualifications objectively assessed during the application and interview process, including but not limited to the candidate’s:

 - Qualifications and relevant work experience

 - Educational background and credentials

 - Relevant skills and certifications

 - Geographic location

 - Market demands

Materialize reserves the right to adjust the salary range based on the candidate's specific circumstances and the overall compensation package.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Streaming Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Streaming Platform team at Sentry is building the next generation of infrastructure that powers our ingestion pipelines and real-time data processing systems. Our platform ingests, processes, and distributes hundreds of thousands of events per second with low latency and high reliability. We are creating a system that makes it easy for Sentry engineers to deploy and run Streaming Applications at scale by simplifying the complexity of Kafka, scaling consumers automatically, and managing state so product teams can focus on building great experiences for developers.



As part of this team, you will work on challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data processing, and developer experience. You will help us create a self-service streaming platform that improves stability, accelerates time to production, and reduces operational overhead.



This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office to work closely with engineering teams.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Design, build, and operate components of our Streaming Platform, including Kafka, the streaming runtime, high-level APIs, and developer-facing abstractions.

 - Implement resilient, high-throughput stream processing systems that handle unbounded datasets with strong correctness guarantees (delivery, checkpointing, watermarking, and more).

 - Build scalable automation and control plane for Kafka fleet management and improve efficiency.

 - Partner with product engineers to ensure our abstractions enable fast, reliable, and consistent ingestion pipelines.

 - Improve observability, monitoring, and failover for mission-critical real-time systems.




YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - You enjoy working on distributed systems at scale and care about reliability and performance.

 - You like building abstractions that make complex infrastructure easier for others to use.

 - You are motivated by designing systems that balance flexibility for developers with best practices for stability.

 - You are excited to shape how Sentry handles near real-time ingestion and analytics at scale.

 - You value being part of a collaborative team where your contributions make a broad impact across the company.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - At least 2-3 years of software engineering experience, with background in distributed systems, data infrastructure, or real-time streaming.

 - Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Rust, Go, or Java (we primarily use Python and Rust, but experience in similar languages is valuable).

 - Experience building and operating systems in cloud environments such as Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP.

 - Nice to have: experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, or similar tools.



The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $155,000 to $190,000 USD. A successful candidate’s actual base salary amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits https://sentry.io/careers/ for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

 




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AT SENTRY

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations@sentry.io.

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.




THE MISSION

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.



In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.



This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

 - Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

 - Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

 - Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

 - Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

 - Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

 - Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

 - Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.

 - Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

 - Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.

 - Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.

 - Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.

 - Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

 - Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.

 - Independently define and execute the long-term vision to bring billing, fulfillment, and provisioning to best-in-class for the company's success.

 - Proficiency using LLMs and coding agents as part of your day-to-day product management workflow.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.



This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:



OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

 - Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

 - Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.



LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

 - Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

 - Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

 - Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.



METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

 - Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

 - Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

 - Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.



CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

 - Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

 - Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

About the Team 

Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

About the role 

We re hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you ll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You ll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language.

This is an individual contributor role. You ll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

Responsibilities

Set the direction:

  • Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team.
  • Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community 
  • Mentor the team s senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you.
  • Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar.
  • Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate.
  • Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it.

Own the Platform: 

  • Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from.
  • Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting.
  • Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples.
  • Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions

jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?
