jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, SSCS : Authentication
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you ll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.

You ll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You ll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.

Some of our projects include:

  • Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
  • Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
  • Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
  • Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
  • Improving service accounts and secure automation
  • Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you ll do

  • Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab s authentication services with the team.
  • Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
  • Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
  • Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
  • Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab s values in these communications.
  • Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
  • Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

What you ll bring

  • Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
  • Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
  • Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
  • Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
  • Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta s co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta s 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

About You

Production builder: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

Careful evaluator: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

What you will be doing

  • Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
  • Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
  • Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.
  • Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
  • Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.
  • Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.
  • Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.
  • Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.
  • Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
  • Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

Scope by level

Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster.

Our stack

Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

And extra credit for

  • Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
  • Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
  • Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the FinHub - Transfers team within the Platform group, you ll own the architectural direction of the systems that power crypto and fiat fund movements across Coinbase. The Transfers team builds one of the most critical and high-scale distributed financial platforms in the industry, enabling fund movement for Retail, Prime, Exchange, International, and Payments products. You ll make key technical decisions, drive platform reliability and scalability improvements, and lead cross-functional initiatives that directly impact how millions of customers move money on Coinbase.

What You ll Do:

  • Own the technical architecture of Transfers fund movement systems, driving design decisions on distributed system structure, correctness guarantees, and scalability across crypto and fiat rails
  • Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives end-to-end, partnering with Payments, Trading, and product engineering teams to deliver new fund movement capabilities and platform improvements
  • Drive the evolution of Transfers backend infrastructure using modern cloud-native patterns, proactively identifying scaling bottlenecks and architecting solutions before they impact customers
  • Establish engineering standards, code review practices, and architectural patterns that raise the quality bar across the team and reduce operational risk in high-correctness financial systemsMentor engineers across levels on system design, distributed systems best practices, and building production services where financial integrity and reliability are non-negotiable

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production, with demonstrated experience owning architectural direction and making technical decisions that shape a team s or domain s long-term trajectory
  • Deep expertise in backend programming (e.g., Go, Ruby, Python, or Java) and cloud-native architecture, with proven ability to design highly available, high-throughput systems where correctness is critical
  • Track record delivering and scaling financial systems, fund movement platforms, or similarly high-reliability domains where transaction integrity, idempotency, and auditability are core requirements
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, and translating complex distributed systems problems into clear architectural decisions and actionable roadmaps
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.



We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

The Role:

Do you get excited when a gnarly API issue finally clicks into place? Do you love being the person customers can count on when things get complicated? As a Technical Support Engineer at Airbyte, you'll bring together deep technical expertise and genuine customer empathy to support our growing cloud and embedded integration platform. You won't just be closing tickets, you'll be influencing how our product evolves by championing the customer voice with our engineering and product teams every day.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

CUSTOMER SUPPORT & TROUBLESHOOTING

 - Be the person customers can count on, responding via email, ticketing systems, and the occasional video call with the kind of clarity and care that turns frustrated users into loyal ones.

 - Triage and prioritize incoming issues with urgency, consistently meeting SLA targets while leveraging AI tools to work smarter and resolve issues faster.

 - Dig into complex issues across APIs, connectors, data pipelines, and SaaS integrations, not just finding workarounds but partnering with Engineering to get to the root cause and drive real fixes.

 - Document and reproduce customer-reported bugs with enough detail that the right people can act on them quickly.

 - Support embedded platform customers through onboarding and troubleshooting, including OAuth flows, widget tokens, scoped API tokens, and connector configuration.

API & Technical Expertise

 - Get hands-on with customers who are building and debugging integrations, helping them navigate the Airbyte API and third-party APIs with confidence, from authentication and pagination to rate limiting, error handling, and webhooks.

 - Test and validate API endpoints, review request/response payloads, and guide customers through integration best practices.

 - Support customers with the Embedded API and Airbyte MCP, covering source creation, connector template management, and widget token authentication.

 - Help customers building on the Airbyte Connector SDK find their footing, including YAML-based connector definitions, OpenAPI specs, and cassette-based testing workflows.

 - Stay sharp on Airbyte's API surface, new connector releases, and platform updates so your guidance is always accurate and timely.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Be the voice of the customer inside Airbyte, working closely with Engineering and Product to surface issues, advocate for feature requests, and make sure customer pain points actually influence the roadmap.

 - Partner with the Engineering teams to relay platform-specific feedback, connector gaps, and SDK usability issues before they become bigger problems.

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success for technical conversations, onboarding, and expansion efforts, bringing the kind of product depth that helps close and retain customers.

Knowledge & Process Improvement

 - Create and maintain internal and external knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and API documentation to support scalability.

 - Document research and troubleshooting processes to aid in faster ticket resolution and team knowledge-sharing.

 - Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements with AI that reduce support load and improve the customer experience.

 - Spearhead initiatives to fill organizational or support gaps and take ownership of unique projects.
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 3+ years in technical support, data engineering, DevOps, QA, or a similar role supporting developers or technical users.

 - Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs and GraphQL, including OAuth, pagination, webhooks, rate limiting, and error handling.

 - Proficiency with API testing tools like Postman or cURL.

 - Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data integration concepts including ELT/ETL workflows.

 - Strong troubleshooting instincts, clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and a growth mindset that keeps you improving even when things get hard.

 - Demonstrated use of AI tools to speed up troubleshooting or automate a workflow, such as agents, MCP, or prompt and context engineering. Tell us what you built.

 - High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural self-starter.

Nice To Have:

 - Familiarity with Python, Java, or Kotlin and experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitHub.

 - Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes or Docker and multi-tenant architectures.

 - Background supporting developer-facing or embedded/platform products in a B2B SaaS context.

 - Familiarity with OpenAPI specs, YAML configuration, and Jinja expressions.

 - Experience with SQL and working knowledge of databases, including CDC setups.

Location: Remote, Canada. 8am–5pm Eastern Time.

 - CAD $89,000 - $105,000 base salary + a generous equity package

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the infrastructure, tools, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake’s engineering organization. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will help define the technical direction of critical CI infrastructure used by thousands of engineers across a rapidly growing, multi-cloud codebase.


AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL

 - Own the technical direction and architecture of large-scale Continuous Integration services and infrastructure.

 - Design, build, and operate distributed systems that support reliable, performant, and secure software delivery.

 - Lead the development of CI capabilities that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and release velocity.

 - Partner with engineering leadership, product managers, and teams across Snowflake to define quarterly and long-term technical roadmaps.

 - Drive architectural decisions across build systems, test orchestration, resource scheduling, workflow execution, and developer tooling.

 - Identify systemic bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and develop solutions that improve engineering efficiency at scale.

 - Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

 - Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

 - Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

 - Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.


OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE

 - 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

 - A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

 - Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

 - Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

 - A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

 - Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

 - A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

 - Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

 - Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

 - Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

 - Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

 - Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

 - A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.


WHY ENGINEERING SYSTEMS AT SNOWFLAKE?

 - Build infrastructure that thousands of Snowflake engineers rely on every day.

 - Solve challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems at significant scale.

 - Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery across Snowflake.

 - Work with experienced engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

 - Influence the technical direction of critical engineering infrastructure.

 - Grow your impact through architecture, mentorship, and cross-team technical leadership.


COMPENSATION

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

For the US-Market 1 location band, the compensation range for this role is:

 - Base salary: $236,000–$354,000 USD

 - Target bonus: 15%

 - Total target compensation: $271,400–$407,100 USD

 - Equity: Eligible for an RSU grant in addition to base salary and bonus

Snowflake also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP,

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



Docker AI Gateway is our answer to the complexity of taking AI agents from prototype to production. It’s a powerful, intelligent, and secure control point that eliminates the toil of model orchestration, tool management, observability, and governance—so developers can focus on building incredible AI agents, not gluing together infrastructure.

The Gateway sits at the center of modern AI applications, offering:

 - A model and tool routing layer with built-in security and cost optimization

 - A familiar OpenAI-compatible interface and MCP server

 - Unified observability and policy enforcement

 - Auto-RAG, tool injection, session summarization, and more

We’re just getting started—and we need exceptional engineers to help us build the backbone of the future of agent-based development.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and implement core systems powering the AI Gateway, including the model router, MCP gateway, and control plane

 - Build infrastructure that supports dynamic model selection/routing, auto-failover, cost-based routing, and policy enforcement

 - Own critical capabilities such as secure credential storage, session summarization, caching, and rate limiting

 - Develop APIs for developers building with OpenAI-compatible interfaces and the Model Context Protocol

 - Build the underlying infrastructure to support evaluation, telemetry, replay, and backtesting for agents and LLM workflows

 - Lead architectural decisions and mentor engineers as the team scales

 - Performance tuning - caching, session summarization, and rate limiting that keep the gateway fast under real production load

 - Contribute to roadmap planning, technical strategy, and cross-functional alignment




KEY PROBLEMS YOU’LL HELP SOLVE

 - Building a unified abstraction over fundamentally different model and tool providers without leaking their differences into the developer experience

 - Making credential and identity handling for tool access both airtight and fast

 - Giving developers real-time and historical visibility into what their agents are doing, with policy enforcement that can't be bypassed

 - Keeping latency low and reliability high as traffic scales from early adopters to production fleets




WHO YOU ARE

Required Qualifications:

 - 6+ years of backend engineering experience with production-grade systems

 - Deep knowledge of distributed and highly scalable systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and API design

 - Experience building secure, high-throughput services (e.g., gateways, proxies, load balancers, policy engines)

 - Fluency in Go, and/or Rust (both preferred)

 - Familiarity with AI/ML platforms or model serving infrastructure

 - A strong product mindset—you're excited about building developer-facing tools

 - Ownership mentality with a bias for shipping, learning, and iterating

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Qualifications:

 - Prior experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs

 - Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI)

 - Experience with policy engines (e.g., OPA), observability frameworks (e.g., OpenTelemetry), or API gateways

 - Understanding of OAuth2.1, secret management, and cloud IAM systems

 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices architecture




WHY JOIN US?

 - Work on what’s next: The agent era is just beginning. Help define the infrastructure stack for the next generation of software.

 - Own mission-critical infrastructure: Be part of a small team building the backbone of secure, intelligent agent applications.

 - Impact at scale: Your work will touch tens of thousands of developers building AI-first applications.

 - Engineering excellence: Join a world-class engineering team that values simplicity, code quality, and deep technical thinking.

 - Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a team that trusts and empowers you.



Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

 

Compensation & Equity

United States: $160,900 – $260,700 + equity

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

 - Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

 - Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

 - Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

 - Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll design and deploy intelligent systems that automate complex, multi-step financial workflows. You’ll turn agentic frameworks, orchestration layers, and pragmatic model selection into reliable production systems at scale.

 - Architect intelligent systems that automate complex, multi-step financial workflows

 - Apply prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, or training models from scratch as appropriate to the problem

 - Design and optimize agent architectures for reasoning, tool use, and workflow automation

 - Build systems that improve with usage and create compounding AI flywheels

 - Partner with backend and frontend engineers to integrate AI reasoning into secure, production systems

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 5+ years of experience in applied AI/ML engineering, including production deployments

 - Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow

 - A track record of building and deploying AI agents, orchestration frameworks, or multi-step reasoning systems

 - Experience designing monitoring, evaluation, and iteration practices for production AI systems

 - Ability to balance innovation with reliability, scalability, and compliance




PREFERRED

 - Experience architecting and deploying intelligent systems that automate complex, multi-step financial workflows

 - Experience using agentic frameworks, orchestration layers, and pragmatic model selection to build production systems

 - Experience designing AI systems for reasoning, tool use, and workflow automation

 - Experience building systems that improve with usage and create compounding AI flywheels

 - Experience partnering with backend and frontend engineers to integrate AI reasoning into secure, production systems




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

T:0's mission is to make finance run itself. We're building an AI-native accounting platform that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so founders can stop managing their finances and start using them to run the business. The hard part isn't adding AI to accounting. It's making AI you can trust with the books. We use AI to understand how a business works, then run the actual accounting on strict, checkable rules, and no black box deciding the numbers. That's why customers pick us over both the legacy tools they've outgrown and the AI wrappers they don't trust. And bookkeeping is just the start: we're building toward a full financial operating system for how companies account, plan, and operate. The team is small, elite, and builder-focused, led by operators with a track record of shipping AI products at scale. We sit inside Airwallex, which means startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure, distribution, and capital behind us. You'll work directly from real customer pain, own outcomes end to end, and ship fast.




APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Back-End), Inference
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS ROLE?

This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions.

Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads.



AS A SENIOR/STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

 - Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle.

 - Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations.

 - Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms.

 - Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability.

 - Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries.

 - Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough.

 - Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You are a strong backend engineer with excellent fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, networking, operating systems, and security.

 - You have strong programming fundamentals and experience building production systems in languages such as Go, Python, Java, C++, Rust, or similar. You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and make thoughtful tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and correctness.

 - You have designed and operated production systems where correctness, availability, security, and performance mattered at significant scale.

 - You can take ambiguous, high-impact technical problems, define the right architecture, and drive them through to reliable production systems.

 - You have strong systems-design instincts and understand concepts such as concurrency, consistency, caching, queues, rate limiting, backpressure, failure domains, idempotency, and graceful degradation.

 - You think deeply about security boundaries and understand authentication, authorization, identity, cryptography, secrets, tenant isolation, and how small implementation choices can create significant security risks.

 - You are comfortable reasoning across backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and the cloud infrastructure they run on.

 - You are comfortable diving into unfamiliar codebases and debugging complex problems that cross service or system boundaries.

 - You care about the details of production engineering, including instrumentation, capacity planning, migrations, backwards compatibility, incident response, and safe rollouts.

 - You are comfortable challenging existing architecture and evolving foundational components when the system’s needs change.

 - You have a track record of taking technically difficult projects from an unclear starting point to systems that other engineers and customers depend on.

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers.   • Experience owning multi-quarter initiatives end to end, from early concept through measurable business impact.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and leading peers through influence, without relying on formal authority.
  • Experience with large-scale refactors, performance and reliability work, and a strong sense of technical ownership over your product area.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and helping teams scale their impact, including knowing when to delegate scoped work to other engineers rather than carrying it yourself.

  • Ability to build well-structured, maintainable, well-documented code.

jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry already sees the moment software breaks: the error, the trace, the replay, the commit that caused it. Seer, our AI debugger, uses all of that to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. We're looking for a Staff engineer to help decide how that system should evolve as models improve every few months. Some of what we build today will be obsolete by next spring. Part of the job is knowing which parts, and building the rest to last.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Build state-of-the-art agentic AI systems to triage, debug, and solve real production issues

 - Set technical direction for how our agents get context, use tools, and decide when they're done

 - Build the evals that tell us whether a new model or prompt actually helped, fast enough that people use them

 - Decide when to use a frontier model, a smaller one, or one we trained, and revisit that as cost and capability shift

 - Leverage Sentry’s novel (and massive) dataset of errors, spans, and profiles

 - Own major AI initiatives end to end, alongside the developers and product teams shipping them

 - Run what you ship in production and debug it with Sentry




YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Are driven by impact and enjoy working on high-stakes, high-visibility projects

 - Enjoy building things. You will have the opportunity to join the AI/ML team as one of its foundational members

 - Thrive in cross-functional teams and enjoy building features alongside developers and product teams




QUALIFICATIONS

 - You've shipped an LLM-backed system people depended on, and can tell us what broke

 - You have strong opinions on agent design and have changed at least one in the last year

 - You've trained or fine-tuned models when it was the right call, and you know when it isn't

 - You write solid production Python

 - You've owned a system or component and led work across multiple engineers and teams, with a design doc people actually read

 - You write clear technical documentation, mentor other engineers, and present to technical audiences

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry helps developers identify and resolve issues in their applications. Behind our products is a complex foundation of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and services that must perform reliably at scale.



Our Platform and Infrastructure Engineering teams build and operate the systems that power Sentry. From cloud infrastructure, distributed storage, and real-time event processing to service reliability, scalability, and developer productivity, these teams provide the technical foundation that enables our products and engineering organization to grow.



We're looking for Staff Software Engineers to tackle some of Sentry's most challenging infrastructure and distributed systems problems. Depending on your experience and interests, you might work on scaling our real-time event processing systems, improving the reliability and efficiency of our cloud infrastructure, or designing and building foundational services that support our products.



In this role, you'll have the autonomy to identify important technical problems, lead solutions from design through production, and influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team. We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems, remain hands-on with the systems they build, and take pride in delivering meaningful technical impact.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable distributed systems that support Sentry's products and engineering teams.

 - Own technically complex projects from identifying problems and defining solutions through implementation, deployment, and production operations.

 - Solve challenging engineering problems involving system architecture, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.

 - Make thoughtful architectural decisions, evaluating tradeoffs between performance, complexity, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

 - Proactively identify technical challenges and opportunities for improvement, including problems without clearly defined requirements or established solutions.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering, contributing production-quality code, reviewing designs, and helping resolve complex technical issues.

 - Collaborate with engineers and technical leaders across teams to influence technical direction, establish engineering standards, and drive improvements.

 - Share technical knowledge, mentor other engineers, and help strengthen engineering practices across the organization.




YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy solving difficult technical problems where the solution isn't immediately obvious.

 - Like designing and building systems that operate reliably at scale.

 - Thrive on taking ownership of complex engineering challenges, from initial design through production.

 - Balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership and enjoy influencing decisions without formal authority.

 - Think critically about architectural tradeoffs and favor pragmatic, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

 - Take initiative in identifying important problems rather than waiting for projects to be assigned.

 - Enjoy collaborating with talented engineers, sharing knowledge, and raising the bar for engineering quality.

 - Find satisfaction in shipping meaningful improvements and seeing the impact of your work in production.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong background in designing, building, and operating distributed systems or infrastructure.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language.

 - Experience designing and implementing technically complex systems, with a track record of delivering meaningful engineering outcomes.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and services, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical projects, navigate ambiguity, and drive solutions from design through production.

 - Deep technical experience in one or more of the following areas:
   
   - Cloud Infrastructure: Kubernetes, container orchestration, Terraform, infrastructure as code, networking, or service discovery.
   
   - Distributed Systems: Distributed architectures, fault tolerance, consistency, replication, or high-availability systems.
   
   - Data Infrastructure: Kafka, real-time streaming, distributed storage, OLAP/OLTP databases, or large-scale data processing.
   
   - Infrastructure Reliability: Observability, performance optimization, capacity planning, incident response, or production operations.
   
   - Developer Infrastructure: CI/CD systems, build and deployment infrastructure, developer environments, or internal developer platforms.

 - Strong architectural judgment, with the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and design systems for reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, collaborate effectively, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams.

 - Experience improving engineering practices, sharing technical knowledge, or helping other engineers grow.



We recognize that strong engineers come from different backgrounds. You don't need experience in every technology or domain listed above. We're interested in candidates who bring meaningful technical depth, strong engineering judgment, and a track record of solving challenging problems.



The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $240,000 to $400,000,

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agent Connectivity
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We're at an inflection point. We started with core durable execution and are now evolving with the world as it transitions to AI. What it takes to get from where we are today to a world where Temporal underpins all software – including and especially agents – is going to be different. It will require unprecedented speed, iteration, market and customer focus, and invention.

As an Agent Connectivity PM, you’ll help the world makes its transition to AI on Temporal. Without any effort, the market has already identified Temporal as a good substrate for agent workloads. But what makes agents powerful is connecting them to services and data. We are in the infancy of building out our connectivity layer, called Nexus, which has been the brainchild of our founder, Maxim, for many years. We now need to realize the full vision of Nexus by continuing to build out foundational capabilities like xyz and importantly, building agent-specific features and integrations, e.g., MCP connector, tool registry. You’ll identify the highest leverage areas for us to invest, and work closely with the founder/CTO and engineering team to get them to market.




 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Deeply understand problems faced by agent builders and identify opportunities where our products can make building agents faster, more intuitive, more reliable, and more powerful.

 - Define and build what’s next for Temporal. Own strategy and roadmap for agent connectivity. Turn ambiguous signals into clear product theses. How should we prioritize new capabilities like identity propagation or rate limits? How do we bootstrap an ecosystem of connectors?

 - Perform up-front discovery and translate customer, field, and open-source community signals into small tweaks, brand new abstractions, or platform bets.

 - Help engineers and designers deeply understand user needs, empowering them to make great product decisions.

 - Craft messaging around upcoming features that resonates with users.

 - Enable sales and marketing teams to effectively communicate with and win customers.

 - Strong technical depth. Ability to reason about distributed systems, workflow orchestration, service-to-service communication, APIs, SDKs, identity, and authorization.

 - Developer-platform experience. Experience with infrastructure, platforms, integrations, APIs, SDKs, service mesh, API gateways, or cloud developer products.

You’ll build new things with a massive tailwind behind you: a proven technology, a large and growing customer base, and a market moving toward problems Temporal is uniquely equipped to solve. The opportunity is to turn that momentum into what comes next—not simply scale what already works. You’ll be expected to move fast, work across boundaries, and do what it takes to make it happen.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - You're ambitious. You want to win big. You don’t need someone else to set the pace. You get impatient when good ideas stay in slide decks, Slack, or meetings.

 - You're an owner. You are accountable to results over the process. You’re less focused on your swim lane and more focused on making the company successful. You have exceptional product and operational judgement.

 - You're resilient. Building at a high-growth company in 2026 is not for the faint of heart. You see the challenges and change as not just normal, but actually desirable.

 - You want to grow, and help others grow. You self-reflect often. You give feedback, and you seek it out. You have shameless curiosity and a propensity to question things deeply.

 - You prioritize the customer above all else. You want to understand our users' world and prioritize solving their problems above everything else.
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - You have 8+ years of product management experience

 - You have technical depth, with experience working on platform, infrastructure, developer tools, or other technical products

 - You have worked at a startup, high-growth company or in a similarly intense and ambiguous environment




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Nexus product strategy and roadmap. Prioritize the work that makes Nexus the durable connectivity layer across teams, namespaces, services, and AI systems.

 - Current execution. Drive completion of in-flight work such as the new Nexus developer experience, Standalone Nexus Operations, connector foundations, caller identity, rate limits, and payload encryption.

 - Customer discovery and evidence. Stay close to design partners and strategic customers like Netflix, Duolingo, and Miro.

 - Developer and operator experience. Balance SDK ergonomics, schema-first contracts, codegen, service discovery, security, visibility, and control-plane needs.

 - Cross-functional launch and enablement. Make sure everyone in the company understands the problems Nexus solves and knows how to sell / deploy / support it.

 - Success metrics. Define adoption and momentum measures: activated accounts, completed Nexus operations, shared-service usage, SDK coverage, design-partner progress, and field readiness.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

 - Nexus is past GA and entering breadth. Adoption is real, but the next challenge is expansion across more teams, accounts, and use cases.

 - The foundation is landing now. Developer experience, connector foundations, and operator controls are the near-term unlocks.

 - The next wave is strategically important. Connector Ecosystem, Service Hub, and Agentic Communication Fabric could define how Temporal participates in the modern AI and service-connectivity stack.

 - You’ll shape an important product category. Nexus sits between durable execution, service-to-service communication, platform engineering, and AI systems.

About the Role

As a Financial Systems Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the financial systems and integrations that support critical accounting processes across Oracle Fusion Cloud and OpenAI’s broader finance technology ecosystem. You’ll partner with Corporate Accounting, Accounts Payable, Revenue Accounting, Supply Chain, Engineering, Data, Tax, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and auditable solutions.

This role requires deep Oracle Financials expertise, strong accounting process knowledge, and an engineering mindset. You will work across corporate accounting processes including equity, payroll, accruals, leases, mergers and acquisitions, intercompany, and close; transform Accounts Payable processes; and design solutions for complex supply chain accounting, cost accounting, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and compute and data-center accounting. You’ll help redefine how finance teams work by applying automation, AI, and agentic approaches to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and accelerate accounting and close processes.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Work with Accounts Payable to deliver transformation initiatives across invoice intake, validation, matching, approvals, accounting, payments, supplier experience, exception management, and operational reporting.

 - Design accounting solutions for complex supply chain initiatives across procurement, receiving, inventory, Supply Chain Financial Orchestration, costing, intercompany flows, logistics, and the lifecycle from acquisition through sale.

 - Apply strong cost-accounting knowledge to standard cost, landed cost, purchase price variance, inventory valuation, manufacturing and logistics costs, cost of goods sold, and related financial controls.

 - Translate complex accounting requirements and operational events into system architecture, accounting rules, data models, controls, test scenarios, and integrations with Oracle.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

  • Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it s product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.
  • Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it s going, and what s in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.
  • Efficiency Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per-config baselines, and working directly with system-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number.
  • Attribution and forecasting Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Germany | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the st

OIG is the leading contributor to Okta s new product bookings, and it runs inside some of the largest enterprises in the world — the kind of accounts where a single tenant carries hundreds of thousands of identities across thousands of applications.

OIG currently supports high-compliance public sector workloads and plans to expand our footprint to support the most secure, highly classified environments in government.

The Staff Software Engineer (Federal) Opportunity

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the OIG (Federal) team, your mission is to adapt the OIG product to the needs of the government customers. 

In this role, you will actively design, build, and maintain both robust backend services and intuitive frontend interfaces. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Engineering team

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

About the team

Affirm’s Communications team builds and modernizes the highly available platform that delivers billions of customer messages reliably and on time across the customer journey. As a senior backend engineer, you will shape multi-region, multi-tenant infrastructure, APIs, and vendor integrations that help product teams communicate with customers at scale.

What you’ll do

  • You will own and deliver quarterly technical goals for the Communications area, collaborating with teammates to solve ambiguous, open-ended problems across messaging infrastructure.

  • You will design and evolve reliable backend services for high-volume communications across multi-region, multi-tenant environments, including orchestration, delivery, preferences, templates, and observability.

  • You will collaborate with product management, design, analytics, security, and engineering partners throughout the product lifecycle, articulating technical constraints and balancing customer impact, risks, and trade-offs.

  • You will design, implement, and operate resilient integrations with external messaging vendors, balancing reliability, latency, cost, and compliance.

  • You will proactively identify and solve project, process, technology, or business issues that affect scalability, developer experience, and operational resilience.

  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s services by defining service-level objectives and metrics, improving alerting and incident response, and participating in on-call efforts.

  • You will foster quality and ownership by improving design, testing, code review, rollout, and operational standards, and advocating for them through writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback, mentorship, and technical direction, and leading by example.

  • On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What we look for

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar.

  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, DynamoDB, and Kubernetes.

  • You have experience designing multi-region, multi-tenant platforms with strong isolation, scalability, failure recovery, and data-consistency guarantees.

  • You have experience integrating with third-party communications or messaging vendors and designing abstractions that account for different capabilities, rate limits, and failure modes.

  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

  • You are proficient with AI-assisted development tools and apply sound judgment to validate their outputs.

  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.


Total rewards

We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That s why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.

In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits.

308,000 zł  -  428,000 zł   

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. 

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).  

Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills.

In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Query and Access Control
jobs.description:
We re looking for a staff software engineer to work on how data is queried and who is allowed to see it. Every read in Asana passes through this layer: it resolves what a user is asking for and enforces, on every object, whether that user is permitted to see it. You will help us keep those guarantees correct and fast as our largest customers grow their domains, their permission structures get more intricate, and AI agents become a significant new class of caller.

The Query and Access Control team owns the query execution path over the Work Graph and the permissioning model that governs it. As a staff engineer on the team, you will take on our hardest technical problems and drive the work that spans several teams, bringing depth to the design decisions that shape this layer for years. We work closely with other teams in the core infrastructure area to build and retain customer trust in Asana as the platform for their critical workflows.

This role is based in our Reykjavik office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you ll achieve

  • Design and implement a query layer over the Work Graph that stays correct and performant as customer domains and permission structures grow
  • Evolve our access control model so that permission checks remain sound, auditable, and fast on every read path
  • Define how new classes of caller, including AI agents acting on a user s behalf, are authorized, without weakening the guarantees customers depend on
  • Drive large, multi-quarter projects that cut across team boundaries, from design and implementation through deployment and iteration
  • Build alignment on the design with engineers and leaders in other teams before the code is written, and keep that alignment as the work lands
  • Share what you know through design review, code review, and mentorship
  • Partner with infrastructure teams across Asana to define how user data in the Work Graph is accessed
  • Support framework and product engineers to build new product functionality at scale, quickly

About you

  • 8+ years of engineering experience building and operating reliable backend services at scale, with 3+ years driving large-scale projects
  • You have driven large technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, and perhaps organizations, from early design to adoption
  • You go deep on hard problems and can carry a design from first principles through to production
  • You enjoy sharing what you know with other engineers and helping them build production-quality infrastructure
  • You are skilled at communicating technical concepts and constraints to cross-functional partners in product
  • You bring care and rigor to systems where correctness is not negotiable, and can reason about the blast radius of a change before it ships

Desirable

  • You have experience with authorization systems, permission models, or multi-tenant data isolation at scale
  • You have worked on query engines, query planning, caching layers, or graph-shaped data access
  • You are familiar with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration technologies like Terraform and Kubernetes

At Asana, we re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you re interested in this role and don t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we re committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 1 600 000 - 1 800 000 ISK monthly. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you re interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
  • Career coaching & support
  • Inclusive family building benefits
  • Long-term savings or retirement plans
  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences 

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you re interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
