jobs.location: Boston, MA; Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint.

Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

Responsibilities

  • Own ChromeOS as a platform at Anthropic: device standards, Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise setup, organizational unit design, and policy
  • Manage ChromeOS policy as code through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team s config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet
  • Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from
  • Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and shipping devices internationally, including regions our current partners don’t reach
  • Design device models for vendor teams (kiosk, managed guest sessions, shared devices, and assigned devices) and pick the right one for each program
  • Lock devices down to what the work needs: copy and paste, downloads, printing, USB, and app and extension controls
  • Own the device lifecycle for vendor fleets, from enrollment to wipe, lock, and retrieval when an engagement ends
  • Feed ChromeOS device data into our fleet telemetry, tracking which devices are checking in, OS version, and drift between expected and actual state
  • Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions
  • Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices
  • Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium
  • Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant
  • Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment
  • Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices
  • Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting
  • Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM
  • Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams
  • Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries
  • Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet
  • Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners
  • View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor
  • Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

Strong candidates may also

  • Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles
  • Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets
  • Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams
  • Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions
  • Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
  • Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

Technical Skills

  • Python and shell scripting
  • ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise
  • Google Admin SDK, Chrome Policy API, and GAM for automating policy and reporting
  • Android Enterprise management (working knowledge)
  • Querying live device state at fleet scale
  • GitOps and CI for configuration management
  • Endpoint security fundamentals

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Position overview

SingleStore is seeking a Principal Cloud Network & Reliability Engineer to lead the architecture, reliability, and automation of the network foundations supporting our engineering organization.

This is a senior hands-on technical role spanning cloud networking, site reliability engineering, infrastructure automation, and platform architecture across AWS, GCP, Azure, and internal infrastructure.

The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with strong software and infrastructure engineering skills. They should be comfortable operating across organizational boundaries, driving technical decisions, improving reliability, and identifying adjacent problems that need ownership rather than limiting themselves strictly to a predefined scope.

This role also provides senior technical coverage during U.S. business hours and acts as a key architecture partner to Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, IT, InfoSec, and product engineering teams.

What you’ll do:

  • Define cloud networking architecture and standards across AWS, GCP, Azure, and internal infrastructure.
  • Design and evolve routing, segmentation, firewalls, NAT, ingress/egress, DNS, VPN, private connectivity, and cloud-to-data-center networking.
  • Lead technical direction for private-access technologies such as Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, bastions, and related access patterns.
  • Establish SLOs, monitoring, alerting, recovery procedures, and operational standards for critical network services.
  • Lead diagnosis and mitigation of significant networking, connectivity, and infrastructure incidents, and drive permanent remediation.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Python, Go, or comparable technologies.
  • Build reusable infrastructure patterns and automation that enable safe self-service for platform and engineering teams.
  • Improve infrastructure change safety through automated validation, required review, observability, change logging, and rollback practices.
  • Partner with Cloud Platform, Developer Platform, Systems Engineering, IT, InfoSec, and SRE teams on architecture that crosses networking, infrastructure, identity, security, and reliability domains.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point during U.S. business hours.
  • Create architecture standards, decision records, runbooks, and operational practices that reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
  • Mentor engineers and raise networking, infrastructure, and reliability expertise across the organization.
  • Identify architectural and operational gaps beyond the immediate networking domain and help drive them to resolution.

Your Experience:

  • Deep experience designing and operating complex production cloud networks in at least one major cloud provider, with meaningful experience in a second.
  • Strong knowledge of routing, subnetting, segmentation, firewalls, NAT, DNS, VPN, ingress/egress, and private connectivity.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex production network and infrastructure failures.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, or comparable infrastructure-as-code technologies.
  • Experience building infrastructure automation using Python, Go, or a comparable programming language.
  • Strong SRE experience including observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, recovery engineering, and reliability improvement.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes or adjacent cloud-platform infrastructure.
  • Experience designing safe infrastructure change and deployment practices.
  • Ability to lead architecture decisions across multiple engineering organizations without formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including architecture documents, standards, runbooks, and incident reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, distribute technical knowledge, and influence technical direction at Principal level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • AWS Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, or equivalent cloud-network technologies.
  • GCP Cloud Router, Interconnect, Shared VPC, Private Service Connect, or equivalent technologies.
  • Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Private Link, or equivalent technologies.
  • BGP and hybrid cloud/data-center networking.
  • Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, or comparable private-access technologies.
  • NetBox or other IPAM/DCIM platforms.
  • Kubernetes CNI or advanced Kubernetes networking experience.
  • Grafana, Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, CloudWatch, PagerDuty, Pingdom, or comparable observability tools.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The IAM Control Plane team’s mission is to empower Stripe users to easily and securely manage their access to Stripe products and data. As part of Stripe s Organizations and Auth Platform, we own the platform for API keys, user roles, and access auditing, ensuring the right people have the keys to the kingdom - and no one else. We are a team of around 10 engineers with an ambitious roadmap, blending deep platform work with direct product impact.

What you’ll do

You will design, build, and maintain the critical systems that control our user’s access to Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the next generation of IAM primitives to securely power AI-driven agentic experiences on Stripe
  • Develop new user-facing permission models, including custom roles and granular access controls
  • Architect and implement platform features like Account Groups to simplify access management for large organizations
  • Own and operate mission-critical, highly-available backend services that are fundamental to every Stripe user s experience
  • Work across the stack to ship end-to-end features, from API design and database modeling to frontend components
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes as well as mentor team members

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • This is a Staff-level role, so we re targeting 10+ years in software development
  • A high bar for engineering quality and a passion for building resilient, scalable distributed systems
  • Experience designing, building, and operating backend services in a professional environment
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems with a product-minded approach
  • Proficiency in a modern backend language such as Go, Ruby, Java, or similar
  • Mentor engineers at all levels, supporting their professional growth and technical leadership development
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and design teams to define product strategy and user experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM), authentication, or authorization systems
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies like React and TypeScript
  • Experience working on developer platforms or infrastructure

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Blockchain Data Platform team within the Platform organization builds an ultra-low-latency indexing platform that ingests, normalizes, and serves data across major blockchains, powering teams across Coinbase and external developers via the Coinbase Developer Platform. We re a small, high-impact, AI-native team taking a platform-first approach, shipping the primitives, SDKs, and tooling that make blockchain indexing as easy as building on a managed database. You ll build and operate the distributed systems at the core of this platform, owning services end-to-end from design through production.

What you ll do:

  • Build and operate distributed systems for real-time blockchain data ingestion, indexing, and query, owning services end-to-end from design docs and data modeling through code, rollout, and observability.
  • Own delivery of key initiatives such as new chain integrations, migrations, and backfills, driving improvements to latency, reliability, and cost.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to define data contracts and contribute to SDKs and primitives that drive adoption across Coinbase and external developers.
  • Execute architecture and performance improvements across the indexing stack, applying strong systems design fundamentals around partitioning, consistency, stream processing, and storage boundaries.
  • Support engineering quality across the team through code reviews, testing rigor, and leveraging AI tools to ship faster and reduce operational burden.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience building and operating distributed or data systems in production.
  • Solid systems design fundamentals including partitioning, consistency/availability tradeoffs, stream processing, and storage/compute boundaries.
  • Proficiency in a backend language such as Go and/or Python, with familiarity across technologies like Kafka, gRPC, Redis, S3, ClickHouse, or MongoDB.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear designs and shipped solutions with measurable impact.
  • Blockchain or crypto data experience is a plus, including familiarity with chain data structures, finality, reorgs, RPC nodes, or wallets.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

Checkr helps state governments verify income and employment in seconds instead of weeks so benefits like SNAP, Medicaid, and TANF reach the people who need them faster. This role builds the automations and systems connecting our marketing, sales, and customer success motion, and then you ll actually run the campaigns that use them: the emails that go out, the lead flows that convert, the nurture sequences that keep the pipeline moving. You re as comfortable writing a webhook as you are hitting send on a campaign.

 

What you’ll do

  • Architect and maintain our martech stack, CRM, email, and support integrations via APIs and webhooks
  • Implement AI workflows with strong human-in-the-loop oversight
  • Build attribution models and funnel dashboards to measure revenue impact
  • Manage email and social media execution, including email list health, compliance, and deliverability
  • Execute nurture and lead-generation campaigns alongside our marketing team
  • Partner on paid media and SEO/AEO initiatives

 

What you bring

  • 3+ years in a GTM function (marketing, sales, RevOps, CS) with a background in B2B, B2G, or SaaS.
  • Proven track record of building reliable systems, automations, and data pipelines.
  • Proficiency with CRMs and martech tools (e.g., Clay, HubSpot, Salesforce, Metabase, Gong).
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, low-code/no-code tools, and technical SEO/AEO.
  • Strong analytical mindset focused on system design, growth metrics (CAC, LTV), and execution.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Foundations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

 

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb s various functions embody the company s innovative spirit and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The Client and Identity Engineering team is accountable for establishing the user identity and endpoint security infrastructure in Airbnb s corporate environment. Client and Identity Engineering encompass corporate zero trust deployments. Our systems enable all Airbnb employees and partners to have secure access to the data they need at the right time and in the right context. We provide Airbnb employees and partners with the best-in-class experience, enabling them to effectively build our platform.

 

The Difference You Will Make

 

The team works on systems which have higher reliability and security requirements than most backend systems or services. Our products are critical services, downtime across these services can result in downtime for Airbnb employees and partners. In addition, the team collaborates closely with our security engineering teams to design new features and evolve the platforms to meet the engineering challenges as business needs present themselves.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and maintain robust, scalable, and secure systems that underpin the entire Airbnb Zero Trust ecosystem. You will play a pivotal role in the execution for these critical platforms. This is an opportunity to be a part of impactful work, and contribute to the safety and trust of the Airbnb community.

 

A Typical Day

 

  • Work with open source products to build the next generation client platform for all Airbnb corporate endpoints. 
  • Build on our zero trust back end suite, supporting security services, network paths, and user and device signaling, with a mind for enabling value for the business for their best work. 
  • Support executive level Airbnb staff with endpoint and identity solutions.
  • Work with product and engineering teams to optimize endpoints and identity flows for Airbnb employees and partners.

 

Your Expertise

 

  • Bachelor s and/or Master/PhD s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in test driven software development.
  • Extensive experience with Go, Python, or Java (Go strongly preferred).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure as code deployments.
  • Experience developing and deploying services in a Kubernetes environment.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work well within engineering organization and cross functions
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Experience leading technical projects and mentoring junior engineers.
  • Show motivation for personal growth and learning new technologies to support the team s needs.

 

Bonus Points

 

  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Familiarity with Apple MDM spec and its implementation in modern MDM deployments. 
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization principles and technologies, such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID, SAML, ABAC, and related Zero Trust security protocols.

 

Your Location

 

This position is based in California - ideally San Francisco. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

As a Senior Value Engineer specializing in Banking, you are at the forefront of solving business-critical problems for some of the world s largest financial institutions. You will work intimately with strategic enterprise clients to understand their complex objectives—ranging from accelerating Loan Origination and Client Onboarding to optimizing Capital Markets Operations and Regulatory Reporting.

You will build Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with top AI and ML technology partners. By feeding operational context to AI, you help banks understand the intricate realities of their massive transactional ecosystems. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Banking Executives (COOs, CROs, and Heads of Digital Transformation), and ensure successful implementation and value realization to solidify and expand the Celonis footprint across the global financial landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand the clients overarching AI strategies and the distinct challenges inherent to Banking (e.g., fraud detection, credit risk assessment, and automating KYC/AML). Translate complex financial workflows into innovative AI solutions that drive measurable ROI.
  • Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Actively drive the customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during the expansion cycle. Remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation, ensuring efficiency and adoption thresholds are met.
  • Hackathons & Prototyping: Think creatively to tackle heavily siloed legacy core-banking systems. Leverage cutting-edge AI to rapidly build prototypes in client hackathons, solving pain points across Settlements, Reconciliations, and Payments.
  • Agentic Process Transformation: Support enterprise clients in shifting from rule-based automation to autonomous AI agents. Enable "intelligent" banking processes, such as autonomous exception handling in Trade Ops or automated Complaints Management.
  • Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. Architect secure, scalable LLM/agent systems (with RAG and guardrails) that integrate with complex enterprise stacks like SAP Banking, Salesforce FINS, or core-banking ledgers.
  • Domain Practitioner Leadership: Serve as a functional subject matter expert for the Banking value chain, scaling knowledge across the organization regarding the nuances of financial operations and transaction lifecycles.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales and post-sales engagements specifically within complex Banking or Financial Services environments. This includes building ROI business cases and guiding technical implementations.
  • Strong Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the banking value chain, with the ability to translate operational needs into AI use cases across:
    • Lending & Onboarding: Loan Origination, KYC/AML, and Banking & Lending.
    • Capital Markets: Sales & Trading Ops, Settlements, Reconciliations, and Custody Services.
    • Support & Governance: Finance, Risk & Controls, and Regulatory/Transaction Reporting.
  • Expertise in Generative AI Techniques: Knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, and multi-agent orchestration used to build high-impact use cases (e.g., intelligent compliance assistants or automated data extraction from complex trade documentation).
  • Technical Fluency: Solid knowledge of Python and common ML/Data libraries (e.g., pandas, LangChain) as well as SQL for handling massive, high-velocity transactional datasets.
  • Communication: Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders, from technical whiteboarding with IT to formal demos for Banking Directors.
  • Degree: Bachelor’s Degree required; Master s Degree in Finance, Computer Science, Economics, or Mathematics preferred.

Nice to Have:

  • Agentic Systems: Hands-on experience building systems using LLM orchestration and function calling within highly regulated "Data Sovereignty" environments.
  • Banking Systems: Familiarity with FSI-specific platforms (e.g., nCino, Guidewire, FIS, Fiserv, or Bloomberg).
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience deploying models across major cloud providers (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex).

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT HEX

Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.

Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hex's infrastructure team owns all of our cloud infrastructure (compute, networking, datastores) along with CI/CD and observability, across a multi-tenant platform and single-tenant environments. Every engineer at Hex depends on what the infrastructure team builds.

We're growing in customers, in users, and in the kinds of data workflows our workload compute backend has to support. That growth has opened up a set of projects that would meaningfully change how fast the rest of engineering ships, and we're hiring to take them on.

We're looking for someone who will pick up one of those projects, own it start to finish, and leave it better than they found it. Bring your opinions, including the ones that disagree with ours. Infrastructure tooling is changing quickly right now, and we want someone who's paying attention to that as we improve the foundational components that power Hex.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your first few months, we'll pick two or three of these together based on where you're strongest and where we're looking to invest:

 - CI/CD. Hex’s CI/CD pipelines need a glow-up: optimizing for speed, cost, and providing more flexibility.

 - Stack lifecycle. Setup, teardown, partial teardown, and updates for single-tenant stacks, today too much of this is manual and runs through our team.

 - Postgres at scale. Performance, migrations, and capacity for our multi-tenant production database.

 - Cost. Infrastructure spend visibility and reduction.

 - Security posture. Workload and container isolation, plus compliance work as we move upmarket.

 - Platform features. Customer-facing infrastructure capabilities: private connectivity, customer defined networking, and making single-tenant deployments easier to operate.


ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years building and operating production infrastructure, including on-call

 - You make the people around you better, whether or not you've had the title

 - Strong Kubernetes operations: you can reason about scheduling, networking, and failure modes, not just apply manifests

 - Solid AWS fundamentals (EKS, RDS, VPC networking, IAM)

 - Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform

 - Comfortable writing and reading enough application code to change a pipeline, a controller, or a service

 - You can take a vague, long-standing problem and turn it into something shippable without waiting to be told how

 - You write clearly, design docs and runbooks that engineers outside infra can follow

Plus depth in at least one of

 - Networking — VPC design, private connectivity (PrivateLink, peering), DNS, TLS and certificate management, agentic sandboxing

 - Databases — Postgres at scale: replication, tuning, connection pooling, major version upgrades, migrations under load

 - Deployment systems — CI/CD platform ownership, build performance and cost, release and artifact management




OUR STACK

 - Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache)

 - Databases: PostgreSQL (RDS), Redis, LanceDB, DynamoDB, MSK

 - Languages: TypeScript (Node.js), Python, Rust, Go

 - Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform

 - Monitoring: Datadog

The salary range for this role is: $214,000 - $285,000



In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.



By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend Platform
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Backend Platform Engineer at Harvey, you will help build and operate the cohesive backend platform that all our services run on. You’ll design and implement shared frameworks and libraries that abstract common concerns, improve developer experience, and raise the baseline for reliability and performance across all teams. 



Your mission aligns with our platform charter: create “a shared foundation that enables product teams to ship reliable, observable, and performant experiences quickly and safely.” By centralizing common work, you’ll let product engineers focus on shipping features rather than re-inventing the wheel. This is a high-impact role where the code you write and the systems you build will amplify the productivity and quality of engineering across the entire company.



If you’re excited about building foundational systems, solving cross-cutting technical challenges, and enabling others to move faster with confidence, we’d love to hear from you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop and maintain Harvey’s internal backend frameworks and libraries that provide common capabilities (API routing, service lifecycle management, caching and messaging primitives, error handling interfaces, etc.), so product teams don’t have to reinvent them

 - Create and improve APIs, service templates, and versioned interfaces that establish consistent patterns for building new services and features

 - Introduce and champion modern backend architecture patterns like asynchronous I/O (asyncio) and streaming data processing, continually evolving our platform for better performance and scalability

 - Design Harvey-specific abstractions and domain-specific frameworks—covering cross-cutting concerns (e.g., authorization, streaming) and areas like data governance and event processing—to provide product engineers with these capabilities out of the box

 - Embed reliability and observability into the platform by building in tracing, metrics, and automated tests (shift-left), ensuring services built on our foundation are robust and easy to monitor

 - Collaborate with Model Infrastructure team to tackle challenges unique to GenAI-native applications — such as supporting high-throughput model inference, managing streaming and long-running API interactions, and designing abstractions for retrieval, context handling, and prompt lifecycle

 - Collaborate with the Developer Experience and Infrastructure teams (who own CI/CD pipelines, build tools, and release infrastructure) to integrate our platform components seamlessly into the deployment and monitoring ecosystem

 - Work closely with product engineering teams to gather feedback, evangelize best practices, and make the “paved road” approach a reality — providing strong defaults and clear documentation so teams can move fast with confidence




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience (post-BS/MS), including building scalable backend systems or internal developer platforms

 - Proficiency in Python (or similar languages) and deep knowledge of backend development fundamentals (APIs, data stores, concurrency, distributed systems)

 - Hands-on experience with web frameworks and service architectures (e.g. Flask/FastAPI, Bounded context services, microservices) and an understanding of designing clean, versioned APIs

 - Familiarity with caching, messaging, and database technologies (Redis, Kafka, SQL/NoSQL databases, Vector databases, etc.) and how to use them effectively for high performance and reliability

 - A track record of writing high-quality, well-tested code and using tools (unit/integration testing, static typing, CI) to catch issues early and ensure reliability

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for improving developer experience — you enjoy creating tools or frameworks that make other engineers more productive

 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams and incorporate feedback.

 - Experience contributing to or maintaining internal libraries/frameworks is a plus.




COMPENSATION RANGE

$231,000 - $340,000 USD

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About The Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking an enthusiastic Staff Software Engineer to join our fast-growing data company. As a part of the databases team, you will help drive performance improvements, improve reliability/architecture and build new features for our NoSQL data pipeline services.

This is a full-time position based out of Fivetran s Toronto office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Java
  • NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch, Firebase)
  • Relational Databases (Db2 z/OS, CockroachDB)
  • GCP, Azure, AWS
  • Bazel, Github
  • Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex

What You’ll Do

  • Write and deliver code reliably, along with automated tests (unit and integration).
  • Optimize critical parts of the code.
  • Lead team projects. Identify risks and break down projects into tasks for one or more engineers with effort estimates.
  • Drive innovation by experimenting with new technologies and problem solving approaches.
  • Independently create technical designs for major features while actively seeking feedback.
  • Write common components to be used within the team or department.
  • Mentor engineers on improving all aspects of their code, according to established coding practices.
  • Resolve customer issues in collaboration with customer support.
  • Work across the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, prototype, implementation, review, release, and monitoring.
  • Use AI coding agents to automatically generate code for use cases such as incident resolution, feature development, testing, and investigations.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Expert in Java development
  • Experience developing reliable software with high-volume data management under strict SLAs
  • Experience working with popular cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Expert in database internal architecture (e.g. you can explain how a database internally responds to particular events and requests)
  • Knowledge of popular NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB)
  • Knowledge of and appreciation for clean code practices
  • Leverages and keeps up with the frontier of agentic AI development

Optional Bonus Skills

  • Experience working with MongoDB and/or Amazon DynamoDB change data capture
  • Experience developing data integration tools (ETL or ELT)
  • Experience identifying and optimizing performance bottlenecks in distributed systems

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Analytics | Canada | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in the US or Canada. 

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Senior Software (Database) Engineer to help build the underlying storage system for our general purpose data platform. The database layer has both OLAP and OTLP capabilities to support classic analytics queries while also serving up freshly stored data. It embraces the separation of compute and storage and is designed to run on multiple cloud providers. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You ll Be Doing: 

  • Take ownership over and build one or multiple parts of the database: Design, implement, test, and operate ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, data formats, storage formats.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant database service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and database interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve data quickly.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument database services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the database solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows. 

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the US and Canada.

What is Grafana Cloud? 

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics, Grafana Enterprise Logs, and Grafana Enterprise Traces. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. 

Mimir Squad

The Mimir squad has two sub-squads, Ingest and Query, which together maintain the Mimir OSS project, and additionally own and operate Grafana Cloud Metrics across three major cloud providers. A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They likely are engaged in a larger project with another engineer, as well as mixing in some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm s engineering team is building a large-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

Affirm runs its workloads on more than 85 Amazon EKS clusters, and the number is growing. The Workload Safety team creates one set of standards for how workloads are configured and run, so Affirm can grow globally and still meet its availability and latency SLOs. The team identifies the industry best practices Affirm needs, drives their adoption across every engineering team on EKS, and enforces them through policy and automation so new workloads comply by default.

As a senior engineer on the team, you will help set its roadmap, decide which standards matter most, and build a repeatable way to take each standard from research to enforcement across the fleet.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve workload safety standards for Affirm s EKS fleet, such as CPU and memory settings, workload isolation and placement, tolerance for disruption, graceful termination to name a few

  • Own each standard end to end: research and prototyping, white-glove onboarding for early adopters, self-service guidance for everyone else, and automation and policy guardrails that keep every workload compliant from day one

  • Lead cross-team initiatives from design through fleet-wide rollout, mentor other engineers, and set a high bar for design, code review, and operational readiness

  • Isolate workloads by criticality and resource profile so one misbehaving workload cannot degrade critical paths such as checkout

  • Fix stuck workloads and node lifecycle problems, such as pods that ignore termination signals, pod disruption budgets that block node cycling, and Karpenter timeouts that prevent bin packing and the removal of excess capacity

  • Determine the safe operating limits of each cluster (pod count, node count, API server request volume), keep clusters within them, and develop control plane scaling patterns for bursty workloads such as scheduled batch jobs and large deployments

  • Analyze workload resource profiles across the fleet (CPU, memory, disk, network) to guide EC2 instance type strategy, and automate that analysis as workloads change

  • Measure each standard s impact on availability, latency, risk, and cost, and use the results to prioritize the roadmap

  • Participate in on-call for Kubernetes runtime issues across the fleet, and turn recurring failure patterns into roadmap items

  • Work closely with the teams that run services, batch jobs, and ML workloads on EKS, and with the deployment, capacity, and SRE teams

  • Keep up with new best practices from the Kubernetes community and adapt them to Affirm s needs

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS across many clusters

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints

  • Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining

  • Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy-as-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno)

  • Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks

  • Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers

  • Experience quantifying the impact of infrastructure changes on availability, latency, and cost

  • Strong written communication, including standards and guidance that teams can adopt on their own

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Finance Engineering
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every dollar Anthropic earns and every dollar it spends on compute has to reach the books correctly, and the volume grows with Claude usage. That data comes from across the company and from partners: usage and billing, compute, infrastructure assets, leases. Products and pricing models keep launching, and each one adds another path into the books. Our goal is a continuous close with zero material issues, with audit-grade controls.

You’ll build the platform that gets us there: one front door for every finance event, an append-only ledger, and an accounting engine that posts each event exactly once. This is a distributed systems problem with an unusually high correctness bar. The system has to be right to the cent, replay cleanly and explain any number as of any date, at that volume. You will shape its architecture. Its users include Claude agents, which read and write through the same APIs and controls as people.

You’ll work closely with SWEs in Billing, Compute and Infra on shared contracts and APIs, and with product owners, finance operations and internal audit to turn accounting and controls requirements into designs. You don’t need a finance background. If you have built backend systems where correctness matters, we will teach you the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the front door into finance and its governed contracts: APIs for apps and agents, an event bus for systems that publish, adapters for vendor apps and reports, data-quality gates, and processing that posts every event exactly once, with replay and backfill
  • Drive the build of the accounting ledger and engine: an append-only ledger with idempotent posting, a rules framework that turns business events into journal entries, translation into the ERP, and period locks
  • Design and build the SDKs and frameworks that finance apps and agents build on
  • Build controls into the platform as code: immutable audit trail, maker-checker, scoped access and segregation of duties
  • Build and run the production services that other engineering teams call in real time, such as the tax and collections services in the billing flow, and own their reliability: uptime, latency, throughput and correctness targets agreed with those teams
  • Shape the platform’s technical direction: architecture, engineering standards and design reviews

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong backend engineering in a statically typed language such as Go, Java or Rust, or Python at scale
  • Experience designing and running high-volume, event-driven systems (publish/subscribe, streaming) with idempotent processing, replay and backfill
  • Experience designing relational data models and writing SQL for complex, versioned data
  • Experience designing APIs, SDKs and service-to-service integrations used by other teams
  • Experience building systems with auditability, access control or compliance requirements
  • Experience turning requirements from non-engineering partners into technical designs
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including design docs

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience
  • Experience building developer platforms or paved paths
  • Experience with streaming systems such as Pub/Sub or Kafka
  • Experience building with LLMs and agents, including MCP
  • Built a ledger, sub-ledger, billing or payments system
  • Familiarity with accounting concepts: double-entry, journal entries
  • Familiarity with internal controls and audit concepts: audit trails, segregation of duties, change management
  • Exposure to ERP or financial systems, such as Workday Financials

jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.




ABOUT THE MARKETPLACE TEAM:

Snowflake  https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/features/marketplace/snowflake-marketplace-for-providers/Marketplace serves as the vibrant hub which enables customers to do more with data. We are building a platform that empowers organizations to seamlessly discover, access, and build with datasets, applications, and AI agents. The monetization team owns the commerce layer of the Snowflake Marketplace — building the end-to-end transactional infrastructure and buyer/seller experiences that power how data and AI products are priced, purchased, and settled across Snowflake's global ecosystem.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER YOU WILL:

 - Build and own end-to-end full-stack features — from polished React-based checkout and billing UIs to the backend services that process, validate, and settle marketplace transactions at scale

 - Design and implement robust backend APIs and services in Java or Python that handle the lifecycle of commercial transactions: entitlements, metering, invoicing, and payment orchestration

 - Develop reusable, accessible React component libraries and frontend systems that give buyers and sellers clear visibility into usage, spend, and revenue — working closely with design to deliver intuitive experiences

 - Contribute to the reliability, correctness, and observability of high-stakes transactional pipelines — including fraud prevention, idempotency guarantees, and audit logging

 - Collaborate with product, operations, and Billing teams to model and evolve the data schemas and APIs that underpin Snowflake’s Marketplace.

 - Participate actively in code reviews, architecture discussions, and sprint planning; raise the bar for engineering quality across the Monetization team

 - Identify gaps in test coverage, monitoring, and operational tooling for transactional workflows and drive improvements proactively



OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of shipping customer-facing features on production systems

 - Backend engineering skills in Java, Python, or Go — including REST/gRPC API design, relational database modeling, and experience with distributed systems or microservices

 -  Some React proficiency — experience building complex, stateful UIs with component composition, hooks, state management (Redux, Zustand, or equivalent), and attention to performance and accessibility

 - Hands-on experience building or maintaining transactional systems — payment processing, billing pipelines, order management, entitlements, or equivalent commerce/fintech domain

 - Comfort owning full-stack features independently: writing specs, implementing across layers, writing tests, and driving to production

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills — ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and cross-functional partners in a fast-paced environment

 - BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience



BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Experience shipping 0 -> 1 products

 - Familiarity with AI Coding Tools such as Claude, Cursor or similar tool

 - Familiarity with Snowflake's platform — data sharing, Snowpark, or the Data Cloud ecosystem.

 - Experience with TypeScript, GraphQL, or modern frontend testing frameworks (Cypress, Playwright, Vitest)

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Scale (Frontend)
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll build frontend experiences and platform capabilities that help companies embed Airwallex financial products at speed and with confidence. You’ll work with ReactJS and TypeScript to support multi-tenant systems, cross-domain product features, and enterprise integrations serving global customers such as Rippling, Navan, Qantas, and SHEIN. You’ll translate complex business, regulatory, and technical requirements into scalable, maintainable user experiences, balancing tenant isolation, performance, resilience, and delivery speed.

 - Build frontend capabilities for multi-tenant platforms, balancing tenant isolation with resource efficiency and long-term extensibility.

 - Own cross-domain product features that bring together business, regulatory, and technical requirements.

 - Design enterprise integrations by translating customer business needs into scalable technical solutions.

 - Partner with Product, Design, Compliance, and Sales to turn complex requirements into clear, reliable experiences.

 - Make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and delivery speed based on business impact.

You’ll work from the Singapore office five days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience with ReactJS and TypeScript.

 - Strong judgment in choosing the right level of abstraction, balancing flexibility and simplicity in system and component design.

 - Clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Pragmatic decision-making on when to optimise for performance versus velocity based on business impact.

 - Experience thriving in cross-functional environments spanning Product, Design, Compliance, and Sales.

 - A track record of designing for scale, maintainability, and production excellence.


PREFERRED

 - Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry.

 - Experience tuning performance at high scale, including 100k+ QPS, large user bases, or strict latency SLAs.

 - A background in multi-tenant SaaS or platform architecture.

 - Proficiency with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, or cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Experience with OAuth 2.0, API design, or developer documentation.

 - Experience with cross-region deployment or data residency compliance.

 - Solutions engineering or customer-facing technical experience.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You've worked in a high-growth or scaling environment and know what it takes to build systems that need to grow with the business.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

 - You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Scale team builds the infrastructure that lets platforms embed Airwallex financial products at speed and with confidence. The team owns multi-tenant systems powering companies like Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, and SHEIN. The engineering challenges are real: balancing tenant isolation with resource efficiency, low-latency performance with cross-data-center resilience, and immediate customer needs with long-term architectural extensibility. Beyond infrastructure, the team owns cross-domain product features and designs enterprise integrations by translating customer business requirements into scalable technical solutions.



#singapore


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Full Stack — Codex
jobs.description:
About the Role
We’re hiring a Principal Software Engineer to help define and build the next generation of AI-powered software development workflows.


“Full stack” in this role extends well beyond traditional frontend and backend development. You will set technical direction and lead major product initiatives spanning user interfaces, developer tooling, workflow orchestration, agent and prompt design, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure.


This is a highly product-oriented technical leadership role. You will identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the software development lifecycle, turn ambiguous user and technical problems into durable product and system strategies, and lead execution across multiple engineers and partner teams. Your work will shape both the architecture of Codex and how developers around the world design, write, review, test, and maintain software.
You will operate as a senior individual contributor: remaining deeply involved in design and implementation while raising the technical judgment, execution quality, and ambition of the broader team.


In this role, you will

 - Set the technical and product direction for significant areas of Codex, translating an evolving product vision into scalable architectures and an actionable engineering strategy.

 - Lead complex, multi-quarter initiatives spanning client applications, backend services, agent systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer tooling.

 - Design AI-powered workflows that generalize across languages, codebases, development environments, and organizations while remaining intuitive, reliable, and safe.

 - Make high-consequence architectural decisions under ambiguity, balancing rapid product learning with long-term system quality and adaptability.

 - Identify opportunities that cut across existing team or product boundaries, align stakeholders around a direction, and drive the work from exploration through launch and iteration.

 - Partner closely with product, design, research, infrastructure, security, and go-to-market teams to turn emerging model capabilities and developer needs into coherent product experiences.

 - Work directly with developers, open-source maintainers, startups, and large enterprises to uncover unmet needs and distinguish foundational opportunities from incremental improvements.

 - Establish patterns and standards for reliability, observability, performance, experimentation, and evaluation across AI-powered developer workflows.

 - Serve as a technical multiplier by reviewing critical designs, mentoring engineers, improving engineering practices, and helping the team navigate its hardest product and technical decisions.

 - Contribute directly to implementation, particularly where the problem is novel, technically demanding, or requires connecting multiple layers of the product.

You might thrive in this role if you

 - Have led the design and delivery of technically complex, user-facing systems with impact extending beyond a single feature or team.

 - Combine deep software-engineering expertise with exceptional product judgment and can move fluently across product interfaces, distributed systems, infrastructure, and developer tooling.

 - Have a track record of creating clarity in ambiguous problem spaces, setting a compelling technical direction, and bringing multiple teams or disciplines along with you.

 - Remain hands-on while increasing the effectiveness of other engineers through architecture, mentorship, decision-making, and technical leadership.

 - Understand modern software-development workflows deeply and can recognize where AI agents require fundamentally new interaction and system designs.

 - Have experience building or operating AI-powered products and understand the challenges created by nondeterminism, evaluation, latency, reliability, safety, and rapidly evolving model capabilities.

 - Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, product learning, technical quality, and long-term leverage.

 - Develop strong perspectives from user evidence while remaining willing to revise those perspectives as technology and user behavior evolve.

 - Communicate clearly across engineering, product, design, research, and executive audiences, especially when decisions involve substantial uncertainty or organizational complexity.

 - Are energized by defining a problem as much as solving it—and by creating the technical and organizational conditions for others to deliver excellent work.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.
