jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Application Core Services | Canada | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

  • Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
  • Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
  • Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
  • Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
  • Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
  • Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
  • Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
  • Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
  • Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
  • Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
  • Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
  • Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.

What Makes You a

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world s best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

What you’ll do

The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.

As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.
  • Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.
  • Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.
  • Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.
  • Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.
  • Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.
  • Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.

Requirements

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.
  • You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.
  • You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.
  • You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.
  • You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.
  • You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.
  • You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.

Bonus points

  • You have worked on identity and access management, authentication, authorization, or audit systems in a production environment.
  • You have hands-on experience with Okta, Oso, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, or WebAuthn.
  • You have experience building enterprise-facing admin controls, authorization platforms, delegated access flows, or audit trails.
  • You have worked on platform teams that provide shared infrastructure, paved roads, or secure-by-default frameworks for other engineering teams.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm s engineering team is building a large-scale, fault-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems.

The AI Platform team owns Affirm s paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents.


What You ll Do

  • Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on-call.
  • Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions.
  • Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re-solving the same platform problems.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on-behalf-of identity model for tool access.
  • Create and monitor metrics for your team s systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on-call.
  • Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks.
  • Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI-native team can deliver. 
  • Educate, mentor, and grow engineers in the team, and drive best practices around design, coding, and testing.


What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have practical experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI frameworks in production: inference APIs, LLM gateways (LiteLLM or similar), MCP, tool calling, evals, or agent runtimes.
  • You understand AI usage and the infrastructure needed to support and leverage AI workloads across different disciplines.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - N
Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 - 255,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000-233,000

ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. _______________________________________________________________________



Docker Hardened Images (DHI) is Docker's catalogue of security-hardened, enterprise-grade container images and Helm charts, built to be minimal, up-to-date, and safe to deploy in regulated and security-conscious environments.  - Drive the hardest, most ambiguous packaging problems where the right answer requires reasoning across upstream dynamics, security tradeoffs, multi-arch constraints, and customer impact simultaneously.

 - Shape the integration test infrastructure and developer tooling strategy so that DHI's engineering platform scales with the catalogue and raises quality across the team.

 - Mentor and raise the technical ceiling for staff and senior engineers across the org, through review, design, and well-chosen architectural decisions that create durable leverage.

 - Take part in the paid on-call rotation; respond to incidents, debug production issues, and drive systemic improvements in reliability.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Comfort working across remote, distributed teams and communicating complex technical strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



About the Role:



Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform.

 - Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production.

 - Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

 - Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts.

 - Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs.

 - Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.

 - Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

 - Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API & AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

 - Run API & AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures.

 - Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close.

 - Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

 - Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API & AI summit, and regional events

 - Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team.

 - And any additional tasks required by manager.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

 - Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

 - Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

 - Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required.

 - Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

 - Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

 - Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives.

 - Enthusiasm for working in a high-profile, fast-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity.



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Cloud Applications
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Cloud Applications team. This team builds and operates critical parts of the Temporal Cloud customer experience, including Namespaces https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/namespaces, Audit Logs https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/audit-logs, and Export https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/export.

Namespaces are the core unit of isolation within Temporal Cloud, providing security boundaries, workflow management, unique identifiers, and dedicated gRPC endpoints. Audit Logs and Export give customers reliable access to the operational and compliance data they depend on.

We're looking for an engineer who is excited to learn these systems and contribute to their scalability, reliability, and developer experience. This is a hands-on role where you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers and partner teams to design, build, and operate backend services and data pipelines while growing your distributed-systems expertise.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for Temporal Cloud with support from teammates.

 - Build and improve services that support namespace provisioning, configuration, scalability, and reliability.

 - Develop data pipelines that process high-volume usage and operational data across multiple tenants.

 - Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing data freshness, query cost, tenant isolation, reliability, and operational complexity.

 - Improve service operability through tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, incident response, and production debugging.

 - Collaborate across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scoped projects safely.

 - Improve developer and customer experience through automation, better tooling, and incremental product improvements.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience building and operating production backend systems in a cloud environment.

 - Proficiency in Go or another applicable backend or systems language, with the ability to ramp up in an existing codebase.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, concurrency basics, testing, and debugging.

 - Working knowledge of distributed-systems concepts such as reliability, fault tolerance, consistency, scaling, and failure handling.

 - Experience with databases, data pipelines, messaging systems, or object storage.

 - The ability to take a scoped problem, break it into smaller tasks, implement a solution end to end, and incorporate feedback.

 - An operational mindset, including familiarity with logging, metrics, tracing, deployment, and production troubleshooting.

 - Comfort collaborating across teams and communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs clearly.

 - A commitment to correctness, maintainability, and leaving systems better than you found them.


NICE TO HAVE

 - 3+ years of work experience

 - Experience with Go.

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Redshift, Kinesis, Firehose

 - Experience with S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, or other object-storage systems.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

 - Experience supporting on-call rotations, investigating incidents, or improving production observability.

 - Familiarity with Temporal concepts—or a strong interest in learning the platform.


TECHNOLOGY STACK

 - Primary language: Go

 - Data storage: PostgreSQL, Redshift, S3,Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, ClickHouse

 - Data processing: Kinesis, Firehose

 - Infrastructure: Kubernetes

 - Core framework: Temporal

You do not need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a high-impact Staff or Principal Software Engineer to drive the architecture, reliability, and scaling of our managed cloud offering, SingleStore Helios. In this role, you will lead the evolution of our multi-cloud SaaS control and data planes, manage high-density Kubernetes deployments across major hyperscalers, and partner directly with our AI Platform initiatives.

As a senior technical leader, you will balance greenfield architecture with hands-on systems programming and operational resilience. You will also allocate approximately 10–20% of your bandwidth toward high-priority Tier-3 operational escalations, identifying root causes in production distributed systems to inform durable platform architecture.

Note: Final leveling (Staff vs. Principal) will be calibrated during the interview loop based on demonstrated depth of organizational influence, architectural scope, and system design experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect Distributed SaaS Infrastructure: Design, implement, and scale multi-tenant Kubernetes operators, custom controllers, and orchestration workflows managing thousands of customer database clusters globally.
  • Write Resilient Systems Code: Develop performant, fault-tolerant backend services and control planes using modern Go language & Python.
  • Lead Cloud Networking Design: Own cross-cloud networking topology, ingress/egress controls, multi-region routing, VPC peering/PrivateLink topologies, DNS architectures, and service mesh performance (Envoy, Cilium, or Istio) across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Support AI Platform Capabilities: Collaborate across business units to build scalable compute, vector indexing pipelines, and ingestion infrastructure supporting real-time GenAI and vector workloads on Helios.
  • Production Operations & Tier-3 Escalations: Dedicate 10–20% of your bandwidth to diagnosing complex production issues, acting as the final escalation point for deep infrastructure failures, performance bottlenecks, and kernel/networking anomalies.
  • Security & Compliance by Design: Build infrastructure that upholds our strict enterprise compliance posture, maintaining automated controls for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS environments.
  • Technical Force Multiplier: Author clear RFCs/architectural design records (ADRs), mentor senior engineers, lead cross-functional reviews, and partner with Product and SRE teams to align roadmap priorities.

  • Deep Kubernetes Expertise: Hands-on mastery of Kubernetes internals, CRDs, custom controller development (client-go/controller-runtime), scheduling dynamics, and container networking/runtime internals.
  • Strong OO / Systems Proficiency: Expert proficiency in Go and Python with an emphasis on concurrent programming, low-latency I/O, and distributed state management.

  • Active open-source contributions within the CNCF or cloud-native container ecosystem.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Staff Software Engineer, Security Engineering

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer that will join the Auth0 Security Engineering organization. In this role, you will join a team of Software Engineers dedicated to building and managing services that secure the platform that Auth0 runs on. You will be instrumental in expanding our platform security controls and architecting custom workflows in a scalable, reliable manner. 

What You Will Do

  • Service Development: Build, maintain, and operate platform security services and controls using Python, Node.js, or Golang.
  • Security Data Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize custom workflows to ingest, process, and distribute security data to downstream systems at scale.
  • Scalable System Architecture: Architect maintainable, secure, and resilient microservices and platform integrations that protect our infrastructure without adding friction for engineering teams.
  • Engineering Quality: Write clean, testable, and well-documented code while driving technical designs and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
  • Mentorship & Influence: You raise the bar for the entire organization by mentoring junior engineers and influencing senior leadership on critical security decisions.

What You Bring

  • Software Development Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade software services.
  • Core Language Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of Python, Node.js, or Golang.
  • System Design Expertise: Strong track record of designing scalable, maintainable, and secure software architectures.
  • Cloud & Containers: Solid experience with cloud-native environments (AWS or Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Security Mindset: Practical experience building platform security controls, managing service permissions, and applying secure coding practices.
  • Education: A Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with high-throughput streaming platforms or log processing tools (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, Vector).
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and Policy-as-Code tools.
  • Familiarity with compliance standards (FedRAMP, SOC2) and security frameworks in multi-cloud environments.
  • Experience or interest in applying AI/ML tools to automate security workflows and analysis.

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer II - IAM
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the InfoSec team
The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.

About the role
We are building the next generation of enterprise Identity and Access Management at Affirm. This role combines hands-on IAM operations, automation, and production software engineering to make identity services more reliable, scalable, and easier to operate.

You will help run core access lifecycle processes, troubleshoot production issues, and automate repetitive work. You will also build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect identity platforms with internal systems.

Software engineering is a must-have. You will work primarily with SailPoint and enterprise identity integrations, with CIAM-adjacent Auth0 work where enterprise systems intersect with customer identity. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to develop deep IAM expertise without stepping away from hands-on coding.

What you’ll do

  • Run and improve IAM operations, including access lifecycle work, requests, certifications, and issue resolution

  • Automate repetitive processes with scripts, services, and workflow improvements

  • Build and maintain production backend software, APIs, tests, and integrations

  • Connect SailPoint and workforce identity events with internal systems

  • Build a paved path that enables Affirm employees to create modern internal tools with Auth0

  • Partner with Security, IT, and Engineering on secure, auditable changes

  • Maintain runbooks, operational metrics, and escalation support

Example problems you may work on:

  • Fixing a provisioning workflow and adding monitoring or retries

  • Reconciling access between source systems and SailPoint

  • Building an API integration for identity lifecycle events

  • Creating reusable Auth0 patterns, tooling, and documentation for internal applications

What we look for

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent internship/co-op experience with strong projects

  • Ability to write, test, and operate production-quality backend code in Python or a similar language

  • Strong foundations in APIs, debugging, logging, error handling, and distributed systems

  • Experience with GitHub, CI/CD, testing, and code review

  • Comfort owning operational work and troubleshooting production issues

  • Familiarity with cloud environments; AWS preferred

  • Strong written communication and documentation skills

    Nice to Have

    • Exposure to IAM, IGA, SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, RBAC, or identity governance

    • Experience with SailPoint, Auth0, Okta, OneLogin, or similar platforms

    • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools

    • Familiarity with audit or compliance environments

Equity Grade - Canada 5

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Recoveries team, part of Affirm’s Repayments area, builds the platform that determines the most effective way to recover value from charged-off loans while providing the best possible customer experience. We do this both by integrating with external recovery partners and by building our own customer-facing experiences that give customers flexible ways to resolve their outstanding balances.

Our systems span the full recoveries lifecycle, including loan placement and recall, partner integrations, payments and remittances, reconciliation, bankruptcy workflows, and customer-facing recovery experiences. Recoveries operates at the intersection of engineering, product, risk, analytics, operations, finance, legal, and compliance, and our systems directly impact recovery outcomes while requiring a high degree of correctness, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help define the technical direction of the Recoveries platform as we scale our decisioning capabilities, expand internationally, strengthen our data integrity and reconciliation foundations, and build the next generation of recovery products.

What You ll Do

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
  • You will help shape the evolution of the Recoveries platform, driving cross-team technical initiatives that optimize recovery strategies, enable flexible customer-facing experiences, and strengthen the reliability and scalability of our financial and partner integrations.
  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.
  • On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What we look for

  • You have a total of 8+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You are proficient in designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes
  • You have experience designing and operating correctness-sensitive batch, asynchronous, or data-processing systems, including scheduled workflows, backfills, reconciliation, observability, and robust failure handling.
  • You have experience architecting solutions across complex systems and organizational boundaries, and are comfortable understanding and driving changes outside your immediate area of ownership—including across backend services and customer-facing applications—to deliver end-to-end outcomes.
  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you re brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you re excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Our Integration Engineering team connects the systems and data that power Figma’s business operations. We partner with teams across Finance, GTM, People, and Engineering to build reliable integrations and data pipelines across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, Snowflake, and other core applications.

We’re looking for a Data & Integration Engineering who combines application integration expertise with hands-on data engineering experience. You’ll build workflows that move business processes forward and pipelines that make data accurate, accessible, and useful for operations, reconciliation, and reporting.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end project ownership, from requirements and architecture through development, deployment, and production support. You’ll help shape our technical direction, mentor engineers, and establish reusable patterns that improve how we build and operate integrations and data pipelines.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Design, build, and operate integrations across CRM, ERP, and HR systems using MuleSoft, APIs, and event-driven architectures
  • Build and maintain batch and incremental data pipelines into Snowflake, using SQL and Python for transformations, validation, and automation
  • Develop data models and datasets that support business operations, reconciliation, and reporting, partnering with Data Engineering on standards and ownership
  • Work with business stakeholders and product managers to translate requirements into technical designs, delivery plans, and measurable acceptance criteria
  • Support business-critical order-to-revenue workflows with reliable processing, clear ownership, and safe recovery from failures
  • Implement automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks to improve reliability and reduce manual intervention
  • Apply security and SOX/ITGC-aligned development practices, including access controls, code reviews, CI/CD, and change management
  • Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and establish reusable components, documentation, and engineering practices

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of both enterprise integrations and production data pipelines
  • Strong experience building and supporting API-led integrations, with an understanding of API design, authentication, asynchronous processing, retries, and idempotency
  • Hands-on proficiency in query languages and programming for data transformation, pipeline development, and automation
  • Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse, including data modeling, incremental processing, and query optimization and integrating enterprise business applications across Finance, GTM, or People systems
  • A track record of independently owning projects from requirements through production, including testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation, while collaborating with business stakeholders and engineering teams

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

Our systems process real-time events from Verkada s global device fleet, delivering intelligent, actionable alerts through multiple channels including email, SMS, push notifications, and webhooks.

In 2025, we launched Operations, a suite of features designed for customers monitoring critical infrastructure with dedicated security teams, starting with enhanced collaboration tools and expanding integration capabilities.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company’s mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

You’ll be the senior data science leader embedded in our Developer Platform product team and a strategic thought partner to its product leads. You’ll help set product direction for the Claude Developer Platform, spanning our core API, agent orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, and knowledge management capabilities. You’ll bring a point of view on where to invest, how to grow our platform business, and how to deliver more value for the developers and enterprises building on Claude. As a tech lead manager, you’ll also manage a small team of Product Data Scientists, setting their agenda and raising the bar for how data shapes product decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Developer Platform product leads, helping shape product strategy, roadmap priorities, and the major bets the team makes
  • Set the data science agenda for Developer Platform, deciding where the Product Data Science team can have the most impact and what it should deprioritize
  • Manage and develop a small team of Product Data Scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions
  • Frame the most important and ambiguous questions facing the platform, from how developers and enterprises adopt it to how AI agents are being built and deployed at scale, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction
  • Define how Developer Platform measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks that align teams and leadership on what matters
  • Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Developer Platform, including where API and B2B products make clean experiments hard, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses
  • Turn complex analyses into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners, including go-to-market teams
  • Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Developer Platform needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our products grow

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product area at significant scale
  • Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction and developing senior data scientists
  • Have been a trusted partner to senior product and business leaders on API or developer-facing products, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision
  • Bring strong product sense and business judgment for developer and B2B products, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information
  • Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others’ technical work
  • Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences
  • Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress
  • Care about the company’s mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI
  • Strong candidates may also have:
  • Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$285,000—$380,000 USD

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Enterprise admins are among the most important users Harvey serves. At the world's largest law firms and legal departments, IT and security teams are part of every buying decision and every rollout, and they hold Harvey to the most stringent access requirements of any industry, from ethical walls to matter-level permissions. At most companies, admin capabilities are checklist items. At Harvey, they're in the spotlight.

The Senior Product Manager, Admin will own the product vision and roadmap for identity and access on Harvey's admin platform, the operational control surface where enterprise administrators manage users and access, govern permissions, and steer their organization's deployment of Harvey at scale. That spans SSO and login, SCIM and user lifecycle, MFA, permissions and RBAC, external users, and global identity across workspaces. You will also help define a brand-new problem space. As agents become part of how legal work gets done, you'll work with product managers across Harvey to define what agent identity means: how agents authenticate, how admins grant them permissions, and how customers govern them.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with strong product judgment who can turn complex, high-stakes enterprise problems into a clear strategy and shipped product: running several platform projects at once, moving with urgency, and owning outcomes end to end. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Security, Legal Engineering, and Go-to-Market, and your work will directly shape whether the world's most demanding enterprises trust Harvey with their most sensitive work.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for identity and access at Harvey, taking problems from discovery through launch and iteration.

 - Partner with Engineering, Design, and GTM to deliver scalable, secure, and intuitive admin experiences that meet the operational needs of large enterprise customers.

 - Engage directly with enterprise customers, customer success, and sales teams to deeply understand admin pain points, access and governance requirements, and integration needs, and translate those insights into high-impact product investments.

 - Define agent identity with product managers across Harvey: how agents authenticate, how admins assign them permissions, and how customers govern them.

 - Make feature access provisioning seamless between our go-to-market systems and the product, so customers reach Early Access and GA capabilities without manual work.

 - Build the permission and identity primitives other Harvey teams build on, and partner with Security and Legal Engineering on the controls enterprise buyers require.

 - Establish and track key metrics for provisioning coverage, admin efficiency, and governance, using data to inform prioritization and measure success.

 - Drive alignment across stakeholders on trade-offs, sequencing, and scope, communicating clearly at both the executive and working-team levels.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of hands-on product management experience building enterprise B2B products, with deep familiarity in identity and access: SSO, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, permissions, and audit logging.

 - A track record of shipping high-quality products end to end in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, running several projects at once, ideally at a startup or growth-stage company that moved upmarket into large enterprises.

 - Platform and systems thinking: you have built something other teams depend on, and you understand how a change in one system ripples through the rest.

 - Experience working directly with security, compliance, and IT stakeholders, such as security reviews or procurement, and shipping products that pass their scrutiny.

 - Strong analytical and communication skills, with experience using data to drive decisions and the ability to articulate a clear product vision to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Enough technical depth to partner with engineers on architecture and tradeoffs, with a strong desire to go deeper.

 - A hungry, curious, ownership-driven approach, with strong attention to detail.

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff NetSuite Engineer with deep expertise in Order-to-Cash(O2C) & Record-to-Report (R2R) processes and accounting best practices. This role will serve as the technical and functional bridge between Finance and Technology, driving automation, process optimization, and scalability within our NetSuite environment.The successful candidate will lead the design, enhancement, and support of accounting systems that power our General Ledger (GL), Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), including credit card process, Tax, and Treasury operations. As a senior member of the Finance Technology team, you will design and implement solutions that streamline accounting workflows, ensure compliance, and enhance financial reporting accuracy.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, NY or Palo Alto, CA or remotely in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Development

  • Lead the design, configuration, and customization of NetSuite to support R2R and accounting processes (GL, journals, allocations, consolidations, fixed assets, intercompany eliminations)
  • Architect scalable NetSuite solutions that integrate seamlessly with upstream and downstream systems (e.g., procurement, billing, expense management, data lake)
  • Develop and maintain SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (Web Services), and RESTlets to support automation and integrations

Process & Accounting Alignment

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Audit teams to translate accounting policies into system-enforced controls within NetSuite
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Finance teams including Accounting, Tax, Treasury and RevOps
  • Ensure compliance with SOX, GAAP, and audit requirements through configuration of role-based security, approvals, reconciliations, and audit trails
  • Optimize financial close processes (journals, reconciliations, accruals, consolidations) to reduce close cycle time
  • Build and enhance reporting frameworks (saved searches, financial reports, dashboards) to support accurate and timely financial reporting
  • Support compliance and audit requirements through appropriate controls and documentation

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for NetSuite R2R and OTC processes, guiding engineers, administrators, and analysts

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user s checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You ll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.

· This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Capacity & Efficiency
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world s biggest financial problems. We re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn t a place for complacency, it s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Capacity & Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood s AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood s storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
  • Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
  • Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
  • Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
  • Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling
  • Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

What you bring

  • Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management
  • Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth
  • A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability
  • Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report
  • Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus
  • Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

 

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account f

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every change to Anthropic s software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production.

We sit within Anthropic s Infrastructure organization and own pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You ll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production.

If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit.

Key responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, and operations
  • Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves
  • Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents
  • Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms
  • Build and operate runtime configuration and feature flag systems with validation, gradual rollout, and fast rollback
  • Build infrastructure-as-code workflows that many teams rely on for safe, routine changes
  • Scale artifact distribution so code and configuration reach machines quickly and efficiently
  • Partner with Security so that the path to production is secure by default, with verifiable builds, least-privilege access, and auditable changes
  • Work directly with teams across Anthropic to understand their deployment needs and bring their workloads onto the platform
  • Take part in on-call and incident response, and turn what you learn into guardrails that prevent the same problem from recurring

Minimum qualifications

  • Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language, such as Rust, Go, C++, or Java
  • Experience leading the design, building, and operation of distributed systems or infrastructure in production, including technical direction across teams
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads, such as Kubernetes on AWS or GCP
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building deployment, release, or change management systems at large scale
  • Experience with production on-call and incident response
  • Experience with Rust in production
  • Experience with progressive delivery and GitOps tooling, such as Argo CD or Argo Rollouts
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, including controllers and operators
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code systems at scale, including state management and locking
  • Experience building feature flag, experimentation, or dynamic configuration systems
  • Experience with artifact or package distribution, such as OCI registries, Nix, or content-addressed storage
  • Experience with software supply chain security, such as signed build provenance
  • Experience building high-throughput workflow engines or control planes backed by relational databases
  • Experience building internal developer platforms and leading adoption across many teams
  • Experience using AI agents in your own engineering work, or building systems that agents operate

Representative projects

  • Build operator controls for progressive rollouts, including pause and resume that preserve rollout state
  • Design a deployment engine built on fine-grained targets and their dependencies, so each change rolls out exactly where it needs to
  • Build cluster-health-aware rollouts that steer around unhealthy clusters
  • Add a new workload type to the platform, including its rollout, verification, and rollback behavior
  • Design a deployment control plane that handles sharp bursts of agent-driven traffic
  • Design a distribution system that delivers configuration and artifacts to every machine in the fleet as demand grows

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description
We are seeking a Revenue Finance Director to join our FP&A team and own how Sonar forecasts, plans, and prices its revenue. You will drive forecast accuracy, partner cross-functionally to optimize revenue, and give executives clear recommendations on revenue strategy. This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who pushes back with data, builds their own solutions, and leads our AI-first approach to FP&A.
 
What you will do
Own the Revenue Forecast and Raise Its AccuracyOwn Sonar’s revenue forecast end to end (bookings, billings, and revenue) across monthly and quarter-end cycles, with a clear view of where we will land and why.Treat forecast accuracy as your personal scorecard. Track misses by segment, motion, and root cause, and run retrospectives on material variances.Challenge cross-functional teams on conversion, renewal, and timing assumptions, and drive the changes needed to make the forecast more reliable.Build driver-based models using leading indicators (pipeline, usage, renewals, price) and ASC 606 treatment; incorporating consumption based revenue models.
Lead long-range and annual revenue planning, translating targets across the P&L.
Turn analysis into executive level recommendations
Shape revenue strategy and bring a position and options to the CFO. Build Board, investor, and ELT materials.
Evaluate pricing and packaging changes (list price, discounting, renewal uplift, plan mix) and quantify the impact on topline and margin.
Partner with Deal Desk, Pricing, and R&D Finance to analyze margin, pricing profiles, and deal structures (discounts, multi-year terms, ramps, payment terms, commitments).
Build deal guardrails and approval frameworks that balance growth, margin, and revenue recognition, advise on non-standard deals, and run post-close analysis.
Build with AI and Automate
Default to AI first. Before adding a manual process, ask whether an AI-enabled workflow can do it better, and build it yourself.
Ship automations that go beyond text generation: forecast roll-ups, variance analysis, anomaly detection, deal and pricing analytics, and agentic workflows.
Define where AI should automate, where human judgment stays in the loop, and how outputs are validated, with appropriate controls and data security.
Roll Up Your Sleeves and Self-Initiate
Stay hands-on in the data and the models. Spot problems and opportunities on your own, propose the fix, and drive it to completion without waiting to be asked.
Partner with Controllership, Accounting, Finance Ops, RevOps, and Deal Desk to ensure data integrity and accurate, streamlined reporting.

Experience and qualifications
The ideal candidate will: 
Required Experience10+ years of progressive finance experience (FP&A, revenue finance, or commercial and strategic finance), with significant time in high-growth SaaS or tech.Ownership of a revenue, bookings, or ARR forecast at scale, with a proven record of improving accuracy and working knowledge of revenue accounting.A history of pricing, packaging, or commercial recommendations that executives adopted, grounded in margin, discounting, and price realization analysis.Experience with consumption based modelsDemonstrated influence: you challenge senior leaders with data, hold your position under pushback, and change how others work.Hands-on AI experience in finance workflows, with specific automations you built and shipped (not just prompts for polishing emails), using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.Expert-level, driver-based financial modeling, and the ability to communicate complex recommendations clearly to executives, the Board, and investors.A self-starter and builder who takes ownership, moves fast, and does the detailed work personally.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.
Preferred QualificationsMBA, or investment banking, consulting, or strategic finance experience.Experience with various pricing models.Hands-on experience with enterprise planning and finance systems (e.g., NetSuite, Pigment, Salesforce).Experience building AI agents or workflows (e.g., Claude Cowork).
