jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Spend
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Spend team, you'll lead the architecture and development of backend systems that support Airwallex's financial operating layer for modern businesses. You'll shape technical direction across corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement while helping build reliable financial workflows at scale.

 - Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of complex backend systems that power Airwallex's Spend products, including corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement.

 - Drive cross-team technical initiatives and shape the long-term engineering strategy for scalable, secure, and reliable financial workflows.

 - Own backend services end to end, from technical discovery and design through implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and ongoing maintenance.

 - Raise the bar on system design, API quality, testing, reliability, and performance while helping teams make sound technical trade-offs.

 - Mentor engineers and collaborate closely with Product, Design, Infrastructure, Risk, and Compliance to deliver dependable solutions for global businesses.

You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience in technical leadership roles.

 - Proven experience architecting and scaling backend systems and APIs in production.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

 - Expertise in at least one backend language, such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.

 - Deep understanding of REST API design and modern backend frameworks, such as Spring Boot.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, such as AWS or GCP, and container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.

 - Strong commitment to code quality, reliability, and performance.

Preferred

 - Experience leading cross-team initiatives and influencing technical direction at a system-wide level.

 - Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools, such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk.

 - Familiarity with security and compliance considerations in financial services.

 - A passion for mentoring and helping others grow.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

 - You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

 - You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Spend team builds Airwallex's financial operating layer for modern businesses, bringing together corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement on top of our accounts, payments, and issuing infrastructure. We're building AI that makes real decisions about expenses, policies, and payments, aiming to get 95%+ of submissions down to one click, while every workflow still has to hold up across multi-entity businesses, currencies, and audit trails. This is a team for people who want broad ownership across product, data, and AI, while the roadmap is still being defined. If you want to build production AI for real financial workflows that directly change how businesses operate, this is where that work happens.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector, Federal & Defense
jobs.description:
Datadog is looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own marketing strategy and execution for our U.S. Federal and Defense business. In this role, you will build and run an integrated, multi-channel field marketing program across Federal Civilian agencies, Federal Systems Integrators, the Department of War (DoW/DoD), and the Defense Industrial Base. 

This will span mission-focused events, executive briefings, account-based programs, and digital campaigns, in close partnership with Public Sector sales leadership.

The role is a full-funnel mandate with the latitude to prioritize the programs that move pipeline in a market where the buying cycle, the procurement path, and the compliance bar all look different from commercial tech.

Datadog for Government operates in a FedRAMP High-certified, AWS GovCloud (US) environment, with work underway toward DoD Impact Level 5. You will be the marketer who translates that platform and compliance story into mission language for program offices, CIOs, and the integrators who build for them.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You ll Do:

  • Set the strategy for, and execute, the integrated Federal and Defense field marketing plan — aligned to Public Sector sales priorities, target agencies and programs, and pipeline goals. You will propose the pipeline target for this segment, not just deliver against one handed to you.
  • Build segment-specific program tracks for Federal Civilian, Federal Systems Integrator, DoW/DoD, and Defense Industrial Base audiences, recognizing that each buys on a different cycle and responds to different proof.
  • Own Datadog’s presence across the federal event calendar, from large-scale defense and civilian conferences to service association events, agency industry days, virtual events, and targeted executive gatherings.
  • Build the program formats that move federal buyers through the funnel — executive briefings, technical workshops, roundtables, and webinars — owning Federal and Defense field marketing budget, audience strategy, target account recruitment, and follow-through.
  • Work with Product Marketing to shape Federal-specific messaging and content: FedRAMP High, IL5 progress, data residency, U.S.-persons operations, continuous ATO, zero trust, and the compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, DISA STIGs) your audience is actually measured against.
  • Partner with Demand Generation on campaign strategy and execution. Adapt nurture tracks and email motions for a federal audience, manage lead flow and follow-up SLAs with sales, and tune programs based on funnel performance You bring the market context that makes a central campaign land with the audience, and you own stage-over-stage conversion for the segment.
  • Raise the bar for the wider field marketing team — mentor less experienced marketers, and bring federal market expertise back into how the broader org plans.

Who You Are:

  • 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years marketing to the U.S. Federal government, with a demonstrated track record of driving pipeline for a public sector segment or business unit.
  • Direct experience with Defense buyers — DoW/DoD services and combatant commands, or the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base firms that serve them.
  • Fluent in the federal buying cycle: appropriations and fiscal-year dynamics, contract vehicles (GSA, SEWP, CIO-SP, GWACs), the role of resellers and integrators, and how an ATO actually gets granted.
  • Proven experience planning and executing large-scale federal events, executive forums, and sponsored trade shows.
  • Comfortable with the technical subject matter — observability, cloud, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity — and tune messaging that holds up with a technical federal audience.
  • Experience with account-based marketing against named agencies and programs.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

The TDI Client Platform Engineering Team

The Technology, Data, and Insights (TDI) team is on a mission to accelerate Okta’s scale. We are a group of innovative engineers who prioritize automation, testing, and performance tuning. We touch every part of the business, and we are obsessed with creating a seamless, secure end-user experience for every Okta employee.

The Staff Client Platform Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Client Platform Engineer, you will be the subject matter expert for Okta’s macOS and iOS fleet. While your primary focus is the Apple ecosystem, you will also play a key role in our broader endpoint strategy, contributing to our Windows, Android, Linux, and VDI management workflows as needed. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks automation-first. You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.

What makes this role unique: You are Customer Zero. Because we build identity and device management products, you will work directly with Okta’s own Product and Engineering teams to validate new capabilities across platforms, surface real-world feedback, and help shape the roadmap for tools used by millions of people globally.

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Client Platform Engineering.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Apple Fleet Management: Own the global macOS and iOS fleet using Jamf Pro, overseeing enrollment, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
  • Cross-Platform Support: Contribute to the management and security of Windows (via Intune/Autopilot) and Linux endpoints as the program evolves, ensuring a consistent security posture across all OS types.
  • Tooling & Evolution: Administer open-source tools (Munki, Santa) and lead evaluations of emerging platforms like FleetDM to enhance cross-platform fleet visibility.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure endpoints meet NIST, CIS, and STIG standards. Partner with Security teams to respond to vulnerabilities across the entire fleet.
  • Engineering & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Apply an IaC mindset to device management using code-based workflows (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or Jamf API). Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure repeatable, scalable, and automated deployments regardless of the OS.
  • Technical Direction: Set the architecture and technical direction for a domain, such as Apple platform, endpoint security tooling or devices-as-code, and write design or docs that formalize it.
  • Customer Zero Advocacy: Act as a primary feedback loop for Okta’s internal product teams. Test new features in production and influence the product roadmap based on operational data.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide Tier 3 escalation support for global IT teams and participate in an on-call rotation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Core Experience: 8+ years in endpoint engineering with a focus on Apple platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Technical Versatility: A strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems; you aren t just a "Mac person", you understand how to apply engineering principles to any OS.
  • MDM Mastery: Deep expertise in managing endpoints at scale via MDM, such as Jamf Pro. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, FleetDM or other cross-platform MDM/UEM solutions is a significant plus.
  • Scripting: Proficiency in Bash, Python, Go, or Swift (PowerShell experience is a bonus).
  • Tooling: Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or similar CI/CD frameworks.
  • Security: Understanding of ADE/DEP, MDM/DDM protocols, and platform-specific hardening (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS).
  • Identity Knowledge: Familiarity with SAML and OIDC and how they integrate with endpoint authentication.

Additional requirements:

  • This position requires the ability to access federal environments and/or have access to protected federal data.  As a condition of employment for this position, the successful candidate must be able to submit documentation establishing U.S. Person status (e.g. a U.S. Citizen, National, Lawful Permanent Resident, Refugee, or Asylee. 22 CFR 120.15) upon hire.

Extra Credit

  • Hands-on experience with FleetDM or osquery for multi-OS visibility.
  • Experience with Autopkg pipelines or AWS Lambda for endpoint automation.
  • Background in Federal compliance (FedRAMP).
  • Relevant certifications (Apple, Okta, Microsoft, AWS, Jamf).

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.


THE OPPORTUNITY

AI applications are moving from prototypes to production, and the infrastructure underneath them is becoming increasingly complex.

We build and run the infrastructure behind our AI products: the cloud and Kubernetes platform they run on, the pipelines that ship code to production, and the observability that tells us when something breaks. We're also building AI agents that can operate that infrastructure themselves

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can work across these areas, build systems from the ground up, and think ahead about how they will behave at scale.

A key part of this role is building AI agents for infrastructure and engineering workflows. We’re looking for someone who has actually built and shipped agents or agentic systems that perform real work, not just used AI coding assistants or experimented with prompts.



WHAT YOU WILL DO?

 - Build reliable infrastructure at scale. Design and improve cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, compute, storage, and distributed systems.

 - Design for failure. Identify bottlenecks, failure modes, and operational risks before they become production issues.

 - Build safer deployments. Improve CI/CD, testing, rollout strategies, and deployment controls.

 - Build strong observability. Develop monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational tooling that makes systems easier to understand and operate.

 - Improve infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and cloud cost.

 - Build AI agents for infrastructure and engineering. Design and ship agents that can use tools and APIs, execute multi-step workflows, troubleshoot issues, or automate operational work.

 - Make agents safe to operate. Build the right evaluation, permissions, guardrails, observability, and failure handling around agents taking real actions.

 - Raise the engineering bar. Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and postmortems.

 - Share on-call ownership. Join the team’s on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and turn what you learn into fixes, runbooks, and automation that reduce future pages.


WHAT MAKES YOU A MATCH?

 - You've built AI agents, not just used AI tools. You have shipped agentic systems that perform meaningful work and understand tools, state, workflows, evaluation, and guardrails.

 - You have strong infrastructure fundamentals. You understand distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, and production operations.

 - You've built systems through scale. You have taken infrastructure from relatively early stages to meaningful production scale and can talk about the trade-offs along the way.

 - You think about reliability by default. Failure modes, blast radius, operational complexity, and recovery are part of how you approach architecture.

 - You can debug across layers. You’re comfortable moving from application behaviour to Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure to find root causes.

 - You build rather than operate manually. Your instinct is to automate repetitive work and build tools that make engineering teams more effective.

 - You've built platforms other engineers build on. Package registries, artifact stores, CI systems or internal developer platforms all count.

 - You write things down. At staff level most of your influence comes through design docs and reviews.

Strong signals: Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or production-grade AI agents. Experience with agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, memory/state, or agent reliability is particularly valuable.

Our stack: AWS/EKS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu, FluxCD, Temporal, VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, Grafana, Go, and Rust. You don't need experience with all of these. Strong engineers from other backgrounds can pick them up quickly.




WHY ATLAN?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

 - Competitive Compensation:  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

 - AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

 - Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

 - Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

 - Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

 - Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership

jobs.title: Principal Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking a Security Architect to join our APJ Field CTO Office to act as a security evangelist, architect, and hands-on subject matter expert/practitioner. In this role, you will cultivate key customer and partnership relationships, demonstrate thought leadership, and act as a trusted security advisor to current and potential customers. You will also collaborate with internal and external technical and business stake Security Architect, you must share our passion and vision in helping our customers and partners secure their Snowflake Accounts, thrive in a dynamic environment, and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop and deep diving with technical audiences.



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:



 - Help to scope security related feature enhancements on behalf of customers to work with Product Management on ways to improve the product from a security perspective.

 - Assist in clarifying concepts of data engineering, data warehousing, data collaboration, AI and Machine Learning. Share industry best practices, and features in the Snowflake platform; Assist in building demos and prototypes using Snowflake in conjunction with other integrated solutions; Engage with other relevant Snowflake stakeholders internally.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support in order to drive customer security feature adoption.

 - Partner with our Product Marketing team to define and support Snowflake's  AI and Data Cloud posture and Security DataLake workload awareness and pipeline building via marketing initiatives including conferences, trade shows, and events.

 - Work and collaborate with other Field CTO members in areas of: Enterprise AI, Gen AI, Data Engineering, Applications, as a security export you may be involved in collaborative engagements.

 - Partner with the best in the industry product team, helping to shape vision and capabilities for Snowflake Data Marketplace.

 - Share knowledge with internal and industry communities via webinars & conferences.




ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:



 - 10+ years of industry, customer-facing, and hands-on implementation experience with a core focus on data concepts, privacy, governance, networking, infosec and security technologies.

 - Strong understanding of security related concepts such as RBAC, OAuth, Identity and Access Management, encryption and data governance.

 - Expertise and in-depth working knowledge and hands-on experience in cloud platforms (at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP), and its corresponding security, data encryption, and networking architecture and technologies.

 - Ability to build out demos, configure CSP environments,  build out prototypes, and test use cases on the Snowflake platform and relevant integrations with CSP services and external security tools.

 - Ability to create security and networking-related reference architectures, security best practices and hardening guides, and articulate them to a customer audience.

 - A demonstrated knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and how to articulate controls and security mechanisms within a Risk Assessment centred approach.

 - Knowledge of ANSI SQL compliant databases and / or data warehousing is preferred

 - AWS/Azure/GCP security and / or networking specialty related certification achievement is a plus

 - Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IP routing, DNS, Proxies and CSP private networking technologies including NAT, Firewalls, TLS and related design and troubleshooting.

 - Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including cloud service providers like Azure, AWS, and GCP

 - Strong understanding of identity management use cases, including authentication (SAML), authorization (OAUTH), and identity governance (SCIM & RBAC)

 - Deep experience with large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.)

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills, presentation and whiteboarding skills to a large audience, and the ability to successfully communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

 - Fair understanding of the culture diversity across Asia Pacific Japan region and flexibility of working with customers and colleagues from multiple APJ time zones.

 - Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Management Systems, or related field required. Masters preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the systems that turn a signed deal into a correct invoice and accurate revenue numbers. You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering.

This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - The big bet: Create a reliable GTM and quote-to-cash foundation across CRM, CPQ, billing and finance systems, marketing automation infrastructure, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them.

 - By day 90, build a clear understanding of the critical data flows between GTM systems, finance systems, and the warehouse, then ship an initial improvement to a high-value integration or workflow.

 - By day 90, develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that reduce manual work for reps, Deal Desk, and Billing Ops while improving the quality of signals available to reps and operators.

 - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust.

 - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure.

 - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices.

 - Demonstrated experience in business systems engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, or a technical sales or marketing operations role, with the ability to own problems end to end and work effectively across functions.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery; you design for clean, traceable data and understand how to protect its integrity across systems.

 - Experience building integrations with APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, reverse ETL, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io http://Tray.io. Scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building serverless integrations, is a plus.

 - Familiarity with finance systems and concepts such as quote-to-cash, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition, and the ability to work effectively with Finance and Billing Ops. Experience with an ERP such as NetSuite is a plus.

 - Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation, following the team’s development and release practices: source control, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and the deployment pipeline - is a plus.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or a similar CPQ tool — including product and pricing data models, price books, bundles, and approval rules — is a plus.

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, with experience applying it to day-to-day work through AI-assisted development, agents, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Salesforce administration and customization—including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations—is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Compute Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm s engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm s products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

What you’ll do

As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

  • Architect and evolve Affirm s EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components

  • Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows

  • Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently

  • Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc

  • Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads

  • Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time

  • Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly

  • Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection

  • Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

What we look for

  • Deep EKS and Kubernetes internals expertise, including cluster upgrades, node lifecycle, scheduling, and autoscaling (Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler)

  • Demonstrated experience automating Kubernetes operations at fleet scale, from cluster provisioning, upgrades, and node lifecycle to self-healing remediation and policy-driven enforcement, replacing manual toil with auditable, self-service workflows

  • Strong grasp of workload reliability patterns: resource tuning, probes, PDBs, topology and isolation constraints

  • Experience designing and enforcing platform standards through policy (admission control, OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent) and automated frameworks

  • Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and a GitOps or pipeline-driven delivery model (ArgoCD, kube-applier, or similar)

  • Observability instincts: defining SLOs, building metrics, logs, and alerting coverage, and running data-driven baseline audits

  • Cross-functional collaboration skills with platform, product, SRE, and capacity teams

  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across teams

  • Drive to track emerging Kubernetes community best practices and adapt them to Affirm s needs

 Qualifications

  • 10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering with proven delivery of complex platform solutions

  • 6+ years hands-on operating production Kubernetes at scale, ideally EKS on AWS

  • Strong cloud-native architecture experience on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS)

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Spacelift a plus) and GitOps-style deployment pipelines

  • Expert-level proficiency in Go or Python and a proven track record building production-grade Kubernetes controllers, operators, and platform tooling that other engineering teams depend on

  • Track record designing and enforcing standards across many teams without becoming a bottleneck

  • Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking skills

  • Demonstrated leadership and cross-functional influence

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Full Stack (Card Pre-Swipe Experience)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We build the experiences that connect a customer s intent to buy with the flexibility of Affirm Card. From making financing options easier to understand to creating intuitive checkout journeys, we turn complex financial capabilities into simple, trustworthy experiences. Our roadmap includes evolving Default Terms, supporting additional cards, and strengthening the mobile experiences customers rely on when deciding how to pay.

Our work sits at the intersection of mobile, backend systems, and product innovation. We partner closely with Product, Design, and engineering teams across Affirm to introduce new capabilities while protecting the reliability of our checkout-critical surfaces.

As a full-stack Software Engineer II, you ll help bring these experiences to life through customer-facing features and the services behind them. We re looking for a curious, collaborative engineer who cares about the complete customer journey and enjoys turning challenging problems into thoughtful solutions. Together, we ll make Affirm Card easier to use and help customers make financial decisions with greater confidence.

What You ll Do

  • With the support of your team s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For

  • You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You have experience designing, developing and launching backend systems and are proficient in one of Python or Kotlin.
  • You are familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
  • You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Base Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: CAD $133,000 - $183,000.

This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human evaluation and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition.

At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI.

At the foundation of these products is the Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design and development of core data storage, streaming, caching, and indexing platforms and underlying systems.  You’ll also get widespread exposure to the forefront of the AI race as Scale sees it in enterprises, startups, governments, and large tech companies.

You will:

  • Drive the architecture, design, implementation, and reliability of our foundational data platforms and systems, working closely with stakeholders and internal customers to understand and refine requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for, and driving improvements to, current programming practices, including process enhancements and tool upgrades.
  • Present technical information to teams and stakeholders, providing guidance and insight on development processes and technologies.
  • Provide technical leadership, including: upholding and upleveling engineering standards across the organization, mentoring junior engineers. 

Ideally you’d have:

  • 8+ years of full-time engineering experience, post-graduation with specialties in back-end systems, specifically related to building large-scale data storage, streaming, and warehousing systems.
  • Extensive experience in various database technologies (MongoDB, Postgres), streaming/processing solutions (Kinesis, Flink, Spark), indexing/caching (ElasticSearch, Redis), and various data query engines (Trino, Presto, Snowflake, etc.).
  • Show a track record of mentoring and leading teams in successful projects.
  • Possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working fluently with standard containerization & deployment technologies like Kubernetes and various public cloud offerings.
  • Extensive experience in software development and a deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud platforms and data systems.
  • Experience driving cross functional collaboration and communication at an organizational or broader level. 

Nice to haves:

  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices and CI/CD tooling (CircleCI).
  • Experience with performance tuning and cost optimizations of cloud based data platforms. 
  • Experience defining a data lifecycle strategy and designing/implementing tooling for data privacy (i.e. GDPR) needs.  
  • Experience scaling products at hyper-growth startups.
  • Excitement to work with AI technologies.

Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You ll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.

$252,000—$315,000 USD

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Metadata
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Software Engineer – Metadata




COMPANY PITCH

Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud. Thousands of organizations run their most critical data, analytics, and AI workloads on our platform. We built Snowflake for the cloud from day one: near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Our goal is to make every organization's data instantly useful and always available.




TEAM PITCH

The Metadata team owns the brain of Snowflake. Every query, table, transaction, and permission depends on the metadata layer we build. Our systems handle millions of metadata operations per second. We also power cross-region and cross-cloud replication and failover, keeping customer data available through outages. If you want hard distributed-systems problems with direct customer impact, this is the team.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the design of core metadata and replication systems across multiple teams.

 - Set technical direction for scalability, consistency, and fault tolerance of the metadata layer.

 - Drive cross-region and cross-cloud replication toward lower RPO and higher reliability.

 - Solve hard problems in performance, availability, and correctness at global scale.

 - Partner with Product and architects to turn customer needs into durable designs.

 - Raise the operational bar through observability, safe rollouts, and blast-radius controls.

 - Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders on the team.




REQUIREMENTS

Core Requirements:

 - 10+ years building large-scale distributed systems or database internals.

 - Strong development skills in Java or C++.

 - Proven record leading multi-team technical initiatives from design to production.

 - Deep understanding of consistency, transactions, and fault tolerance.

 - BS/MS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Any of the following would make you a stronger candidate:

 - Experience with FoundationDB or other distributed key-value stores.

 - Experience building replication, disaster recovery, or geo-distributed systems.

 - Experience with database metadata, catalogs, or query compilation.

 - Experience running services on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GTM
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



We are looking for a GTM Forward Deployed Engineer to build and launch AI agents for our go to market (GTM) teams (Marketing, Sales, Product and Revenue Operations) using platforms like Salesforce, Slack, Claude Code, Gemini, Snowflake, Marketo, Clay, Nooks, and Rox


Key Responsibilities


 - Prototype and deploy AI agents for customer retention, pipeline generation, GTM productivity, deal inspection, account research, opportunity updates, and meeting prep.

 - Create prompt templates and system instructions for accurate, consistent outputs.

 - Define agent persona, tone, and fallback logic

 - Re-engineer GTM processes by connecting LLMs to GTM systems

 - Build and test agentic tools quickly.

 - Document agent logic and prompt structures to ensure scalable, independent automation across the global GTM organization.

 - Test system prompts, context retrieval, and model selection to boost output quality, seller adoption, and deal velocity.

 - Track and audit production agents to quickly fix output drift, performance gaps, and accuracy issues

 - Partner with GTM Analytics teams to integrate GTM data sources for real-time customer and pipeline insights.

 - Create practical prompt libraries, quick-reference playbooks, and training sessions to maximize seller, customer and/or potential customer value.

 - Ensure prompt, workflow, and deployed solutions meet security, legal, and company AI standards.
   



Required Qualifications



 - Have 5+ years of software engineering experience

 - Working knowledge of GTM strategy, AI Operations and hands-on experience putting AI workflows or LLM agents into production.

 - Experience creating internal documentation, toolkits and playbooks that outlived your involvement and were adopted at scale.

 - Experience in a technical or cross-functional role that required problem-solving across teams and functions.

 - A track record of building AI-powered tools, automations, or workflows that changed how real work gets done — with specific examples you can speak to.

 - Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain a technical concept to someone who's never thought about it before, without talking down to them.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and self-direction; you don't need a detailed roadmap to know where to start.




Preferred Qualifications:

 - Hands-on experience with AI development platforms and tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, LLM APIs, custom agent frameworks, or workflow automation platforms.

 - Background in change management, organizational development, or a large-scale rollout that required bringing skeptical stakeholders along.

 - Experience in solutions engineering where you had to earn trust and deliver results quickly.

 - Familiarity with the enterprise SaaS tools Kong runs on: Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Jira, or Freshservice.

 - Familiarity with Kong Konnect, Kong Gateway, or API management concepts — understanding how APIs and AI models connect will help you build smarter tools.

 - Experience helping others develop new technical skills, whether through formal training, one-on-one coaching, or team enablement programs



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to land and expand n8n inside the world’s largest organisations, closing the biggest deals in our portfolio.

As a Large Enterprise Account Executive covering US West (California, Washington, Colorado and Texas), you will own a territory of global-scale accounts and lead long, complex deals from first conversation to multi-year commitment:


BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS

 - Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees in the US West territory.

 - Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders.

 - Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities.


LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS

 - Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case.

 - Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement.

 - Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption.


CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

 - Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more.

 - Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

 - Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

 - 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more.

 - 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers and executives: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs and CIOs, and you can carry a technical conversation and an executive one in the same deal.

 - 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than relying on expansion or inbound.

 - 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

 - 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews.

 - 📍 Location: You are based in California, Washington, Colorado or Texas and you already have the right to work in the US. This role covers the US West territory and involves regular travel to customers in the region.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

 - 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners.

 - 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

Why join us?

You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise.About the role

Our company language is English.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer to own the shared layer that every Harvey IT system runs on. You'll join Core IT Engineering & Infrastructure, reporting to Dave Vega, Director of IT, alongside engineers who own identity and collaboration, Microsoft platforms, networking, and client platforms.

Harvey is cloud-first. We run no servers or data centers of our own. Our IT infrastructure is cloud tenants, SaaS configuration, office networks across a growing global footprint, and the automation that ties them together. Today that cross-cutting work is done on the side by each platform owner. This role makes it someone's primary job, so it gets built once, done well, and doesn't break quietly.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own the shared infrastructure, automation and reliability work that cuts across every IT platform.

 - IT cloud accounts and tenants. Own access, guardrails and cost for the cloud accounts IT runs (AWS, Azure, GCP projects for IT tooling). Be the BizTech engineering partner to Security and Infrastructure on tenant-level changes, such as cloud migrations that touch Entra and M365.

 - Infrastructure as code for IT. Build and run the Git repos, CI pipelines and review process for IT configuration (Okta, Jamf, Intune, Google Workspace). Platform owners keep owning their config. You own the framework they all use.

 - IT automation and provisioning. Own the automation behind identity lifecycle and IT workflows: SCIM and provisioning flows, onboarding and offboarding orchestration across systems, and IT workflows in Serval.

 - Monitoring, backup and resilience. Set up health checks and alerting for critical IT systems and integrations, config drift detection, SaaS backup (Google, Slack, M365) and tested recovery runbooks.

 - Scripts and internal tooling. Take over the scripts and admin utilities that live on individual laptops today. Put them in source control, document them and keep them running.

 - Office site standard. Work with Network and AV/Media teams to define the repeatable technical template for new offices: configuration, monitoring and documentation each site copies. Network and AV build execution stays with their owners.

 - Engineering practices. Raise the bar on change control, documentation and runbooks across the pillar, so primaries and backups can cover for each other.

 - Certificates, domains and DNS. Track and renew every certificate IT depends on (Apple Push, SAML signing, SSL, Wi-Fi/802.1X). Work with Network and CorpSec teams to own and manage DNS NS solutions for IT. Build expiry monitoring to avoid surprises.







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 6+ years in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or SRE, with at least 2 years owning shared infrastructure or automation for a SaaS-first company.

 - Strong infrastructure-as-code experience. You've managed real systems with Terraform or similar, in Git, with pull-request review and CI.

 - Solid scripting in Python plus one of Bash, PowerShell or Go. You write code other people can read and maintain.

 - Hands-on with identity and provisioning: SAML, OIDC, SCIM and lifecycle automation in Okta or Entra.

 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP): IAM, accounts and cost basics.

 - Comfort with DNS, TLS and certificate management, and basic enterprise networking.

 - You've built monitoring and alerting that people actually trust, and written runbooks that someone else used successfully.

 - Clear written communication. You can explain a change, its risk and its rollback to non-engineers.


BONUS POINTS

 - Terraform providers for Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf, or config-as-code tools for Intune

 - Serval or similar IT automation platforms

 - SaaS backup and recovery tools for Google Workspace, Slack or M365

 - Multi-site office rollouts across regions, including working with local vendors and ISPs

 - Experience at a fast-growing company where company headcount grew faster than the IT team







COMPENSATION

$153,000 - $210,500 USD

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, LLM Gateway
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

As a Principal Software Engineer on the LLM Gateway team, you will set the technical direction of UiPath’s AI Trust Layer: the gateway through which every UiPath product, and every agent our customers build, reaches models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other commercial and open-weight providers. You will lead the architecture of a secure, globally distributed, high-throughput proxy serving text, image, voice and emerging modalities, with intelligent routing, rate limiting and cost controls, running the same way in our public cloud, in government and sovereign clouds, and in customer-hosted deployments. You will own the LLM infrastructure behind it: sourcing and balancing model capacity across vendors, tiers and regions, with data residency guaranteed in every geography. You will also own how customers see and control AI in their organizations: which models their users and automations can access, including the models they bring themselves, under what conditions, and with what policies, data protection and audit trail. You will raise the engineering bar of the team, work closely with product teams, security, legal and our model vendors, and help shape how we build software with AI agents.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Lead the architecture and technical direction of complex backend and cloud-native services across the UiPath platform.

 - Design scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing distributed systems across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

 - Partner with engineering leaders, architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to shape technical solutions for high-impact product and platform areas.

 - Drive technical planning and roadmap input for complex services, platform capabilities, or cross-team initiatives.

 - Identify long-term scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost challenges, and lead the design of sustainable solutions.

 - Set high standards for system design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, incident management, and engineering excellence.

 - Mentor and guide engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, architecture decisions, and hands-on technical feedback.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and cloud development experience.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more modern programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, or Go.

 - Strong experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native architectures.

 - Proven ability to influence technical direction and drive architecture decisions across teams.

 - Experience building and operating production-grade services in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

 - Good knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, observability, and production operations.

 - Strong understanding of system design, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization.

 - Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, or high-scale data processing.

 - Ability to balance customer experience, reliability, security, scalability, and cloud cost when making technical decisions.

 - Strong technical leadership, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to guide teams through ambiguity.

 - Interest in automation, AI, developer platforms, enterprise software, or large-scale cloud systems is a plus.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

A short note on what you would change to run this in production. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer, AI Tooling Infrastructure to join our AI Tooling team and help build and run the backend services behind Supabase’s AI products. The Supabase MCP server is one example of what the team runs in production, alongside the services that support agent skills and the dashboard assistant. You’ll work closely with the Platform, SRE, Auth, Billing and Edge Functions teams, and with the engineers on the AI Tooling team who build the product surfaces.

The AI Tooling team runs its own services in production and carries its own on-call. Traffic from AI clients and agents behaves differently from traffic from people: hundreds of calls a minute, retry loops, and no reading of deprecation warnings. This role makes sure the services they use are reliable, correctly authorized and observable. It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role. You will build and operate these systems, not only advise on them.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, owns what they ship in production, and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

 - Build and operate the production backend services behind Supabase’s AI products, including the MCP server: deployment, scaling, configuration and release.

 - Take ownership of how those services are structured, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

 - Define, measure and meet reliability targets for the services the team runs. Set SLOs with the SRE team, track error budgets, and use them to decide what to fix first.

 - Participate in the AI Tooling team on-call rotation, and be a first responder for incidents in those services. Investigate, fix, coordinate with other teams during incidents, and write the follow-ups and runbooks.

 - Work the AI Tooling team support queue alongside on-call, and turn recurring issues into fixes rather than repeated manual answers.

 - Own authentication and authorization for AI and agent clients: OAuth apps, scoped tokens, and permissions that make sense for agents as well as humans, including how we change or deprecate a permission without breaking existing integrations.

 - Own observability for the services the team runs: metrics, traces, logs, dashboards and alerts, so we find problems before customers do.

 - Handle capacity and abuse for agent traffic: rate limits, cost and safety controls, and behavior under load or when a dependency degrades.

 - Improve the architecture of the services the team owns as they grow, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

 - Work with the Platform team on shared code, review ownership and release process, and with the SRE team on infrastructure, alerting and incident practice.

 - Contribute to the code of the AI Tooling team’s tools, such as the MCP server, where it affects reliability and security, in partnership with the engineers who own the product surface.



YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

Must have:

 - Have 5+ years of experience building and running backend services in production, and have carried on-call for them.

 - Write strong TypeScript or Go, and are comfortable working in the other.

 - Have designed and operated APIs with real consumers: versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backwards-compatible change.

 - Know OAuth, OIDC, JWT and API authorization well enough to debug them in production and to explain where implementations commonly deviate from the spec.

 - Have a good understanding of PostgreSQL and relational databases.

 - Are comfortable with CI/CD, Docker and containerized deployments, and with infrastructure as code. Any tool is fine.

 - Can debug across services: follow a slow or failing request through several systems using metrics, traces and logs.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Pick your centre of gravity. We expect you to be deep in at least one of these, and to tell us which:

 - APIs and auth: You have designed permission models, token scopes or OAuth flows for third-party or machine clients, and you have migrated them without breaking users.

 - Operations: You have run production services yourself: carried the pager, written alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix, and made shared systems less risky over time.

 - Gateways and distributed systems: You have built or run proxies or gateways, or debugged hard failures across services (retries, partial failures, upstream outages, fail-open vs fail-closed decisions), and you can reason about load and degradation.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with agent tooling (MCP or similar), or serving traffic from AI agents and LLM clients.

 - Experience moving a service out of a larger codebase while keeping existing clients working.

 - Experience with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Logflare or a similar observability stack, and real SLO work.

 - Open-source contributions, especially to Node.js, Go, TypeScript or API tooling.


WHAT WE OFFER

   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer- Databricks AI
jobs.description:
P-1700

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping enterprises that build ML models and AI agents deliver high-quality AI to production fast. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing great developer experiences to building reliable systems at global scale. And we re only getting started.

Our team builds the MLOps and LLMOps platform that millions of AI developers and ML practitioners use to track model training experiments, manage model registry, observe and evaluate AI agents. We re the team behind MLflow, the most widely adopted open-source AI engineering platform with more than 30 million package downloads per month, and its managed service used by thousands of organizations globally. We re now expanding to Bengaluru, India, and building our first AI engineering team there from scratch to work on this platform.

As a Staff Software Engineer and a founding member of the Bengaluru team, you ll be the team s technical lead. You ll set the platform strategy and architecture, drive alignment with partner teams, and lead the team to deliver a world-class MLOps and LLMOps platform, while staying hands-on.

 

Check out our recent blog post: coSTAR: How we ship AI agents at Databricks fast, without breaking things

 

The impact you will have:

  • Define the platform strategy and long-term architecture.
  • Lead engineering efforts from design to production rollout, with high standards for performance, correctness, and reliability.
  • Solve hard problems in ingesting and querying traces, metrics, and artifacts at scale, and in evaluating AI agents in production.
  • Align product, research, and engineering teams across sites on technical direction and trade-offs.
  • Shape APIs and developer experiences that make it easy for customers to ship AI.
  • Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and technical discussions.
  • Represent the team externally through blog posts, talks, and open-source contributions to popular AI frameworks.

 

What we look for:

  • BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems, scaling infrastructure, or building platforms and developer tools for other teams.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and system design.
  • Strong experience with backend technical stacks such as Scala or Java.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Engineering maturity in security, correctness, and operational excellence.
  • Proven track record as a technical lead, driving architecture decisions and delivering complex, high-impact projects end-to-end.
  • Ability to lead through influence across teams.
  • Strong communication skills and a passion for mentoring engineers.
  • Experience with ML or LLM systems is a plus.



About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
