jobs.title: Director Partner Programs & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



Partners are one of Kong's biggest levers for AI Gateway pipeline and bookings, and our partner business is growing fast. Kong is hiring a Director, Partner Operations to build the operating model that helps it scale.

You'll be the operating partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders, sitting in Revenue Operations. You own how partner business flows through Kong — registration, deal structure, attribution, crediting, and payout — and you bring an AI-first mindset to how it runs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business partner to Ecosystem leadership
Serve as the strategic and operational partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders across theaters. Run an AI-assisted operating cadence — forecast and pipeline reviews, QBRs, and executive reporting — where the prep is automated and meetings go to decisions. Facilitate cross-functional alignment on people, then process, then systems, so changes are agreed before they are configured.

Partner GTM strategy & planning
Lead annual and quarterly planning for the partner organization, including targets, capacity, and coverage. Help build a business that maximizes the impact of partner investments and resources. 

Rules of engagement, deal registration & attribution
Own the rules that govern how partner deals are registered, protected, sourced, and credited, including sourced vs. influenced credit, lookback windows, and the line between partner credit and partner marketing credit. Encode them into systems and agents so they apply automatically.

Partner lead & deal workflows: Define and own how partner-touched leads and deals move between ADR, PSD, and AE, including routing, SLAs, and prioritization. Cover partner event leads, prospective partners, existing partners, and deal registrations, and give PSDs one view of the leads that need their action.

Partner deal execution
Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to make partner deals easy to structure, discount, and book across resale, referral, and cloud marketplace routes

Partner compensation & crediting
Partner with Incentive Compensation on channel-neutral crediting and referral fees, so sellers choose the best route to market.

Manage cloud marketplace operations: Own Kong’s cloud marketplace operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including listings, private offers, channel partner private offers (CPPOs), and co-sell registration. Lead the launch of marketplaces in new regions, and manage marketplace dynamics with Deal Desk, Finance, and the cloud alliances team, including fees, customer commit drawdown, and partner involvement on marketplace deals.

Performance insights & data quality
Define and report the partner KPIs that matter, give every partner leader a run-the-business view, and keep partner data accurate.

Partner marketing measurement & MDF
Work closely with Partner Marketing and Marketing Ops to define how partner marketing is measured. Tie MDF and event spend to registered deals by capturing funding source on deal registrations, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately.
Operational playbooks & enablement
Build and maintain the partner operations handbook and repeatable workflows, from partner onboarding to software access, including prospective partner intake and ADR and PSD training on routing rules, so every seller knows the process on day one.

Systems & data architecture
Own partner data design and routing rules. That includes partner account structure, alignment of deal registration approval with lead routing, and alerts when opportunities open on partner accounts. Evaluate whether the PRM remains the right long-term fit.

AI & automation roadmap
Own the Partner Operations AI roadmap: find the highest-leverage workflows, build or buy the agents and automations, and measure the hours returned to the field. Own business requirements for partner tooling across Salesforce, PRM, and CPQ.

Lean, high-output team
Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.

Required Experience:

 - 10+ years in Partner or Channel Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure software company, including 3+ years leading partner operations - with direct ownership of deal registration, rules of engagement, and partner attribution.

 - 3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

 - Hands-on partner deal execution end to end - resale, referral, and cloud marketplace transactions, partner discounting, and order form requirements - in partnership with Deal Desk and Finance.

 - 3+ years experience leading partner planning - targets, quota, capacity, and coverage  and designing channel-neutral crediting with Incentive Compensation.

 - Proven track record as a trusted advisor to VP-level Partner or Sales leaders, with the presence to hold a governance line and the judgment to know when to evolve it.

 - Deep Salesforce fluency (opportunity design, sourcing fields, reporting) plus PRM and BI tools, and hands-on use of AI tools to automate ops workflows.

Preferred experience:

 - Hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace mechanics: AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate, Marketplace private offers, Microsoft co-sell, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

 - Experience supporting a shift to usage-based or consumption pricing and reflecting it in partner deal structures and crediting.

 - Experience leading a team from building processes to running them at scale.

 - API, cloud infrastructure, or AI platform experience.

The Partner Sales Director owns Kong's partner business within the DACH territory. That means recruiting the right partners, building a real go-to-market motion with them, and driving sourced incremental revenue, not slideware pipeline. The PSD is the single point of contact for anything partner-related: for field sellers who need partner help on a deal, for partners who need a path into Kong, and for leadership setting regional strategy. The ecosystem spans channel resellers, technology partners, GSIs, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the PSM works across all four. At the Intermediate level and above, this is a senior individual contributor role: the PSD runs their territory as their own business, in close partnership with the territory's sales leader.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure Foundations
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

 

Infrastructure Foundations builds and operates the multi-cloud platform underneath Temporal Cloud, turning the complexity of AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), and Azure into one cohesive platform the rest of Temporal builds on. Every cell we run is provisioned, managed, and safely changed by systems this team owns. When a customer's workflow runs, it runs on our work. We are heading into the next stage: Kubernetes-based infrastructure platforms built for the next orders of magnitude of growth.

 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to design and build the next version of that platform. You will own a significant multi-component system, from the APIs other teams build on to how infrastructure state is modeled, changed, and recovered, and coordinate the engineers building its parts. You will stay close enough to the code to prove decisions out, build the capability roadmap for this area with the engineering manager, and lead through design reviews and the hardest incidents.

 

What makes this team different



 - Real multi-cloud, not multi-cloud on a slide. We run across AWS, GCP, and Azure and keep extending the platform to new providers. The abstractions you design are the ones every new cloud plugs into.

 - We build Temporal Cloud with Temporal. Cell creation, component deployment, and cloud provisioning run as Temporal workflows. You will shape how Temporal runs its own infrastructure on Temporal.

 - A platform transformation, not maintenance. HA/DR for our control infrastructure, a declarative model for the whole platform, and a deployment control plane, all designed while a live platform keeps running.

 - Everything sits on top of it. Nearly every team at Temporal depends on what we build, so the standards you set for this platform shape how those teams ship.

 

Responsibilities

 

 - Multi-cloud architecture: Design the abstraction model that makes AWS, GCP, and Azure read as one platform. Decide where provider differences in IAM, networking, quotas, and failure modes get absorbed, and how new regions and providers plug in.

 - Own a significant system: Design and build the multi-component platform end to end, and coordinate the engineers working on its parts. Make the system-level tradeoffs between conflicting requirements, and make them explicit.

 - Declarative infrastructure model: Define how components are described, versioned, and reconciled across Kubernetes workloads and supporting cloud resources. Set the approach for reproducible environments, drift visibility, and safe reconciliation.

 - Deployment control plane: Design the shared inventory, dependency awareness, rollout sequencing, and approvals that let many teams change production safely. Keep orchestration and safety policy cohesive while integrating with the frameworks that execute deployments.

 - Reliability by design: Spot architectural flaws before they cost us performance or reliability. Make bounded blast radius, progressive rollouts, observability, load and failure testing, and recovery part of every design. Stay cool in the hardest incidents, then bring what we learn back into the platform.

 - Roadmap and judgment: Build the capability roadmap for this area with the engineering manager. Scope big ideas down into well-understood pieces, evaluate the viability of requests from other teams, and weigh technical and business risk when the path isn't clear.

 - Raise the bar: Define the team's development process and operational best practices. Coach Senior engineers and invest in their growth, lead design reviews, and catch the critical PRs, as a keeper of standards who is seen as a value-add, not a blocker. Help hire the engineers who will build this with you.

 - Cross-team collaboration: Work with Traffic, Control Plane, Developer Productivity, Security, and service owners. Communicate complex designs clearly, influence toward the right course of action, and earn adoption through useful abstractions and dependable operations. Own compatibility and migration as the platform evolves.

 

Qualifications



 - 10+ years building software, including significant time designing and operating distributed infrastructure in production.

 - Production infrastructure experience on at least two of AWS, GCP, and Azure, including building, operationalizing, and scaling Kubernetes-based platforms across them.

 - Deep Kubernetes knowledge: scheduling, controllers and reconciliation, resource management, isolation, and upgrade safety.

 - A record of designing and building a significant multi-component system and coordinating other engineers to deliver it, ideally through a substantial infrastructure transition while production kept running.

 - Proficiency across a diverse set of technologies, with strong coding skills in Go or another systems language. You still write meaningful code.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain complex systems, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive alignment with engineering and leadership.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Required Skills



 - Multi-cloud platform thinking: reusable abstractions that account for provider differences and stay secure, observable, and maintainable.

 - Kubernetes architecture and operations judgment, especially recovery under failure.

 - System-level tradeoffs and good judgment in ambiguous situations, balancing foundational work, customer needs, and unplanned operational demands.

 - Raising the bar through design reviews, code reviews, coaching, and clear technical writing.

 

Preferred Experience

 

 - All three providers. Building and operating infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure, especially bringing a new provider onto an existing platform.

 - Building Kubernetes controllers and operators, including cloud resource controllers like Crossplane or AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK).

 - Upstream open source contributions or maintainer experi

jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



About the Role

Ramp's Advisory & Services channel is one of the most strategically important growth levers in the business. As an Advisory& Services Partner Development Representative (PDR), you'll be the engine behind acquiring, reactivating, and qualifying the consulting firms, System Integrators (SIs), and advisory practices that refer, implement, or integrate Ramp for their clients.



You'll be holding conversations with partnership heads, business development leads,Managing Directors, and practice leads at consulting firms, ERP implementation shops, and strategic advisory practices - building relationships that turn into signed referral agreements and a pipeline of activated partners that are Ramp champions.



This role is perfect for someone who:

 - Is gritty and relentless - comfortable reaching out to firm leaders who are slow to respond and keeps going anyway

 - Carries real executive presence and can credibly hold a conversation with a Partner or MD at a top-tier firm

 - Has a strong client hand - naturally curious about how consulting and advisory firms serve their clients, and speaks their language

 - Thrives when the playbook is still being written and takes ownership of building it

 - Embraces AI to augment and automate processes to drive greater efficiencies for workflows



What You'll Do

 - Source and qualify net new consulting, advisory, and technology partners that can drive referral pipeline and commercial value to Ramp, focused on firms with active CFO-level client relationships

 - Build top-of-funnel pipeline for Channel Partner Managers by qualifying partner candidates against Ramp's tiering criteria and handing off warm, ready-to-activate relationships

 - Reactivate dormant services partners across Ramp's existing book of ~400 consulting, technology, and advisory firms - identifying which relationships have gone cold and reigniting them through strategic, senior-level outreach

 - Identify and engage system integrators (SIs) and ERP implementation specialists - specifically firms in the NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Dynamics, and Odoo ecosystems - to build Ramp's productized SI implementation program

 - Craft outbound messaging and campaigns tailored to services partner archetypes - boutique firms, PE-focused advisory practices, tech consulting firms, and ERP implementation shops

 - Maintain accurate partner and opportunity data in Salesforce; track pipeline health across both dormant reactivation and net new acquisition motions

 - Leverage AI tools and lightweight automations to scale partner outreach, surface reactivation opportunities, and build repeatable workflows across a high-volume partner book



What You Need

 - Grit and drive to run a high-volume, high-quality outbound motion against senior contacts who are hard to reach - and the persistence to keep going

 - Executive presence: you can hold a credible conversation with a Partner or Managing Director at a consulting or advisory firm, and they take you seriously

 - Deep understanding of how consulting firms go to market, how they serve CXO-level clients, and drive influence

 - A client-oriented mindset - you lead with what's in it for the partner's business, not just Ramp's

 - Strong written communication skills - outreach that is pithy, credible, and gets responses from senior people at busy firms

 - Comfort managing a large, segmented partner book and staying disciplined across long reactivation and qualification cycles

 - 1-3 years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or sales development or as a business analyst in a strategy consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG)

 - Bachelor's degree from a four-year university




Nice to Haves

 - Background at - or selling to - consulting firms, strategy practices, Systems Integrators (SIs) or advisory businesses

 - Exposure to ERP ecosystems: NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or similar implementation partner communities

 - Familiarity with how system integrators operate: how they price services, staff implementations, and build revenue relationships with technology vendors

 - Experience working in a partner channel that was still being built - first rep in a motion or early team member in a new GTM track

 - Background in B2B fintech, SaaS, or financial services

 - Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM tools

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (specifically Claude Code), building basic automations (bots, workflows, etc.) to drive efficiency in a sales, partnerships, or business development context




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility

jobs.location: Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt, Germany; Munich, Germany
jobs.description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

The Engine team develops and maintains core components of the Workato Recipe runtime. Scope includes recipe execution, DSL, event pulling, webhook processing, and job execution. The team owns trigger and event infrastructure that defines how integrations start and react to external events. Current focus: modernization of a high-throughput platform to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term evolvability. Work is platform-oriented and directly impacts runtime performance and system correctness.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

  • Design and implement distributed backend systems in Go with deep consideration of performance and memory behavior.

  • Work on runtime-level components operating under high concurrency and throughput.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge of Go internals (scheduler, memory model, garbage collection behavior) to improve system efficiency.

  • Design and optimize concurrent workflows using goroutines, channels, synchronization primitives, and context propagation.

  • Analyze and optimize slice usage, memory allocations, and data structures for performance-critical paths.

  • Improve execution engine for custom third-party code (isolation, performance, feature extensions).

  • Modernize runtime components with focus on modularity, structured architecture, and observability.

  • Improve trigger configuration and execution across webhooks and polling mechanisms.

  • Integrate and optimize data storage solutions (Postgres, S3, DynamoDB, Kafka, ClickHouse).

  • Identify bottlenecks, race conditions, deadlocks, and performance degradation in distributed systems.

  • Own initiatives end-to-end, from design to rollout and production support.

  • Conduct code reviews with emphasis on correctness, concurrency safety, and performance characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior FullStack Engineer - Grafana Catalog | Canada| Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates based in the US and Canada only, within the Eastern or Central time zones.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Grafana Catalog team, you will help grow the Grafana plugin ecosystem. Plugins are how Grafana connects to almost any data source, panel type or app, and the catalog has more than 300 of them from Grafana Labs, commercial partners and the open source community.

We own the full plugin lifecycle. Developers build plugins with our tooling, publish them to the catalog, and users discover, install and update them in Grafana and Grafana Cloud. We are also building the Grafana Marketplace, which lets partners and independent developers sell their plugins to Grafana users. It is in pilot today and you will help us take it from there.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Some of the things we own:

  • The Grafana Marketplace: paid plugins, publisher onboarding, and how customers buy and get access to them
  • The plugin catalog in grafana.com and inside Grafana, where users search, compare and discover plugins
  • Plugin installation and management in Grafana and Grafana Cloud
  • Plugin delivery: publishing, signing, validation and the CDN that serves plugins to every Grafana Cloud instance
  • Plugin review: every plugin published to the catalog goes through our review process before it reaches users
  • Developer tooling and developer portal that helps develop the plugins

A typical “day in the life” could include:

  • Building new Marketplace features across the Grafana frontend, our Go services and grafana.com
  • Improving how users find and install plugins, for both humans and agents like Grafana Assistant
  • Making it easier and faster for developers to build, test and publish plugins
  • Automating and improving the review process that every published plugin goes through
  • Supporting the operations and reliability of plugin installs and delivery in Grafana Cloud
  • Talking to plugin developers and partners and turning their feedback into roadmap items
  • Coming up with suggestions for process improvements
  • Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects.
  • You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward.
  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge
  • You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration
  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company

Requirements:

  • Solid experience with Golang & Typescript
  • Experience with React and building user-facing web applications
  • Experience with Kubernetes & microservices
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SR

jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what s next. For more than a decade we ve helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we re scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role:

As a Member of Technical Staff, Finance Data, you’ll lead the design of the Financial Data Platform that Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations rely on to close the books, report revenue, and forecast. You’ll build auditable pipelines on Kafka, ClickHouse, Tinybird, and Snowflake that turn raw usage into revenue, and set the bar for data accuracy and governance where correctness isn’t optional. Your main focus is a multi-phase roadmap that takes the platform to maturity and audit readiness as the business grows. This is a hybrid role with 3 in-office days per week in San Francisco or New York City.

What you ll do:

  • Design and build the data platform behind revenue recognition, consumption-based billing, and financial reporting, across batch and real-time workloads
  • Set standards for financial data ingestion, transformation, and storage, with auditability, lineage, and data integrity
  • Work with FP&A, Accounting, and RevOps to turn reporting requirements, close-cycle timelines, and forecasting needs into architecture
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit to meet SOX and SOC 2 requirements, backed by monitoring, alerting, and incident response
  • Set the technical roadmap, make build-vs-buy calls on ERP, billing, and revenue tools, and mentor engineers as the team grows

What you need:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field
  • Owned production data pipelines end-to-end on AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Production experience with Kafka, ClickHouse, Tinybird, and Snowflake
  • Built data pipelines that feed financial reporting, revenue recognition, billing, or consumption-based pricing
  • Supported audit, SOX, or SOC 2 requirements for data systems
  • Translated Finance or Accounting requirements into technical architecture

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $264,000 - $396,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Disclosures:

  • Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.
  • Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don t necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Big Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

In this role, you’d be joining the Big Data Infrastructure team. Our team builds and maintains the platforms that power data work across Stripe, managing three core layers:

  • Data Orchestration (Airflow)
  • Batch Compute (Spark, Celeborn)
  • Data Lake (Iceberg, Hive, S3, Azure Blob Storage)

We support over 2,000 engineers and 600+ internal teams, processing workloads that organically grow more than 30% year over year. Our infrastructure handles massive scale, managing over 800 PB of data, running 325,000 applications a day, and accounting for hundreds of millions of dollars in annual spend, directly powering critical pipelines like inbound payments, network reconciliation, and capital underwriting.

What you’ll do

As the technical leader for the Big Data Infrastructure organization, you will guide a 40+ person engineering team to scale our foundational data systems. You will partner closely with major internal customers like Data Foundations, Payins Engineering, and AI/ML Foundations to modernize our tech stack and execute Stripe s transition to the "Agentic Era" - building "invisible infrastructure" where AI agents operate data pipelines end-to-end. 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical leader for the Big Data Infrastructure organization, overseeing distributed systems that manage 20% of Stripe s total AWS spend
  • Execute Stripe s transition to the "Agentic Era" by building invisible infrastructure that empowers AI agents to author, validate, ship, and operate data pipelines
  • Drive the architecture and delivery of critical modernization bets, including YARN to Kubernetes migrations, native vectorization (Gluten/Velox), and Airflow and Data Catalog modernization
  • Lead the implementation of a multi-region and multi-cloud data strategy for high availability, disaster recovery, and Azure Blob Storage compliance
  • Reduce operational burden and maintenance overhead (KTLO) from over 40% to under 10% by shifting fixes into the platform instead of relying on runbooks
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence and mentor engineers at various stages in their careers, up to Staff+

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field
  • This is a Senior Staff role, so ideally 12+ years of professional experience in a software development role
  • A strong engineering background in distributed infrastructure and/or platform services, including one or more of the following: storage, databases, or compute
  • Experience leading projects on a cross-team and company-wide scale, including scaling and migrating systems with little to no downtime
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and debugging distributed systems while optimizing their reliability and security
  • Experience driving a culture of operational excellence, with a deep understanding of metrics, alerts, and dashboards

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience driving AI-led architectural transformations and integrating agentic workflows into large-scale data systems
  • Experience in a development team at AWS, Azure, OCI, or Google
  • Experience with big data infrastructure at scale, such as Spark, Iceberg, S3, Airflow, YARN, and Celeborn
  • Experience with database internals and/or with Kubernetes

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tooling (West Coast Preferred)
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




THE ROLE

Docker's Platform Engineering team builds and operates the cloud-native platform behind Docker's products. Inside the company, teams across Engineering and the business rely on a growing set of internal applications, and each one is built, deployed, and run a little differently.



We're looking for a Senior Engineer to give those applications a common foundation and then build the custom tools the business needs on top of it. You'll create a framework that makes it easy to build and deploy internal tools, including slack bots, web apps, workflows, etc, with authentication, hosting, observability, and alerting in place. You'll use it to build internally-facing tools to support cross-org efforts: roadmapping, headcount management, business reporting, etc. You'll decide when to build, when to buy, and when to integrate an existing product. You'll help shape how internal systems fit together across the company.



This is a hands-on role. You'll own projects from scoping through rollout and adoption, working with platform leads, engineering teams, and business teams such as HR, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Support.

_______________________________________________________________________




WHAT YOU'LL DO


INTERNAL APP FRAMEWORK

 - Build and maintain a framework that makes it fast to create and deploy internal applications and services, with defaults for authentication, hosting, CI/CD, logging, observability, and alerting

 - Provide templates, documentation, and examples so teams can ship their own tools without starting from scratch

 - Set the standards for how internal apps are built, secured, and run, and make the standard path the easiest one

 - Leverage existing systems and sources of truth to build cross-connects where they don’t exist


CUSTOM BUSINESS TOOLING

 - Work across teams and organizations to understand where tools, processes, or systems are falling short, and turn those gaps into proposals that platform leads can prioritize

 - Scope and deliver apps and tooling to address identified gaps

 - Ship early versions quickly, learn from how people use them, and improve them over time

 - Own the tools you build through rollout, adoption, and ongoing support


BUILD, BUY, OR INTEGRATE

 - Evaluate whether a need is best met by building, buying, or integrating an existing product, and recommend one with the tradeoffs

 - Connect tools to the systems the company already uses, such as identity, data sources, and Slack, so they work together

 - Help shape the architecture of internal systems, so they stay consistent and maintainable as the company grows


RELIABILITY AND AI

 - Build operational basics into the framework, so every internal app gets incident management, SLO, and alerting defaults automatically

 - Use AI tooling to speed up delivery and to automate workflows where it adds value

_______________________________________________________________________




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


REQUIRED

 - 6+ years of software engineering, including building and shipping internal tools or full-stack web applications

 - Strong full-stack skills: a backend language such as Go, Python, or TypeScript, and a modern frontend framework

 - Experience designing reusable frameworks, templates, or platforms that other engineers build on

 - Experience deploying to the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with containers and CI/CD, and working knowledge of Kubernetes

 - Sound judgment on build, buy, and integrate decisions, and experience integrating third-party SaaS products and APIs

 - Experience working directly with non-engineering stakeholders to turn a need into a working tool

 - Experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-powered automation

 - Clear written communication and comfort working asynchronously on a remote team

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


NICE TO HAVE

 - Cross-functional experience in program management

 - Experience with internal tool or developer portal platforms

 - Web design experience

 - Familiarity with observability and incident tooling (incident.io http://incident.io, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar)

 - Experience at a developer tooling or SaaS company at scale, and familiarity with compliance and security standards



Visa sponsorship: Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

_______________________________________________________________________




COMPENSATION & EQUITY

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

 

United States: $160,900 – $260,700 base

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

_________________________________

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business.

Responsibilities

  • Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews).
  • Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making.
  • Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management).
  • Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development.
  • Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams.

Who you are

We re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains.
  • Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems.
  • User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways.
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level.
  • Ability to communicate technical content to non-technical audiences and translate business insights into practical recommendations, with a willingness to grow into presenting to leadership.
  • Experience initiating and completing analytical projects, taking a structured approach to solving unique business problems.
  • Experience in Salesforce (or other CRM). Intermediate to advanced SQL and strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills.
  • Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to creatively solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis in a fast-paced, high-volume business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve analytical and operational workflows.

You will manage large, complex technical projects with our strategic customers, influencing both internal product roadmaps and external customer technology frameworks. This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, GPS
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer, Global Public Sector 

Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:

  • Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens
  • Generating high-quality training data for national LLMs
  • Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to join a small team of our most senior engineers who take on the problems no one else can. You will work at the earliest stage of our engagements: shaping the technical approach with clients, defining the technology we build on, and turning ideas into working prototypes fast. You will step in when a project is stuck or a problem is unusually hard, and turn what you learn in the field into shared capabilities every team can build on.

This is a very senior, hands-on role. Our engineering organisation is young, so mentoring is a core part of the job: you will raise the bar for how we design, build and deliver, and grow the next generation of technical leaders around you. The role is based in London.

At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions, we are building repeatable blocks to enable the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a member of our rapidly expanding team, we’d love to hear from you.

You will:

  • Take on the hardest technical problems across our programs, stepping in where projects are stuck or the path forward is unclear
  • Lead the technical side of early engagements: work with clients to scope problems, shape proofs of concept and keep the scope needed to prove value as small as possible
  • Build working prototypes quickly, from AI agents and evaluation pipelines to data and knowledge systems, and take the most promising ones to production
  • Define the technology and architecture our solutions are built on, keeping them cohesive, secure and reusable across clients
  • Mentor engineers across a young organisation through pairing, design and code reviews, and set the bar for engineering excellence
  • Partner with Directors, VPs and client executives to navigate high-stakes business and technical trade-offs, including travel to client sites as engagements require
  • Turn patterns from the field into reusable capabilities, contributing components back to our core platform so every engagement starts further ahead
  • Lead from the front on agentic engineering, both in the AI systems we build and in how our teams use coding agents day to day, and push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI

Ideally you’d have:

  • A strong engineering background, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 10+ years of post-graduation engineering experience, with demonstrated proficiency in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C++
  • 5+ years of experience applying AI/ML in production environments, such as building generative/agentic AI applications, RAG systems or evaluation pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of taking ambiguous, early-stage problems from a blank page to a working prototype and into production
  • Deep expertise in system design and architecture, including experience with cloud-based machine learning tools and platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team or organisation
  • Comfort working directly with clients, from their engineering teams to senior executives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment

Nice to haves:

  • Past experience in a forward deployed engineering role
  • Experience working at a startup, particularly as a founding engineer
  • Experience building and deploying large-scale AI solutions
  • Experience delivering technology programs for governments or regulated industries
  • Experience deploying solutions on-prem or in customer-controlled environments
  • Current or previous UK government security clearance (e.g. SC or DV)

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the foundation for faster, safer innovation.

Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud supports critical enterprise workloads across multiple clouds and regions. As AI accelerates software development, the volume and pace of change are outgrowing what engineers can manually review, coordinate, and monitor. Moving faster requires systems that make understanding, diagnosing, and resolving issues an integral part of how customers and engineers work.

The Observability team builds the telemetry, analytics, and diagnostic platform that helps Snowflake customers and engineers understand the health of their workloads and services, detect problems early, and resolve them quickly. We’re looking for a hands-on, product-minded Principal Software Engineer I to help build an AI-driven observability platform, combining deep distributed-systems engineering with a strong instinct for what customers and developers need.

You will shape technical direction, solve challenging systems problems, and lead initiatives from concept to customer launch across engineering, product, and design. The opportunity is to build a platform where AI agents and engineers detect, diagnose, and resolve issues together, so that growing scale and complexity translate into faster answers rather than more manual investigation.




AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

 - Architect and build distributed infrastructure. Design scalable pipelines and services for ingesting, storing, and querying logs, metrics, traces, and events at very high volume, with predictable cost, low query latency, fault isolation, and clear data-freshness guarantees.

 - Ship observability products to customers. Partner with product management and design to define and deliver customer-facing capabilities, from telemetry collection and alerting to dashboards and diagnostics, that work natively within Snowflake. Turn customer feedback and usage data into product decisions, and own outcomes through launch and adoption.

 - Build AI-driven detection and diagnosis. Develop agentic workflows that correlate signals across the stack, surface anomalies, explain likely root causes, and recommend or take remediation steps. Ground these capabilities in high-quality telemetry and rigorous evaluation so customers and engineers can trust them.

 - Clear written communication, low-ego collaboration, strong ownership, and experience mentoring senior engineers.

Especially relevant: Experience building observability, monitoring, or analytics platforms (logs, metrics, traces, alerting); OpenTelemetry; time-series or columnar storage; AIOps or agentic diagnosis systems; or developer-facing data products.

jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



We're looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our ClickUp Engineering team, with a focus on AI evaluations. You'll own how we measure and improve the quality of ClickUp's AI: building the eval systems that tell us how well our AI is performing, the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals. You'll work on backend systems that make AI-powered capabilities scalable, reliable, and secure, while working hands-on with LLMs to solve real user problems and drive product innovation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Design, build, and own ClickUp's AI evaluation system, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and automated scorers, regression detection, and quality tracking across AI features.

 - Build and evolve the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals, partnering closely with product and engineering to define what "great" looks like.

 - Build self-improvement loops where agents modify other agents or prompts, rerun evals, and iterate automatically.

 - Benchmark new models as they're released and own model selection, routing, and fallback strategies across providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight), balancing quality, latency, and cost.

 - Architect, design, and implement scalable AI platform services that support the deployment, orchestration, and lifecycle management of LLMs and other AI models.

 - Build and maintain robust APIs and backend systems that integrate AI-powered features into ClickUp's core platform.

 - Develop infrastructure for model serving, monitoring, logging, and automated evaluation to ensure high reliability and performance of AI services in production.

 - Drive best practices in AI privacy, security, and compliance, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and regulatory adherence.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data teams to deliver seamless, reliable, and user-centric AI experiences.

 

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or ML systems.

 - Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation systems in production (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, judge calibration, offline and online evals), tied to real product quality.

 - Strong experiment design and statistical rigor, including A/B testing, offline vs. online metrics, and separating real regressions from noisy or variable results.

 - Proven track record of applying LLMs and AI models to real-world, customer-facing product features.

 - Proven experience integrating and managing multiple LLMs, including benchmarking, routing, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.

 - Deep expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

 - Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Go, TypeScript, or similar languages used for backend and AI platform development.

 - Proficiency in orchestration frameworks and workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Airflow, Ray, or similar).

 - Familiarity with search and retrieval technologies and their integration into AI-driven applications.

 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

 - Passion for staying at the forefront of AI and applying new technologies to solve real-world problems at scale.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Background in data science, applied science, or machine learning engineering.

 - Experience with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Weave, Arize, or in-house frameworks).

 - Experience with model routing, AI gateways, or inference optimization.

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. 

Networking Infrastructure is a core part of the platform that powers all our data and AI products. The platform also powers key enterprise security features used by customers across all our products to build connectivity solutions to cloud resources and prevent data exfiltration. And we re setting up the team from scratch in Bengaluru , India.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineers with a networking background to join the Networking Infrastructure team. As one of the seed members of the Bangalore site, you will be focussing on building new backend connectivity services that powers millions of VMs running on Databricks. You will also be leading the design and development of new services that powers the connectivity between our control plane and compute plane. This new platform enables Databricks to increase scalability of our compute plane while also efficiently use cloud resources. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, operations, and other engineering teams, to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and efficient networking systems. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about solving novel multi-cloud and distributed systems challenges.

What we look for:

  • 8+ years of production level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C++, or similar language

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Integration Network (OIN)
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Okta Integration Network (OIN)

The Okta Integration Network (OIN) is the platform that lets Okta customers discover, connect, and manage third-party applications and identity providers — from single sign-on and provisioning to newer, higher-order integration patterns as the ecosystem of connected software (including AI agents) continues to grow. It s core infrastructure: the workflows OIN powers run continuously for a very large share of Okta s customer base.

Our team builds and operates all of OIN — from the foundational data model, APIs, and security posture every integration in the network is built on, to the tools partners and customers use to build, test, and ship integrations, to the systems that power what those integrations can actually do once connected. In practice that spans connector metadata and provisioning primitives, partner-facing tooling, and the infrastructure work that keeps a very large, long-lived system fast, secure, and easy to extend as the network grows.

We re actively expanding OIN s scope beyond its original SSO-and-provisioning core — including new integration patterns as AI agents and machine-to-machine access become part of the identity landscape, and a lower-friction path for partners to bring new integrations into the network. You d be joining at a point where the platform s scope is visibly widening, working closely with product, architecture, and design to help figure out what "right" looks like as much as building it.

Staff Software Engineer, Integration Network (OIN)

As a Staff Software Engineer on the OIN team, you ll be a technical leader for a platform a very large share of Okta s customers depend on every day. You ll independently own complex, ambiguous problems end-to-end — from technical scoping through design, delivery, and production operation — partnering closely with product, architecture, and design to help figure out what "right" looks like as much as building it. You ll also be expected to raise the technical bar for the engineers around you, not just deliver your own code.

We re looking for self-motivated engineers who think from first principles, take pride in high-quality software, and are genuinely kind and collaborative to work with.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Lead discovery and technical scoping for new requirements, turning ambiguous product asks into a concrete architecture, phased delivery plans, and credible estimates, in close partnership with product, architecture, and design.
  • Design and evolve the APIs, data models, and security posture that OIN s integrations depend on, with an eye toward backward compatibility and long-term extensibility.
  • Drive technical decisions across ambiguous, multi-team dependencies, aligning stakeholders across engineering, product, and other parts of the business when the "right answer" isn t obvious yet.
  • Modernize and evolve a large, long-lived production system incrementally without disrupting the customers and integrations that depend on it every day.
  • Maintain a high bar for security, testing, and code quality, including vulnerability remediation and threat-aware design, while keeping a real sense of urgency on customer-impacting work.
  • Own the production health of the systems you build by writing root-cause analyses when things break, driving follow-through on the fixes, and building the observability that prevents repeat incidents.
  • Champion AI-native engineering practices by using AI coding assistants and AI-augmented workflows as a core part of how you design, build, review, and ship software, and helping the team adopt them well.
  • Mentor and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you, and represent the team s technical point of view in cross-functional forums.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a demonstrated history of technical leadership and mentorship.
  • Deep proficiency in Java (our primary backend language) or a comparable strongly-typed backend language/framework, with the judgment to know when and how to modernize a large, long-lived codebase without disrupting the customers depending on it.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating complex, large-scale distributed systems in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including caching, asynchronous processing, and data migrations at scale.
  • Real depth in identity and access protocols (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, and/or SCIM) and the security instincts that come from having built systems that other companies software authenticates against.
  • Experience designing and evolving APIs and integration frameworks that external developers or partners build on, not just internal consumers. You think about backward compatibility, versioning, and developer experience as first-class concerns.
  • Comfortable driving technical direction across ambiguous, multi-team dependencies. You can align product, architecture, and other engineering teams around a plan when the "right answer" isn t obvious yet.

We re hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join the Coinbase Advisor team within the Consumer & Business group. Coinbase Advisor is the world s first RIA-licensed agentic trading system: an AI advisor living inside the Coinbase app that holds a natural conversation about a user s portfolio, gives personalized financial advice, and executes trades on their behalf. This role is primarily backend on a full-stack team. You ll own the services that make agentic trading feel fast, clear, and trustworthy for millions of customers.

  • Build integrations with Coinbase s trading APIs so agent recommendations and user-configured strategies translate into correct, auditable execution

  • Shape agent behavior through prompt engineering, evals, and conversation analysis, partnering with our registered investment adviser on changes to financial advice

  • Partner with frontend engineering, product, design, trading infrastructure, and legal/compliance to ship customer-facing capabilities within regulatory guardrails

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.


THE ROLE:

Airbyte is incubating new product opportunities at the intersection of data, AI, and developer infrastructure. Our small team builds tooling and infrastructure for data practitioners and software engineers, leveraging Airbyte's foundation in enterprise connectivity.

This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We're looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands-on with AI applications or infrastructure. You'll own technical explorations, build prototypes, and take promising ideas through to production.

We're still early. Some of our work extends existing products, while other projects begin as hypotheses that need validation. There's significant room to influence technical direction, challenge assumptions, and help shape what we build next.






WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Airbyte MCP: Build infrastructure that lets AI agents configure Airbyte, troubleshoot syncs, and access data directly from connected sources and warehouses. Design reliable, secure, and observable interfaces across the connector ecosystem.

 - Semantic Search & Retrieval: Build and operate search infrastructure for high-quality retrieval over enterprise data. Improve relevance, latency, and reliability in production.

 - Semantic Models: Develop systems for defining and maintaining semantic models over enterprise data. Help AI applications use consistent business definitions and produce answers that can be verified against underlying data.

 - SaaS Sandbox: Build realistic, stateful replicas of SaaS systems for developing and testing agents. Reproduce API behavior, failures, and state changes so workflows can be evaluated without using production accounts.


EXPLORE NEW PRODUCT OPPORTUNITIES

 - Turn product hypotheses into focused technical experiments. Build prototypes that test feasibility and expose important constraints.

 - Work directly with customers, Product, Design, and customer-facing teams to understand real-world problems and incorporate feedback into technical decisions.

 - Evaluate competing technical approaches and use what you learn to influence product direction.


BUILD PRODUCTION-GRADE INFRASTRUCTURE

 - Design and implement backend systems, APIs, and infrastructure for AI, data, and developer products.

 - Build reliable, observable systems with clear failure handling, debugging, and operational safeguards.

 - Take promising prototypes into production and improve them based on usage, incidents, and customer feedback.


LEAD TECHNICAL DIRECTION

 - Own architecture and execution across technical design, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

 - Lead technical decisions that span teams. Align interfaces and dependencies, and influence architecture beyond your immediate projects.

 - Communicate priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly, and follow through on commitments.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has shipped AI-powered products.

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing distributed systems.

 - Experience building complex systems involving APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency, queues, state, retries, or distributed execution.

 - Hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered products using LLMs, agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, or similar technologies.

 - Experience with orchestration systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or infrastructure products.

 - Strong system design skills and the ability to reason about reliability, scale, observability, and failure modes.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction across teams and influence architectural and engineering decisions.

 - Ability to move quickly from prototype to production without sacrificing engineering quality.

 - Strong product instincts and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 environments.

 - Exceptional written communication skills.

 - A strong bias toward ownership and shipping.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building and operating AI agents in production, including debugging, observability, and evaluation.

 - Experience building agent infrastructure, agent platforms, or evaluation systems.

 - Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, search infrastructure, or semantic models.

 - Experience building developer tools, platform infrastructure, or integrations with third-party SaaS APIs.

 - Experience with data infrastructure such as Kafka, Iceberg, Postgres, Spark, or modern data warehouses.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success is not measured by the number of prototypes we build. It is measured by whether we turn promising ideas into products customers use and infrastructure they can depend on.

You'll help us:

 - Take new ideas from prototype to production and improve them through customer feedback and real-world usage.

 - Build reliable, observable systems that are easier to operate, debug, and improve over time.

 - Use technical experiment

jobs.description:
About Monte Carlo

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at montecarlo.ai https://montecarlo.ai.

 


THE ROLE

We're hiring an Applied Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales) to own the technical side of every new customer from the moment the deal closes until they're live and getting value. You'll write production code in customers' Snowflake and Databricks environments, integrate Monte Carlo with their real pipelines, and become the technical advisor they call before they escalate. This isn't support and it isn't a CSM role: your metric is whether the customer is live and consuming. It's an early hire into a new function, so you'll help write the FDE playbook, not inherit one. Remote (US), with roughly 25% travel to customers.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own deployment from day one post-close: monitors, alerts, and integrations configured for the customer's actual environment.

 - Write production-quality Python, SQL, and API integrations tailored to customer pipelines, and clear whatever stands between a signed contract and a fully operational deployment.

 - Drive customers to consumption. You're accountable for active usage and measurable value, not just go-live.

 - Expand adoption beyond the first champion across teams, data assets, and use cases.

 - Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering so it shapes the core product instead of turning into one-off work.

 - Shape the FDE playbook as an early member of the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Data platform depth. 5+ years building on Snowflake, Databricks, or a modern cloud warehouse as the person who designed and built it, not an end user. Production Python and SQL, and comfortable wiring up REST APIs in someone else's environment.

 - Post-sale ownership. You've owned technical outcomes for enterprise customers after the contract: implementation, solutions or forward deployed engineering, technical onboarding. You measure yourself on go-live and adoption.

 - Range with people. You can run a working session with a room of data engineers and brief a VP in the same week.

 - Builder in ambiguity. You've operated without a playbook and built the structure yourself. You create motion instead of waiting for direction.

 - Nice to have. dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or Looker; data quality, pipeline monitoring, or incident response; a background in data observability or an adjacent category.


THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You want a support queue or a defined playbook to follow.

 - You've only worked pre-sale and never owned what happens after the contract is signed.

 - Your data experience is all internal, with no customer-facing context.

 - You'd rather advise on the stack than write code in it.

#LI-REMOTE

#BI-REMOTE




WHY MONTE CARLO

 - We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust https://montecarlo.ai/agent-trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled

 - Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures

 - Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes

 - Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory

 - Remote-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it

 - Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote-first environment.

Come As You Are

Equality is a core tenet of Monte Carlo's culture. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. 



Monte Carlo is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re leading the data revolution, building the world’s best data and applications platform. Our "get it done" culture empowers everyone at Snowflake to innovate, create lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

Snowflake is rapidly expanding its Systems Integrator (SI) Go-To-Market initiatives. SIs are key to helping customers unlock the power of Snowflake Data Cloud.

Success in this role requires relationship management, program execution, goal-setting, and tracking progress. The candidate will help shape and deliver a strategy to build mindshare with Snowflake’s SI partners.

We seek a candidate with a proven track record of working with large SI partners, strong business acumen, and knowledge of the broader platform ecosystem, products, and competition to be a trusted advisor.

The role requires up to 25% travel within Brazil for partner engagement, enablement, deal support, and marketing events.




AS A SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER - SI PARTNERS, YOU WILL:
