jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Starburst

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

About the role

As a Senior Systems Software Engineer on the Build & Delivery team, you ll own the systems that every team at Starburst ships through — the backend services and infrastructure of one trusted, self-service, increasingly autonomous delivery platform. You will help design and build the core delivery infrastructure, as well as build “the machine that builds the machine” that is used to ship across Starburst Enterprise, Galaxy, and customer-managed deployments at scale. Daily tasks will include developing backend services and infrastructure, building operational tooling, supporting our platform in production, and driving the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of how we deliver software.

The problems are concrete: keep the mainline green by construction, so a red build always means a real defect; provision production-like environments on demand instead of a shared staging bottleneck; deliver testing as a service across every repo; and treat AI as a first responder for test maintenance, failure triage, and remediation.

As a Senior Systems Software Engineer you will:

  • Design and build the core services and infrastructure of the delivery platform, following the immutable cloud infrastructure paradigm, consistent across Starburst Enterprise, Galaxy, and customer-managed deployments
  • Build the merge-orchestration and gating systems that keep the mainline green by construction, including flaky-test detection and auto-quarantine
  • Build Testing-as-a-Service — shared, on-demand test infrastructure, intelligent test selection, and unified coverage and quality gates for every team
  • Build the service that provisions production-like environments on demand, so every change is proven and dogfooded before customers see it
  • Design the AI workflows in the delivery loop — test maintenance, failure triage, and remediation — validated before rollout
  • Own the reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of the platform in production
  • Continuously improve our engineering processes, tests, and systems that allow us to scale the code base and productivity of the team
  • Provide considerate and timely review of your peers pull requests and design proposals

Some of the things we look for:

  • Passion for software engineering, with an interest in build, delivery, and infrastructure engineering in particular
  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend systems in production
  • Experience building for reliability, scalability, and efficiency at scale
  • Experience developing software in Java and Typescript
  • Cloud infrastructure architecture and orchestration experience
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and related tooling such as Pulumi or Terraform
  • Interest in applying AI and agentic workflows to engineering problems, with a validate-then-deploy discipline
  • Prior experience building CI/CD, merge queues, test infrastructure, or ephemeral environments is a strong plus
  • Prior experience in developing for or operating Trino is a plus
  • Demonstration of ownership, grit, and bias for action - core values at Starburst
  • Ability to Travel: This role will require occasional in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

Build your career at Starburst

All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we’re empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry –  and the future. 

Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more. 

We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically.

Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state
 or local laws.

jobs.description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision: 

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.  

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers.

Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

Responsibilities

Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70–80%)

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering.
  • Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO (OIDC/SAML) and RBAC configurations.
  • Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise customer development teams on Neo4j driver optimisation, connection pooling, and retry logic.
  • Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools (logs and metrics) and deliver best-practice guidance on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
  • Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and runbooks—to ensure smooth operational handoffs.

Technical Mentorship & Team Escalation (~20–30%)

  • Serve as the senior technical point of escalation for the onboarding team, unblocking colleagues on complex customer architectures and troubleshooting edge-case issues.
  • Pair with and mentor team members through design reviews, architecture discussions, and customer engagements to continuously elevate collective technical execution.
  • Help balance day-to-day account coverage across the team to maintain consistent onboarding velocity and delivery quality.
  • Synthesise field insights, lessons learned, and reusable blueprints to iterate and optimise our core onboarding methodologies, tooling, and onboarding automation.

Minimum Qualifications

jobs.title: [CONTRACT] Part-Time Sales Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



Location: Remote (100%) with preference for Mountain or Pacific time zone

Contract Duration: 3 months, with possible extension

Hours: 20-30 hours per week

_______________________________________________________________________




ABOUT THE ROLE

Docker is looking for a Sales Compensation Analyst to join our Finance team on a contract basis and support the administrative backbone of our sales compensation program. This is a writing-heavy, detail-oriented role. You'll draft and maintain participation agreements, create clear documentation, and manage SPIFF programs in our compensation system.

If you can turn complex comp plan language into clear, accurate, plain-English documents, and you enjoy the operational side of sales comp, this role is for you.

_______________________________________________________________________




WHAT YOU'LL DO


PARTICIPATION AGREEMENTS

 - Draft, edit, and finalize sales compensation participation agreements and plan documents

 - Make sure plan terms, quotas, payout mechanics, and eligibility language are accurate and consistent

 - Manage agreement distribution, tracking, and signature follow-up

 - Partner with Legal, HR, and Sales leadership to review and approve language


DOCUMENTATION

 - Write and maintain comp plan documentation, process guides, and policy FAQs

 - Create step-by-step procedures for recurring comp admin tasks

 - Keep documentation current as plans, territories, and policies change


SPIFF ADMINISTRATION

 - Set up, configure, and maintain SPIFF programs in the compensation system

 - Track eligibility, calculate payouts, and validate results against program rules

 - Answer SPIFF questions from sales reps and managers

 - Audit program data for accuracy before payouts are finalized


GENERAL SALES COMP SUPPORT

 - Help with commission data validation, reconciliation, and dispute resolution

 - Support quota, territory, and roster updates in the comp system

 - Respond to rep inquiries with clarity and professionalism



_______________________________________________________________________




WHAT YOU BRING


REQUIRED

 - 1-2 years of sales compensation experience

 - Strong written communication skills, with a proven ability to write clear, precise, professional documents

 - High attention to detail and comfort working with plan rules, rates, and payout logic

 - Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets

 - Ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on SPIFF administration experience

 - Experience working in a sales compensation system (for example Xactly, Varicent, CaptivateIQ, Performio, SAP Commissions, or similar)

 - Experience drafting or editing participation agreements or comp plan documents

 - Familiarity with CRM data (Salesforce) and how it feeds comp calculations

_______________________________________________________________________




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Participation agreements go out accurate, on time, and with minimal back-and-forth

 - Documentation is clear enough that reps and managers can find answers on their own

 - SPIFFs are set up correctly and paid without errors or disputes

jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.




THE MISSION:

At Kong, we are pioneering the Agentic Era of service connectivity by building the infrastructure that powers the modern API world. As a Software Engineer on the Konnect Control Plane team, you will architect the next-generation cloud-hosted control plane that manages global customer configurations seamlessly.

Your work will directly empower developers worldwide, ensuring high availability, speed, and seamless connectivity for Kong’s flagship service connectivity platform.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Architect and scale microservices that power Kong Konnect’s cloud-hosted control plane to manage global customer configurations seamlessly.

 - Design, implement, and maintain highly performant, low-latency APIs and services that deliver exceptional Developer Delight.

 - Drive solutions for technical problems of moderate complexity, keeping an active focus on preventing technical debt.

 - Prevent regressions and guarantee product stability by writing robust, automated tests.

 - Own the reliability and uptime of services in production by participating in an active on-call rotation.

 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, Solutions Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to implement impactful business features.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING:



THE TOOLKIT

 - 5+ years of experience working in a team environment to develop, deliver, and maintain complex, distributed software solutions.

 - Solid proficiency in Go (Golang) and designing relational database data models.

 - Practical experience building, debugging, and maintaining microservices architectures at scale.

 - Demonstrated experience performing DevOps monitoring, observability, and supporting a large-scale SaaS platform running on Kubernetes and containerized environments.

 - Working knowledge of L4/L7 proxies such as Nginx, HA-proxy, or Envoy.

 - Firm grasp of API lifecycle management, design standards, and testing frameworks (TDD/automated testing).

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


THE KONG DNA

 - Ownership: You act as a driver, not a passenger, and take complete accountability for the quality of your systems and outcomes.

 - Urgency: You thrive in a high-growth environment, iterating quickly and pushing for results with passion and grit.

 - Collaboration: You break down silos, communicate transparently, and model the true spirit of a team player.


BONUS POINTS:

 - Deep experience with Go standards and writing idiomatic, highly optimized Go.

 - Direct experience with Nginx, OpenResty, LuaJIT, or the Kong gateway core.

 - Experience with cloud-native observability stacks, specifically Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

 - Active contributions to open-source software projects.

#LI-AW1



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Ramp Travel team builds the travel booking and management platform built-in to Ramp. We build the capabilities that allows travelers to stay productive on the road: flight and hotel search, booking and checkout, our agentic travel assistant, and on-the-go mobile trip guidance. We also own the capabilities that ensure companies are spending their travel dollars effectively: travel policy evaluation, supplier and TMC integrations and benchmarking, and data insights.

Growing the sophistication and global reach of the Travel product is a top strategic priority at Ramp. The work this team does directly enables Ramp to to support some of the largest and most interesting customers in the world.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Analytics
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS ROLE?

We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the founding lead of Agentic Analytics, a new team in our Analytics and Data Insights organization, you'll own how Cohere gets answers from its own data: an agentic analytics system that answers business questions over governed data, shows the source, query, and freshness behind every answer, and asks for clarification or declines when the evidence is insufficient.

Agentic analytics is far from a solved problem, and correctness is the hard part. A query that runs can still answer the wrong question. Agents go wrong when a business term maps to more than one table, when data goes stale, and when the right context never reaches the model. The worst failures are silent and plausible: a join that double-counts, a wrong denominator, missing data read as zero. Getting this right takes governed definitions, context an agent can use, and an evaluation bar that decides what ships.

You'll build on work already in motion: an internal analytics agent in pilot on our BigQuery warehouse, which is fed by tested ingestion pipelines and modeled in dbt. In your first year, you'll take it to production for teams across Cohere, one domain at a time, and make it replicable: each new domain stands up with configuration, a fresh evaluation set, and very little new code.

This is a hands-on  staff engineering role reporting to our Senior Director of Data Analytics. You'll write production code and evaluation sets yourself while managing a small founding team that grows as the system proves itself. You may have held the title software engineer, AI engineer, or data scientist; what matters is that you've built a system like this and run it in production.



RESPONSIBILITIES

As the lead of Agentic Analytics, you will:

 - Own the system end to end. Set the architecture for how a business question becomes a governed query and a verifiable answer: interpreting the question, retrieving the right context, applying approved definitions and joins, enforcing the asking user's permissions, and attaching the evidence (source, query, freshness) to every answer.

 - Build and run it in production. Design the core services and write much of the first version yourself: agent-facing data tools (MCP or equivalent), context retrieval, agent skills for analytics, and the APIs that serve answers. Hold them to production standards for reliability, latency, cost, security, and observability. Put it where people already work: Slack, North, IDEs, and other agents.

 - Hold every release to the evaluation bar. Build and run the evaluation harness, and define what correct means in each domain: ground-truth question sets, including held-out cases and questions the agent should clarify or decline; result-level scoring, correct-or-decline rates, coverage, and error severity; and regression tests on every change to context, skills, or models. Nothing ships below the bar, and the call on when a domain is ready for production is yours.

 - Engineer the context layer. Turn metric definitions, approved joins, documentation generated from the code that builds each table, a business glossary, and worked examples into context the agent can use. Every correction becomes a reviewed definition and a regression test.

 - Roll it out across Cohere. Bring domains such as marketing, revenue, finance, and product onto the system one at a time, each with named owners, certified definitions, and its own evaluation set. Measure adoption, accuracy, turnaround, and correction effort against how those teams work today.

 - Make it replicable. Package the tools, skills, context templates, and evaluations, and document them well enough that other teams at Cohere can run the system without you.

 - Hire and lead the team. Bring on the team's first engineers, set the technical bar, review the work, and develop the people doing it.

 - Partner across Cohere. Work with our data platform team on the warehouse and semantic models, our model evaluation team on evaluation methodology, our security team on access, and each domain's owners on definitions and rollout.


QUALIFICATIONS

You may be a good fit, if you have:

 - 10+ years building and operating production analytics or software systems, including technical leadership of a team or of systems that span teams

 - Experience shipping LLM agents to production: tool use, MCP or similar, retrieval and context engineering, guardrails, and observability, with firm opinions on where they fail

 - Hands-on experience building natural-language or agentic analytics (text-to-SQL, analytics agents, question answering over a semantic layer) that real users relied on, and evidence that it was right

 - Depth in evaluating LLM systems: golden sets, result-level comparison, abstention metrics, error taxonomies, and regression testing in CI, plus the judgment to tell a good demo from a system you'd put in front of a CFO

 - Strong Python and SQL, and experience designing and running

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Director - Finance Solutions
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

Finance teams lose hours every week chasing approvals, re-keying data, and reconciling records across systems that don’t talk to each other. As a member of UiPath’s product marketing team, you’ll bring our agentic solutions for the Office of the CFO to market, focusing on the source-to-pay and order-to-cash functions. These solutions orchestrate work across the ERP, procurement, and receivables systems customers already run. Drawing on your knowledge of how finance organizations buy and what they’re measured on, you’ll own positioning, launches, and sales enablement that speak to finance leaders in their own terms.




WHAT YOU’LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Lead go-to-market strategy and launch planning for source-to-pay (invoice processing, procurement, and supplier communications) and order-to-cash (collections and cash application), working with the field marketing and sales teams that bring it to market.

 - Define positioning and messaging for the full CFO buying center, from AP, AR, and procurement leaders to controllers and the CFO, presenting UiPath as the layer that orchestrates work across their existing systems rather than replacing them.

 - Build the sales story and the tools to tell it: pitch decks, battlecards, ROI calculators, demo narratives, objection handling, and sales training.

 - Recruit customer advocates and turn their results into proof points tied to finance KPIs such as DSO, cost per invoice, and on-contract spend.

 - Run buyer research, including personas, buying journeys, and win/loss analysis, and share what you learn with product management to shape the roadmap.

 - Develop the messaging, content, and audience insight behind campaigns across demand generation, field, and partner channels, and support analyst relations.

 - 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 10+ years in B2B marketing, consulting, or product development, ideally including SaaS product marketing for finance, procurement, or order-to-cash software.

 - Deep knowledge of source-to-pay and order-to-cash processes and the finance leaders who own them. Experience in finance operations, shared services, or finance advisory is a strong plus.

 - Working knowledge of enterprise SaaS, GenAI, agentic AI, and automation, including how they integrate with ERP and other systems of record, and the ability to explain them in terms of business outcomes.

 - A track record of successful launches built on sharp positioning, messaging, and sales collateral.

 - Clear, persuasive communication with every audience, from AP specialists to the CFO, in writing, in meetings, and on stage.

 - Experience partnering closely with marketing, sales, partners, product management, and engineering.

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work, such as research, content development, and analysis, is a plus.

 - A degree in business, finance, accounting, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.



Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

jobs.description: Staff Engineer You'll be the most senior engineer on the agents that run finance operations for our customers — designing, building, and operating the autonomous agents that handle accounts payable and receivable end-to-end. From invoice validation and dispute resolution to cross-company negotiation and cash optimization. This is an individual-contributor role at the top of our ladder: no direct reports, full technical authority over the architecture the rest of the team builds on. What you'll do Agent architecture — Design the multi-agent system: agent boundaries, event contracts, orchestration patterns, and the separation between LLM reasoning and deterministic enforcement. LLMs inform; rules enforce. You own where that line sits for every action that moves money, and the authorization gateway that makes it non-negotiable. Agentic dispute resolution — An agent that reads the claim, gathers the evidence from the PO, contract, and delivery record, forms a position, and works it to settlement — negotiating with the counterparty where that's appropriate, escalating to a human where it isn't. Deductions and short pays classified, tied to the underlying claim, and driven to resolution rather than parked in an aging bucket. Agentic dynamic discounting — Agents that continuously price early payment against the cash position on both sides of the transaction, propose terms, and execute them. Static payment terms become a negotiation that runs on its own. Matching and reconciliation — Three-way matching across purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice with configurable tolerances; cash application against bank statements and remittance advices, including partial payments and residuals; the exception paths that follow when any of it fails. Unglamorous but important: The foundation everything agentic sits on. Validation & anomaly detection — Business rule checks, duplicate and near-duplicate detection, pricing discrepancy detection, and anomaly detection across time. Precision matters as much as recall here: a false positive is a blocked supplier and an angry procurement lead. Integration framework — ERP systems first and deepest, then banking APIs, accounting platforms, Gmail, Drive, and Slack. Auth model, credential lifecycle, data normalization. Today each connector is a project; you make the next one a configuration. Compliance & security — Agents operate within a zero-trust model. You'll design how agents verify independently against source data, how outbound content is reviewed, and how the system prevents cascading failures from prompt injection. Plus the European e-invoicing mandates now landing across France, Germany, and Spain, and what EN 16931 means for the pipeline. Platform & data infrastructure — Own the primitives every agent action rests on: an append-only PostgreSQL event store with tamper-evident hash chaining for replay and audit; cryptographic signature verification on agent events and approval chains before anything external fires; the Workflow Constraint Engine that gates payments, emails, and API calls on deterministic policy, not model output; row-level multi-tenancy and tenant-scoped credentials across every data store; attribute-based authorization via Cerbos, evaluated the same way whether the caller is an agent or a human; and the MCP security layer — auth, capability-scoping, rate limiting — for external agent-to-agent access. The engineering standard — Architecture decision records, review bar, on-call, and a clear view of what we deliberately don't build. You'll write the things the next ten engineers read in week one, and you'll spend time with controllers and AP leads watching agents fail in ways no test predicted. What we're looking for 8+ years shipping production systems; currently Staff, Principal, Lead IC, or a founding engineer. You've carried an architecture through a scaling step and lived with your own decisions. Strong systems design thinking — agent boundaries, failure modes, trust boundaries, contract evolution. Money movement is not retry-safe by default and you already know why. Depth in Python and/or TypeScript in production, and deep PostgreSQL: event sourcing, row-level security, indexing tradeoffs, schema evolution under load. Hands-on experience with LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or similar), and document AI (LlamaIndex, LlamaParse, or similar). Strong opinions about when to use an LLM vs. a rules engine vs. traditional ML — and the courage to defend them. Experience designing data pipelines, integration architectures, or event-driven systems in production. Security awareness — you think about what happens when untrusted input meets your pipeline, and about segregation of duties before someone makes you. Technical leadership without a title: reviews that teach, designs that get adopted, engineers who get faster because you're there. Effective use of AI coding tools with strong review skills for LLM integration and auth code. Domain knowledge across the purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash cycle. You don't need all three areas below, but you need real depth in one and working fluency in the rest — enough that when a controller describes an exception, you understand it before they finish: Accounts payable — PO and non-PO invoice intake, coding to GL account and cost centre, approval routing and delegation of authority, three-way matching and tolerance handling, blocked-invoice and exception workflows, duplicate detection, payment runs, payment terms and early-payment discounts, supplier master data and bank-detail verification, period-end accruals for un-invoiced receipts. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing. Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products. We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing. Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn. The role Physical engineering is one of the hardest domains for AI. Designs have to meet standards, calculations must be deterministic and checkable, and a wrong number can end up in a power system or a data centre. CurieOS is built to let agents do real engineering work and to show exactly how every output was produced. The platform team builds the foundation that every workflow, agent and product on CurieOS depends on, and runs it in production for people who need to trust it. Your work sets the floor for how reliable our AI is, and the ceiling for what it can do. This is a small team, and you'll shape what we build as well as how. You'll see the results of those decisions in production within days. If you want a narrow, well-defined slice of a large system, this isn't the role. If you want to own a platform while it scales, it is. How we work We build with agents, not just for them. Everyone on the team works with the latest frontier models and coding agents every day, and token budgets won't hold you back. Part of what we build is CurieOS's ability to work on itself: triaging defects, proposing fixes and opening pull requests for engineers to review. So engineers here spend more of their time on design, review and judgement, and less on typing. If you already work this way, you'll feel at home. If you want to see how far it can go, this is the place to find out. You'll also work alongside our AI researchers, turning cutting-edge research and evals into things that run in the platform and in production. What you'll work on first In your first six months you'll work across the parts of CurieOS that customers have to be able to trust. Like everyone on the team you'll touch most of them, and go deepest where your interests take you: Tenancy, isolation and identity. How CurieOS keeps each customer separate, from shared multi-tenant accounts to dedicated single-tenant deployments. That covers data isolation, SSO and access control. You'll also be an engineering voice in customer security reviews. Release and production. How changes get to production safely: release gates, staged rollouts and rollback, automated smoke tests, on-call and incident response. We ship often, and you'll build what lets us keep doing that without breaking what customers rely on. Agent quality in production. Measuring how well agents perform on real customer workflows, working with our researchers to bring the latest evals into the platform, and using those measurements to decide what is good enough to release. A model or prompt change should have to pass the same gate as a code change. Observability and cost. Knowing the platform is healthy and what it costs. That means SLOs, tracing and alerting, plus cost telemetry and usage metering for every workflow and every customer, so we can see where model and compute spend goes and make deliberate choices about it. Infrastructure and deployment. One standard for how CurieOS is deployed, configured and upgraded in each environment, across our own cloud accounts, GPU capacity and customer-dedicated deployments. Where the platform is going Once those foundations are solid, there's a lot to shape next: Traceable results. Provenance for every number an agent produces: which inputs, tools, models and versions went into it, so our users can check it and sign it off. Agent runtime and context. How agents plan, call tools, manage context across long-running work and hand off to people at the right moment. Durable workflows. Orchestration that survives failures, retries and runs lasting hours, mixing agent steps with deterministic calculations. At Staff level, you'd set technical direction across these areas, not just within one. You'd own one of them end to end, run the design reviews that our research and forward deployed teams build on, make the architecture calls that are hard to reverse, and help shape how we hire and grow engineers. Our stack Python services on Kubernetes, running on AWS plus specialist GPU clouds for heavy compute. Strong engineers from Go, Kotlin, Java or a comparable stack will pick up the language quickly. What matters more is that you've run real systems in the cloud. You'll have most of these Designed and built backend services that other teams or customers relied on, and made the key decisions yourself. Owned a system in production after it shipped: the cloud infrastructure it ran on, on-call, incidents, how changes went out, and the monitoring that told you it was healthy. Built and run something where LLMs do real work for real users, and dealt with the cost, latency and quality trade-offs that come with it. Used coding agents heavily in your own work, with opinions on where they help and where they break. Led a project end to end, made trade-offs you can explain, and raised the bar for the engineers around you. Bonus points Shipped software to external enterprise customers: SSO, tenant isolation, per-customer deployments, security reviews. Run infrastructure as code at scale,

jobs.description: AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk. We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down. Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build. How We Work: AI-First by Design Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity. For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive. About the Team Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Intercept team, which builds the Endpoint Agent and Browser Extension that run on our customers' devices, and the backend services behind them. You'll be a full-system contributor. You'll design and build complex Java backend services and make significant contributions to the agent's Rust codebase and the extension's TypeScript codebase. This software has to be fast, resilient and trustworthy across operating systems and real-world conditions. Java is the foundation. You don't need expert-knowledge of Rust or TypeScript yet, but you must be willing and able to learn them and comfortable working across all three. You'll join a fast-moving team that ships often and cares about correctness, observability and maintainability. What You'll Do Own deliveries and features from start to finish, across backend services, the Endpoint Agent and the Browser Extension Design, build, and own Java backend services in a microservices-based, event-driven architecture Ingest and process high-volume event data from the agents and extensions running on customer devices Expose well-designed APIs used by the Endpoint Agent, Browser Extension, UIs, and external systems Make significant contributions to the Endpoint Agent in Rust across Windows, macOS and Linux, and to the Browser Extension in TypeScript across Chromium, Firefox and Safari Build robust tests, validation tooling and deployment mechanisms for releases that customers rely on every day Investigate and resolve platform-specific issues with precision and speed Work closely with security engineers, other engineers, and product stakeholders to shape technical requirements What You Bring 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, mostly building backend services and distributed systems in the Java ecosystem (Java, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle) Some experience in a systems programming setting, such as Rust, C++, or native software running on user devices A solid grasp of systems programming concepts: memory safety, concurrency, error handling and IPC Experience with Rust or TypeScript is a bonus. You must be willing and able to learn whichever you don't know Strong understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing patterns, messaging systems, and distributed system design Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs and service-to-service integrations Comfortable operating in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments and working with modern observability tooling, logging, and monitoring platforms A track record of delivering performant, reliable and scalable applications Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional teams You Might Be a Fit if You Learn quickly and independently, and are happy with a wide variety of work Understand how the whole system fits together, from backend services to the code running on a user's device, and why architectural decisions matter Know when to move fast and when to slow down, and make careful decisions in security-critical code Test and validate rigorously, and care about building bulletproof software that runs reliably around the clock Have led a technical initiative, or want to grow into leading one Have worked with OS platform APIs on Windows, macOS or Linux, or built browser extensions Have experience building products in cybersecurity, identity, data protection, or enterprise SaaS environments Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better Why Join Us This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions

At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.

Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.

About the team

You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.

Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

  • Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.
  • Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.
  • Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.

jobs.description: Location: Poland, Remote Employment Type: Full-time, B2B Contract Compensation: PLN 12,000–22,000 net + VAT per month About PubNub PubNub powers real-time interactive experiences that drive engagement, retention, and monetization. Our market-leading platform for real-time interactive apps enables customers to efficiently and effectively build, manage, and optimize engaging apps that captivate and delight users. Founded in 2012, PubNub is backed by notable investors like The Raine Group, Sapphire, Scale, Relay, Cisco, Bosch, Ericsson, and HPE. To date, over 2,000 companies worldwide, including Amazon, RingCentral, Gameloft, and DAZN, choose PubNub to build and enhance large-scale apps that launch quickly to engage, monetize, and retain users. At PubNub, you’ll enjoy the freedom of a remote-first environment paired with a collaborative culture designed to support your unique work style, so you can do your best work. About the Role We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to build the AI-powered tools, automations, and integrations that help PubNub's go-to-market teams operate more effectively. This is a hands-on engineering role combining software development, AI agents, automation, and business systems integration. You'll work across Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Customer Success, translating operational challenges into reliable technical solutions. You'll take ownership of projects from discovery and prototyping through production deployment, helping teams reduce repetitive work, improve data quality, accelerate execution, and make better-informed decisions. Success means delivering production-ready tools and automations that are adopted by teams and create measurable business impact. Key Responsibilities Design, build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered tools, agents, and workflow automations for go-to-market functions. Develop internal applications and integrations that improve prospecting, account research, lead enrichment, campaign execution, and customer intelligence. Partner with business stakeholders to understand workflows, identify bottlenecks, and prioritise engineering opportunities. Build and maintain integrations with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and other business systems. Develop and maintain web-based applications and website infrastructure that support Marketing and Growth initiatives. Use LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, and agent-based development workflows to accelerate engineering productivity. Ensure solutions are maintainable, reliable, secure, and suitable for production use. Measure tool adoption, operational efficiency, and business outcomes, iterating based on stakeholder feedback. About You Minimum Requirements Strong professional software engineering experience, ideally involving full-stack development, internal tools, automation, or growth engineering. Hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern web frameworks such as React or Next.js. Strong experience working with APIs, system integrations, and data-driven applications. Practical experience building AI-powered applications, agents, or automations using LLM APIs. Experience taking applications from prototype to production, including testing, deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Ability to understand business problems and independently translate requirements into working technical solutions. Strong ownership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Strong English communication skills and the ability to work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience integrating Salesforce, marketing automation, or revenue operations platforms. Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor. Experience maintaining CMS-driven websites or marketing technology. Familiarity with developer-focused SaaS products, API platforms, or agent-based workflows. Experience developing reusable internal AI tools or agent skills. Why PubNub At PubNub, you'll help power real-time experiences used by millions around the world. What sets us apart is our people-first culture and strong sense of collaboration. Our team values the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, grow their skills, and help build innovative, high-impact technology. We offer competitive B2B compensation and the flexibility of a remote-first environment. We're committed to fostering collaboration, professional growth, and opportunities to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, own meaningful projects end to end, and work closely with teams that directly benefit from your engineering contributions. Ready to Make an Impact? If you're excited about building real-world AI solutions, automating complex workflows, and applying engineering to business challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and help shape how PubNub uses AI and automation across its go-to-market operations. For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world s most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.  

At Cockroach Labs, you ll solve problems that didn t exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.  

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Storage Team to help shape and build CockroachDB’s storage systems. Storage is the foundation of CockroachDB, responsible for the safe, durable and efficient persistence and retrieval of data, on top of which the rest of the database is built. Our team develops and maintains Pebble, an innovative Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree storage engine purpose built for Multi Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) data, and Plenum, the elastic, disaggregated storage layer that separates a cluster’s storage from its compute and allows them to scale independently. 

In this role, you’ll bring deep storage expertise to complex problems spanning Pebble, Plenum, encryption at rest (EAR), CockroachDB’s storage interfaces, and the cloud environments in which they operate. You’ll work hands-on, lead the design and delivery of significant improvements, and help the team make sound tradeoffs among durability, performance, scalability, cost, and operational simplicity.

You Will

  • Work on hard technical problems. Apply your deep knowledge of storage systems to solve technical challenges at the core of CockroachDB and its storage layers.
  • Lead through collaboration. Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify, design, and drive significant Storage initiatives, making tradeoffs clear and building alignment across involved teams.
  • Be a trusted partner across the company. Work closely and collaboratively with other engineers across the database and cloud organizations, product, support, and field engineering.
  • Set the standard for engineering excellence. Raise the effectiveness of the team through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Help the team leverage AI to produce high-quality software in a modern development environment.
  • Ship mission-critical software. Ensure that CockroachDB remains scalable, survivable, and consistent as we continue to grow as a company. We work in Go and Rust, but if you don t know them, you ll learn while you re here.

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you will establish relationships with the Storage team and learn about the Storage team’s domain and CockroachDB architecture. You will ship your first project.

After 3 months, you will be fully integrated into the team and comfortable contributing to the Storage team’s roadmap in partnership with Product. You’ll have built an understanding of the Storage team’s tech stack and feel comfortable with the architecture and components the team develops and maintains.

After 6 months, you will have led a meaningful piece of Storage work and participate in the Storage oncall rotation.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Security
jobs.location: New York City; Seattle; United States
jobs.description:
MongoDB s Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Principal Engineer. The GSO secures MongoDB s products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

The Principal Engineer will serve as a senior technical anchor for the team. This is a deep individual-contributor role that will stay hands-on with hard security and architecture problems, form sharp independent opinions, and know how to debate, align, and commit once GSO has made a call.  

Key topic areas will include collaborating with our product teams to ensure identity and permission models meet customer needs for our new autonomous agent platform and working with integration security teams to push the envelope on automated detection, reproduction, and remediation of security vulnerabilities via AI.  What we need here is depth, judgment, and the ability to build up the bench of senior technical talent around you.

This role can be based out of our NYC office or remotely in the North America region.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain real technical depth in security and in MongoDB s product architecture — compute, network, and storage — deep enough to evaluate actual risk rather than apply generic best practice.
  • Form independent, well-reasoned opinions on security and architecture decisions, and voice them even when they cut against consensus or a leader s default plan.
  • Push teams to move faster when process or over-engineering is introducing complexity without reducing risk — and push teams to slow down when GTM pressure is outrunning a clear-eyed view of the risk.
  • Debate hard, then align, then commit: help the org land on the right call, then execute on it.
  • Seed and grow a working community of senior ICs embedded in security operations, product security, and enterprise security — connecting people, sharing knowledge, and creating the venues (formal or informal) for that to happen.
  • Lead time-boxed, high-stakes, cross-functional engagements such as M&A security due diligence and partner risk assessments, often with incomplete information and a short runway.
  • Draw on your own expertise where it applies, and quickly figure out how to close knowledge gaps elsewhere — staying accountable for the outcome either way.

Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline, including senior individual-contributor or technical-lead experience.
  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep, credible technical expertise in security, plus working depth across compute, network, and storage architecture.
  • A track record of forming and defending independent technical positions, along with the judgment to know when to stop debating and commit.
  • Experience influencing without formal authority, including with management and cross-functional partners, in both directions — accelerating and slowing down decisions.
  • Comfort owning ambiguous, deadline-driven work such as M&A diligence or partner risk reviews, and being accountable for the result even without the full picture upfront.
  • A genuine interest in mentoring and connecting other senior engineers, without needing a management title to do it.

Don t feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.

Nice to Haves

  • Direct experience leading M&A security due diligence or partner/vendor risk assessments.
  • Background spanning multiple layers of the stack (e.g., network and storage, or application and infrastructure security).
  • A history of building or growing technical communities of practice.

Success in This Role Means

  • Leadership trusts your technical judgment on the hardest, most ambiguous calls.
  • Your willingness to disagree — in either direction, faster or slower — makes decisions better, not just louder.
  • A real community of senior security talent has formed around you in GSO.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone.

What is Grafana Cloud? 

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics, Grafana Enterprise Logs, and Grafana Enterprise Traces. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. 

Mimir Squad

Engineers on the team focus on optimizing the efficiency and resilience of processing, storing, and querying metrics at large volumes. These services operate at a large scale and performance is key to keeping the offering competitive and running smoothly.

A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They likely are engaged in a larger project with another engineer, as well as mixing in some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. They are also responsible for writing and reviewing PRs and design documents from other engineers in the squad, shepherding automated release rollouts, and participating in the on-call rotation for their systems.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab s Authentication team, you ll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.

We re an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You ll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab s new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You ll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.

Our projects include:

  • OAuth across Cells: Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells
  • Global identities: One user identity that works across organizations and cells
  • Token consolidation: Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith
  • Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads: OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes

What you ll do

  • Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.
  • Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.
  • Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
  • Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.
  • Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.
  • Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.
  • Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.
  • Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you ll bring

  • Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.
  • Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).
  • Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.

About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on core platform capabilities, improving our existing systems for extensibility and scalability, and building the future of Gusto s Tax platform. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by influencing initial feature specs, understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!

 

About the Team:

Payroll is the beating heart of Gusto’s business. The Tax team ensures Gusto customers remain compliant and confident by managing every aspect of payroll taxes—including setup, calculation, payments, filings, and year-end communications. We design seamless, end-to-end experiences that simplify complex processes and build the infrastructure that keeps taxes accurate and on time. By combining reliable systems with thoughtful design, our team makes one of the most complicated parts of running a business simple for employers. Tax is a stabilizing pace layer at Gusto: continuity and trust are paramount, change is deliberate, and impact is wide. The domain is highly complex and offers the opportunity to engage in system design that simplifies this for customers.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Design, build, and test the platform that supports tax compliance for millions of people
  • Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world
  • Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams
  • Improve the productivity and happiness of our teams with the services, tools, and APIs you build.
  • Build guardrails into the Tax platform that enable Gusto to safely leverage agentic AI to interact with tax concepts in a way that ensures compliance, accuracy, stability, and reliability. 
  • Engage in a highly supportive environment working with others to drive productivity and innovation
  • Own and drive the technical strategy and roadmap for your team’s domain area in alignment with team and group-level OKRs
  • Identify and prioritize long-term investments to improve foundational systems and architecture
  • Lead improvements to incident response processes, tooling, and culture to enhance system reliability and team effectiveness
  • Mentor and develop engineers on your team working to create holistic and scalable solutions. Track record of elevating team capabilities through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience
  • Experience in designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages
  • Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products 
  • Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code
  • An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems
  • Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs
  • Enthusiasm for a highly collaborative, test-driven environment
  • Able to build maintainable, structured, well-documented code 
  • Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software
  • Experience building products in highly regulated and high risk domains
  • Experience in one of these domains is preferred: Payroll, Taxes, or Compliance
  • Familiar with current AI tools (LLMs, Agents) and their shortcomings / benefits
  • Embeds AI in daily development workflow (scaffolding tests, summarizing docs) to measurably reduce cycle time.
  • Mentors engineers on effective AI usage and helps develop an AI strategy for other engineers 
  • Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React
