Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

  • Samsara is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join our Developer Experience team within the larger Developer Experience organization. We are responsible for the ‘outer-loop’ of the SDLC, with a dotted line to our sister team Dev Agents, who is responsible for the ‘inner-loop’.
  • We are building an AI-enabled software factory that transforms how Samsara moves code from pull request to production. We use AI to eliminate repetitive steps, shorten feedback loops, and help engineers spend more time on ensuring intent. Our systems provide AI-assisted PR auto-approvals, risk-aware reviews, and automated workflows that help changes become merge-ready. We are extending that intelligence through CI and CD with AI-assisted deployment checks, production validation, and automatic rollbacks. Our goal is to enable our engineers to scale out their productivity by making the ‘outer-loop’ autonomous while keeping it safe, observable, and reliable by default.
  • We tackle this ambitious goal from two different angles. First, we ensure our agents have the most context and their own sandbox to reduce the amount of guessing an agent needs to do in order to reach its result. Second, we ensure production is bulletproof, such that the blast radius of any issue is as minimal as possible. Our north star motto is “Merge and forget”.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role, you will: 

  • Help scale our in-house CI/CD systems to meet the needs of a rapidly more efficient engineering organization and increasing pull-request throughput.
  • Reduce tech debt using efficient AI workflows that would otherwise be cost prohibitive in a non-AI workflow. 
  • Design and build deployment safeguards that protect production at scale, making use of AI to monitor and fix issues.
  • Build the observability, evaluation, and feedback systems used to improve our AI-driven automation.
  • Serve as a thought leader for using AI to increase engineering productivity while maintaining a high bar for safety, quality, and signal over AI-generated slop.
  • Redefine the outer loop of the SDLC by designing AI-native workflows that increase engineering throughput without compromising reliability.
  • Push the threshold of what is possible with AI by turning emerging capabilities into safe, observable, and production-ready engineering systems.
  • Partner with product engineering teams to reduce operational toil, and make safe, AI-enabled delivery practices easy to adopt across the company. Ensuring their specific team needs are met.
  • Help keep Samsara at the cutting edge of AI-assisted software development by experimenting boldly, learning quickly, and converting successful experiments into platforms used across the company.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience designing and building products in a software engineering team
  • Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years of experience working on developer experience, CICD and/or platform engineering-focused teams
  • Experience in building AI workflows, orchestration systems or other harnesses of AI
  • Proven track record in architecting CICD systems, build and deploy platforms, and automated response workflows, Buildkite (or equivalent BYOC software).
  • Proven experience working on large-scale enterprise software applications
  • Experience in building and maintaining a large organization s Software Development Life Cycle (DevEx) 
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or the like)

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial.

As one of our principal privacy engineers, you will be among Anthropic s most senior individual contributors on privacy. You will set technical strategy for how personal data is handled across products, research, and infrastructure, and execute the hardest parts of delivering it. You ll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, distributed systems, and AI safety, on problems without established answers. You will lead through influence, quality of thinking, and trust rather than formal authority.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and drive technical strategy and architecture for major areas of privacy, spanning product surfaces, research and training data, internal tooling, and multiple clouds
  • Identify and lead the highest-complexity, company-critical privacy initiatives, guiding engineers across many teams. Be comfortable building the most difficult pieces yourself
  • Architect the primitives that make privacy the default and the safe path the fastest one: data discovery, classification, lineage, purpose-based access control, audit, retention, deletion, and export
  • Turn regulatory, contractual, and consent obligations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act) into enforced, continuously verified technical controls in partnership with Legal, Policy, and Compliance team
  • Anticipate where AI capabilities, regulation, and customer expectations are heading, and position our systems ahead of them
  • Mentor and develop staff and senior staff engineers, raise the bar for privacy design across engineering, and help hire senior privacy talent
  • Represent Anthropic s privacy engineering to customers, regulators, standards bodies, and the research community

Minimum qualifications

  • A track record of operating as a Principal engineer or equivalent: setting technical direction that multiple teams adopted, and delivering company-critical, multi-year initiatives
  • Deep experience applying privacy engineering principles in production systems with a large user base, including privacy by design, data minimization, and purpose limitation
  • Experience architecting data governance infrastructure (classification, lineage, access control, retention, or deletion) across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages; you are effective writing design docs, making architectural calls, and coding in critical paths
  • Understanding of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, and the ability to work as a peer with legal and policy experts to turn requirements into technical designs
  • Written and verbal communication that builds alignment across engineering, research, legal, and product teams, up to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building privacy infrastructure or controls for machine learning or AI systems, including training data governance or AI agents
  • Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, secure enclaves, secure multi-party computation)
  • Experience establishing or re-architecting a privacy engineering practice under enterprise-customer or regulatory scrutiny
  • Experience briefing executives, auditors, regulators, or enterprise customers on privacy risk, and defending your recommendations under challenge
  • A history of growing engineers into Staff-level and more senior roles
  • Contributions to open-source privacy tooling, privacy research, or industry standards

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Sandbox Secrets (West Coast)
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




THE ROLE

As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the local and cloud sandboxed environments that make interactive and autonomous agentic workflows trustworthy by default. At the heart of our trust model is the fact that user credentials and other sensitive secrets are injected at the sandbox layer and never exposed to an agent. An agent can never leak secrets it never sees.



The Secrets team builds the software that makes that possible, from easy-to-use SDKs to secure cloud services to high-performance network proxies. We operate at the intersection of the developer experience, enterprise governance, and security – delivering core security features that make Docker sandboxes the best way to run agents and other workloads safely.



As a Staff Software Engineer on the Secrets team, you’ll design and build core security systems that power Docker’s agentic platform and AI governance products. Your work will focus on creating scalable, reliable, and secure software that enables developers to safely run agentic workloads while allowing administrators to confidently manage their organization’s security posture.



The successful candidate is a technical, product-minded engineer with deep experience building secure software and scale-out cloud services and a track record of shipping critical infrastructure. They think naturally about isolation and security boundaries, understand the tradeoffs involved in running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads safely, and can reason confidently about a system that spans multiple surface areas.



If you thrive on solving security and usability challenges, are enthusiastic about agentic development but conscious of the risks it entails, and want to help shape the future of Docker’s platform, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: this role is currently prioritizing candidates currently located in the Western time zone (US or Canada).

_______________________________________________________________________




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop, and lead improvements to the secrets management and credential injection systems.

 - Investigate and resolve security, correctness, performance, and stability issues across cloud, macOS, Windows, and Linux.

 - Collaborate with peers, Product, and adjacent teams to evolve the architecture as requirements grow.

 - Mentor engineers on the team and set the bar in design reviews and code reviews.

 - Engage with the open source and agentic development community around sandboxing, MCP, and related ecosystems.

 - Participate in on-call rotations and respond to critical stability issues affecting users.

 - Document your work clearly and share knowledge with the rest of the team.

_______________________________________________________________________




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems at scale.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - Experience building developer tools, desktop applications, or runtime infrastructure used directly by developers.

 - Familiarity with the agentic software development ecosystem: how coding agents work and how tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents interact with their environment.

 - Ability to reason about isolation and security boundaries: what a sandbox should and shouldn't expose, and how to make safe defaults obvious to users.

 - Experience driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineers or teams.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy in a remote-first environment.


PREFERRED

 - Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and/or Java

 - Experience with cryptographic key management systems and techniques (key wrapping, HSMs, cloud KMSes, etc.)

 - Familiarity with best practices for protecting credentials and secret material at-rest and in transit

 - Understanding of networking, TLS, HTTP, and the like.

 - Understanding of one or more OS-specific credential management capabilities.



Visa sponsorship: Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

_______________________________________________________________________

 


COMPENSATION & EQUITY

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.



United States: $170,350 – $275,550 base

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer - West Coast
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.



As a Staff Solutions Engineer, you will help the sales team drive revenue growth by evangelizing our technology via demos and technical discussions. You will get to collaborate with infrastructure engineering and security teams at the most sophisticated technology companies in the world. Most importantly, you will help these companies solve problems and get exposed to the latest ideas in technology.

You will partner with account executives, other solutions engineers, and other teams to understand customer challenges, design secure and scalable solutions, and guide prospects through technical evaluations and proof-of-value engagements. You will support our most strategic accounts.

While this role is fully remote, candidates must be based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to ensure alignment with our customers.

You have experience working with AI technologies and infrastructure (LLMs, MCP, vector databases, AI tooling), and familiarity with traditional infrastructure networking and security (Linux/Unix, Windows, VPNs, bastion hosts, etc) and modern cloud-native technologies (cloud compute, containers, IaC, etc).

What You'll Do

 - Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to expand technical discovery, and map Teleport’s capabilities to customer initiatives.

 - Architect and deliver compelling demos and proof-of-concepts that showcase Teleport’s differentiation with Zero Trust principles, handling of human and non-human identities, identity governance, and identity security.

 - Act as the trusted advisor to engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and security leaders.

 - Advise on protecting sensitive datasets and model endpoints with Teleport’s identity-based controls.

 - Position Teleport as a solution to eliminate API keys and static tokens in machine pipelines.

 - Support customers exploring AI/LLM use cases, including secure infrastructure for training and inference workloads.

 - Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on feature gaps and market needs.

 - Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership around identity, human, non-human, and AI security.

 - Support channel and technology partners with technical enablement.

 - Help across various go-to-market activities, including marketing collateral, product positioning, customer interviews, sales cycle optimizations, traveling to conferences, brand evangelism, attending meetups, etc.

 - Listen deeply and perceive feedback as an opportunity to improve.

 - Demonstrate a high level of empathy, resilience, and humility.

What You'll Bring

 - 8+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, DevSecOps or a highly technical customer-facing role.

 - Experience with using/configuring/debugging Linux machines and network issues.

 - Strong understanding and experience with Kubernetes, including hands-on troubleshooting.

 - Strong knowledge of at least one cloud computing platform

 - Strong knowledge of DevSecOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and securing infrastructure at scale (e.g., source control, code reviews, unit testing, agile principles).

 - Advanced understanding of identity security and modern Zero Trust security approaches.

 - Proven ability to develop scripts and automation using Linux shell, Go, and Infrastructure as Code tools

 - Strong understanding of system architecture, provisioning, and administration

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM infrastructure (GPU clusters, data governance, inference workloads, ML pipelines) and associated security requirements.

 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues

 - Ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders with credibility and clarity.

 - Strong presentation, demo, and white-boarding skills.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities

You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working pre-sales to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers.



Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will drive compelling technical evaluations and proof-of-concept engagements. This will ultimately accelerate deal velocity and increase win rates while helping to shape competitive positioning, sales strategy, and product roadmap feedback.



GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programs in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC program needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on.



What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta:

 - Own the technical relationship with our customers

 - Develop a deep understanding of our product capabilities, integrations, configurations messaging, partner ecosystem, and competitive landscape.

 - Listen carefully to prospects and clients to provide market feedback to the product team and help prioritize functionality needed to drive sales opportunities

 - Support customers thought their trial process with Vanta

 - Build product examples, documentation, and other critical resources for our customers

 - Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement

 - Creatively identify and help drive new programs to improve the pre to post-sales transition



How to be successful in this role:

 - Have 3+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, technology consultant or equivalent title

 - Ideally have prior experience in the GRC space or cybersecurity domain

 - Have previous B2B SaaS experience

 - Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture

 - Have strong project management skills with a proven ability to operate in a startup environment that lacks structure of a larger organization

 - Be creative, technical, and naturally persuasive

 - Be detail-oriented and organized.

 - Love listening to customers, discussing strategy with colleagues, but also diving into the weeds.

 - Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus

 - Be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

 - Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



ClickUp's mission is to make the world more productive. As we build an all-in-one productivity platform that helps teams plan and do their best work, dependable sales incentives help our go-to-market teams stay focused on customers and growth. The Senior Sales Compensation Manager sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales, and Revenue Operations, making variable pay accurate, understandable, and dependable.

 

The Role

 - Own the monthly commission calculation process for sales roles, translating approved plan rules and sales data into accurate payout results delivered on schedule.

 - Reconcile source data and compensation-system records, investigate discrepancies, and document calculations and adjustments so payout results are clear and auditable.

 - Own the investigation and resolution of complex commission exceptions, identify root causes, and partner across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Payroll to implement lasting improvements to processes and controls.

 - Maintain accurate compensation plan and participant data in the compensation system, and flag missing or inconsistent inputs before they affect payouts.

 - Respond to sales representatives' and leaders' questions with clear explanations of how plan rules were applied, and coordinate resolution of pay discrepancies.

 - Partner with FP&A, Sales, Revenue Operations/Sales Operations, and Payroll to manage handoffs and keep recurring commission workflows reliable.

 - Identify repeated errors or manual steps and recommend practical improvements to controls, documentation, and processes.

 

Qualifications

 - Hands-on experience calculating, validating, or administering sales commissions or other variable-pay programs; experience owning a complete payout cycle is especially relevant.

 - Experience using AI tools and building AI-powered workflows to streamline sales compensation calculations, reconciliations, and reporting, with the ability to validate outputs for accuracy and protect confidential compensation data.

 - Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills, including working with detailed datasets, formulas, reconciliations, and error checks.

 - Careful, methodical approach to validating inputs, tracing variances, documenting assumptions, and protecting confidential compensation information.

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain calculations and policy details to sales and finance partners in plain language.

 - Collaborative approach to working with Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Payroll teams.

 

Desirable

 - Experience with a sales compensation platform such as CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly, or a similar system.

 - Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM, sales quota and attainment data, or quota adjustments.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Paying vendors is one of the most manual, error-prone jobs in finance. Invoices arrive by email and PDF, get keyed in by hand, wait on approvals, and then have to be paid on time, by the right method, for the right amount, and recorded correctly in the books. A single mistake can mean a late fee, a duplicate payment, or an unhappy vendor.



Ramp's Bill Pay team builds the accounts payable system that automates that work end to end: bill intake and parsing, approvals, payment execution by ACH, check, card, and international transfer, vendor credits, and sync to customers' accounting systems. Bill Pay is one of Ramp's fastest-growing products, and businesses rely on it every day to move large amounts of money.


We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own a core part of that system. You'll take responsibility for an area such as payment execution, bill intake and AI-powered extraction, approvals, or accounting sync, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and reliable as volume grows. You'll work closely with product, design, and payments partners to make accounts payable faster and more trustworthy for finance teams.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and evolution of a core Bill Pay system, such as payment execution, bill intake, approvals, or accounting sync, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Build payment workflows that move money correctly across ACH, check, card, and international rails, with strong safeguards against duplicate, late, or incorrect payments

 - Build AI-powered AP automation, including invoice extraction, auto-coding, and agents that reduce manual review for finance teams

 - Design data models that keep every bill, approval, payment, and credit accurate and traceable through to the general ledger

 - Build reliable integrations with ERPs and accounting systems that stay consistent through retries, partial failures, and edits on either side

 - Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of Bill Pay systems as customers process larger payment volumes

 - Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time

 - Strong system design judgment, especially around correctness, idempotency, and reliability in systems where mistakes have real financial impact

 - Product sense: you care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering



NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with accounts payable, payments, money movement, or other financial systems

 - Experience building integrations with ERPs or accounting systems, such as NetSuite or QuickBooks

 - Experience applying LLMs, OCR, or other automation to document processing or financial workflows

 - Experience scaling high-volume, event-driven systems

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Product team at Harvey, you'll play a critical role in designing and building new backend systems while equally scaling and strengthening our existing infrastructure. Our backend infrastructure is the foundation that powers every user interaction with Harvey — processing billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests across our global legal AI platform.

You'll work in an environment balanced between innovation — building new systems — and operational excellence, ensuring that Harvey remains resilient and efficient as it scales products, regions, customers, and usage. Your contributions will directly impact the reliability, scalability, and security of our platform as we serve the world's leading law firms and professional service providers.

This role is based in Bengaluru, India.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend infrastructure systems that power Harvey's AI platform across multiple cloud regions

 - Own and evolve our multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP), including Kubernetes orchestration, networking, and container management

 - Lead technical initiatives around observability, incident response, and operational excellence — building systems that enable rapid detection and resolution of issues

 - Architect and optimize our distributed systems for reliability, including load balancing, quota management, and failover mechanisms

If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda. We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box. You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings. Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works. This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes. What You Will Do Vulnerability management : triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release. Threat modeling and security reviews : run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions. Code analysis with LLMs : use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong. Build internal security tooling : contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself. Help engineers do the secure thing by default : answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop. On-call and incident response : share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents. Support the wider team : help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits. What You Will Bring to the Role Around 3+ years in security or software engineering , with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count). Experience at a SaaS or software product company , working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments. Hands-on vulnerability triage : you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration). Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services. You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review. You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security. Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists. Nice to haves Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools. Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus. Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation. Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes. Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse). Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance. As domain experts, we proactively develop and disseminate reference infrastructure, best practices, knowledge, and tooling across all technical teams at Dataiku. As a key contributor to the deployment of our core product, the team actively participates in development initiatives related to infrastructure and Linux system interactions. We foster a collaborative environment and seek a like-minded individual to engage in highly collaborative projects. Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with diverse teams throughout the company. This position is based in Paris and may be considered for remote work. Your responsibilities: Design, deploy, and manage our core product based internal data platforms. Design, deploy, and configure production environments for multiple web services. Collaborate with teams to architect technical solutions, and subsequently deploy and manage those solutions. Develop core product features around cloud services and Linux integration. Guarantee optimal service capacity and robust security for all running workloads and services. The role might be a good fit if you have: Proficiency in infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform. Expertise in container technologies and managed Kubernetes clusters. Advanced scripting skills in Python. Field experience with Linux operating systems and low-level system troubleshooting Practical experience in networking and compute within a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Demonstrated resilience in resolving complex technical challenges, with a relentless pursuit of root cause analysis. Bonus point for any of these: Experience in implementing authentication and authorization systems, including LDAP, SAML, and OAuth2. Experience with configuration management tools as Ansible, Puppet or Chef. Knowledge of additional programming languages, particularly Go, considered a strong asset. Experience in networking and compute across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP). What are you waiting for! At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. jobs.description: About You You’re a self-starter who thrives on tackling the toughest and most meaningful problems, even if they are the most difficult problems. You’re comfortable with the unknown and understand that #startuplife means that you’re going to be wearing multiple hats. And that’s what motivates you. You’re accountable and obsessed with improvement, both in yourself and in others. You’re up to the challenge of building a world-class company that aims to be the infrastructure for more secure software for all. About the Company CertiK leads blockchain security by protecting smart contracts and blockchains with cutting-edge Formal Verification technology. Founded by Computer Science professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK has audited and secured over $500B in assets, including many of the world’s top blockchain projects. About the Role The primary responsibility of this role is for CertiK’s security-related services. Intersecting cybersecurity and blockchain, CertiK’s security offerings include security consulting, security reviews, security auditing of smart contracts and blockchains, verification of smart contracts, penetration testing, and more. As a Security Engineer at CertiK, you will contribute to the security offerings of the company, working with the rest of the security team to deliver the best products and services. You might engage directly with CertiK’s existing and future clients, participate in expanding security-related products and services, and follow the blockchain world on emerging security problems and trends. Responsibilities Conduct in-depth security evaluations on blockchain nodes, validators, consensus mechanisms, mempool behavior, networking layers, and chain modules. Review and analyze blockchain frameworks such as Cosmos SDK, CometBFT, Geth, Hyperledger, and other L1/L2/L3 infrastructures. Identify security issues related to consensus safety, chain halting, permission models flaws, block production vulnerabilities. Implement and run custom scripts and test scenarios to simulate real-world validator/network behaviors, chain stress conditions, and edge cases. Requirements Strong written and spoken English communication skills. High diligence and strong attention to detail, especially in multi-step testing and long-running experiments. Solid understanding of blockchain architecture and node internals (e.g., Cosmos SDK / CometBFT, Go-Ethereum (Geth) internals, and Hyperledger Fabric / Besu) Strong scripting & automation skills with Python or Bash Familiarity with Docker and containerized testing environments. Prior experience in manual Web3 security auditing is preferred, but not required. What We Offer Opportunity to shape the national conversation on blockchain and security. Collaborate with industry-leading security researchers, technologists, and global institutions. Flexible work environment and mission-driven culture. Compensation Additional Information Compensation: If the role is performed in the US, the target annual compensation is $120,000 - $180,000. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates. #blockchain #startups #hiring CertiK accepts applications for this position on an ongoing basis. CertiK is proud to offer medical, vision, and dental insurance, 401(k) plan with company matching, life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, HSA (with high deductible plan), FSA, and other benefits to all full-time employees, along with flexible paid time off and holidays. CertiK also offers a variable commission program for business development sales roles. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. CertiK is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of age, race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, medical condition, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status or civil partnership/union status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, genetic information, military and veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state or local law. jobs.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. Location: Remote (US East Coast/Central) As our team and customer base grow, we need to make sure our security efforts scale accordingly. For that, we are looking to expand the Synthesia Infosec team by onboarding an additional Security Engineer (L6)! You will report to the Head of Security and work within the Security Operations team. Key Responsibilities: Build and own deeply technical security improvements across our Cloud Infrastructure(s) and associated territory (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD), including shipping production changes yourself when needed. Design, implement, and iterate on detection and response capabilities (SIEM, EDR/MDR, cloud-native detections, CNAPP) with an engineer’s bias for automation, reliability, and measurable outcomes. Hunt, investigate, and respond to security alerts and suspicious activity end-to-end (triage → containment → eradication → recovery → learnings), including writing tooling and detection logic to prevent recurrence. Build internal security tooling and automations (IaC, scripts, integrations) that reduce toil and raise the security bar by default. Experience & Qualifications: You’re a deeply technical security engineer with a builder/hacker mindset, able to go from idea → prototype → production and comfortable making changes directly in Cloud Infra / DevOps systems. You have 5+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, ideally in a cloud-first SaaS environment. Have worked in a fast-growing startup, scale-up and/or SaaS company We would expect you to have experience in: Cloud security engineering in AWS and/or GCP, with the ability to implement improvements hands-on (IAM, networking, compute, storage, logging). Kubernetes security (cluster hardening, workload isolation, runtime security, policy controls) and container ecosystems. DevOps fundamentals: CI/CD security, secrets management, artifact integrity, and secure-by-default platform patterns. Incident response and investigation, including creating repeatable playbooks and automating response where appropriate. Strong programming/scripting ability (Python or similar) plus comfort with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and automation. Serious agent coding - ideally you’re on the bleeding edge in the space. Endpoint security tooling, such as CrowdStrike Bonus points for: Hands on experience with any/all of: Hunters, Wiz, Falcon, Tracebit, Torii, Okta, Google Workspace, StrongDM, Github, StepSecurity, Dope Security Any relevant Information Security certification, e.g AWS Certified Security, GIAC GWEB, OSCP, or CSSLP. The good stuff.. In addition to being a part of a great team, working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer: A competitive salary + stock options in our fast-growing Series E startup Remote-friendly environment 100% Medical, Dental & Vision 401k Plan Paid parental leave 25 days of annual leave + Public holidays + paid sick leave Fun culture with regular socials A generous referral scheme A brand new computer + monitor Budget and support for conference travel, community events, and content production

jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: About 3Y Health 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry. About the role Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. What you'll do Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex Our stack Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot Must-haves 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built. At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply. What we're looking for A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure Comfort working in a large, established codebase Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar) Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit. Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets. Nice to have Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR) Temporal or another durable workflow engine React Native Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent Open-source work or internal tools that other people use If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Mobile Monetization) | Feeld
jobs.description: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of Feeld , GT is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help them improve their inclusive dating application. About the Client Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. The technology stack of the project: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL/REST, TypeScript, AWS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, SQS, EventBridge, WebSockets. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Mobile Monetisation) to take ownership of the backend systems powering Feeld's subscription and in-app purchase experiences across iOS and Android. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with mobile monetisation platforms such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or similar solutions , as well as integrating mobile payment flows with custom backend services. This includes managing subscription lifecycles, synchronising payment data, handling receipts, and ensuring accurate entitlement management. We're looking for a highly experienced, proactive engineer with the potential to act as a technical lead , capable of independently driving complex technical initiatives, contributing to architectural decisions, and ensuring the reliability and scalability of revenue-critical systems. 📌 Full-time, long-term ⌛️ Preferred immediate start Responsibilities: Take ownership of the backend systems supporting Feeld’s monetisation, ensuring their reliability, performance, and contribution to business goals. Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and integrations for subscriptions, billing, payment processing, entitlements, pricing, and promotional features. Ensure the accuracy, stability, and reliability of monetisation flows, proactively identifying and resolving production issues that could impact revenue or user experience. Support the development and optimisation of subscription and payment flows, including improvements to system performance, scalability, and error handling. Implement and maintain feature flags, testing, and analytics instrumentation to support experimentation and continuous improvement of monetisation features. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to build and improve analytics and reporting capabilities, providing insights into revenue performance, user behaviour, and system health. Essential knowledge, skills & experience: 5+ years of commercial backend development experience , ideally building high-load, business-critical systems. Proven experience with mobile monetisation and subscription platforms , such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or comparable solutions. Hands-on experience implementing mobile in-app purchases and subscription flows for iOS and/or Android applications, beyond web-based payment integrations. Experience integrating mobile payment platforms with custom backend systems , including payment data synchronisation, receipt handling, subscription status tracking, and entitlement management. Strong understanding of mobile subscription and payment lifecycles , including renewals, cancellations, refunds, failed payments, and subscription state changes. Experience ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of revenue-critical backend systems , including troubleshooting production issues. Strong backend development experience with Node.js or TypeScript or JavaScript , ideally using NestJS and building GraphQL or REST APIs. Good understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems . Experience writing reliable unit and integration tests . Strong technical ownership, independent problem-solving, and architectural decision-making skills, with the potential to take on technical leadership responsibilities . Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English. Nice to Have Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure , SQL and NoSQL databases. Our current stack includes ECS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, and PostgreSQL. Experience working directly with Apple App Store and Google Play billing ecosystems . Experience running monetisation experiments , including A/B testing, subscription pricing changes, and conversion optimisation. Experience managing regional pricing, multiple currencies, and country-specific monetisation strategies . Experience analysing the performance of monetisation experiments, including revenue, subscription conversion, and retention metrics. Previous experience acting as a Tech Lead or Lead Backend Engineer , mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions. Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Staff Backend Engineer, Identity Threat Protection

 

The Identity Threat Protection Team

Identity Threat Protection (ITP), powered by cutting-edge Okta AI, shatters the mold of traditional login security. We deliver real-time, surgical defense against the most sophisticated and rapidly evolving threats. By deeply integrating with existing security infrastructure, ITP relentlessly analyzes user behavior and system data to proactively hunt down and neutralize risks before they impact our customers.

Join an elite team of full-stack engineers, visionary data scientists, and pioneering ML engineers. We are not just redefining cloud authentication—we are engineering the next-gen security platform that continuously evaluates global threats and constructs a comprehensive, dynamic risk. ITP stands as the uncompromising guardian of trust and security, placing decisive risk prioritization at the core of every authentication and authorization decision.

Identity Threat Protection with Okta AI

The Staff Software Engineer Opportunity

Okta is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to be a driving force on the ITP engineering team. This is your chance to dive into the deep end and solve the most critical and complex security challenges facing enterprises today. We seek a candidate who has not just experience, but a proven record of designing, building, launching, and scaling world-class security products—from concept to global deployment.

You will be a technical cornerstone of a team that lives and breathes elegant solutions and uncompromising quality. Our philosophy is rooted in relentless automated testing, rigorous code reviews, and the design of systems for massive, planetary-scale operations. As a Staff Engineer, you are a player-coach and a standard-setter, demonstrating absolute excellence in software engineering.Our environment is high-speed, fiercely innovative, and highly autonomous, utilizing agile cycles where individual ownership is paramount. If you crave stimulating, mission-critical security projects, pioneering emerging technologies, and conquering complex security and Machine Learning challenges, this is your defining career opportunity.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Architect and Lead: Command the design, development, delivery, and supportability of cloud-native security products—leading the charge from initial concept to final, production-ready implementation.
  • Drive Collaboration: Build solid, cross-group partnerships and demonstrate exceptional interpersonal communication, working closely with engineering, product management, design, support, and documentation teams.
  • Uphold Excellence: Commit to the highest programming standards through rigorous code reviews and the creation of comprehensive unit and functional tests.
  • Lead Remote Teams: Excel at working with remote teams and individuals while relentlessly ensuring product quality, agility, and velocity.
  • Mentor and Empower: Act as a player-coach to mentor, groom, and educate junior engineers.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a demonstrated history of technical leadership and mentorship.
  • Deep expertise in Java, including a strong understanding of object-oriented design, multithreading, and building high-performance services.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating complex, large-scale distributed systems in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • A strong grasp of architectural patterns for scalability, reliability, and security, with the ability to lead technical design discussions and make informed trade-offs.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently debug and remediate issues in complex, unfamiliar codebases and systems.
  • A proactive and ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to manage your own priorities and spot areas for future work.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a history of working effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful products.
  • A powerful security background and a proven track record of championing best practices.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

  • Experience building anomaly detection systems or risk systems is a monumental advantage.
  • Expertise in cloud security, identity, and/or authentication protocols.
  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js) is a plus.

jobs.title: Principal Enterprise Architect (Germany), German speaking
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

This is a role based in Germany. We welcome applicants German speaking open to relocate to Germany.

The Role:

We are looking for a curious, smart, and “learn it all” Architect with proven experience and a passion for designing transformative solution architectures for our prospects and customers. This high-impact role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise and executive presence, requiring you to confidently present to C-level executives and translate their strategic goals into actionable technical plans. You will work with technical teams at our prospects and customers to design architectures that drive enterprise modernization, leveraging techniques like capability mapping and exploring innovative solutions with Agentic AI.

Your primary goal is to support our growing sales team in achieving revenue goals by unlocking technical blockers and partnering closely with our Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams. You will be responsible for supporting engagements with new prospects as well as existing customers that look to expand their footprint. Measures of success include new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and contribution to overall sales team and business success.

The work you’ll do:

  • Lead and define the overall architecture, data, and cloud strategy for our largest client accounts, leveraging expertise like enterprise modernization and capability mapping.
  • Confidently engage with and present to customer C-level executives, aligning their strategic objectives with the Celonis technical strategy.
  • Drive innovation by identifying and architecting solutions that leverage emergent technologies, including Agentic AI.
  • Be the bridge between our product & engineering teams within Celonis and the client s teams to provide the best technical services.
  • Assess the IT landscape maturity of our customer installed base for the region.
  • Participate in pre-Sales and post-Sales phases by engaging with customer Architecture and security teams.
  • Coach and guide Celonis consulting teams and ecosystem partners on technical implementation issues such as architecture, integration, performance, and scalability.
  • Develop re-usable assets for the consulting teams on projects.
  • Develop customer-facing position papers, assets, and thought leadership presentations on architecture and innovation with Celonis.
  • Create technical designs and presentations for internal and client stakeholders.

This position can be based in either Munich, Berlin or Frankfurt.

The qualifications you need:

  • 10 to 15 years of relevant experience (e.g., Software vendor Architect, CTO at a top consulting firm, or Enterprise Architect at a customer).
  • Proven ability to think strategically, connecting technical solutions to business value and customer objectives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of presenting complex technical concepts and strategic visions to C-level executives.
  • Demonstrated experience in Capability Mapping, Enterprise Modernization, and a strong understanding of Agentic AI
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS solutions, ERP (SAP Salesforce, Dynamics CRM, ServiceNow), cybersecurity posture fundamentals, API ecosystems, along with legacy on-premise enterprise architectures.
  • Strong background in Data Architecture, Integrations patterns, and a development background in data-related languages (SQL, Python, etc.)
  • Strong technical background with a focus on system integrations, data operations, and automation capabilities.
  • The ability to comfortably switch from explaining an architecture diagram to an environment where you have coded or assembled a demo of that architecture.
  • MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent in an Information Technology-related field.
  • Fluency in German and English is required; an additional language such as Spanish, French or Italian is a strong advantage.

Additional qualifications preferred:

  • Celonis Certifications and Experience with OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
  • AWS/Azure/GCP Certifications.
  • ESB / ETL Certifications (Mulesoft, Oracle, SAP, Talend, Informatica).
  • TOGAF/Zachmann Certification.
  • Experience in at least two domains among: Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Customer/Consumer Management (Service, Order Management, Sales), HR, Procurement.
  • Experience in at least two industries among: Consumer Goods, Banking, Pharma, Aerospace, Telco, Transport.

jobs.title: AI-Native Staff Product Designer, AI + Compute
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

As AI agents move into production, they need a foundation that keeps them running through failures, retries, and long waits. Temporal is that foundation, and building AI-native experiences on top of it is paramount to where we are headed. We're looking for a technical, AI-native Staff Product Designer to shape how developers build, run, and scale agents on Temporal, from the agent platform and harness down to the compute and workers that execute them.

You'll design with AI and for AI. You use AI as a core part of how you work, and you bring that fluency to the products developers use to run AI in production. You're comfortable going deep on how workers execute tasks, how compute scales, and what it costs, and you turn that depth into experiences that feel simple. This role owns a focused domain while spanning the full developer experience, well beyond our UI.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design the experiences developers use to build, run, deploy, and observe agentic workloads on Temporal, across Agent Platform, Agent Harness, and Serverless Workers.

 - Shape the compute experience end to end, from configuring and scaling workers to understanding usage and cost.

 - Create future state prototypes with your design leadership that show where Temporal's agent and compute experiences are headed, giving Product and Engineering a concrete vision to align roadmaps around.

 - Work across the surfaces where developers meet Temporal, including the Cloud UI, CLI, SDKs, and documentation.

 - Design with AI as a daily practice, using it to explore, prototype, and test ideas faster, and bring that perspective into product decisions.

 - Partner with PMs and Engineers from discovery through delivery to define problems, validate direction, and ship at Temporal's pace and scale.

 - Contribute to and extend Temporal's Design System for agentic use cases, keeping our expanding product surface consistent.

 - Bring rigor to ambiguous, technical problem spaces, translating infrastructure complexity into interfaces that feel simple and clear.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 8+ years of Product Design experience, including senior or staff-level ownership of complex, technical products, with a track record of influencing product direction through strong execution.

 - A solid understanding of compute and infrastructure concepts such as workers, scaling, queues, and resource usage, and the ability to discuss them credibly with engineers.

 - A portfolio that shows systems thinking and 0→1 work in developer tools, B2B or infrastructure products, dashboards, or similarly dense, data-heavy interfaces.

 - Experience designing AI-powered products or agent experiences.

 - Fluency with AI tools like Claude or Codex in your own design workflow, along with comfort in GitHub and terminal environments.

 - Hands-on experience with Figma.

 - Experience partnering directly with Engineering on technically constrained problems, ideally in developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or platform products.

 - Experience instrumenting and analyzing product usage to inform design decisions.

 - A bias for building. You prototype quickly, often in code or with AI, and you move through build, ship, learn, and iterate cycles in days rather than weeks.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Working knowledge of distributed systems, workflow orchestration, or durable execution concepts.

 - Experience with serverless platforms, container orchestration, or cloud compute products.

 - Familiarity with agentic AI patterns and the challenges of running agents in production.

 - Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and comfort reading code.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.
