jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - West Coast
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.



As a Solutions Engineer, you will help the sales team drive revenue growth by evangelizing our technology via demos and technical discussions. You will get to collaborate with infrastructure engineering and security teams at the most sophisticated technology companies in the world. Most importantly, you will help these companies solve problems and get exposed to the latest ideas in technology.

You will partner with account executives, other solutions engineers, and other teams to understand customer challenges, design secure and scalable solutions, and guide prospects through technical evaluations and proof-of-value engagements. You will support both mid-market and enterprise customers. 

While this role is fully remote, candidates must be based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to ensure alignment with our customers.

You have experience working with AI technologies and infrastructure (LLMs, MCP, vector databases, AI tooling), and familiarity with traditional infrastructure networking and security (Linux/Unix, Windows, VPNs, bastion hosts, etc) and modern cloud-native technologies (cloud compute, containers, IaC, etc).



What You'll Do

 - Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to expand technical discovery, and map Teleport’s capabilities to customer initiatives.

 - Architect and deliver compelling demos and proof-of-concepts that showcase Teleport’s differentiation with Zero Trust principles, handling of human and non-human identities, identity governance, and identity security.

 - Act as the trusted advisor to engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and security leaders.

 - Advise on protecting sensitive datasets and model endpoints with Teleport’s identity-based controls.

 - Position Teleport as a solution to eliminate API keys and static tokens in machine pipelines.

 - Support customers exploring AI/LLM use cases, including secure infrastructure for training and inference workloads.

 - Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on feature gaps and market needs.

 - Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership around identity, human, non-human, and AI security.

 - Support channel and technology partners with technical enablement.

 - Help across various go-to-market activities, including marketing collateral, product positioning, customer interviews, sales cycle optimizations, traveling to conferences, brand evangelism, attending meetups, etc.

 - Listen deeply and perceive feedback as an opportunity to improve.

What You'll Bring

 - 3+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, DevSecOps or a highly technical customer-facing role.

 - Experience with using/configuring/debugging Linux machines and network issues.

 - Strong understanding and experience with Kubernetes, including hands-on troubleshooting.

 - Strong knowledge of at least one cloud computing platform

 - Strong knowledge of DevSecOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and securing infrastructure at scale (e.g., source control, code reviews, unit testing, agile principles).

 - Advanced understanding of identity security and modern Zero Trust security approaches.

 - Proven ability to develop scripts and automation using Linux shell, Go, and Infrastructure as Code tools

 - Strong understanding of system architecture, provisioning, and administration

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM infrastructure (GPU clusters, data governance, inference workloads, ML pipelines) and associated security requirements.

 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues

 - Ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders with credibility and clarity.

 - Strong presentation, demo, and white-boarding skills.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities



Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Territory Account Executive - Germany
jobs.description:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Southern Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts, from established Mittelstand to larger companies, and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart or Munich, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Knowledge of the industrial, financial and Mittelstand landscape in Western and Southern Germany.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

#LI-CH2 #LI-remote

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World s AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

  • Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

  • Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

  • Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

About The Team

The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku s corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.

The team s expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku s business operations.

 

About The Role

As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.

 

What you ll be doing

  • Design, develop and deploy scalable web applications and services, being part of everything from contributing to web technology and framework stack, to use case and data model design
  • Drive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timeline
  • Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure the application meets compliance, security and audit requirements
  • Participate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies/services, and process
  • Define and participate in Agile development process, including scoping, technical design, estimation effort, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance and support
  • Collaborate with cross-function teams and demonstrate great communication skills

 

We re excited if you have

  • 5+ years of experience in delivery multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web application
  • Deep understanding in software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structures
  • Extensive experience in developing microservices using Java, Python
  • Good experience in Test driven development and automating test cases using Java/ Python
  • Experience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database design
  • Demonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needs, entrepreneurial spirit
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Experience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache Spark
  • Experience in developing Finance or HR related applications
  • Experience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, Lambda
  • Working experience with Terraform
  • Experience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow

What s Roku s approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days a week attendance.

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Strong system design : distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability. Strong AI affinity. Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from. Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture ; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck. jobs.title: Tech Lead - Platform
jobs.description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. About the Platform squads Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product : our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us. You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on. Your mission You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself: Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it. Your impact Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks. What we're looking for This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room. You'll need: A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate) Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records) A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating A track record of leading senior engineers by example , not by leaving the keyboard Nice to have: Running a team as an internal platform (adoption metrics, internal NPS, deprecation, roadmap) Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development) Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context French is a plus, not a requirement If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist. What we offer A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities Your interview experience Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min) Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min) Case Study onsite 1h30 / 2h Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO) Offer + References , run in parallel Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack, JavaScript)
jobs.description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build high-quality products using Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. You will operate across architecture and delivery, taking ownership of systems while also guiding teams and driving technical direction. What We’re Looking For Day-to-Day Responsibilities Design and build end-to-end applications across frontend and backend. Define system architecture, APIs, and data models for scalable products. Lead technical discovery by understanding systems, constraints, and opportunities. Guide engineering decisions and support other engineers through design and code reviews. Partner with product and design to shape solutions from idea to implementation. Write and review code with a focus on quality, performance, and maintainability. Communicate clearly with stakeholders on approach, progress, and risks. Drive delivery while helping maintain a high technical bar across the team. Required Skills & Experience 10+ years building production-grade applications with real-world complexity. Experience operating as a technical lead or owning significant parts of a system. Strong expertise in JavaScript or TypeScript, React including Next.js, and Node.js. Experience building full-stack applications across frontend and service layers using modern TypeScript frameworks such as React, React Native, or NestJS. Experience designing and building APIs using REST and GraphQL. Strong experience working with databases and data modeling across systems such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or DynamoDB. Strong understanding of system design, application architecture, and scalable system patterns. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience with deployment, CI/CD, and infrastructure practices such as Terraform or similar. Ability to clearly explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience producing clear architecture documentation and guiding implementation. Strong ownership with the ability to drive problems end-to-end. Nice to Have Experience operating as a technical lead or owning end-to-end systems Experience building AI-enabled product features or integrating ML systems Experience working in client-facing roles or multi-project environments Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed. Payments made in USD. 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years. Wellness + Remote Stipend AI Voucher About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

East Coast

Midwest

Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Associate Director Specialists to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives within our Retail vertical to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

The impact you will have

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You ll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team s dedicated software engineer, you ll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You ll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana s multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Code Forge
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Developer Productivity organization works to make Stripe the most productive place of an engineer’s career. The Code Review team builds the tools and processes that help Stripe engineers review and ship code safely and efficiently. We treat engineers’ attention as a valuable resource, building tools that help them understand changes and focus on the decisions that need human judgment.

Our goal is to build an AI review agent that outperforms human review at preventing problems after changes merge, while helping developers move quickly. We are also moving code review from GitHub to Orbit Diffs, Stripe’s own review interface, and enabling Stripe’s migration from legacy source control infrastructure to new systems, including infrastructure built at Stripe.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of problems across the code review domain, set technical direction, and build alignment across Stripe. You will combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering to build the systems that determine which changes can be approved by agents and when human judgment is needed. Your decisions will influence both the pace and safety of changes across Stripe.

You will work across user interfaces, backend services, source control integrations, and agent harnesses. Our team works primarily in Go, Ruby, and TypeScript, and you will use the technologies each problem requires. As AI capabilities evolve, you will experiment with new approaches and turn them into reliable, maintainable tools for developers.

Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for code review, build alignment across Stripe, and mentor engineers as you lead complex projects from problem definition through delivery and adoption
  • Build and improve agent harnesses that enable review agents to exercise judgment and safely approve pull requests
  • Develop evaluations that compare agent and human review decisions, assess the safety of merged changes and the impact on developer velocity, and guide improvements to approval decisions
  • Evaluate and apply advances in AI and agent orchestration to accelerate engineering delivery across Stripe while maintaining review quality, maintainability, reliability, and change safety
  • Build and maintain Orbit Diffs and the surrounding code review tools, helping engineers understand changes and focus their attention where their judgment is most valuable
  • Improve code ownership, intelligent reviewer assignment, stacked pull request workflows, and controls for change management
  • Support Stripe’s migration to new source control infrastructure by adapting code review workflows and integrations
  • Partner with security, compliance, infrastructure, reliability, and language and runtime teams to improve how software changes are evaluated and approved across Stripe

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic s products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help.

We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can t or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners.

Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product.

Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn t unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that s the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask.

As one of the team s early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person.

This is a hands-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform.

Key responsibilities

  • Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem
  • Make our support agents reliable first responders: Build the tools, APIs, and safe, audited workflows our Claude-powered support agents use for common fixes, with evals, guardrails, and clean handoffs to people, and measure whether customers problems actually get solved
  • Build the platform foundations: Create a reliable support platform that scales with our growth, including the experience and tools for customers and specialists, and the data that shows what customers are running into and whether our changes help
  • Support enterprise and partner channels: Extend support to business customers, admins, and partner-sold customers, including cases that start outside our own products
  • Raise the bar and build with Claude: Set standards for reliability, observability, testing, and rollouts, mentor engineers, and use Claude heavily in your own work

Minimum qualifications

  • Deep backend and distributed systems skills, including APIs, data models, event-driven systems, and third-party integrations
  • Experience building production software, including technical lead roles on multi-team projects
  • Experience building systems where correctness, access control, and auditability matter
  • A clear vision for how capable models like Claude can improve customer support, and motivation to build it
  • Judgment about when to ship a simple fix and when to invest in a platform
  • Track record of leading without formal authority and getting other teams to own and ship fixes

Preferred qualifications

  • 8+ years building backend or platform systems in production, including 3+ years leading large-scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead
  • Experience building and improving customer-facing products with measurable impact
  • Experience with billing, payments, or subscription systems
  • Experience shipping LLM-based or agentic systems in production
  • Experience building with helpdesk or contact center platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, or Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Experience building internal tools or platforms for operations teams such as support, risk, finance, or trust and safety
  • Experience building data pipelines for support or operations analytics
  • Full-stack experience, including web UIs for internal tools or customer-facing flows
  • Experience with enterprise features such as SSO, admin controls, or provisioning, or with partner and cloud marketplace integrations
  • Experience setting multi-year technical direction for an area and growing other senior engineers

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform Infrastructure - Dublin
jobs.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io http://www.astronomer.io.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

Astronomer’s products run on a complex, multi-cloud platform — and the scalability, and operational maturity of that platform is what we’re actively investing in. The work ahead on our Platform team isn’t about managing data or curating pipelines; it’s about building the foundational systems that everything else runs on — the kind of systems where the failure modes matter, the latency budgets are real, and getting it wrong has visible consequences for hundreds of enterprise customers.

We’re looking for a Staff-level engineer who has built production platform systems at scale before — not just consumed them. You’ve designed systems under load, reasoned carefully about failure, and made your colleagues’ lives better by giving them something solid and well-understood to build on top of. You write strategy documents and then write the code that proves them out. You’ve driven a decision through, and lived with the consequences.

This is a foundational role at a consequential moment: your work will directly shape what Astronomer’s products — Astro, Observe, and our IDE — are capable of over the next several years.


WHAT YOU GET TO DO

Astronomer has a healthy and complex infrastructure estate spanning multiple cloud providers, a mix of managed and self-hosted systems, and an increasingly ambitious set of requirements as our products evolve. We have a clear sense of where we need to go; we need the right person to figure out how to get there and then go build it.

This is a deeply technical role with a high bar for code, so you’re an experienced developer, ideally in Go. A substantial part of your impact also comes from setting direction: design docs, proposals, and bringing along teams you don’t manage. Prefer heads-down coding most of the week? This role may not be the best fit.

 - Blaze a Trail: Own and develop our platform infrastructure strategy, with the sponsorship and responsibility to match. Map out what we need, build the case, bring the affected teams along, and own the outcomes.

 - Be an Owner: Be directly involved in deciding what we work on and how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.

 - Do Sensible Things: Make principled build vs. buy assessments and advocate for the right tools for the right job — not the fashionable ones, not the ones already in the estate just because they’re there.

 - Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation and decision records for systems and processes. Participate in architectural forums and make principled, open decisions that the rest of the organization can learn from and hold us to.


IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?

 - A small, senior team. No direct reports; you lead through influence, not management.

 - Broad scope. Our control plane, CI/CD, builds and releases, observability, secrets and networking, with internal teams as your customers.

 - Buy-in, not authority. You’ll often need agreement from teams you don’t manage.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

 - Distributed systems depth, grounded in practice. You have a solid working model of how production systems fail — consistency and availability tradeoffs, failure cascades, backpressure, graceful degradation. You can draw the diagram, explain the failure modes at each node, and make a reasoned argument for which ones actually matter in a given context. NALSD https://sre.google/workbook/non-abstract-design/ thinking is how you naturally approach a new system design.

 - Kubernetes at operator depth. You know what happens inside the scheduler and the control loop when things go wrong, because you’ve been there. You’ve operated clusters under real load, not just deployed workloads onto them.

 - Strong Go proficiency. The platform team writes production Go. You should be fluent: you’ve built and shipped systems in it, and you have opinions about what good Go looks like.

 - Multi-cloud experience, not just multi-cloud exposure. You’ve made considered architectural decisions across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure — not just consumed managed services, but evaluated tradeoffs between them and lived with those decisions in production.

 - A track record of influence without authority. You’ve taken a proposal to teams you don’t manage, handled real pushback, changed minds with evidence, and known when and how to escalate. You can tell us specific stories about it.

 - Generalist platform breadth. You’ve worked hands-on across several of: Kubernetes, CI/CD, builds and releases, observability, networking and secrets management, rather than going deep in just one.

 - Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a design doc that changes minds, and a postmortem that makes the organization smarter. You’ve worked effectively in a globally-distributed team.


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience with storage primitives at the system level — you’ve reasoned about when to reach for a relational store vs. an object store vs. something else, and you have real opinions informed by real failures.

 - Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.

 - Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration systems.

A note on level: titles vary a lot between companies, and we level on scope of influence, not title.

Staff Software Engineer, Storage

Location: Bellevue, WA

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We're at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world's greatest data and applications platform. Our 'get it done' culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

About the Team:

Snowflake's mission is to mobilize the world's data by building the greatest data and applications platform. Not just of the cloud era, but in the history of computing. To support this mission, the Storage team focuses on building the world's best storage platform. That means enhancing value-added services such as disaster recovery and AI integrations, and providing enterprise-grade, cloud-native storage for containerized workloads, especially in the fast-growing AI space.

We are seeking an outstanding Staff Software Engineer with a passion for large scale databases and distributed systems to help drive our continued growth. In this role, you'll connect customer needs with the business and technology, and act as a technical leader who helps the team carry out its vision.

We are at an inflection point as we continue to scale the footprint and expand the TAM of Snowflake through new and Neo Clouds onboarding, changes in the workloads, and need to simplify in order to enable Snowflake customers to unlock their full data potential.

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

 - Translate business and customer needs into technical designs that deliver new capabilities to existing and new Snowflake customers

 - Drive innovation in how table data is stored, accessed, and processed in the Snowflake cloud

 - Architect, design, and implement new systems and solutions that advance the Snowflake Data Infrastructure platform

 - Collaborate closely with product managers, architects, other engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to design and build new technologies that go directly into our customers' hands

 - Provide technical leadership for your team, setting direction on design, code quality, and operational excellence

 - Mentor and coach engineers on your team and across partner teams

AN IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE MOST OF THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 10+ years of industry experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale, durable distributed systems in production

 - An excellent team player who is committed to helping everyone around them reach their potential and grow

 - Alignment with the Snowflake values

 - A proven track record of leading and delivering large, complex projects across multiple teams in the storage space (object storage, data warehouses, SQL/NoSQL databases, distributed file systems, etc.)

 - Strong development skills and AI-forward mindset with a critical eye towards code maintainability

 - Experience with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - Demonstrated ability to build alignment across teams and disciplines to bring complex technical solutions to life

If you're a leader who thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment and has a passion for shaping the future of storage technology, we'd love to hear from you!




Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT HEX

Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.

Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hex's infrastructure team owns all of our cloud infrastructure (compute, networking, datastores) along with CI/CD and observability, across a multi-tenant platform and single-tenant environments. Every engineer at Hex depends on what the infrastructure team builds.

We're growing in customers, in users, and in the kinds of data workflows our workload compute backend has to support. That growth has opened up a set of projects that would meaningfully change how fast the rest of engineering ships, and we're hiring to take them on.

We're looking for someone who will pick up one of those projects, own it start to finish, and leave it better than they found it. Bring your opinions, including the ones that disagree with ours. Infrastructure tooling is changing quickly right now, and we want someone who's paying attention to that as we improve the foundational components that power Hex.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your first few months, we'll pick two or three of these together based on where you're strongest and where we're looking to invest:

 - CI/CD. Hex’s CI/CD pipelines need a glow-up: optimizing for speed, cost, and providing more flexibility.

 - Stack lifecycle. Setup, teardown, partial teardown, and updates for single-tenant stacks, today too much of this is manual and runs through our team.

 - Postgres at scale. Performance, migrations, and capacity for our multi-tenant production database.

 - Cost. Infrastructure spend visibility and reduction.

 - Security posture. Workload and container isolation, plus compliance work as we move upmarket.

 - Platform features. Customer-facing infrastructure capabilities: private connectivity, customer defined networking, and making single-tenant deployments easier to operate.


ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years building and operating production infrastructure, including on-call

 - You make the people around you better, whether or not you've had the title

 - Strong Kubernetes operations: you can reason about scheduling, networking, and failure modes, not just apply manifests

 - Solid AWS fundamentals (EKS, RDS, VPC networking, IAM)

 - Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform

 - Comfortable writing and reading enough application code to change a pipeline, a controller, or a service

 - You can take a vague, long-standing problem and turn it into something shippable without waiting to be told how

 - You write clearly, design docs and runbooks that engineers outside infra can follow

Plus depth in at least one of

 - Networking — VPC design, private connectivity (PrivateLink, peering), DNS, TLS and certificate management, agentic sandboxing

 - Databases — Postgres at scale: replication, tuning, connection pooling, major version upgrades, migrations under load

 - Deployment systems — CI/CD platform ownership, build performance and cost, release and artifact management




OUR STACK

 - Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache)

 - Databases: PostgreSQL (RDS), Redis, LanceDB, DynamoDB, MSK

 - Languages: TypeScript (Node.js), Python, Rust, Go

 - Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform

 - Monitoring: Datadog

The salary range for this role is: $246,000 - $329,000



In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.



By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Sandbox
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




THE ROLE

The Products Team at Docker is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead components of Docker Sandbox. You will own and drive this strategic product area from high-level concept design through delivery, adoption, and operation. You will help shape how developers and AI agents use fast, secure, isolated environments across local and cloud workflows. You will work closely with developers inside and outside of Docker, our customers, and our partners to expand our open ecosystem offering and provide value. As the company and ecosystem grow, you will help foster teams eager to continuously build, measure, and learn.



To thrive in this role, you will need experience working with developers, deep technical fluency in systems and developer infrastructure, and prior experience as a software engineer. You will need to understand containers, sandboxes/microVMs, virtualization technologies, hypervisors, the software development lifecycle, and how untrusted or agent-generated code can be safely executed and orchestrated. You will need a relentless drive to try new things and an eye for detail. Your long-term success will depend on your ability to own the product roadmap, earn the trust of the developer community, and scale reliable services. Most importantly, you will need to be comfortable taking ownership of big objectives with big goals, working with a cross-functional team, and maintaining a bias for action.

_______________________________________________________________________

 - You believe in and can succinctly articulate our customers, their workflows, and their pain points. You empathize with the world they live in and the security, performance, compatibility, and cost constraints they work through.

 - You will engage deeply with developers building AI agents, coding environments, CI and testing systems, and other workloads that require secure, isolated execution, finding solutions for today while optimizing for tomorrow's vision.

 - You enjoy building infrastructure products that are easy to adopt and use. You will turn complex tradeoffs across isolation, startup time, performance, density, networking, storage, and cost into simple product experiences.

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and will guide product definition, feature prioritization, and scope in concert with engineering, design, security, operations, and go-to-market teams.

 - You are a fan of iterative development, working with customers and cross-functional teams to hypothesize, measure adoption and impact, learn from releases, and continually improve the roadmap.

_______________________________________________________________________





QUALIFICATIONS

 - You have deep empathy for the needs of developers and are obsessed with talking to your users.

 - You have prior professional experience as a software engineer, ideally in systems, infrastructure, platform engineering, developer tools, or cloud.

 - You have strong technical familiarity with sandboxes/microVMs, containers, virtualization technologies, and hypervisors, including the isolation and security boundaries each provides.

 - You understand the building blocks of modern developer infrastructure, including Linux, container runtimes, orchestration, networking, storage, APIs, and cloud services.

 - You have experience designing, building, or operating systems that execute customer-provided, untrusted, or agent-generated code at scale.

 - You are comfortable interacting with a command-line interface and discussing APIs, SDKs, and technical architecture with engineers and developers.

 - You have experience building B2B or SaaS products, or a background in public cloud and developer infrastructure.

 - You understand software supply chain and software security concerns, including multi-tenant isolation, identity, secrets management, observability, and reliability.

 - You can break down complex technical problems into small, releasable, user-valuable features.

 - You can explain complex ideas simply and communicate effectively in writing, verbally, and visually across diverse stakeholders.

 - You can analyze qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, define success metrics, and prioritize investments.

 - You have a collaborative approach, experience running products from greenfield to scale, and the ability to work with fast-moving, distributed, cross-functional teams. You are a doer as well as a strategist; we are small and need all hands on deck.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Self-Hosted and Connected Temporal
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Temporal is used by a lot of companies in a wide variety of contexts. Many use Temporal Cloud. Many others users don’t yet know about Temporal Cloud, believe self-hosting is cheaper, and/or just don’t yet see a need to move. Still others (often happily using Temporal Cloud at large scale) also operate environments where a managed service isn't an option today and may never be, like:

 - AI and application companies embedding Temporal inside software their own customers run in isolated, air-gapped environments, or offering a remote management BYOA posture

 - Large enterprises keeping operational control of critical systems in-house by policy

 - Companies operating in sovereign clouds and similar contexts where legal or organizational requirements make outside management difficult or impossible

This role owns understanding the world of Temporal usage outside Cloud, what the different contexts demand, and where Temporal should (and shouldn't) engage. That includes what we build, what we support, what we charge for, and what we leave alone. You'll shape which offerings we pursue and how they make money or contribute to the larger business. Then you'll take the ones we commit to through launch and adoption.

Open source Temporal is central to this. We’re investing heavily in OSS, from performance improvements to easier management to clearer guidance on compatibility and cost. When companies write their apps on Temporal, they’re making a huge bet on us, and that trust is sacred. A large part of this role is improving and shepherding how we keep making OSS better.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Map usage outside Temporal Cloud. Build the company's clearest picture of where Temporal runs outside Cloud and why. Separate structural constraints (air gaps, regulation, owning operational risk) from cost, inertia, and/or other factors. Turn that into segments and use cases leadership can make decisions with.

 - Decide what we pursue. Recommend which needs deserve new offerings, which Temporal Cloud should cover, and which we deliberately leave alone. Write the case, defend it, and revisit it when the evidence changes.

 - Define the line between open source and paid. Set clear guidelines for which improvements and support go into open source Temporal, and where paid offerings take over. Keep the open source experience strong, and make the line easy for users and internal teams to understand.

 - Define the business model. Work with leadership, Sales, and Finance on packaging, pricing, and how we sell offerings that run outside our infrastructure. Know what customers will pay for and what it costs us to support it.

 - Help Cloud win where it should. Work with other PMs so workloads that can run on Cloud move there more easily, with a clear value and TCO case.

 - Lead without authority. Align Engineering, Resident Architects, Dev Success, Security, and go-to-market teams, including when their incentives conflict.

 - Own outcomes. Define success in terms of adoption, revenue, and retention. Use the results to steer further investment.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - A track record of setting product strategy, not only executing it. You've spotted a new offering or market, made the case for it, and seen it through to revenue.

 - Experience with infrastructure or platform products that customers operate themselves: open source, on-prem, or hybrid.

 - Commercial judgment. You can connect a customer problem to willingness to pay, pricing, and the cost of delivering and supporting the product.

 - Technical depth in distributed systems and operations: Kubernetes, databases, replication, upgrades, and failure recovery. You can go deep with engineers and turn the tradeoffs into product decisions.

 - Comfort saying "not this" and backing it with evidence. You change course when the facts change.

 - Clear writing. You can turn messy evidence from customers and the field into a recommendation leaders can act on.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience making money from open source or open-core products

 - Familiarity with air-gapped, regulated (FedRAMP, sovereign cloud), or bring-your-own-cloud environments

 - Experience selling to platform teams at large enterprises or AI companies

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer at Vanta, you’ll lead technical engagements with our enterprise customer base & VIP logos side-by-side with our Sales team. Your main goal is to ensure there’s nothing stopping our prospects and existing customers from realizing the fullest value with Vanta, driving customer acquisition, key account expansion, cross-selling, and long-term customer retention.



The Solutions Team drives customer acquisition and accelerates revenue growth through a mastery of strategic sales and Vanta platform expertise. We create meaningful leverage across Vanta through deep partnerships with Sales - Working side by side to elevate discovery, articulate value, and enable consistent, high quality sales execution.



You’ll be an integral part of the Enterprise team, working pre-sales to consult and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail and focus on customer needs will help ensure prospects clearly understand the value of our solutions from the earliest stages of engagement. By aligning our capabilities to their business priorities and demonstrating impact before purchase, you will build confidence, differentiate us competitively, and lay the groundwork for long-term customer success. This approach will contribute to the overall success of our Sales teams while also capturing prospect insights, use cases, and feedback to help shape messaging and influence product roadmap decisions.



What you’ll do as an Enterprise Solutions Engineer at Vanta:

 - Sales Cycle & Customer Engagement
   
   - Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand their security, compliance, cloud infrastructure, and development workflows.
   
   - Partner closely with Account Executives to develop deal strategy, identify technical champions, and guide prospects through evaluation, proof-of-value, and purchase decisions.
   
   - Deliver tailored product demonstrations, walkthroughs, and integration deep dives aligned to customer use cases and success criteria.
   
   - Partner with Account Executives post-sale to identify expansion opportunities, lead technical cross-sell discussions, and demonstrate new platform capabilities to scale footprint within existing accounts.
   
   - Act as the primary technical advisor during the evaluation process, addressing technical objections, competitive comparisons, and solution fit.

 - Technical Ownership & Execution
   
   - Develop and maintain deep expertise in our product capabilities, integrations, configurations, APIs, partner ecosystem, and competitive landscape.
   
   - Design and explain how our solution integrates with customers’ cloud providers, identity systems, version control platforms, and security tooling.
   
   - Ensure a clean technical handoff to Customer Success and Implementation teams post-sale.
   
   - Architect technical expansion strategies and custom solution proofs for growing accounts, driving active commercial up-sell motions rather than post-sale support or routine maintenance.

 - Sales Enablement & Revenue Impact
   
   - Support revenue growth by responding quickly and effectively to inbound technical questions from Sales and prospects.
   
   - Help qualify opportunities by identifying technical fit, risks, and dependencies early in the sales cycle.
   
   - Participate in account planning, QBRs, and expansion conversations by demonstrating ongoing technical value.

 - Product & Cross-functional Collaboration
   
   - Capture and communicate structured customer feedback to Product, helping influence roadmap priorities for the Upmarket segment.
   
   - Build reusable demos, technical documentation, reference architectures, and enablement materials in partnership with Product, Success, and Marketing.
   
   - Share learnings from the field to improve sales motions, messaging, and technical positioning.

 - Team & Culture
   
   - Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive Solutions Engineering culture focused on continuous improvement, technical excellence, and customer empathy.
   
   - Mentor peers and help evolve best practices for technical selling in the Upmarket segment.

 - Strong project management skills with a proven ability to operate effectively in uncertain environments

 - You are creative, curious, technical, and naturally persuasive

 - You are detail-oriented and organized

 - You are solution oriented with problem solving abilities

 - You love listening to customers, discussing strategy with colleagues, but also diving into the weeds

 - You can interact with various titles and roles within an organization including the technical and security-minded, plus executives within large companies

 - General knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills

 - Familiarity with REST API development, MCP and service integrations is a plus
