jobs.title: Product Manager | Bill Pay
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Every business pays bills, and many of them still do it by hand. Someone opens the invoice, types it in, codes it, chases approvals, pays it, matches it and syncs it to the books. It's one of the largest manual workflows left in finance.

We're building the version where software does that work. Bills come in and get read, coded, matched, approved and paid, and a person steps in only when judgment matters. Bill Pay is already one of Ramp's fastest-growing products. The next few years decide who owns AP for the next decade, and we plan for it to be us.

We're looking for a PM who wants to build that.

 - Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.

 - Level will be determined based on the candidate’s interview performance and previous scope of responsibility.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own strategy, roadmap and results for a major part of Bill Pay.

 - Spend real time with AP clerks, controllers and CFOs, and turn what you see into product.

 - Prototype with customers, set quality bars with Engineering and Data, and ship automation people trust.

 - Measure success by adoption, automation and time saved, then use the data to decide what comes next.

 - Work with Procurement, Accounting, Payments and Risk so a bill moves from inbox to payment to the books without gaps.


PROBLEMS YOU'LL WORK ON

 - How do we get from "AI drafts the bill" to "AI handles the bill" without customers losing trust or control?

 - When should an agent act on its own, when should it ask, and how do we show our work so a controller signs off with confidence?

 - How do we make one product that a 10-person startup sets up in minutes and a multi-entity enterprise with an ERP and an AP team runs at scale?

 - How do we catch the wrong bill, the duplicate and the suspicious vendor change before the money leaves?

 - How do we use what Ramp knows across millions of transactions to help customers pay smarter, not just faster?


WHAT YOU NEED

 - You have 5+ years building products, and you've owned at least one from first customer conversation to real adoption.

 - You've built with AI hands-on, whether in products, prototypes or side projects, and you have opinions about evals, failure modes and user control.

 - You're technical enough to go deep with engineers on data models and integrations, and you pull your own data.

 - You can make complex workflows simple without stripping out what power users need.

 - You learn new domains fast. You don't need to know AP today, but you'll want to know it better than anyone in six months.

 - You write clearly, decide quickly and get teams to ship.

 - You want a hard problem, a high bar and more scope as soon as you've earned it.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - You've worked on AP, payments, accounting or other finance software.

 - You've shipped AI to production, especially document understanding or agent workflows.

 - You've built for enterprise customers: ERPs, multi-entity setups, complex approvals and permissions.

 - You've worked at a high-growth startup and know what it takes to scale a product that's working.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Databases
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Engineer on the Core Infra team at Harvey, you will define how our database infrastructure operates and evolves across our legal AI platform. Harvey runs a global fleet of PostgreSQL databases spanning multiple regions and availability zones. You’ll own the technical strategy for this fleet—setting the standards for migration governance, driving architecture decisions for multi-region scaling, and establishing the operational practices that keep our data layer reliable as we grow.

This is a leadership role with deep hands-on expectations. You’ll partner directly with Principal and Staff Engineers on infrastructure roadmap decisions while also being the person who can diagnose a replication lag spike at 2am. You’ll build the migration review framework, define the tooling strategy, and raise the bar for how the entire engineering organization thinks about database safety and performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

The Enterprise Accounts team at UiPath serves the largest companies in America, segmented by industry. In this role, you’ll own and grow a portfolio of existing Oil & Gas customers across upstream, midstream, downstream, and oilfield services. Your job is to expand UiPath’s footprint inside these accounts, taking automation from early wins in a single function to an enterprise-wide agentic automation program. You’ll work with the C-suite, Digital Transformation, IT, Finance, and Operations leaders to show how UiPath helps them run leaner, safer, and more efficiently in a volatile commodity market. You’ll be challenged and supported by the best in the industry as you build your own path to success.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Own a named set of Oil & Gas enterprise customers. Build account plans that map white space across business units, functions, and geographies to maximize expansion revenue.

 - Hit or beat quarterly and annual targets for expansion, upsell, cross-sell, and renewals.

 - Grow existing deployments into new use cases, such as joint interest billing, AFE and field ticket processing, land and lease administration, hydrocarbon and revenue accounting, procure-to-pay, maintenance work orders, HSE and regulatory reporting, and supply chain and logistics.

 - Position the full UiPath platform (agentic automation, document understanding, process and task mining, test automation) to move customers from tactical bots to strategic, scaled programs.

 - Build ROI and value cases that speak to O&G priorities: lower lifting and operating costs, capital discipline, margin protection during price swings, workforce productivity, and compliance.

 - Build executive relationships beyond the original buying center. Create champions in Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Land, HSE, and IT.

 - Work closely with Customer Success Managers to drive adoption, measure realized value, and turn success stories into new expansion opportunities.

 - Work with global systems integrators and energy-focused partners to find new opportunities and deliver successful implementations.

 - Track industry trends, competitors, M&A, and technology shifts in energy (ERP modernization, SAP S/4HANA migrations, energy transition initiatives) to anticipate customer needs.

 - Share wins, plays, and best practices with sales, solutions engineering, marketing, and industry teams.

 - Look for ways to use automation in your own daily work.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - A track record of growing revenue inside existing enterprise accounts through expansion, upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year renewals

jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably. Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design. Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later. Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs. Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate. How we work: AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production. Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence. Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital. Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints. Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog. Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage. What we’re looking for: Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team. Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count. Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes. Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code. Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required. Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team. Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act. What we offer Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow. Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals. Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities. Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement. Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories. Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany). Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones. Together: team meetups and company-wide events. Location We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front. Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi. We re the world s leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We re driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

How we work 💻

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don t have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you re nearby. We believe you ll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we ll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We re on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you re not sure what level you re aiming for chat to your recruiter! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll be working on: 

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: 

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
  • React for our public web apps and internal tools
  • We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role The Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations. You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson. You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field. What you’ll do Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable. Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management. Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate. Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs. Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable. Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands. Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release. Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback. Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware. Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks. Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. What success looks like Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template. Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code. Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field. Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack. Automated tests and bench validation catch defects before deployment, reducing issues discovered in the field. Releases move predictably from bench validation to pilot vehicles and the wider fleet, with clear readiness gates and rollback procedures. Services stay within resource budgets and remain diagnosable under hardware constraints and degraded connectivity. Architecture documentation and runbooks help engineering, QA, and field teams integrate changes and resolve failures faster. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Wayflyer Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer. Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan. You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney. The challenge When a founder applies for funding, one flow carries them from application to money in their account - the processes that assess their business in minutes and the product experience that makes it feel effortless are all part of the same system. Our full stack engineers are the ones who can follow a feature all the way through: from the data model, to the API, to the screen a founder trusts with their business. That doesn't mean being equally deep everywhere. Most of our full stack engineers have a home base - backend or frontend - and range outward from it. We're hiring for that shape. What you'll actually do Own features end-to-end: shape solutions with product and design, build across the API and the UI, ship to production to create outcomes, not just deliver tickets Lean into your specialism - whether that's backend architecture, data modelling and performance, or frontend architecture, accessibility and user experience - and act as the go-to person for it on your team Design and develop backend services using Python and Django, including the data models and RESTful APIs that power our financial products Build high-quality, reusable frontend features using TypeScript and React Write clean, testable code with strong test coverage across the stack (pytest on the backend; Storybook/Chromatic, Playwright and Vitest on the frontend) Participate in code reviews on both sides of the stack in order to share knowledge and improve the quality of our solutions Monitor and maintain production systems, ensuring reliability, performance and security Who thrives here You should be comfortable making and defending decisions about the experience you’re building, while remaining open to feedback and alternative approaches. You'll need to balance technical excellence with business needs and help guide the team toward good solutions that elevate the experience as quickly as possible. You excel at stakeholder management and can effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. You're proactive in identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems. We look for candidates with most or all of the below traits that can point to real experience applying them. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine depth - we'll play to your strengths Useful skills include a strong proficiency in Python and Django (or similar frameworks like FastAPI or Flask), SQL databases (preferably PostgreSQL), and API design — plus working proficiency in TypeScript and React and a real appetite to build product UI We also value advanced proficiency in TypeScript and React, experience with modern frontend architectures, state management (e.g. TanStack Query) and design systems Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms Experience with CI/CD pipelines (especially GitHub Actions) and a strong testing culture Solid understanding of version control with Git Understanding of security best practices and data protection Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Excellent communication abilities and proven track record of successful team collaboration Given what we do, experience in financial services, fintech and business-to-business organisations is particularly interesting to us. We hire for range What you're like as a person and how you treat people is a big deal for us. People love working with you. You're helpful and generous with your time and knowledge. People love helping you back. People know where they stand with you. You're always looking to learn and grow, on a personal and professional level. And you're always looking to help others learn and grow by sharing your own knowledge and experience. You know why diversity, equality, inclusion and belonging matters, and speak up when we can do better. What this role could turn into Our engineers here grow in whichever direction their interests pull them. Some deepen their specialism and move toward staff or principal tracks in specific technologies; some stay broad and take on architecture across whole product areas; others step into engineering management. Joining as a full stack engineer doesn't mean giving up your specialism - it means choosing where to deepen it with more context. Location and working policy 📍 Remote in Europe The good stuff 25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems Architecture
jobs.description: Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security. Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it. About The Role We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management. We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs. What You'll Do 1. Overall Software Architecture Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end. Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs. Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become. 2. Data Handling & Pipeline Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled. Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable. Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply. 3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity. Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work. Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output. 4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use. What We're Looking For Required Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time. Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity. Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself. At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them. Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place. Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else. Strongly Preferred TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus. Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling. Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes). Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl , or similar). Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform. What Valinor Offers Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others. Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year. We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey. Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us. This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred

jobs.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
jobs.description:
SLSQ327R892

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world s most challenging problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Databricks is looking for a motivated Strategy and Execution Manager to join our Deal Desk Transformation team that helps define Quote-to-Order (QtO) strategy and drive scalability. You will collaborate with the Deal Desk functions, senior leaders, and stakeholders across lines of business to execute on process and system enhancement projects. You will also own the operating model and automation roadmap for cloud Marketplace Private Offers across AWS, Azure, and GCP.  Managing stakeholder expectations and ensuring smooth implementation of process/system changes are key aspects of this role. You will be accountable for end-to-end transformation project lifecycle support, from strategic QtO process design and requirements gathering through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live, and post-release enablement and support. Your ability to manage resistance to change, lead cross-functional conversations, and influence stakeholders sets you apart. You thrive in a dynamic environment and excel at problem-solving, project management, and driving results. You are passionate about helping us build a Deal Desk function with industry-leading business agility, process scalability, and automation in an environment of rapid growth.

The impact you will have:

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Strategy & Operations, Finance Data and Strategy (FDS), IT systems teams, and relevant stakeholders such as GTM, Legal, Order Management, Field Sales, and Finance to roll out new and improved system/process enhancements and new commercialization initiatives
  • Effectively enable internal stakeholders and field organization on new system/process enhancements and new commercialization initiatives
  • Be a trusted partner to the Strategy & Execution Leadership by being independently capable of driving small-to-medium projects and initiatives
  • Contribute to the delivery team by working with the IT, business, and product owners to refine user stories and requirements and perform UAT and go-live on said requirements
  • Solve complex business problems by breaking them down into tangible steps for business systems developers to implement.
  • Own the end-to-end Marketplace Private Offer process across AWS, Azure, and GCP: intake, offer creation, matching price and terms to the approved CPQ quote, custom EULA handling, acceptance tracking, and handoff to Order Management and Billing
  • Design and deliver automation across the offer lifecycle, such as generating offers directly from approved quotes, syncing offer status and acceptance back to Salesforce, and flagging offers that are expiring or don t match the booking, to shorten cycle times and reduce manual errors
  • Partner with Cloud Partnerships, Finance, and Billing to reconcile marketplace transactions against bookings (commit drawdown, usage metering, disbursements), including partner-led scenarios such as AWS CPPO and Azure multiparty private offers
  • Define and report Private Offer KPIs such as turnaround time, acceptance rate, rework rate, and share of offers processed without manual work
  • Shape QtO strategy and set up prioritization processes so the team works on the right things at the right time
  • Formulate your own key questions and analyze large datasets from multiple sources to identify the highest-impact opportunities and actionable insights.

 

What we look for:

  • 6+ years of experience in a business analyst, operations strategy, tech quote-to-cash, or corporate strategy role (with a focus on operational performance). Experience in the enterprise software,  SaaS, and B2B industry preferred. 
  • Ability to effectively deliver enablement materials to both internal stakeholders and field organizations.
  • Advanced research and analysis skills that you can flex to define, prioritize, and break down complex problems.
  • The propensity to summarize and communicate complex ideas and concepts within internal teams with authority, influencing stakeholders including Databricks executives and department leadership. 
  • Comfortable and thrive in a rapidly scaling and dynamic startup environment
  • Process expert: Envision E2E process change to solve our needs, drive agreement, document requirements, guide execution in partnership with IT, perform UAT, and report on progress.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ and common Go-to-Market and Deal Support business processes

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We re looking for a Senior Partner Operations Manager to join our Global Revenue Operations team and make sure the partner programs for both Fivetran and dbt Labs run like a well-oiled machine.

You ll be the operational backbone of our partner ecosystem, covering resellers, cloud marketplaces, global and regional system integrators, and technology alliances. Your work will keep partner programs scalable, measurable, and easy for partners and internal teams to work with.

This is a full-time remote position based out of the US.

Technologies You ll Use

Salesforce, a Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform (such as Impartner, ZINFI, PartnerStack, or Salesforce Experience Cloud), Looker, Google Sheets, Slack, Jira, Gong, and cloud marketplace consoles (AWS, Azure, GCP), Clari.

What You ll Do

  • Own the day-to-day operations of the Fivetran and dbt Labs partner programs, including onboarding, tiering, certification, and renewals
  • Design and continuously improve partner processes so they are scalable, consistent, and easy for partners and internal teams to follow

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing without direct authority across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal

  • Background in data, analytics, or developer-focused products such as data integration, transformation, or warehousing

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | NASA | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates from US and Canada only (EST time zone). 

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You ll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team s dedicated software engineer, you ll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You ll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana s multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io http://www.astronomer.io.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The world’s most regulated companies, from global banks to healthcare systems, need a secure and reliable way to orchestrate the flow of mission-critical data. With 3,600+ contributors and 30 million downloads a month, Airflow is one of the most active projects in the history of the Apache Software Foundation, and the de facto standard for data orchestration. Astro Private Cloud (APC) lets regulated companies run managed Apache Airflow at scale inside their own infrastructure, meeting their security, compliance and data-residency requirements.

APC customers are among Astronomer’s largest: at one global retailer more than 1,000 data teams use it for workloads that cannot fail, everything from supply chain to payroll. They expect the same experience as our hosted platform, but their environments are locked down, sometimes air-gapped, and each one differs from the next. So some features need a different architecture to work here, and others exist only in APC.

As Staff Product Manager for APC, you’ll own its roadmap end to end. You’ll decide the strategy to make APC the obvious choice for even the most sophisticated open-source Airflow teams. You’ll work out which capabilities matter most to these customers, how to deliver them in environments we don’t control, and where APC should lead — including new AI pipelines. You’ll work with engineering to ship on dates customers can plan around, spend real time with customer executives, and partner closely with sales and services to keep our biggest accounts growing. And you’ll help build the foundational systems that our products will depend on for years.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the vision and roadmap. Define and drive the strategy for APC, starting with the near-term goal of reaching feature parity with Astro Hosted.

 - Write the requirements. Specify a complex distributed platform that serves platform administrators, platform engineers, data engineers and AI teams.

 - Build alongside engineering. Work with R&D from design through release, including the infrastructure decisions that shape the product: Kubernetes, cloud environments, multi-tenancy and observability.

 - Listen to our most strategic customers. Engage executives and technical leaders on their security, compliance, certification and central-management needs, and use what you learn to prioritize.

 - Balance the few and the many. Weigh specific customer demands against a committed roadmap that serves the broader customer base. Push back where necessary, and work with forward-deployed engineers to deliver custom requirements.

 - Enable go-to-market teams. Support product marketing and sales with customer-focused messaging and content.

 - Be the voice of APC. Represent the product externally through conferences, webinars and written content.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Staff-level product experience. 8–9 years of product roles at enterprise data or infrastructure companies, with demonstrated experience driving product strategy and delivering impactful outcomes.

 - Technical depth. You can engage as a peer with engineering partners across R&D.

 - Platform knowledge. Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and the modern data stack.

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're seeking a Senior/Staff Engineer to build and maintain the automation infrastructure that powers the development cycles of our North platform. This engineer will design and implement robust automation systems that enable engineers to efficiently test and validate changes across diverse environments and configurations. This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure and standards. You'll build the systems, frameworks, and culture that allow the rest of engineering to own quality themselves; improving and extending our testing platform by creating the infrastructure that allows engineers to write and execute tests, and enable every engineering team to ship with more confidence.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and implement automation pipelines that support comprehensive testing across multiple environments with varying feature flags and realistic customer data profiles

 - Create intelligent testing agents that simulate real user behavior to validate different configuration combinations

 - Develop and maintain GitHub workflows and actions to automate testing, deployment, and validation processes

 - Manage and optimize Helm charts for deployment consistency across environments

 - Implement and maintain ArgoCD workflows for continuous deployment and environment management

 - Establish best practices for testing methodologies and ensure adoption across engineering teams

 - Build scalable infrastructure that supports parallel test execution across diverse configurations

 - Develop infrastructure-as-code templates and configurations for reproducible test environments

 - Implement containerization strategies for test environments and dependencies

 - Create benchmarking frameworks to measure performance and reliability across different configurations

 - Monitor and improve test coverage and reliability metrics

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand testing requirements and translate them into automated solutions

 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex testing infrastructure issues
   


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on automation and testing infrastructure

 - Expert proficiency in Python and TypeScript

 - Extensive experience with GitHub workflows and actions

 - Deep understanding of testing methodologies and best practices

 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

 - Containerization experience (Docker, Kubernetes)

 - Benchmarking experience and performance testing methodologies

 - Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 - Background in developer tools or platform engineering

 - Ability to design and implement complex automation systems

 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience working with LLMs in production environments

 - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code principles

 - Experience with container orchestration and management

 - Knowledge of performance testing tools and frameworks

 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools

 - Background in test framework development

 - Strong working knowledge of Helm charts and ArgoCD

 - Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

You'll enhance our testing platform to allow engineers to:

 - Spin up environments with specific feature flag combinations using infrastructure-as-code

 - Load test configurations with realistic customer data volumes in containerized environments

 - Run comprehensive test suites across multiple environment configurations with automated benchmarking

 - Generate detailed performance and reliability reports across different cloud environments

 - Automatically detect and flag regressions in diverse usage scenarios

 - Scale testing infrastructure to accommodate our growing customer base
   

This is a critical role for ensuring the reliability and scalability of our North platform as we continue to grow our customer base and expand our feature set. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of our development infrastructure and make a significant impact on product quality. (edited)

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering. Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Cruise
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Backend Engineer within our Maritime domain, you will lead the backend architecture and streaming services that process high-volume vessel tracking, port intelligence, and maritime trade flows. Working with core technologies including Python, PHP, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse, you will design scalable, highly available systems that transform raw maritime telemetry into real-time actionable insights for global shipping and commodity markets. Operating with high autonomy under a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture, you will play a crucial role in modernizing core services, elevating technical standards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners and client-facing technical teams. Key Responsibilities Architect and scale backend services: Design, build, and maintain high-throughput backend applications and microservices using Python and PHP. Build real-time streaming & analytical pipelines: Leverage Kafka and ClickHouse to stream, process, and analyze massive volumes of real-time maritime tracking data. Optimize data persistence and storage: Manage relational and analytical databases, optimizing PostgreSQL queries and ClickHouse schema designs for low-latency queries at scale. Own production health and reliability: Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks while maintaining operational ownership across staging and production environments. Drive cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Cloud Platform teams, and client-facing technical teams to deliver features aligned with customer needs. Elevate engineering standards and mentorship: Guide peer engineers through technical design reviews, code quality benchmarks, and architectural best practices within the Maritime domain. Experience & Background What you'll need (Must-haves) Senior-level backend experience: ~5+ years of professional software engineering experience developing, scaling, and maintaining complex production backend systems. Core tech stack mastery: Strong proficiency in Python and PHP alongside deep experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL. Event streaming & analytical data tech: Hands-on production experience with Apache Kafka and high-performance analytical data stores like ClickHouse. System design & API development: Proven track record designing RESTful APIs, distributed microservices, and high-concurrency architecture. Operational mindset: Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), and production observability/monitoring tools. Nice-to-haves Maritime & geospatial domain knowledge: Familiarity with vessel AIS data, geospatial systems, logistics, or global trade datasets. Legacy modernization: Track record of refactoring monolithic architectures into event-driven, decoupled microservices. Cloud infrastructure: Experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us? jobs.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership. What You Will Do: Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis. Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes. Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems. Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements. Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making. Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders. Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods. Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience. Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship. Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain. Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems. Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling. Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals. jobs.description: Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. Perform hands-on validation and offensive security testing of applications and fixes, including exploit development, bypass testing, adversarial thinking, and focused red-team-style exercises, to confirm remediations address the underlying issue rather than only the initial symptom. Work across the kinds of application security issues common in modern SaaS environments, including authentication and authorization weaknesses, access control risks, OAuth and CSRF design flaws, SSRF, cryptographic and verification issues, information disclosure and data exposure risks, unsafe execution and deserialization patterns, and dependency or runtime vulnerabilities. Apply clear, risk-based severity decisions using exploitability, data sensitivity, customer impact, and blast radius Tooling, automation, and AI Configure and improve AppSec tooling and integrations, including SAST configuration, ignore lists, dashboards, and other controls that maintain useful coverage without excessive noise. Select, build, or refine security tooling, small automations, and workflow enrichments that reduce manual effort and scale AppSec operations responsibly. Use AI to automate, transform, and scale security and engineering-adjacent processes where it materially improves speed, consistency, or signal quality, while still validating outputs with strong engineering judgment. Embed AI-specific security checks into SSDLC reviews and code analysis, including input and output handling, AI-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, and abuse or data-exfiltration paths. Partner cross-functionally on AI security requirements and controls so AI systems and AI-powered features are designed, deployed, and operated securely. jobs.title: Product Engineer (all levels)
jobs.description: I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy. I started Anima to change that. Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima. We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions. Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them. If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives. -- Shun Long before the "vertical AI" craze, we were obsessed with active reinforcement learning—a niche field in 2021 that the world, pre-ChatGPT, largely ignored. Our trajectory has been unwavering since our YC application: achieving the "holy grail" of personalized medicine and deep phenotyping. This is powered by our proprietary active learning architecture - a system we codified in a 2021 patent that anticipated the Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) and active learning loops now foundational to modern LLMs. While others are just arriving at the party, we’ve spent years executing a plan to build what is now one of the world’s largest, highest-quality labeled datasets. We’re looking for someone who Has a track record of relentless shipping. Has proven ability to navigate ambiguity and tackle novel technical challenges from conception to production. Has strong CS Fundamentals. A deep understanding of data structures, algorithms (e.g., breadth-first search), and first-principles thinking to solve complex product problems. Is expert-level in TypeScript (TS). Proficiency in building type-safe, scalable applications. You are a full-stack expert in the JavaScript/Node.js ecosystem with a pragmatic approach to tech debt and tool selection. Has hands-on expertise with React, Angular, or Node.js, with the ability to move between frontend and backend as needed. Has experience architecting on AWS (specifically Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, and CloudFormation) or a proven "hungry to learn" mindset regarding serverless infrastructure. Is disciplined towards best practice version control, CI/CD and code extensibility. Values interface safety through dimensionality reduction at interfaces. Is obsessive about UX and optimises for this over arbitrary technical goals. Is driven, impatient to grow and wants their shot to change the world. We hire at all levels: our team has new grads and product leaders with 20 years experience. What to expect in the role You’ll work with an incredibly smart team. Like Michael who built a working CPU from logic dates at age 16 and co-founded YC-backed Embark Trucks, the first self-driving vehicle on Canadian roads. Or Souradip, who built an acoustic fall detector using on-device deep learning; he’s also an MB/PhD from Cambridge who’s published in top medical journals. You’ll own your projects end to end and ship fast. Like Alex who built ‘Slack for medical teams’ supporting 1000s of channels per organisation and a real time single source of truth for patient data in 4 weeks. Or Dennis who built and shipped a lightning fast cloud document library for clinics in a few days with <100ms traversals through preloading. You’ll work on a well-established stack that’s already highly scalable, cost effective, secure and performant with minimal to zero ops. You’ll learn new technologies; whatever is needed to solve the problem. We are tech agonistic, and collectively choose the best tools for the job. We’re constantly looking to maximise our productivity and minimise what we call “discounted dev time cost” for shipping features. Our current stack We have 2 separate fully functional web apps in prod: one for clinical users and one for patients. Angular, React and Electron, Mixpanel/Posthog for analytics, a fully serverless backend in AWS (Cognito, Appsync GraphQL, Lambda, DynamoDB). We have good functional & unit test coverage and CI/CD. What we offer Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with: Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off. Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance. Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay. Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you. Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development. Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month. Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget. Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico. Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week. Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.
