jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (App-Framework)
jobs.description:
P-1492

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we re only getting started in Bengaluru , India ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.

The Role : 

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer with a deep understanding of low-level systems to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and optimizing application frameworks  that form the building blocks for all software development at Databricks. This is not a full-stack role; your expertise will be focused on the intricate details of system internals, performance, and efficiency.

What we look for : 

  • Design, implement, and maintain core system infrastructure and low-level software components.
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability through meticulous analysis and innovative solutions.
  • Work with JVM internals, memory management, concurrency, and distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and architects to define technical strategies and roadmaps.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architectural decision-making.
  • Troubleshoot complex system issues and provide effective resolutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of professional experience in software development.
  • Deep understanding of Java Virtual Machine (JVM) internals, including garbage collection, JIT compilation, class loading, and memory model.
  • Proficiency in at least one JVM language and extensive experience with its runtime environment.
  • Strong programming skills in Scala/Java/Rust or other systems-level languages.
  • Extensive experience with operating system concepts; including processes, threads, concurrency, scheduling, and I/O.
  • Proven track record of building and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and reliable systems.
  • Experience with distributed systems concepts and technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities
  • Experience with performance profiling and tuning tools.
  • Contributions to open-source projects related to JVM or systems software.
  • Experience with RPC frameworks.

If you are a systems-level expert with a passion for optimizing the core of technology and possess a deep understanding of JVM internals, we encourage you to apply and help us build the future.

 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet s infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet s platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don t own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.
  • Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.
  • Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.
  • Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.
  • Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.
  • Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.
  • Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.
  • Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.
  • Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.
  • Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Tempora

You’ll be part of a small, experienced team with a high level of responsibility. Support integrations with external game studios by helping build wrappers and bridges between third-party game implementations and Playson’s platform. Work with data structures and protocols that connect game logic with frontend and backend systems. Contribute to RTP monitoring processes, including validation of production transaction data against simulation data and expected mathematical behaviour. Support and evolve tools used for mathematical review, simulations, data files, monitoring, and alerting. Implement and maintain round details logic required for regulated markets, ensuring that detailed game round information can be correctly provided to partners and regulators. Collaborate closely with mathematicians, backend engineers, platform teams, compliance stakeholders, and product representatives. Investigate issues related to game logic, mathematical validation, monitoring, and engine behaviour. Ability to understand domain-specific logic and work with technical systems where business rules, mathematics, and engineering are closely connected. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with complex, non-standard technical challenges. Ability to collaborate closely with non-engineering technical experts, especially mathematicians or domain specialists. Strong ownership mindset and willingness to become a key expert in a narrow but highly important technical domain. jobs.description: The Role Ashby's GTM engine runs on a set of interconnected systems. Keeping them accurate, efficient, and trusted is the foundation everything else is built on. As our GTM Systems Analyst, you'll own the daily maintenance and configuration of technical layer that powers our Go-to-Market organization: the CRM configurations, integration architecture, and data quality practices that let our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams move fast with confidence. This role sits within Revenue Operations, the horizontal function that makes the entire GTM system work. You'll be embedded in daily operations (triaging issues, implementing new tooling, and translating business requirements into scalable configurations) while also contributing to longer-term systems strategy as we move up-market and expand our product suite. Why this role matters now We're in an active expansion phase: new products, new segments, new GTM motions. Our systems need to keep pace. The person in this role will shape how we build the technical foundation for the next chapter of Ashby's growth. What You'll Do System Administration: Own the day-to-day health of our core GTM platforms. You'll manage configuration, user permissions, custom objects, and workflow automation across our CRM stack — making sure the systems actually reflect how our teams work, not just how they were set up two years ago. Integration Support: Maintain clean data flows across our GTM toolset ( including intent data, conversation intelligence, and sales engagement platforms). You'll be the person who knows how signals travel between systems and why, and who makes sure they're flowing reliably. Data Governance: Enforce standards for data quality, deduplication, and field taxonomy. Revenue reporting and forecasting are only as good as the data underneath them, along with our GTM Engineers and our System Architect, you'll build the infrastructure of trust that makes those outputs credible. Stakeholder Support: Be the go-to technical partner for frontline GTM teams. You'll triage issues, gather business requirements, and deliver solutions that scale. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners and know when to say "that requires a bigger conversation" rather than patching around a root cause. Tooling Evaluation: Help evaluate new GTM tech and AI tools as our needs evolve. You'll assess how new tools will integrate with our existing systems, support contract renewals, and support implementation of emerging solutions, with a practical bias toward what will actually get adopted and maintained. What We're Looking For Advanced proficiency in CRM administration: Salesforce Administrator or HubSpot Administrator certification strongly preferred Experience connecting marketing automation, CRM, and revenue intelligence tools (e.g., 6sense, Gong, Outreach, Gainsight) Ability to translate abstract business goals into documented, scalable technical configurations Strong analytical skills: you can diagnose data discrepancies, form a hypothesis, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences Instinctive troubleshooter: you don't wait for a problem to be fully described before you start hypothesizing Clear written communicator; we're a remote-first company and documentation is how work gets shared 2–4 years in a RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Sales Ops systems role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company Nice to Have Familiarity with SQL or data warehouse querying (Snowflake, BigQuery) for ad hoc analysis Experience with AI-assisted workflow automation or prompt-based tooling in a GTM context Exposure to multi-product or multi-segment GTM motions This role may not be a fit if: You have used CRM systems extensively, but have not owned CRM administration work directly. jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description: Documo is on a mission to help businesses digitize and streamline their document workflows. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, our platform makes it easier to handle unstructured files like faxes and forms through tools like Intelligent Document Processing - turning messy paperwork into structured, usable data. We believe great products start with great people. That’s why we invest in top talent, value strong culture, and prioritize customer success and design excellence. If you’re excited to do impactful work and want to grow with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and purpose - we’d love to meet you! About Documo Documo helps healthcare organizations turn information into action. Referrals, records, and authorizations still arrive as faxes and forms, and someone has to read, sort, and key in every page. We automate that manual document work. Our platform combines HIPAA-compliant cloud fax, Direct Secure Messaging, and AI-powered document and workflow automation, so critical work moves faster and care teams get time back for patients. We’re a small team, so everyone has real ownership and can see the impact of their work. We hire people who care about customers, sweat the details, and want to build something that matters in healthcare. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you. The role This is a pipeline generation role. You will decide who we target, when, why and with what message, then run integrated campaigns that carry that plan across our channels. Those channels include BDR outreach, events, LinkedIn and social, partner marketing, marketplaces, review sites, email, the website and paid media. The job is campaign strategy and execution, not just channel management. You will need enough digital skill to work hands-on across web, email, social and paid, and you will help manage our paid media agency. You will work daily with the BDR team and sales, and with content, product marketing and SEO. Your ultimate KPI is pipeline. What you'll own Integrated and account-based campaigns Own the integrated campaign calendar: one theme and offer per campaign, sequenced across outbound, website, events, email, LinkedIn, paid media (with our agency) and content. Build and run our ABM program with sales: target account list, tiers (1:1 for top enterprise accounts, 1:few clusters by EHR or segment, 1:many for the broader ICP), and a play for each tier. Launch a go-to-market campaign for each new EHR integration: buy and enrich lists of that EHR's customers, target the right ICP titles and specialties, and brief content on EHR-specific messaging and assets. Build automated sales enablement that gives BDRs and AEs timely reasons to reach out to prospects and open opportunities, such as intent signals, EHR and technology fit, hiring, funding and event attendance. Brief content, product marketing and web on the assets and landing pages each campaign needs. Track engagement and pipeline at the account and buying-group level, not just leads. BDR programs and outbound campaigns Be marketing's partner to the BDR manager: you build the lists and messaging, they run the team and the daily outreach. You work side by side on what each segment needs. Build target segments by ICP, EHR, specialty, organization size and buying trigger, with sales and the BDR manager. Source, enrich and maintain prospect lists using Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, enrichment tools and intent data; keep data clean and routed. Write messaging and multi-touch sequences (email, phone, LinkedIn) for each segment with the BDR manager; test, measure and retire what doesn't book meetings. Run campaign sprints with the BDRs: account lists, talk tracks, offers and event follow-up plays. Report weekly on meetings booked, meeting-to-opportunity conversion and pipeline by segment. Inbound lead programs Work with the website manager on campaign offers and CTAs, so each campaign's landing experience matches its segment and message. Run nurture for leads that aren't ready to buy, and track MQL-to-SQL-to-pipeline conversion with sales. Events Own pipeline generation for every event on our calendar: industry shows such as HIMSS, EHR and partner events such as PointClickCare, and category events. Event selection, logistics and booth setup are run by our Content Marketing Manager. Before the show: build target attendee and account lists, and run pre-event outreach with the BDRs to book meetings. At the show: staff the booth, run booked meetings and capture leads (roughly 25% travel). After the show: run follow-up sequences with the BDRs within days, and track meetings and opportunities to close. Report meetings, pipeline and cost per meeting for each event, and recommend which events to keep, add or drop. Paid media partnership Help manage our paid search and paid social agency: shape campaign ideas, set targeting and offers, and review results against pipeline. Align paid retargeting and ABM audiences with outbound and event target lists. Reviews, marketplaces, partner marketing and LinkedIn Own our G2 profile and presence on other review sites (Capterra, TrustRadius, KLAS where relevant); keep listings, categories and screenshots current. Run an always-on review program with CS and sales: ask timing, incentives and quarterly targets; use reviews in campaigns and sales materials. Manage marketplace listings with EHR and technology partners and keep them generating leads. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

 

Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

Tagline: Build the engine that builds Okta.

🚀 Your Mission: Define the Future of Developer Velocity at Okta

Are you a software engineer who believes that an exceptional developer platform is the key to unlocking engineering-wide innovation? Are you obsessed with building the high-leverage tools, services, and automated infrastructure that make building, testing, and deploying software a seamless experience?

Okta s Platform & Infrastructure team is the central nervous system for all of Okta Engineering. We build and own the entire internal developer platform—the CI/CD pipelines, the build-and-test orchestration, and the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers it all.

This isn t just about maintaining systems. It s about building a scalable, resilient, and blazing-fast "paved road" that empowers hundreds of engineers to ship high-quality code, multiple times a day.

Our scale is immense. We run tens of thousands of automated tests for every single commit. As Okta grows, this CI/CD workload presents a monumental engineering challenge.

Your primary goal will be to attack this problem head-on. You will be a key builder  in our quest to shrink massive, distributed compute jobs from hours or days down to just minutes. This role requires deep systems thinking, clever orchestration, and a passion for wringing every last drop of performance out of the infrastructure.

💻 What You ll Do (The Impact)

As a Staff Engineer, you are a technical leader, architect, and hands-on builder. You will:

  • Architect & Build: Design, code, and operate the next generation of our CI/CD platform, primarily using Go (Golang) and Python.
  • Master Kubernetes: Leverage your deep Kubernetes (K8s) expertise to orchestrate our complex and ephemeral build, test, and deployment workflows at massive scale.
  • Own the Multi-Cloud: Build services and automation that abstract and manage workloads extensively across AWS, GCP, and Azure, optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability.
  • Build a Platform, Not Just Tools: Create robust, self-service, and elegant internal products for our engineers. You ll treat our internal developers as your first-class customers.
  • Drive Innovation: You will not just use our build and CI systems, you will be responsible for building and scaling them.
  • Mentor & Lead: Collaborate with peers, mentor other engineers, and set the technical direction for major platform initiatives.

✅ What You ll Bring (The Requirements)

We are looking for a seasoned engineer who has built and scaled internal platforms before.

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering 
  • Coding Skills: You are a strong software engineer first, with proven experience building and maintaining complex systems in Go (Golang) and/or Python.
  • Kubernetes is a Must: You have deep, practical experience building, running, and troubleshooting workloads on Kubernetes. You understand pods, operators, scheduling, and networking inside and out.
  • CI/CD as a Platform: You have architected, built, and/or significantly scaled CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Tekton, ArgoCD) as a platform for other engineers, not just as an end-user.
  • Cloud Expertise: You have demonstrable experience working in major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and understand the nuances of their core services.
  • The Platform Ecosystem: You re fluent in the tools of the trade: Docker, container registries (like Artifactory), and modern build systems (like Gradle or Bazel).
  • Platform Mindset: You are customer-obsessed (your customers are other engineers) and have a proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects to completion.
  • Education: B.S. in Computer Science, equivalent technical experience, or just a proven track record of shipping incredible systems.

 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



About the Role

ClickUp is looking for an FP&A Manager to serve as the financial business partner across three functions: R&D, G&A, and Corporate. You'll own the full cycle of forecasting, month-end close, and budget vs. actuals reporting for each, partnering directly with department leaders and the accounting team. This is a high-autonomy role on a lean Strategic Finance team where you'll have real ownership from day one.

 

What You'll Do

 - R&D: Own expense management, vendor and invoice approvals, headcount planning, non-headcount forecasting, cloud infrastructure cost tracking, and month-end variance analysis and leadership reporting.

 - G&A: Drive expense forecasting, headcount planning, vendor approvals, and month-end close activities including variance analysis and BvA reporting for G&A departments.

 - Corporate: Prepare board of directors, QFR, and investor-ready reporting decks. Manage billings actualization and forecasting, and deliver monthly finance readouts to executive leadership.

 - Partner with Accounting through the monthly close cycle, including soft close, hard close, and results review with budget owners.

 - Maintain rolling forecasts, provide variance commentary for material deviations, and lock forecasts on a monthly cadence.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with recruiting, procurement, and department leaders on headcount and spend decisions.

 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate forecasting workflows, variance commentary, and ad-hoc analysis, setting the bar for AI-augmented FP&A on the team.

 

What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years of FP&A or strategic finance experience, ideally in a high-growth SaaS/tech environment.

 - Experience owning multiple cost centers or business lines simultaneously.

 - Fluency in SaaS financial metrics (ARR, NRR, gross margin, CAC, CLTV) and the ability to connect operating metrics to financial outcomes.

 - Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and budget-to-actual analysis skills.

 - Comfort with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan, or similar), ERP systems (NetSuite preferred), and procurement platforms (Coupa or equivalent).

 - Experience preparing materials for board, executive, and investor audiences, distilling complex data into clear, actionable narratives.

 - Ability to operate independently across multiple stakeholder groups with minimal direction.

 - Strong business partnering instincts: you make department heads sharper, not slower.

 

Nice to Have

 - Prior experience in a high-growth, pre-IPO environment.

 - Genuine AI fluency: you actively use AI tools to accelerate modeling, analysis, and communication in your daily work.

 - Familiarity with AWS/cloud cost tracking and COGS reporting.

 - Experience with HRIS/ATS systems (Workday, Ashby, Greenhouse) for headcount management.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You'll architect the governed, reusable data, knowledge, and skills layers that power analytics, AI agents, and real-time decision systems across Airwallex. You'll define scalable patterns for structured datasets, semantic models, business metrics, entity relationships, contextual documentation, analytical workflows, agent-callable tools, and transformation primitives.

 - Design scalable patterns for governed datasets, semantic models, knowledge artifacts, analytical workflows, agent-callable tools, and transformation primitives.

 - Reconcile local compliance constraints with global consistency in data definitions, metrics, and knowledge assets.

 - Partner with Data Science, AI Engineering, Product, and Risk teams to support experimentation, high-quality decision-making, and reliable AI-enabled workflows.

 - Lead global data modelling efforts, define Agent Interfaces through APIs and tools, and embed automated lineage and quality controls through Governance-as-Code.

 - Serve as the primary technical authority as the team's most senior individual contributor, leading design reviews and mentoring engineers.

You'll work from our Seattle or San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of experience designing and building large-scale data systems with strong architectural fundamentals.

 - Hands-on experience with the Databricks ecosystem, including Unity Catalog and Delta Lake.

 - Experience implementing semantic layers or metric stores to enable consistent reporting and analytics.

 - Strong understanding of how AI and agent-based systems consume data, with experience building APIs or data services to support them.

 - Experience designing data solutions that meet regional data residency and compliance requirements.

 - Demonstrated senior-level individual contributor experience, including leading design reviews and mentoring engineers.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

 - You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

We are evolving traditional data infrastructure into knowledge infrastructure—turning structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable context that helps people and AI systems make better decisions and take action.

You’ll build the platform end to end, from core technologies such as Databricks, Clickhouse, Spark, and Kafka to real-time analytics, knowledge retrieval and indexing, model infrastructure, agent capabilities, and AI interaction history. You’ll also develop the evaluation, annotation, feedback, governance, permission, and freshness frameworks required to operate AI reliably at global financial scale.

Our mission is making this ecosystem truly agent-ready. That means enabling teams to explore data through natural language, investigate business drivers in real time, and give AI systems secure access to the context and capabilities they need to support decisions and execute workflows.

If you want to build the foundation that turns Airwallex’s data into knowledge, knowledge into intelligence, and intelligence into measurable business impact, this is where that work happens.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Workforce Security
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to protect how our staff work: the accounts they sign in with, the devices they use, the third-party tools they rely on, and the agents they delegate work to. You'll work closely with IT, which operates our employee services and devices. This is an engineering role: you'll spend your time building tools and automations, designing practical controls, investigating escalations, and shipping changes. What You’ll Work On These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover them all at once: Identity and access. Strengthen how staff authenticate and what they can reach: single sign-on coverage, phishing-resistant authentication, and access provisioning and revocation that stay reliable and complete as people and tools change. Design scoped, short-lived credentials for the tools and agents that act on staff's behalf, and improve our ability to detect credential misuse. Endpoint security. Work with IT on device trust, hardening, and visibility across our fleet. Find practical ways for engineers and researchers to install what they need without introducing unnecessary risk. AI agents and staff tooling. Help staff use agents and AI-powered tools productively and safely. Review the threat models, permissions, and data flows of tools staff build or adopt, including coding agents, desktop assistants, browser extensions, and MCP servers. This includes how staff supervise and stay accountable for delegated actions, and the audit trails that make agent activity reviewable. Build sandboxes, credential patterns, and guardrails that make the secure path the convenient one. Third-party tool security. Define a scalable security review for the tools staff use day to day, and work with IT, which owns procurement and provisioning, to build security checks into how tools are onboarded and offboarded. Maintain a current picture of which tools can reach company code, credentials, and customer data as tools are added and retired. Visibility and response. Make sure identity, endpoint, and SaaS telemetry is collected and usable. Investigate escalations and incidents in these areas, verify that we can contain a compromised account or device quickly, and turn findings into lasting fixes. What We’re Looking For Strong experience in identity and access security and endpoint security. Hands-on experience administering an identity provider and a device-management platform. Practical understanding of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, secrets handling, and authorization design. You can trace how an application obtains and uses credentials and find where access controls can be bypassed. Hands-on engineering ability. You can read unfamiliar code, inspect how an app talks to APIs, and write the automation and tooling that replace manual processes. Experience using LLMs and agents in your own work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they can be attacked or misused. Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones and apply controls in proportion to the risk. Experience supporting researchers, engineers, or other highly technical staff, and a track record of finding secure ways to meet their needs. Comfort working with real autonomy and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements. Experience with macOS security, developer tooling, SaaS security, software distribution, agent integrations, or threat hunting would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems for real users than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list. How We Work Together We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you. Base Annual Salary: US $180,000 - $225,000 USD + Equity Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team. Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering organization and play a key role in shaping the architecture, scalability, and long-term evolution of our platform.

As a Staff Engineer at Nozomi Networks, you will operate at both a technical leadership and hands-on engineering level, driving complex initiatives across teams while setting a high bar for engineering excellence. You will own critical areas of the system, influence architectural decisions, and mentor engineers, while delivering impactful features and platform improvements at scale.
The final job title (e.g., Software Engineer, Senior, or Staff) will be aligned to the successful candidate s demonstrated level of knowledge, skills, and impact, rather than years of experience.

You could be the next "Nozomier"! If this sounds like you, read on. 

In this role you will: 

  • Lead the design and evolution of distributed systems that power our OT/IoT cybersecurity platform
  • Drive architecture decisions with a long-term perspective on scalability, performance, and maintainability
  • Own cross-team initiatives, aligning engineering efforts with product and business priorities
  • Identify and systematically reduce technical debt, improving system reliability and developer productivity
  • Act as a technical multiplier, mentoring engineers and raising the bar on design, code quality, and operational excellence
  • Define and champion best practices in software design, testing, and observability
  • Collaborate closely with Product, SRE, and Security teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
  • Influence and improve engineering processes, ensuring effective delivery in a fast-paced agile environment
  • Take ownership of mission-critical features and services, from concept through production and beyond
  • Embody Nozomi Networks’ cultural pillars, promoting transparency, trust, and accountability

To be successful in this opportunity, you will have: 

  • Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems in production environments
  • Strong expertise in at least one core language: Golang, C++, or Ruby
  • Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript and React is a plus
  • Proven track record of technical leadership beyond team boundaries
  • Deep understanding of system design, algorithms, and data structures
  • Experience with modern backend architectures, APIs, and service-oriented systems
  • Solid background in automated testing strategies (TDD, BDD, integration testing)
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling is a plus
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP , UDP , etc.) is highly valuable
  • Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to operate in high-trust, high-confidentiality environments

Nozomi Networks is the leader in OT and IoT Cybersecurity. We protect the world s critical infrastructure, industrial and government organizations from cyber threats by providing exceptional network visibility, threat detection and operational insight. We’re always innovating and we hire the best at what they do to ensure our customers always have access to fast product enhancements, exceptional engineering support and rapid deployment across continents. If you like a challenge, and value integrity and customer success, we invite you to help Nozomi Networks build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! jobs.description: Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Role Overview The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo’s Security department and delivers it through hands-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI-powered features, including problems with no established playbook. The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person. Key Responsibilities AppSec strategy, standards, and influence Lead Apollo’s multi-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi-quarter, cross-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence. Shape Engineering, Product, Platform, and Data roadmaps so security work is planned in early, and represent AppSec in cross-department decisions. Set the secure design, code review, and risk model standards used across the department and adjacent engineering teams, including expectations for AI-generated and agent-generated code. Mentor senior engineers and security champions, grow the champions program, and help raise the hiring bar, so the AppSec program does not depend on one person’s expertise. Secure architecture and vulnerability depth Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high-scale, multi-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists. Design and drive adoption of secure-by-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing. Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk-based severity decisions. Stay hands-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams. Tooling, automation, and AI (AI-native by default) Set the standard for AI-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality. Strong software development skills and the ability to ship production code. Ruby and Ruby on Rails experience is highly valuable, and Python is a plus. Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP and Kubernetes. Deep experience with secure architecture and authentication and authorization patterns, and with building security building blocks that other teams adopt. Hands-on experience securing AI-powered systems or agent features, and a clear point of view on how AI changes application security. The judgment to make hard risk calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading security for AI-native products, internal agents, or AI-assisted engineering workflows at scale. Experience building or scaling a security champions or developer enablement program. Public security work, such as CVEs, research, talks, or open-source tools, or certifications such as OSCP or OSWE. Example Success Outcomes An AppSec strategy tied to Security department KRs, with supporting work committed in other teams’ roadmaps. A measurable drop in high-risk vulnerability classes, backed by shared guardrails or libraries. AI-assisted AppSec workflows adopted by teams outside Security, with clear gains in speed or signal quality. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, CKD
jobs.description: At NerdWallet , we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do. NerdWallet is looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical direction for bringing NerdWallet's financial guidance into the AI assistants consumers already use. More and more people start their financial decisions with a conversation instead of a search. We want NerdWallet's trusted guidance to be there when they do. You'll architect and build NerdWallet's apps and integrations on leading third-party AI platforms. That means production LLM-backed systems that run inside environments we don't control: they have to stay accurate, grounded in trusted content, and compliant in a highly regulated domain, while adapting to fast-moving platform capabilities, protocols, and policies. You'll be the senior technical voice across the platform integration teams and partner closely with the team that owns the shared services these integrations run on. This is a hands-on role. The ideal candidate writes a lot of code, sets the architectural bar, and makes the engineers around them better. You're a staff engineer who is energized by building on brand-new platforms where the playbook doesn't exist yet. You'll turn ambiguous product bets into clear technical plans, then build the critical parts yourself. You'll define how NerdWallet shows up across multiple AI platforms, balancing what should be shared against what needs to be platform-specific so each team can move fast and independently. You're a trusted technical advisor to Engineering Managers and Product Managers, you raise the quality bar through design and code review, and you mentor engineers on building reliable systems on top of non-deterministic models. You stay close to the rapidly changing AI ecosystem and help NerdWallet decide where to invest. This role reports to the Director, Engineering. Where you can make an impact: Lead the technical direction for AI platform integrations. Own the architecture for how NerdWallet's guidance is packaged, exposed, and rendered inside third-party AI assistants, from tool and protocol design to in-conversation UI. Build a lot of it yourself. Write production code for new integrations, prototype new platform capabilities as they launch, and unblock teams on the hardest technical problems. Design for reuse across platforms. Define the abstractions, contracts, and patterns that let multiple platform teams share a common foundation while still using each platform's unique features. Adapt as platforms change. Track evolving platform protocols, SDKs, review processes, and policies. Turn those changes into roadmap and architecture decisions before they become blockers. Make quality measurable. Help define eval and testing strategy for platform integrations, including automated evals, regression suites, and end-to-end tests across environments you don't fully control. Build safely for a regulated domain. Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance so integrations handle authentication, consent, and sensitive consumer data correctly and follow financial compliance requirements. Own reliability and performance. Set standards for monitoring, latency, cost, and incident response on platform-facing services, and help resolve production issues when they happen. Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, set coding and architecture standards, and conduct code reviews that model what good looks like. Mentor and multiply. Coach engineers across FTE and contractor teams on system design, LLM-backed development, and good engineering practices. Partner with leadership on the roadmap. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. About Apollo Apollo is the AI-powered go-to-market platform that helps revenue teams find, engage, and convert their best customers. We combine a database of more than 210 million contacts and 35 million companies with an agentic end-to-end GTM platform, and more than 500,000 companies rely on us to run their go-to-market motion. We are profitable, growing fast, and rebuilding the product around AI and agents. About Builder Studio Builder Studio is Apollo's new product for building custom GTM software in plain English. A RevOps lead, GTM engineer, or founder describes the tool they need, and Builder Studio plans it, generates real code, and turns it into a working app they can preview, refine through conversation, publish, and share with their team. Every app is made of four building blocks: Pages for the interface, Databases for structured records, Workflows for visible backend logic and scheduled jobs, and Agents that reason over Apollo context and take action. What makes it different from a generic app builder is that Apollo's data, enrichment, sequences, deliverability, and CRM sync are native building blocks, not bolted-on third-party integrations. It is one of Apollo's flagship AI bets. The product is in the hands of early design partners now and is heading toward broad launch, which means the next year is about taking a working product and making it reliable, secure, and loved at scale. Your role and mission You will own major slices of Builder Studio end to end, across the builder experience customers see and the systems that make generated apps actually run. You use agents to move faster on design, investigation, and implementation, with clear judgment about where to review closely, and you look for ways AI raises the leverage of the whole team. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, App Analysis
jobs.description:
MongoDB is dedicated to solving one of the industry s biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. To accelerate this transition, MongoDB is growing its Application Modernisation Platform (AMP) engineering teams in Sydney, focusing on building intelligent tools that help customers understand and modernise their application codebases. Our products guide customers through the entire journey of modernising their applications — from legacy relational platforms to modern, scalable systems built on MongoDB. The App Analysis team owns the critical first stage of this journey: building the context that powers everything downstream. The team builds code analysis tools that construct code dependency graphs and generate deep insights for codebases, giving customers a clear understanding of their existing applications before transformation begins. Our work sits at the intersection of analysis, data modelling, and AI — helping developers make confident, data-driven decisions as they transition to MongoDB. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who excels at leveraging GenAI capabilities, architecting complex systems, and bringing strong backend engineering fundamentals with the ability to contribute across the full stack. You will lead and collaborate closely with product management and other engineering teams to design and deliver cutting-edge features that guide customers through complex modernisation journeys.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Sydney for our hybrid working model.

  • Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in engineering designs and implementations, and hold a high engineering excellence standard.
  • Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with code analysis, static analysis tooling, or building tools that traverse and interpret code structures programmatically

Position Expectations

  • Thought Leadership: Proactively identify opportunities to improve how we analyse and understand complex application codebases. Lead exploratory work and focused PoCs to evaluate emerging technologies, including AI/LLMs, agentic approaches and new code analysis techniques.
  • Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, and Designers to shape the technical roadmap. Anticipate future business needs and translate them into scalable, long-term technical initiatives.
  • Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Define and champion engineering best practices, patterns, and standards across multiple teams. Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level engineers, cultivating a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

Success Measures

Within the first three months, you will have:

  • Familiarise yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

Cloudflare runs one of the world s largest networks, and every API call that configures it, from any customer, integration, or internal service, starts by proving who is calling and what they re allowed to do. The IAM team owns the authentication and authorization systems behind that: the identity layer of the Control Plane operating at global scale. Our surface spans things like login and SSO, OAuth and API tokens, account membership, roles and permissions, and SCIM provisioning.

We’re hiring a hands-on Principal Engineer to shape the technical direction of Cloudflare’s IAM platform and lead complex initiatives across teams. You’ll work from architecture through production code and rollout, evolving services under live traffic to deliver new customer capabilities, greater scale, edge-native execution, and support for data residency requirements. You’ll help teams make sound tradeoffs between security, correctness, latency, and availability.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture & strategy: Set the technical direction and delivery strategy for IAM, connecting customer needs with architectural decisions and practical, incremental investments.

  • Technical leadership & delivery: Lead complex initiatives across engineering teams, resolve ambiguity, build agreement on tradeoffs, and carry decisions through implementation and production rollout.

  • Hands-on engineering: Design, build, and debug critical authentication and authorization services, including safe migrations and backward-compatible API changes.

  • Security & reliability: Partner with Security to strengthen threat models and tenant isolation. Guide reliability improvements through observability, incident learning, and resilient system design.

  • Mentorship & engineering judgment: Develop senior and staff engineers through design collaboration, code reviews, and clear technical decisions.

  • Engineering effectiveness & automation: Identify and lead investments in automation and AI that improve how teams build, test, and operate IAM services. Prioritize measurable improvements in delivery speed, reliability, and engineering capacity while maintaining security and correctness.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Extensive experience: A sustained record of building and operating large-scale production systems, setting technical direction across teams, and delivering complex initiatives with measurable customer or operational impact.

  • Identity expertise: Deep experience building production authentication or authorization systems, with sound judgment around identity protocols, permission models, tenant isolation, and credential and session lifecycles.

  • Distributed systems mastery: Proven track record in designing, architecting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems that handle global traffic.

  • Languages & storage: Strong backend engineering skills and willingness to work extensively in Go, with practical depth in relational data modeling, transactions, caching, and distributed consistency. Experience with Go and PostgreSQL is particularly relevant.

  • API stewardship: Significant experience designing and versioning public-facing APIs that are used by millions of developers.

Bonus Points

  • Cloudflare ecosystem: Experience building on Cloudflare Workers or similar serverless/edge computing environments.

  • Observability advocate: A passion for building "observable" systems using Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana to proactively identify failures.

  • Infrastructure as code: Experience with modern containerized deployment (Docker & Kubernetes), Terraform, and infrastructure automation.

  • Security mindset: A background in security engineering or formal verification of protocol implementations.

We’re looking for talented team members to help build high-growth products, help scale our expanding network, build tools to improve availability, performance, uptime, and response times, and make systems failure-resistant and ready-to-scale.

We are looking for a talented Senior Systems Engineer to join the Security Rules team. You will work on the distributed systems behind Cloudflare s Application Security products, mainly in Rust. As a senior engineer, you will take ownership of complex technical problems, lead projects from design through production operation, and help shape the architecture and reliability of systems that run at Cloudflare’s scale. You will also mentor other engineers, provide thoughtful technical guidance, and help raise the quality of engineering practices across the team.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

  • Help raise the technical bar for the team by identifying systemic improvements, reducing operational toil, and influencing long-term engineering direction.
  • Review work from your peers throughout all stages of the development lifecycle to ensure high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Mentor engineers across the team by sharing technical context, providing thoughtful code and design feedback, and helping others grow in scope and ownership.

jobs.title: Demo Engineering Developer
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

About the Team & Impact
At Okta, Demo Engineering bridges the gap between product innovation and go-to-market execution—acting as a global force multiplier for our technical sales organization. We equip internal and partner Solution Engineers worldwide with the tools and environments needed to effortlessly demonstrate how Okta secures identities across workforces, customers, and AI agents.

In this role, your code directly powers Okta’s global sales engine. The demo architectures and interactive experiences you create will be leveraged by hundreds of field engineers across dozens of countries, influencing thousands of enterprise customer conversations. Operating within an engineering-first, collaborative culture focused on automation, modularity, and self-service, you will build the core platform that makes Okta’s field teams faster, sharper, and more scalable.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect Reusable Assets: Design and develop modular demo components and pre-configured product environments tailored to high-impact, solution-driven customer scenarios.
  • Capture Field Insights: Partner closely with global field teams to gather "Voice of the Customer" feedback—translating prospect expectations, preferences, and friction points into platform improvements.
  • Drive Platform Adoption: Team up with Field Readiness to champion the Demo Platform and accelerate usage across the broader go-to-market organization.
  • Measure & Optimize: Build telemetry, analytics, and reporting dashboards to monitor demo engagement and quantify field impact.
  • Launch New Capabilities: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management and Core Engineering to build demo-ready experiences ahead of new product releases.
  • Influence Product Roadmap: Represent field and customer insights during release planning to help shape future product direction.
  • Enable the Field: Author clear technical walkthroughs, demonstration guides, and video tutorials to empower self-service adoption.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Industry Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software development experience building Enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Full-Stack & Cloud Expertise: Strong proficiency in React.js, Node.js, and AWS Serverless architectures (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS).
  • Multi-Tenant Architecture: Proven background designing and implementing multi-tenant systems with strict tenant isolation.
  • DevOps & Automation: Practical experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) or automated configuration management tools.
  • Identity & API Fluency: Solid experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs with identity providers, backed by strong working knowledge of modern authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).

How You Work

  • Globally Minded: Experienced in collaborating across time zones and supporting a distributed, international field organization.
  • Proactive Builder: Self-driven and resourceful—you spot gaps, propose solutions, and execute without needing micromanagement.
  • Cross-Functional Connector: Energized by working at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering.
  • Systems Thinker: Capable of balancing fast-turnaround field requests with long-term architectural scalability and code reuse.
  • Customer-Obsessed: Skilled at distilling qualitative customer and field feedback into concrete technical requirements.

Bonus Points For

  • Prior experience on a Demo Engineering, Technical Marketing, or Developer Relations team.
  • Background in Presales, Solutions Engineering, or Customer-Facing Technical Consulting.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Okta or Auth0 platforms.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure (Datastores)
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Datastores team owns Coinbase s production online databases and caches: Aurora, RDS Postgres, MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, ElastiCache (Valkey, Redis), and ClickHouse. We build the paved paths, tooling, and client libraries that let hundreds of engineering teams run reliable, secure, cost-efficient data layers serving millions of requests per second. We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help evolve our storage platform: consolidating how databases are provisioned and operated, building zonal resilience and disaster recovery into every production datastore, securing access to data, and giving teams well-paved ways to use it.

What you ll do

  • Shape the architecture and multi-year roadmap of Coinbase s storage platform across relational, document, key-value, and caching datastores.
  • Lead platform initiatives from design through production, such as consolidating databases onto shared, proxy-fronted clusters and building client libraries that make applications resilient to failover.
  • Drive resilience and disaster recovery for online datastores: zonal failover, backups and replication, restore tooling, and regular recovery validation.
  • Harden the security and compliance posture of our datastores: encryption and key management, least-privilege access, audit logging, and the controls and evidence that regulators and auditors expect.
  • Design for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency; set and defend SLOs, lead capacity planning, and eliminate recurring classes of incidents.
  • Partner with senior engineers and product-group leadership on database technology choices, and work directly with AWS, MongoDB, and other vendors.
  • Mentor engineers across the team, raise the bar on design reviews and operational excellence, and participate in the on-call rotation.

 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years of industry experience building and operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems in production.
  • Deep hands-on experience operating online databases at scale in production (e.g., PostgreSQL/Aurora, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis/Valkey, Memcached), including replication, failover, performance tuning, and version upgrades.
  • Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, consistency models, and the trade-offs between datastore technologies.
  • Experience securing data infrastructure in a regulated environment: encryption at rest and in transit, key management, access control, and audit requirements.
  • Strong backend development skills in Go, Java, or Python, with a track record of building database tooling, client libraries, or automation.
  • Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives, writing clear design documents, and influencing without direct authority.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

About the team + role

We collaborate with teams across Data Science, Crypto, Security, and Product to build reliable infrastructure! Our culture is high-performing, fast-moving, and ethical in everything we do.

As a Software Engineer, Backend - Government Products, you will design, build, and own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s core products. jobs.title: Staff Product Software Engineer, Consumer Money
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

As a Staff Engineer, you will play a key role in building new products and scaling existing ones to further evolve Gusto’s personal finance platform. Your work will focus on improving financial tools for everyday employees, helping them reduce financial stress, build healthy money habits, and gain greater control over their paychecks. You will collaborate with a talented cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise throughout the product development lifecycle—from ideation and architecture to development, release, and long-term scaling.

About the Team:

The Consumer Money team is on a mission to help employees achieve financial peace of mind by bridging employment and personal finances. The team s product suite gives workers complete control over their money—including on-demand pay, high-yield cash accounts, and automated savings—all anchored to the paycheck relationship Gusto uniquely powers.

Operating as one of the fastest-growing engines within Gusto Money, the team builds at a fast, startup-like pace. Beyond scaling core worker-facing products, the team is actively incubating 0-to-1 foundational technologies to power Gusto’s broader financial platform vision. Handling people’s livelihoods in a regulated banking space requires combining rapid innovation with deep technical rigor, system reliability, and an uncompromised focus on user experience. This role represents a high-impact opportunity to help shape the future of personal and platform finance at Gusto.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Build products & services and scale the platform that powers consumer money and accounting experiences at Gusto
  • Take ownership of projects, ensuring they meet high standards of quality and performance
  • Adopt the latest best practices for using AI technologies across all aspects of product development
  • Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams
  • Engage in a highly supportive environment working with others to drive productivity and innovation
  • Help drive the product development process from concept to launch

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience
  • Proven track record architecting, building, and testing large-scale, resilient distributed systems and software platforms
  • High-agency ownership: a self-starter who independently takes ambiguous workstreams and drives them to the finish line, rather than waiting for assigned tasks
  • Technical leadership experience guiding multiple engineers through large, complex initiatives from concept to delivery
  • Proactive cross-functional partnership, comfortably driving alignment with Product, Design, and other functions to resolve ambiguity
  • Fluency with modern AI developer tooling, paired with an enthusiasm for modeling and mentoring the team on AI-assisted development practices
  • An aptitude for bringing clarity and simplicity to ambiguous, fast-moving environments with tight iteration cycles
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to distill technical complexity and guide well-reasoned architectural and product tradeoffs

Nice, but not required:

  • Experience in the Fintech industry building scalable backend systems to power financial services and products
  • Experience with banking, lending, or personal financial systems and familiarity with these financial workflows
  • Ruby/Ruby on Rails, GraphQL, React, Typescript, AWS

Please note that a two day travel to a Gusto office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $197,000–$247,000 for San Francisco. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.
