jobs.description:
LunaDb is Asana’s core reactive data loading platform, powering our GraphQL-like query model to deliver instantaneous updates across web, mobile, and external API platforms at a scale of billions of daily queries. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Data Loading Infrastructure team, you will lead the next chapter of LunaDb by driving stack modernization, challenging architectural assumptions, and building dependable, highly available distributed services. You will set technical direction, improve workload isolation and query performance, and partner closely with product engineering teams to ensure Asana remains fast, reliable, and scalable as we expand platform capabilities.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Define and execute a technical roadmap that improves scalability, reliability, developer productivity, and operational simplicity.
  • Design, build, and operate highly available distributed services, caching layers, and realtime data pipelines processing millions of events per second.
  • Advance query performance, cache invalidation, workload isolation, and resource efficiency while preserving data correctness across the platform.
  • Partner with product engineers to support new capabilities, making complex data access easier, faster, and more predictable.
  • Lead major initiatives through architecture, implementation, safe migration, rollout, and long-term production operations.
  • Mentor teammates, guide cross-team technical architecture, and raise the bar for system design, reliability, and engineering quality.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident investigations, and translate operational learnings into lasting improvements across tooling, automation, and infrastructure architecture.

About you

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed backend services.
  • 2+ years of experience building and scaling high-throughput data pipelines, relational/non-relational data stores, and realtime streaming systems.
  • Proven track record of operating mission-critical production systems and maintaining high reliability standards.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in setting architectural direction, driving cross-team consensus, and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Deep architectural judgment with the ability to articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineering peers and cross-functional partners.
  • Practical expertise with Kubernetes, distributed caching technologies (such as Redis), and cloud-native infrastructure design.
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

At Asana, we re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you re interested in this role and don t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we re committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $248,000 - $282,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

  • Career coaching & support

  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

jobs.title: Staff Data SRE
jobs.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About the role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

The Data Production Engineering team is an SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team responsible for the overall ownership of 3rd party data services at Netskope. Including relational databases, noSQL datastores, data caching and streaming services, etc… The team designs, implements, automates, maintains, monitors, and manages these platforms. The team consists of Data Systems Architects and Data SREs.

What’s in it for you

As a Lead Data SRE on the DPE team, you will participate in strategic architectural direction and lead the implementation, operation, performance tuning, and scaling of Netskope’s production data services. In addition, you will provide overarching technical leadership for the team, and mentor senior and junior team members.

Essential Functions

  • Serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and technical lead for designated DPE platforms, storage systems, and infrastructure automation tools.
  • Working closely with DPE architects and Product Engineering leads to architect, scale, and improve the overall reliability, efficiency, and performance of DPE platforms.
  • Designing, building, and maintaining software tools and automation using a variety of programming languages including Python, Go, and Bash at a senior/staff level.
  • Establishing and driving organization-wide adoption of SOPs, engineering standards, and procedural documentation.
  • Leading cross-functional technical evaluations, POCs, and integration of next-generation data platforms and tooling.
  • Applying a deep understanding of non-functional requirements (scalability, disaster recovery, high availability, latency, throughput) to shape platform architecture and ensure business requirements are met.
  • Embracing our corporate culture by fostering collaboration without boundaries, and encouraging teamwork and communication that is clear, open, and honest.

Required skills and experience

  • Please note that due to the specific requirements of working within a FedRAMP High certified environment, all candidates for this position must be U.S. citizens currently residing within the United States.
  • 5+ years of general Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering experience.
  • 8+ years of experience with large-scale, high-throughput, distributed clustered data system environments.
  • 8+ years of experience with deep troubleshooting, kernel/system performance tuning, and configuration of Linux systems.
  • Hands-on experience building tools and automating repetitive tasks with Python and Bash
  • Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence architectural decisions, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional remote teams.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide tier-3 technical escalation support for critical systems in emergency situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to track industry trends, evaluate emerging data technologies, and provide data-driven technical roadmaps and strategic recommendations.
  • Actively mentor senior and junior team members, foster technical growth, and share best practices across the engineering organization.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Compute
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Temporal powers durable execution for the world’s most demanding AI and enterprise systems. The Compute team at Temporal makes that durability feel effortless by building the managed compute primitives that run workers and other execution systems across Temporal Cloud.

We’re solving a hard platform problem: make compute transparent, elastic, safe-by-default, observable, and multi-cloud — without turning customers into infrastructure operators. We build platform primitives that span a variety of execution environments (e.g., serverless-style runtimes, containerized fleets, and customer-controlled deployments). Our work sits at the intersection of control plane + data plane: scaling decisions, isolation boundaries, multi-tenant safety, and production-grade observability. If you’ve built autoscaling systems, multi-tenant platforms, or cloud infrastructure, you’ll find a lot to love here.

See the "Compute team" link to read more --> Compute team https://temporalio.notion.site/Join-Temporal-s-Compute-Team-598b6bca8bf84d3babf3e8e2a22c283c




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Invent

 - Create new managed compute primitives that feel first-class in Temporal Cloud: crisp abstractions, clean APIs, and an extension story across compute providers.

 - Design self-optimizing autoscaling systems (signals, backstops, debouncing, guardrails) that scale worker fleets safely and predictably.

 - Define the Open Source Server ↔ Cloud boundary for compute capabilities, keeping the architecture cohesive and maintainable.

Own

 - Architect, build, and operate services on the hot path of task execution where performance and correctness are customer-visible.

 - Deliver real-world cloud integrations (e.g., customer-account execution): IAM boundaries, secure credentials handling, networking constraints, quotas, and failure modes.

 - Make operability a feature: SLOs, tracing/metrics, load and failure testing, incident reviews, and continuous hardening.

 - Ship end-to-end: API design, rollout strategy, backwards compatibility, and long-term maintenance.

Teach

 - Raise the bar through design docs, strong reviews, pragmatic technical leadership, and mentorship.

 - Lead through influence across teams (Server, SDKs, Security, Control Plane) to land coherent platform changes.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Significant experience building distributed systems or multi-tenant platform services (design, implementation, and production operations).

 - Strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, performance, reliability, and failure-mode thinking.

 - A record of shipping platform primitives used by other engineers/customers (APIs, control planes, data planes).

 - Comfort owning outcomes: SLOs, incident response, and improving on-call quality over time.

 - Excellent written communication and crisp trade-off thinking. (Go experience is a plus; judgment matters most.)


SUPER TO HAVE

 - Experience building cloud compute platforms spanning physical servers, CPU/GPU resources, virtual machines, container orchestration, and networking.

 - Experience extending Kubernetes through custom controllers and CRDs, and operating heterogeneous Kubernetes worker fleets.

 - Experience with IAM/security boundaries for cross-account execution models.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Foundations
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We have an opening to hire a Staff Software Engineer - Agent Optimization

Temporal provides a reliable foundation powering AI leaders such as OpenAI, NVIDIA, Cursor, Lovable, and others. Its adoption is expanding to users spanning a broad range of AI applications ranging from agents to data pipelines and everything in between.

The mission of the AI Foundations team is to accelerate Temporal adoption across the entire ecosystem. Our approach combines a deep understanding of use cases with rigorous application of computer systems and software design principles.

In this role, you will lead our agent optimization efforts. You will design tools and mechanisms to help Temporal users build agents that are optimized for token spend and response time while maintaining result quality. Model routing is a first step, but represents the tip of the iceberg of techniques that we can apply. For example, multi-agent architecture, cache policy, and context management are all relevant. Candidates for this role should have direct experience with this problem domain.

You will work closely with other AI Foundations team members, e.g., those who focus on agentic development, maintaining a set of agents skills that lift performance of Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools for developers of Temporal applications. Other team members build ecosystem integrations or develop policy and security systems.

If you thrive on blending theory and practice, then this is the right team for you. We are an action-oriented group that loves to ship fast and solve customer problems. We also seek thorough technical grounding for our work and invest in systems and practices that foster long-term success.

Most of Temporal’s work is open source—see for yourself here: https://github.com/temporalio [new window]




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work as a software engineer

 - Maintain and expand a deep understanding of agentic coding

 - Design and build agentic coding systems that we can trust to deliver high-quality outputs

 - Develop a deep understanding of AI application development patterns and techniques, including emerging approaches and architectures.

 - Take end-to-end ownership of new features, working with other teams to deliver exceptional reliability and a great developer experience.

 - Work with multiple programming languages: Python and TypeScript, Java, Go.

 - Serve as a domain expert on AI design patterns, collaborating with field staff to provide best-practices and canonical examples.

 - Work directly with our developer community to debug issues that need expert attention and get feedback on Temporal features and APIs.

 - Write public technical documentation describing Temporal concepts and APIs.

 - Go the extra mile to support a customer in need, on the rare occasion that our teams’ engineering expertise is needed.

 - Travel to meet your coworkers for a week once or twice a year.

 - Attend the occasional developer conference to talk about how great Temporal is (optional).




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 8+ years of professional work experience.

 - Proven experience in optimizing AI systems using both machine learning and systems techniques

 - Experience and passion for harnessing generative AI, particularly for agents and coding.

 - A deep appreciation for how to use AI to improve quality, not only to increase quantity. 

 - A sense of taste in code and software development practice. Your approach should be opinionated and thoughtful, but not dogmatic.

 - Fluency in multiple programming languages, and an affinity for learning new ones.

 - Deep experience with concurrent programming—you should know how to use mutexes, atomics, and other concurrency primitives safely.

 - Experience designing APIs and writing documentation for publicly-available libraries or modules.

 - Strong technical communication skills—written and verbal—in English.

 - BS or MS in Computer Science (or a closely-related degree), or equivalent work experience writing production-grade software.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with Temporal’s programming model (e.g. you’ve written an app on Temporal).

 - A track record of open source software contributions, including contributions to 3rd party libraries. 

 - Experience contributing to the architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems.

 - Deep background in machine learning, model training, data science, or machine learning systems.

 - Graduate degree in Computer Science.

jobs.title: Staff Enterprise Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Join our Security team as a Staff Enterprise Security Engineer, where you'll own the security of the systems our employees rely on every day: their laptops, the SaaS applications that hold our data, and the AI assistants and agents now woven into how we work. In this position, you'll set technical direction across endpoint, SaaS, and enterprise AI security, building secure-by-default controls as code and partnering closely with IT, Detection & Response, GRC, and Engineering. You'll also build AI-assisted security workflows of your own, with the right guardrails. We're looking for someone who treats security as an engineering discipline and helps the whole company move fast, safely, as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own endpoint security architecture for a macOS-first fleet (plus Windows, Linux, and mobile), including hardening baselines, working with IT on MDM, EDR, patching policy, application control, and device trust.

 - Manage endpoint and SaaS security configuration as code, using Terraform, version control, code review, and automated rollouts so every control is repeatable and auditable.

 - Build and run the SaaS security program: application inventory, secure configuration standards for critical platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Salesforce), and drift detection.

 - Govern third-party integrations, OAuth grants, browser extensions, and non-human identities to prevent data leakage and over-privileged access.

 - Lead discovery and inventory of AI usage across the company, covering approved assistants, coding agents, MCP servers, plugins, and shadow AI.

 - Design and deploy guardrails for enterprise AI, including data loss prevention, agent and MCP access scoping, tool-call policies, and defenses against prompt injection.

 - Lead cross-functional security initiatives from proposal through rollout, partnering with IT, Engineering, Legal, and People teams: scoping the work, setting milestones, managing stakeholders, and reporting progress and outcomes to leadership.

 - Perform threat modeling and security reviews of new SaaS vendors, AI tools, agents, and internal integrations.

 - Stay current on emerging standards and guidance (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, MCP security specifications) and translate these into actionable internal policy.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure endpoints, identity, SaaS, and AI platforms produce the telemetry needed for detection, and automate response workflows.

 - Mentor engineers across Security and IT, and serve as the senior escalation point for complex enterprise security issues.

 - Able to participate in on-call rotation.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 - 7+ years in enterprise security, corporate security, or a related role, including technical leadership of initiatives that span multiple teams.

 - Deep hands-on experience securing endpoint fleets at scale, with MDM (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet, Intune) and EDR (e.g. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) platforms and macOS hardening.

 - Proven ability to model SaaS threats, assess vendor and integration risk, and harden configurations across platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, and Salesforce.

 - Strong knowledge of identity as the foundation of SaaS and device security: SSO, federation, SCIM provisioning, conditional access, and device posture enforcement.

 - Practical understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool connectors, and over-privileged agents, and experience putting guardrails around AI assistants and coding agents.

 - Ability to write production-quality code in at least one language (e.g. Python or Go), with a history of building automation and security tooling beyond simple scripting.

 - Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps workflows (Terraform, CI/CD pipelines) and with SOAR or workflow automation platforms.

 - A track record of leading projects that span several teams outside Security, from getting them prioritized through delivery, including clear plans, measurable success criteria, and a handoff to long-term owners.

 - Ability to influence without authority, bringing along teams whose goals and constraints differ from Security’s.

 - Excellent communication and ability to explain complex security concepts to non-technical stakeholders.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience administering enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, Copilot) and their admin, audit, and compliance controls.

 - Building MCP servers, agents, or other AI tooling for security workflows.

 - Familiarity with SSPM, enterprise browser security, and DLP or CASB tooling.

 - Supporting audits and compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.

 - Experience in a remote-first company of similar size and growth stage.

 - Open Source contributions or automation projects.

 - Security conference talks or published research.

 - ⚡ Scaled Customer Success experience: You’ve worked in a high-volume or scaled CS/renewals model before.

 - 🏢 Exposure to a mature renewals function: You’ve seen what strong renewal processes look like at a larger SaaS company and can bring some of those learnings into an earlier-stage environment.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Spend
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Spend team, you’ll design and build scalable backend systems that power corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement. You’ll own features end to end—from architecture and implementation through production—while building reliable, secure services and APIs that support complex financial workflows across multi-entity businesses, currencies, and audit trails.

You’ll collaborate with product, infrastructure, design, and other cross-functional partners, contribute to the long-term technical direction of the platform, and mentor engineers across the team.

 - Design and build scalable, secure backend services that power Spend products.

 - Own end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements, from architecture through production.

 - Shape the long-term technical direction of backend systems and APIs.

 - Raise the bar on reliability, maintainability, observability, and API design.

 - Partner with cross-functional teams and mentor engineers to deliver reliable financial workflows.

This is an in-office role—you’ll be in our Singapore office five days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Hands-on experience designing and building backend systems and APIs in production.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems.

 - Proficiency in at least one backend language, such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.

 - A solid understanding of REST API design and backend frameworks, such as Spring Boot.

 - Experience working with cloud infrastructure, such as AWS or GCP, and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes.

 - A strong focus on performance, reliability, and code quality.

Preferred

 - Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools, such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk.
   
   


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

 - You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Spend team builds Airwallex's financial operating layer for modern businesses, bringing together corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement on top of our accounts, payments, and issuing infrastructure. We're building AI that makes real decisions about expenses, policies, and payments, aiming to get 95%+ of submissions down to one click, while every workflow still has to hold up across multi-entity businesses, currencies, and audit trails. This is a team for people who want broad ownership across product, data, and AI, while the roadmap is still being defined. If you want to build production AI for real financial workflows that directly change how businesses operate, this is where that work happens.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Search
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role overview:

We are looking for talented individuals to help us develop state-of-the-art models for information retrieval as part of our Search team. This group is working on a range of tasks including training our embedding and reranker models. You'll have the opportunity to revolutionise people's search experience by contributing to building an intelligent, efficient and precise search system and you would have a lot of opportunity to try new things out, innovate, and productionize your ideas.

Your work will specifically focus on advancing semantic search techniques to improve accuracy and efficiency, involving working with a wide range of novel technologies and collaborating with other teams to integrate your work into our search infrastructure.

We're looking for someone who is passionate about search and has a strong background in information retrieval. Candidates should have experience working with a wide range of technologies and have worked collaboratively with other teams in the past.



Key responsibilities:

 - Design, train and improve upon cutting-edge search models.

 - Gather high-quality retrieval datasets and optimize data pipelines for model training and evaluation.

 - Work closely with the model serving team to ensure that inference is fast and stable.

 - Collaborate with product teams to develop solutions.

 - Engage in research collaborations with our partner organizations and academic affiliations and publish your work in top-tier conferences and journals.

 - Join us at a pivotal moment, shape what we build, have a strong ownership mindset, and wear multiple hats!



Qualifications:

 - Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Tensorflow, TF-Serving, JAX, and XLA/MLIR.

 - Familiarity with training and using various information retrieval models.

 - Experience leveraging Large Language Models as part of training data or evaluation pipelines.

 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills.



Bonus points for:

 - Experience building training and/or evaluation datasets for practical use cases.

 - Proficiency in other programming languages, such as C++ or Golang.

 - Experience using large-scale distributed training strategies with GPUs.



Working location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

WHY THIS ROLE?

The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads at petabyte scale. In this role, you would have the opportunity to architect and lead the design of this system from the ground up, serving petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. You'd be a key contributor, leading the effort to solve a problem few teams have tackled at this scale.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design, architect, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation, driving the technical vision from concept through production.

 - Lead and own the deployment of this system across multiple Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale, setting standards and best practices for the organization.

 - Collaborate with researchers and training-infra teams to define how jobs read and write data, translating those patterns into throughput, latency, and durability requirements that shape the platform's roadmap.

 - Navigate the networking, I/O, and consistency challenges of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the key metrics of success — and drive the solutions that improve them.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE:

 - Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management, with demonstrated architecture and design experience.

 - Strong coding ability in Python and Go, with the ability to lead implementations and mentor others in either language, and the willingness to contribute to the other.

 - Proven experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets, with the capacity to design and execute operational strategies.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems.


IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience with parallel or HPC filesystems such as Weka, VAST, or Lustre, and a track record of applying them at scale.

 - Familiarity with the data-loading and checkpointing patterns used in large-scale model training, with the ability to innovate on them.

 - An interest in how large models are trained and evaluated, including the trajectory and eval data those runs generate, and a desire to understand the workloads the platform is serving — with the capacity to guide others in that understanding.

jobs.description:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.


Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

Senior Software Engineer - Java, React & AWS - Contract

Build software that matters. Shape the future of engineering.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer - Java, React & AWS who is passionate about building scalable, high-quality software and helping teams grow. This is more than a hands-on engineering role. You’ll influence technical direction, mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and help us embed AI and automation into the way we deliver value for our clients.

You’ll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex problems, challenging assumptions, collaborating openly, and taking pride in delivering software that makes a real business impact.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer - Java, React & AWS, you will:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable, secure and resilient applications, from backend services using modern Java and the Spring ecosystem to responsive, accessible front ends built with React.
  • Build and run cloud-native services on AWS, using Lambda, S3, RDS and CloudWatch to deliver solutions that are secure, observable and cost-effective.
  • Lead technical design and architectural discussions, ensuring solutions are maintainable, performant and aligned with best practices.
  • Develop and evolve RESTful APIs with a focus on security, versioning, performance and reliability, and integrate them seamlessly with React applications.
  • Champion engineering excellence through clean code, automated testing, documentation and code reviews.
  • Drive delivery across multiple initiatives while balancing speed, quality and commercial value.
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, pairing and constructive feedback, helping raise capability across the team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve problems together and deliver outstanding outcomes for clients.
  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks and AI capabilities that improve how we build software.
  • Promote automation wherever possible, removing repetitive work so teams can focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation and technical excellence.

What You’ll Bring

Technical Expertise

You’ll have strong commercial experience with:

  • Modern Java (Java 8+) including Streams, Lambdas and Optional
  • Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem
  • React, including hooks, component design and state management
  • JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Spring Data JPA / Hibernate
  • Spring Security including OAuth2 and JWT
  • REST API design and implementation
  • Microservices and distributed system design
  • SQL databases with strong query optimisation skills
  • NoSQL databases
  • Messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Docker and containerised application development
  • CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI
  • Git and modern software development workflows
  • Observability tooling including logging, metrics and distributed tracing
  • Comprehensive testing across unit, integration and functional layers, including front-end testing with tools such as Jest and React Testing Library
  • Maven or Gradle
  • Java concurrency and JVM performance fundamentals

AWS

You’ll have hands-on experience building and running production workloads on AWS, including:

  • AWS Lambda: designing event-driven, serverless functions triggered from API Gateway, S3, SQS or EventBridge, including running Java on Lambda and reducing cold starts (for example with SnapStart)
  • Amazon S3: bucket design, access control, lifecycle policies and event notifications
  • Amazon RDS (PostgreSQL or MySQL): connection management, read replicas, backup and restore, and performance tuning
  • Amazon CloudWatch: structured logging, custom metrics, dashboards and alarms, and using Logs Insights to diagnose production issues
  • IAM: least-privilege access for services and people
  • Infrastructure as Code: CloudFormation, CDK or Terraform

jobs.title: SRE Platform Manager
jobs.description: Who we are Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role At Yubo, Platform Engineering plays a key role in keeping our product reliable and scalable for millions of users, while supporting new technical challenges, including AI. We're looking for an SRE Platform Manager to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael, our Platform Engineering Director. You'll lead 6 experienced DevOps/SRE and Backend Platform Engineers , including Staff Engineers and an Infrastructure Tech Lead. Your mission? Ensure platform reliability, improve delivery performance, and help your team grow while preserving their technical autonomy. After lunch, you join the team for a quick standup via Zoom to discuss current work and the plan for the next few days. You mention that you’re finishing up a small improvement to improve the logging and alerting for one of our components that requires high uptime. A teammate offers to review your changes. You draft a short tech design doc that links the API spec, code examples, and optimization tips. Your day ends with a chat with a product manager about questions that came up while drafting the tech design. jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. About BeQuick BeQuick is the OSS/BSS platform that mobile virtual network operators run their businesses on. Founded in 2002 and part of the Banyan portfolio, BeQuick handles the operational core of a wireless carrier: subscriber lifecycle, rating and billing, provisioning and activation, payments and dunning, taxation and regulatory fees, customer care workflows, retail and dealer channels, and the reporting that tells an operator where its margin actually is. Roughly 30 active MVNO clients depend on the platform daily, including prepaid and postpaid operators, Lifeline providers, faith-based and affinity brands, and enterprise IoT plays. The product suite spans Fusion (core OSS/BSS), Connect (converged billing, including ISPs and WISPs), Orbit (subscriber and dealer portals), Echo (multi-tenant IVR), and Vector. The team is about 15 people, fully remote, and unusually senior for its size. BeQuick has been an early and aggressive adopter of agentic AI in engineering, support, and commercial work, and is recognized inside the Banyan portfolio for it. This is a switching-cost business in the truest sense. Customers do not casually replace the system that bills their subscribers. That durability is real, and it comes with an obligation: the platform has to keep up with carrier requirements, regulatory change, and what operators now expect software to do for them. The Opportunity You would own the whole business: strategy, product direction, go-to-market, team, and P&L. You report to a Banyan Operating Partner and have full operational authority over how you run the company day to day. The mandate: Grow recurring revenue in a market where the buyer universe is finite and every new logo is a competitive displacement or a launch you help stand up. Protect retention and pricing power. Revenue is concentrated in a handful of large accounts. Managing that concentration, both by defending those relationships and by widening the base under them, is a core part of the job, not a footnote. Push the product forward on an AI-first thesis. BeQuick sits on the transaction, usage, and margin data for millions of subscriber-months. Turning that into wholesale margin intelligence, churn prediction, and automated care is the clearest path to structural advantage. Expand adjacent. Converged billing for ISPs and WISPs, and other subscriber-billing markets that share the same operational spine, are open ground. Own the carrier and regulatory surface. Carrier partnership diligence, enterprise security questionnaires, and compliance posture land on the CEO's desk in a company this size. Who You Are You have run a P&L in telecom, and you know this market from the inside. You have sat on the operator side of an MVNO agreement, or built the systems that make one work, and you can tell the difference between a wholesale deal that looks good and one that actually clears. You are technical enough to be dangerous, but you are not here to write code. You can read an API spec, interrogate a data model, hold your own in a carrier integration call, and tell when an engineering estimate is optimistic. You have a Head of Development and a strong engineering team. You need to lead them, not do their jobs. You are comfortable being the primary commercial voice: negotiating your own MSAs and renewals, walking into a carrier's supplier review, and presenting to a board without a chief of staff assembling the deck for you. And AI is not a slide in your strategy deck. It has already changed how you think about where value comes from and what your product should become. Qualifications Required Executive experience (CEO, COO, CRO, CPO, GM, or SVP-level) at an MVNO, MVNE, or MVNA, or at a company selling directly into them. Direct P&L ownership with accountability for growth, net revenue retention, and margin. Working fluency in wireless operations: wholesale carrier economics, activation and provisioning, rating and mediation, number porting, eSIM and BYOD, device financing, dealer and retail channels. Practical command of the regulatory environment: CPNI and Section 222, CALEA, STIR/SHAKEN, USF and state regulatory fees, 10DLC, and the post-ACP Lifeline landscape. Technical literacy sufficient to make credible build-versus-buy calls and to be a real counterpart to an engineering leader. Demonstrated use of AI in a product, in a business, or both, with a clear point of view on where it creates durable value versus where it is theater. Track record leading a small, senior, fully remote team. Strongly preferred Has led a company or business unit through a repositioning, pricing redesign, or platform transition before the market forced it. Experience with B2B SaaS in a concentrated-customer environment, including how to grow out of concentration rather than just survive it. Hands-on carrier relationship management with T-Mobile, Verizon, or AT&T wholesale organizations. Familiarity with telecom tax and compliance engines, and with the operational reality of migrating between them. Nice to have ISP, WISP, or fixed wireless billing exposure. M&A experience, either as an acquirer of small software assets or as an operator inside an acquired company. jobs.title: Senior SRE, Managed Gateways
jobs.description: Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. Senior SRE, Managed Gateways About the Role: Kong's Managed Gateways is the fastest-growing product in the Kong portfolio, a SaaS offering with ARR growing multifold. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer focused on Managed Gateways, you'll be instrumental in architecting and maintaining the resilient, scalable infrastructure that powers Kong's mission-critical managed services — and you'll be the technical face of that product for the enterprise customers who depend on it, directly ensuring the reliability and performance that lets them build the next generation of connected applications at global scale. What You’ll Do: Cloud Gateways is a complex, multi-cloud problem — supported across AWS, GCP, and Azure — and our enterprise customers run large, often unique topologies. This role carries two equally deep engineering mandates: owning production reliability for the platform, and acting as the senior technical authority who takes an enterprise customer from kickoff to a fully successful, live implementation. Platform & Reliability Engineering Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of Site Reliability Engineers dedicated to Kong's Managed Gateway offerings. Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers. Own the end-to-end operational lifecycle, from proactive monitoring and alerting to incident response and blameless post-mortems, ensuring continuous service improvement. Drive a culture of developer delight by implementing automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways. Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs to ensure optimal performance and reliability of Managed Gateways. Champion technical debt prevention and advocate for architectural best practices that enhance system resilience and reduce operational toil. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and Customer Success to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features. Enterprise Implementation Engineering Partner directly with enterprise customers — working alongside Product leadership, Professional Services, and Customer Success — to drive end-to-end onboarding and implementation of Cloud Gateways, and productize recurring implementation patterns into repeatable playbooks and platform capabilities. Bring deep, cross-cloud breadth (AWS, GCP, Azure) to handle unique customer topologies and turn complex setups into successful, production-ready deployments. Serve as the technical owner of the customer relationship through implementation, primarily supporting our North America customer base, and be the escalation point Customer Success leans on for technically complex accounts. Feed real-world implementation patterns and customer constraints back to Product to further contribute the roadmap. What You’ll Bring: The Toolkit Extensive experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, focusing on highly available and distributed systems. Deep expertise with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures, preferably across multiple public cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). Strong proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for automation and tool development. Proven track record in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). In-depth knowledge of monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog). Experience with managed services, API gateways, or similar network infrastructure is highly desirable. The Kong DNA You take immense ownership of your systems, treating reliability as a first-class feature. You operate with a sense of urgency, especially in critical situations, and drive quick, effective resolutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, actively sharing knowledge and elevating the entire team. Kong moves fast, and our team's spread across continents and time zones — plans shift mid-flight, and things don't always line up neatly. You don't need everything settled to do good work. You bring your own calm to the noise, figure things out as you go, and help the people around you do the same. Bonus Points: Experience with Service Mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd). Familiarity with database administration for high-throughput systems (PostgreSQL, Cassandra). Contributions to open-source SRE tools or projects. Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA). #LI-KC1 About Kong: Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Home Energy)
jobs.description: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. AI is fundamental to how we work AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at. What we're looking for: We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating. You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform. In this role, you will: Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC. Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on. Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal. Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation. Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations. Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build. Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack. Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions. Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it. This role will be right for you, if: You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes. Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring: Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems. AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast. Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance. Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights. Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together. Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams. A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates. Nice to have: Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling. Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems. Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms. On-call or incident response experience. What we offer: Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale. A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Cloud Security
jobs.description: At Qualia , we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Millions of consumers close on homes through Qualia every year, which means our cloud carries wire instructions, identity documents, and nonpublic financial data at scale. Cloud Security owns the security of the infrastructure that platform runs on: our AWS accounts and organization, Kubernetes clusters, identity and access paths into production, the CI/CD systems that deploy to it, and the detection and response signal that tells us when something is wrong. The team works alongside Application Security, SRE, Platform, and InfoSec. We're hiring a Senior Cloud Security Engineer who builds. Most of your week goes to writing code and infrastructure: Terraform modules, policy-as-code, Go services for detection and automation, and the integrations that wire them into how Qualia ships. You'll be one of two engineers on the Cloud Security team, working with its EM, so the patterns you set for AWS, Kubernetes, and production access become the ones the rest of engineering follows. Implement just-in-time access, short-lived credentials, and secrets management for humans, services, and CI Run posture to zero. Build and run our in-house posture checks in Go across AWS accounts and container images; fix root causes in code and automate the fix where the class repeats Respond. Investigate cloud alerts and take the infrastructure side of incidents, then close the gap so it doesn't recur Review and teach. Review infrastructure PRs and design proposals; pair with SRE and product engineers to land fixes YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH 6+ years in cloud security, infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering, with at least 3 focused on securing production cloud environments Deep hands-on AWS: IAM policy evaluation, Organizations, VPC and private connectivity, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or equivalent Production Kubernetes security: RBAC, admission control, network policy, pod security, and how workloads authenticate to cloud APIs Strong Terraform (or similar IaC) — you write and review modules, and you've built guardrails other teams depend on You write production code. Go preferred; Python or TypeScript welcome if you're ready to work in Go You can explain how an attacker moves from a leaked credential or a compromised pod to sensitive data, and how you'd detect each step Clear, direct writing: findings an engineer wants to fix and design docs that hold up in review Experience in fintech, real estate tech, or another regulated, high-liability domain (Optional) Cloud penetration testing, red team, or DFIR experience (Optional) Supply chain security: artifact signing, SBOMs, SLSA-style provenance in CI/CD (Optional) Open source security tooling, published research, or conference talks (Optional) THE TECH STACK YOU'LL SECURE AWS (primary), some Azure, and limited GCP (Vertex AI) Kubernetes and a microservice architecture, defined in Terraform and our infrastructure-as-code monorepo Okta for workforce identity and SSO into AWS NodeJS / TypeScript services, MongoDB, and an internal ClickHouse + Grafana security telemetry pipeline Go for internal security tooling and detection services We are a remote-first development organization that values flexibility in how our teams work. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Enterprise Advanced)
jobs.description:
Enterprise Advanced is a distributed team across Europe and India that builds the software running MongoDB on any infrastructure, at global scale — from on-prem data centers to private cloud. You ll work primarily on Ops Manager and Automation, the systems that let customers deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. Our software manages some of the largest self-managed MongoDB deployments in the world, with production clusters running hundreds of shards and nodes under a single deployment.

The main focus of this team is to adapt our software to manage MongoDB clusters which are deployed in data centers or private cloud platforms.

You will work on the core functionality for all of our products.  Our team s end users are some of the largest businesses in the world, deploying massive clusters and processing huge amounts of data.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, test, and release features for Enterprise Advanced Product
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from design through incremental shipping
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues surfaced in customer deployments running at scale
  • Apply engineering judgment and MongoDB s core values across planning, design, and code review

A great fit for this role will be

  • You enjoy distributed-systems problems; consistency, fault tolerance, and scale are the daily reality, not edge cases
  • People who like ambiguity and are comfortable defining their own approach with guidance, not step-by-step instruction
  • You re flexible! You re willing to take on a wide variety of responsibilities, learning as you go
  • You re a self-starter! You re comfortable organizing your own time, acting on feedback and prioritizing with guidance from senior members of your team

Requirements

  • 7+ years experience with a language such as Java or GO
  • Experience building multi-threaded, asynchronous, distributed systems
  • Good knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals (data structures and algorithms)
  • Good understanding of Object Orientation concepts
  • Ability to think conceptually and design modular, complex systems

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity running services on Cloud Infrastructure (Amazon AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure), using containers and/or container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift)
  • Experience working directly with production systems
  • Experience with multiple programming languages
  • Experience with the MongoDB Server (specialized, in-depth training will be provided upon joining)
  • Experience or interest in full-stack web application development

What is in it for you

  • Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits)
  • Hybrid working model (3 days in office, 2 days working from home) 
  • Opportunities to learn on the job (time to upskill in new technologies)
  • Team budget for attending industry-specific conferences and training
  • High level of independence in your day to day work
  • Engineers in our team have the chance to work with multiple programming languages (JAVA, Javascript/React, Golang, Python)
  • You ll be joining a good-humored supportive team that works well together!

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

We build the platform that gets Okta s code tested, merged, built, and shipped. Bacon, our CI system, runs tens of thousands of tests on every commit. Around it we own the services that make CI observable and self-healing, and the release tooling that takes a green commit to a production release: code freeze, backporting, release assembly, artifact promotion, and release auditing.

We are a small team, we ship weekly, and engineers own services end to end. Our goals are to cut feedback time from hours to minutes, keep mainline green, and make every release predictable, auditable, and boring.

Our engineering team is fast, innovative and flexible; with a weekly release cycle and individual ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, emerging technologies and the chance to be part of a company that is changing the cloud computing landscape forever.

You will get an opportunity to work in scaling our infrastructure to the next generation. Our scale is already huge in running tens of thousands of tests for every commit automatically.  This comes with challenges in speed by reducing compute time from days to a few minutes. 

Responsibilities:

Release engineering

  • Own and evolve the release toolchain: code freeze, backporting to release branches, release assembly, artifact promotion, and release auditing. You ll build the automation and Slack workflows (for example in Baconbot) that engineers rely on.
  • Keep weekly releases on schedule. That includes release branch health, cherry-pick/backport gaps, and promotion of build artifacts through environments.
  • Build controls and audit trails that prove what shipped, from where, and who approved it, supporting compliance requirements without slowing teams down.
  • Run the release process during freezes and incidents. You ll triage blocked releases, retry or unstick commits, and write the post-incident follow-ups.

CI platform

  • Design, build, and operate the services behind Bacon: REST/GraphQL APIs, data pipelines, and the React frontend, in Java, Python, Node/TypeScript, and Go.
  • Improve CI speed, reliability, and cost across runner infrastructure on AWS, host images, queue and job allocation, and flaky-test detection and quarantine.
  • Make CI and releases observable with telemetry, metrics, and dashboards (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, time-series stores) that show why a build or release failed and how healthy the fleet is.
  • Apply LLMs to developer workflows, such as automated log triage and failure root-causing, with sensible guardrails.

Across both

  • Automate everything. Everybody automates here, so you ll write tools and scripts that remove toil for thousands of internal users.
  • Partner with product engineering, QA, and Ops teams on rollouts, adoption, and feedback.
  • Share operational ownership: on-call participation, runbooks, alerting, and incident follow-up for what you build.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of professional software development in one or more of Python, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Experience building and running CI/CD and release pipelines, including branching strategies, versioning, and artifact management
  • Strong Git skills: release branches, cherry-picking/backporting, merge conflict resolution, and release tagging
  • Experience building and running backend services and APIs (microservices, multi-service systems)

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Our team sits within Developer Productivity, whose mission is to make software development at Affirm simpler and faster across the company. The broader org owns much of the path between a developer’s laptop and production, including developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, dependency management, and release engineering, all in service of helping engineers ship code quickly, safely, and with confidence.

The Continuous Delivery team’s charter is centered on enabling engineering teams to release independently through strong automation, standard patterns, predictable rollouts, resilient recovery mechanisms, and less manual toil. This role is uniquely positioned to help solve one of Affirm’s most important engineering challenges: scaling developer productivity in an era where the software development lifecycle is increasingly AI-enhanced. The team builds and improves the platforms, workflows, and guardrails that help engineers move from idea to production faster, with better safety, consistency, and developer experience.

We value engineers who listen closely, invite feedback, and work well across organizational boundaries, while also holding a high bar for ownership, technical judgment, and follow-through. Strong candidates will care about building reliable shared systems, reducing friction for other engineers, and making durable improvements that raise the quality and speed of software delivery across Affirm.


What You ll Do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.


What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience building or evolving CI/CD, deployment, or release automation systems that reduce manual toil and improve rollout predictability, recovery, and auditability across many engineering teams
  • You are comfortable working on shared developer infrastructure and defining clear platform interfaces, templates, or guardrails that make it easier for product teams to adopt standard deployment patterns with confidence.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

This team builds and operates the systems that provide oversight and management of Coinbase s financial flows, ensuring that every transaction across the platform is accurate, reliable, and reconciled. You ll own critical backend infrastructure spanning reconciliation, capital flows, anomaly detection, and inventory management, directly protecting the financial integrity of Coinbase and its users across every product line.
