jobs.description: About AlphaSense: AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. About the Team: Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search. At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves. About the Role: AlphaSense has spent more than a decade helping professionals find, trust, and synthesize market intelligence. With SuperAnalyst , we are expanding that foundation into continuous, decision-ready execution: workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile is a critical part of that future because the moments that matter do not only happen when customers are sitting at a desktop. iOS is an important surface for that future because continuous, decision-ready workflows need to feel fast, secure, and reliable across iPhone, iPad, and managed enterprise environments. As a Senior Staff iOS Engineer, you will set technical direction for iOS and the mobile-facing systems that shape product quality across customer workflows. You will work from deep iOS expertise while influencing the architecture, standards, and system contracts that help teams build reliable native experiences across initiatives. This is a hands-on Senior Staff role with significant architectural ownership, multi-team leverage, and long-term product impact. You will help teams move faster while preserving the quality, reliability, and trust that enterprise mobile experiences require, including by shaping how AI-enabled development changes mobile engineering. What you'll do: Set iOS-rooted mobile-system direction:Define the technical direction for iOS and the mobile-facing systems that make AlphaSense experiences fast, reliable, secure, and easier to evolve across teams. Lead through hands-on iOS system design:Turn complex mobile-system problems into durable production architecture grounded in deep iOS expertise. Scale reliability and execution practices: Shape how mobile work is designed, reviewed, tested, shipped, and operated across initiatives, including the automation, observability, rollout practices, and AI-enabled validation needed to move quickly with confidence. Create durable mobile-facing system contracts: Help teams define the boundaries, ownership, and operating expectations that let mobile-facing systems evolve without pushing hidden complexity into native clients. Raise mobile-system judgment across teams:Turn complex mobile-system work into reusable standards and stronger engineering judgment for the teams building native experiences. What We're looking for: Required: Deep expertise in modern production iOS architecture, with a track record of setting technical standards beyond one feature team. Ability to represent mobile platform principles from a deep iOS base, with enough Android fluency to shape cross-functional architecture decisions where backend, web, and product choices affect identity, reliability, release quality, observability, and native product outcomes. Experience shaping mobile-facing platform contracts or backend service boundaries that improve product quality across native and adjacent client surfaces. Ability to read, debug, and contribute to backend systems when needed to unblock mobile-facing outcomes. Experience shaping AI-enabled engineering systems that improve validation, product quality, and delivery confidence across teams. Strong reliability and release-quality judgment across production mobile systems, with experience raising quality standards across multiple initiatives. Track record making engineers around you better by turning complex mobile-system work into clear standards, reusable patterns, and stronger technical judgment across teams. Excellent product judgment and communication skills, including the ability to connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and align teams around durable technical decisions. Preferred: Experience building Apple-platform product experiences across varied device and form-factor contexts, such as iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, CarPlay, or other platform-native surfaces. Experience with enterprise mobile environments where identity, device management, compliance, or security constraints shape architecture, including MDM/MAM. Experience shaping mobile design-system foundations and design-to-code workflows that improve consistency, accessibility, development velocity, and AI-assisted UI generation across native platforms. jobs.description: About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the full stack systems that power Airtm’s financial products. jobs.description: This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group. ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising. Profile Overview This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief. Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be: Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks. Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of. Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us. Your responsibilities Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them. Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on. Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth. What you bring to the table Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut. Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs. Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes). The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts. A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement. jobs.title: Back-end Engineer
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineer within our Commodities tribe, you will lead the end-to-end integration of US inland waterway barge data into Kpler’s global cargo intelligence platform. Operating under a "you build it, you run it" philosophy, you will design robust ingestion paths, stream real-time data using Kafka, and connect barge movement models directly to our customer-facing surfaces. This role carries genuine design authority, empowering you to solve complex entity resolution problems while mentoring peers and elevating technical craft across our crews. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end integration architecture: Drive the full engineering lifecycle—from external feed ingestion and domain modeling to streaming, entity resolution, and UI distribution. Design robust ingestion & entity-resolution systems: Map incoming barge data onto Kpler reference data (vessels, zones, installations, products) using existing Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL matching patterns. Build scalable Kafka streaming pipelines: Construct event-driven contracts, schemas (Avro), deduplication mechanisms, and dead-letter queue replays with Python and Scala. Deliver data across customer surfaces: Surface integrated barge data cleanly across Elasticsearch read models, external APIs, data warehouse feeds, and the Kpler Terminal (TypeScript/Vue). Champion production quality & observability: Maintain full operational ownership of your services, setting SLOs, participating in on-call rotations, and driving post-incident improvements. jobs.description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. This role sits in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters. Customers come to us with pipelines nobody trusts, metrics nobody agrees on, and warehouses that stall every new business question. You'll build the data products that fix that — working with business leads, analysts, and data scientists to understand the domain, then shipping pipelines and models that hold up in production. Because Aedeon handles the repetitive layer source discovery, schema mapping, validation harnesses — you won't spend your early career grinding through spreadsheet audits. You'll spend it writing code that reaches production and learning judgment from engineers who own cutovers. Data quality isn't a checkbox here; it's the product. What you will do? Write efficient PySpark and Amazon Glue code that ships to production. Write SQL in Amazon Athena and Amazon Redshift. Pick up new technologies and techniques and put them to work on real business problems. Work across engineering and business teams to build data products and services people actually use. Deliver projects with the team and land customer updates on time. What are we looking for? 1 to 3 years of experience in Apache Spark, PySpark, and Amazon Glue. 2+ years of experience writing ETL jobs using PySpark and SparkSQL. 2+ years of experience with SQL queries and stored procedures. Deep understanding of the Dataframe API and the transformation functions supported by Spark 2.7+. You will be preferred if you have Prior experience in working on AWS EMR, Apache Airflow Certifications AWS Certified Big Data – Specialty OR Cloudera Certified Big Data Engineer OR Hortonworks Certified Big Data Engineer Understanding of DataOps Engineering How we work? We run a forward-deployed model. Engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally. Aedeon absorbs scale; engineers absorb judgment; the contract absorbs risk. As an associate, you'll work inside that model from day one shipping alongside senior engineers rather than watching from a bench. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We care about what ships, and we let you be yourself while you ship it. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Overview We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices , and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams. Key Responsibilities Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures. AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow. Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change. Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team. Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities. Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards. Required Qualifications & Experience Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization. Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java). Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform. Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams. DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices. Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. jobs.description: About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. Our Stack Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our TaskTiger scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented public API that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools. We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub and on The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark , TaskTiger , LimitLion and ciso8601 . AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. Operating on billions of Mongo documents with Elasticsearch underneath. Growth. Run the experiments and own the billing infrastructure that turn trials into paid customers. Stripe metered billing, AI credit top-ups, the activation and conversion funnel, and the team's biggest bet right now: agentic onboarding (an agent that walks new customers through setup, configuration, and first comms). jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


THE ROLE

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead n8n’s Partnerships team across the Americas, and to own the partnership strategy for the region across all our Solution partners (Systems Integrators (SIs), Global System Integrators (GSIs) and international resellers) and Technology Partners (SAP, Hyperscalers…).

Our Global Partner Ecosystem is strategic to n8n’s success and we need you to build out our existing relations across regional SIs, GSIs such as Accenture and Capgemini and Technology companies such as SAP and Microsoft.

The Americas are a strategic growth region for us and partners are a key pillar to scale our expansion.

Our regional team is expanding quickly and you’ll be the leader of the partner managers in the region and turn strong early partner momentum into a repeatable, predictable source of pipeline and revenue. Reporting to our VP Partnerships, you’ll be based in the US, close to our hub in Boston would be a plus.

Here’s how you’ll make that happen:

🎯 Own the partnership strategy and number for the Americas

 - Define our partner strategy for the Americas as part of the regional leadership team, representing the partnership team internally and externally.

 - Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue targets for the region.

 - Build out and own the resell channel and number for LATAM.

 - Define which partners to invest in, with clear targets per partner and joint business plans with priority partners.

 - Bring visibility on partner performance, pipeline progression and revenue contribution to leadership.

 - Work alongside our Technology Partners team so that the full partner ecosystem contributes to the regional number.

👥 Build and lead a high-performing team

 - Lead, coach and grow a team of Partner Managers covering SIs, GSIs and international resellers across North America and LATAM.

 - Run a strong operating rhythm: forecasting, pipeline reviews, partner business reviews and 1:1s.

 - Raise the bar on how the team plans, prioritizes and executes with partners.

🤝 Scale our SI, GSI and reseller ecosystem

 - Shape and execute the regional strategy across GSIs, boutique SIs and international resellers.

 - Build executive relationships with partner leadership, from practice leads to alliance and sales leaders.

 - Help partners build n8n practices, service offerings and repeatable delivery capabilities.

 - Expand our reach into LATAM and Canada through the right partners.

📈 Drive co-selling with our Sales team

 - Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Marketing leadership in the Americas.

 - Make sure every Account Executive knows which partner to bring in, when and how.

 - Build co-sell motions, account mapping and joint campaigns that move enterprise deals forward.

🌀 Shape the partner program

 - You’ll be part of the global partnership leadership team and act as the voice of partners internally, sharing insights that shape programs, incentives and product priorities.

 - Help define what excellent partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale globally.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

 - 🚀 Partnerships leadership: You have 10+ years of experience in partnerships, alliances, channel or sales in B2B SaaS, including several years leading a team of partner or channel managers.

 - 🎯 SI and GSI track record: You have launched and scaled motions with GSIs and SIs (e.g. Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini) and can show the partner-sourced and influenced pipeline you drove.

 - 📈 Number ownership: You have owned a regional partner revenue or pipeline target and know how to forecast and deliver it.

 - 🌎 Americas network: You know the North American partner landscape and have an established network across SIs, GSIs or resellers.

 - 💼 Enterprise deals: You have supported partner-involved enterprise deals and complex sales cycles.

 - 💻 Technical depth: You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, automation and the AI landscape.

 - 🏗️ Builder’s mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, prioritize well in ambiguity and enjoy building programs and teams from early stages.

Nice-to-haves

 - 🌍 LATAM and Canada experience, and Spanish or Portuguese.

 - 🌐 International reseller or distribution experience.

 - 🔧 Industry knowledge: iPaaS, workflow automation, AI or developer tools.


LOCATION

US-based, close to our hub in Boston would be a plus. We’re also open to candidates in California, Virginia, New York, New Jersey, Florida, Texas, Georgia, Colorado, Washington, North Carolina, Pennsylvania and Illinois.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll build AI tools and applications used by Airwallex employees, taking projects from inception through implementation. You’ll work across platform engineering, security, automation, and infrastructure to help teams operate more effectively.

 - Lead the development of AI tools and applications from inception through implementation

 - Build, monitor, and maintain infrastructure including Kubernetes clusters, serverless workloads, ETL pipelines, and terabyte-scale log pipelines

 - Partner with engineers and product engineering teams to identify opportunities for automation and tooling development

 - Support incident response by building tools for threat hunting, remediation, and security scanning

 - Deliver security improvements such as automated patching, gateways, and other services that reduce risk

 - Mentor Software Engineers and help grow the engineering team

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field

 - 3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer

 - Experience working with production codebases

 - Experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, and one systems programming language, such as Go or C/C++

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, including data pipelines, serverless workloads, and Kubernetes

 - A track record of working autonomously on projects and delivering high-quality work on time

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - The ability to dive deep to find the best solution to a problem

 - Strong curiosity and a willingness to ask questions, gather context, and learn

Preferred

 - Experience working in a high-growth technology company

 - Hands-on experience with AI, specifically leveraging AI to build applications

 - Experience maintaining Linux operating systems


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

InfoSec at Airwallex runs one of the most modern security teams in the world, protecting hundreds of thousands of customers and hundreds of billions of dollars. Our scale, funding, and industry make us a real target, so we skip the standard playbook of off-the-shelf tools and tiered SOC analysts and build almost everything ourselves, often with AI ahead of the rest of the industry. You'll go back to first principles constantly, because the off-the-shelf answer is rarely right for us, and we can build better than what already exists. If you want to build security from the ground up, against a real adversary, with people who are actually good at this, this is the team for you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Integrations & Customer Success (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We maximize product availability with minimal cashflow investment in 1/10 of the time. We solve a real problem for SMEs. With AI. VOIDS is the AI brain for mid-size Shopify brands inventory. We forecast demand at the product level, catch stockouts and inefficiencies before they happen, and give e-commerce teams exactly the right action — or execute it automatically with a single click. The result: 98% inventory efficiency, 20x ROI, and six-figure cash unlocked. Within weeks. We launched in June 2023. Since then: 300% growth, 1B+ data points processed, €2M ARR, and 50+ brands live — including Hyrox, 6pm, Creamyfabrics, and NatureHeart. Now, we're targeting €10M ARR by 2028. Today we own demand forecasting and stock management. Our vision for tomorrow: AI handles procurement end-to-end — fully autonomous. This is where you come in. We're a small, fast team and every hire shapes the trajectory of the company. You'll shape how we ingest, process, and activate 1B+ data points, and help us build the data foundation for a fully AI-driven procurement future. Work directly with Jannik and Tobias, who live and breathe e-commerce and AI. High autonomy. Real data scale. Work that actually ships. We're just getting started — want to build it with us? Tasks You'll own the reliability and growth of our data infrastructure end-to-end. This isn't a ticket-execution role — you'll identify problems, design solutions, and ship them yourself. Connectivity Expansion & Integrations Expand our data connector ecosystem far beyond Shopify and Amazon, paving the way for complete AI-driven custom integrations. Evaluate, implement, and maintain new data sources in a way that works with existing flows — system stability and customization tolerance are non-negotiable. Work closely with customers to understand their data sources, requirements, and edge cases — you are the first technical contact when it comes to what data goes into our system. Customer & Team Collaboration Communicate fluently in German and English — with customers during onboarding and pilot projects, and async with the internal team. Act as a bridge between customer needs and technical implementation, translating real-world data messiness into clean, reliable pipelines. Understand the e-commerce space intuitively - Suggest solutions to customers and implemented them before the customers even asks for it. Data Pipeline Architecture Take ownership of our Bronze → Silver → Gold medallion architecture: the logic between layers needs to be airtight, well-documented, and consistent. Scale the piplines to new heights: More data, faster pipelines, less costs. You need to find abstraction layer that allow to scale across multiple customer with very unique requirements. Improve Developer Experience: Enable fast iterations cycles and smooth developer experience when working with existing systems or building new things on top. AI-Delegated Development Workflows Fully embrace AI tooling — not just as a productivity booster, but as a core part of how you work: delegate end-to-end workflows (testing, development, staging, production) to AI agents where possible. Build and maintain AI-driven pipelines that can handle deep customiszation without system failures — the architecture must be robust enough that AI-generated changes don't break production. Push the limits of what's achievable by combining your engineering judgment with AI automation. 10x yourself every year. Data Quality, Testing & Reliability Own the full development lifecycle: testing → development → staging → production, with automated checks at every layer. Set up and maintain robust testing environments and DataOps/MLOps workflows to enable rapid iteration. Proactively identify bottlenecks, inconsistencies, and schema drift — and fix them before they reach downstream consumers. Requirements ✅ Must-Have Skills Fluent German and English — both written and spoken (customer-facing communication required) 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or closely related roles 3+ years experience in Python, particularly with data manipulation libraries (Pandas, Polars) for efficient data processing Deep proficiency in SQL and PostgreSQL for structured data Hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable streaming, event-driven and batch data pipelines and workflows as inputs for web applications and AI models Proven ability to set up and maintain robust testing environments , and manage efficient DataOps/MLOps workflows to enable rapid iteration Familiarity with infrastructure and containerization frameworks ( Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform ) End-to-end expertise in designing and operating scalable data platforms , including storage (S3/Parquet), data pipelines, APIs, and connectors, with a strong grasp of layered data architectures. Strong understanding of medallion / layered data architecture — and the ability to fix one that isn't working properly Daily, fluent use of AI tools — you actively delegate end-to-end workflows to AI: from testing and development through to staging and production. AI is not a helper tool; it's how you multiply your output. Strong product intuition and understanding with a proactive, ownership-oriented mindset Comfortable with ambiguity, autonomous decision-making , and direct customer contact 🌟 Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience in B2B AI startups / scale-ups Experience with eCommerce data sets and solutions (Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Klaviyo, Channable, etc.) Familiarity with scalable big data tools and frameworks (dbt, dask, Apache Spark, EMR, Databricks, AWS Glue) Familiarity or interest in Data Science workflows, especially related to time series forecasting (Nixtla, Darts, statsmodels, sktime) Contributions to developer experience, data observability, or internal tooling improvements 🧱 Tech Stack Programming : Python (Pandas, Polars), SQL Data Storage & Management: PostgreSQL, AWS S3 (Parquet), BigQuery Orchestration : Airflow, EventBridge, Cron

jobs.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
jobs.description:
(GAQ128R87)

 

The Senior Sales Compensation Manager (L7) is the senior systems expert for Databricks commissions platform. You will co-own how commissions get calculated: how the Xactly Incent plans are built, and the data integrations and pipelines that feed every calculation. You ll be the trusted co-owner of the system design, the technical roadmap, and the systems controls in a fast-growing, consumption-based SaaS business. You’ll take on ambiguous, cross-functional problems that span several systems. You ll influence senior leaders in Finance, GTM, and Engineering, and raise the bar for the team through documentation, enablement, and AI-first automation.

 

The impact you will have

 

Plan configuration and calculation engine

  • Co-lead annual (and mid-year if applicable) plan builds in Xactly for every major plan family, including AE, sales leaders, xDR, field engineering, and partner plans. This covers rule logic, rate tables, accelerators, quotas, crediting hierarchies, and tuning the calculation engine.
  • Partner with Plan Design to turn plan design decks into system specifications. Configure, run UAT on, and test new plans before they go to production. Co-own the system implementation timeline and the go-live schedule for the new fiscal year.
  • Be the responder when calculations break, data sync fails, or configuration has defects.

 

Integrations, data pipelines and system design

  • Co-own the integration layer between Salesforce and Xactly and the data loads from the Databricks lakehouse into Xactly. This covers object mappings, the API integration user, OAuth and IP restriction upkeep, and the schedules and dependencies of the pipelines that feed plan crediting.
  • Collaborate and influence the future-state design and technical roadmap for the commissions platform. That includes evaluating the commission engine strategy and moving manual files onto governed pipelines with change management and SOX-aligned logging.
  • Collaborate and influence vendor escalations and support cases, and lead day-to-day work with the Xactly account team.

 

Controls, close, and audit

  • Co-own the commissions systems SOX controls: plan configuration and change management, system-to-system validation, plan reconciliation, quarterly user access reviews. Act as a subject-matter expert in walkthroughs with external auditors.
  • Run the systems side of the monthly and quarterly close calendar with high precision.
  • Make change requests to the change-approval board (CAB) audit-ready from the start, with full descriptions, approvals, and test evidence.

 

AI, automation and insight

  • Collaborate and influence AI adoption. Use it to turn plan design into configuration, automatically generate documentation, and validate data with AI agents. Use AI-driven anomaly detection to find payout discrepancies before they reach payroll.
  • Use predictive modeling to estimate commissions impact of proposed plan changes/adjustments or for accrual purposes.
  • Turn prototypes into tools the team actually uses, and track the time saved and quality gained.

 

Cross-functional influence

  • Represent Commissions Systems to Engineering, IT, Finance Data & Strategy, GTM Strategy & Ops, Accounting, FP&A, and Partner teams. Turn business requirements into engineering terms and the other way around, and agree on SLAs and intake processes.
  • Be the voice telling downstream teams about system changes that affect their reporting and analysis.

 

Leadership & culture

  • Help make the team resilient by design. Turn undocumented rules and configuration knowledge into playbooks, wikis, and recorded walkthroughs so no one person is a single point of failure.
  • Mentor and cross-train other team members, including offshore resources. Help build a culture of continuous learning and AI adoption.
  • Turn concerns into recommendations with clear trade-offs that win senior leaders support. 



What we look for

 

  • Bachelor s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12+ years in sales compensation, commissions systems, or sales/finance operations, including deep hands-on administration and configuration of an SPM platform.
  • Expert skills in Xactly Incent and Connect. Experience with other SPM tools is a plus.
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce data models and integrations, and of data pipeline concepts. SQL or lakehouse experience (e.g., Databricks) is strongly preferred.
  • A track record of running SOX controls and ITGCs, and of leading audit walkthroughs.
  • Fluency in SaaS go-to-market comp models: quotas, OTI, accelerators, overlays, SPIFFs, MBOs, and consumption-based crediting.
  • A proven record of efficiency gains from automation and AI. You re comfortable prompting and evaluating LLMs, building practical tools, and judging where people still need to make the call.
  • Experience in a fast-paced SaaS or tech company, plus strong communication and presentation skills for senior audiences.

jobs.title: Marketplace Deal Operations Specialist, EMEA
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We’re hiring a Marketplace Deal Operations Analyst to become the hands-on expert in cloud marketplace transactions (AWS, Azure and GCP) for our EMEA business. This role takes the operational detail of lower segment marketplace deals off Deal Desk Analysts and Field sellers, so they can focus on strategy, structuring and higher-value deals. It is a distinct function from Deal Desk Analyst: a specialist execution and process-ownership role for someone who wants to go deep on marketplace mechanics, build genuine subject-matter expertise, and bring order to a high-volume, detail-heavy process.

If you enjoy being the person everyone turns to for the right answer, and you take pride in getting every detail right at speed, this role is for you.

CET business hours (approx. 1:30pm–10:30pm IST in winter, 12:30pm–9:30pm IST in summer)

What You Will Be Doing

  • Executing marketplace transactions at high velocity

    • Generate, submit and manage private offers across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace and Google Cloud Marketplace for EMEA deals
    • Own the end-to-end execution of marketplace transactions: validating deal requirements, ensuring documentation accuracy, and processing offers against defined SLAs
    • Process amendments, renewals and cancellations

  • Becoming the marketplace expert

    • Be the go-to subject-matter expert on operational marketplace processes across all three hyperscalers for the EMEA organization
    • Spot process gaps and create clear, repeatable guidance (SOPs, checklists and playbooks) so Field and Deal Desk can self-serve where possible
    • Stay current on program and process changes from AWS, Azure and GCP, and turn them into updated internal guidance

  • Supporting Deal Desk and Field

    • Provide hands-on administrative support on marketplace transactions to Deal Desk Analysts and EMEA Field sellers
    • Resolve ad-hoc operational issues and one-off transaction challenges as they arise
    • Act as the first point of contact for “how do I handle this marketplace scenario?” transactional process questions from the field

  • Growing into Deal Desk

    • Over time, build working knowledge of broader Deal Desk processes
    • Provide ad-hoc deal support to the Deal Desk team when volume or complexity requires it, as a development opportunity rather than a core responsibility

What You Bring

  • Direct, hands-on experience with cloud marketplace transactions (AWS, Azure and/or GCP Marketplace) in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Experience working in a high-velocity SaaS company
  • Sound judgment in nuanced, non-templated scenarios. This is not a pure checklist-following role
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with accuracy in documentation and process treated as non-negotiable
  • Strong organization and analytical skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent, detail-heavy transactions without anything slipping
  • Comfort with repeatable, high-volume work, and an understanding that transaction volume will fluctuate
  • The confidence to ask questions and surface ambiguity rather than guess silently
  • Ambition and motivation to provide excellent support to a field sales organization
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, as you’ll work daily with EMEA Field and Deal Desk
  • Experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and a CPQ tool
  • Prior experience supporting a field sales organization in a support or operations capacity

Bonus Points

  • AWS Partner accreditation, Azure Marketplace certification, or equivalent
  • Experience in a shared-services or GCC model supporting a Western HQ or the EMEA region specifically

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

  • United States: Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City; Washington D.C.

About the Role

Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).  Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.  Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide.  The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you will own the entire software development lifecycle—from design and architecture to deployment and monitoring—for systems that serve both threat disruption and legal response efforts. You will be responsible for translating complex legal and security requirements into robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that have a direct impact on making the internet better, safer, and more powerful every day.

Responsibilities

  • While the majority of our services are now written in Golang and TypeScript, you will also work with technologies such as Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal and PostgresSQL.   • Collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Product teams to understand goals and translate complex technical requirements into elegant, scalable solutions.

  • Interest in opportunities to be a technical mentor for teammates

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Company Description

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

Position Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta s enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Feature Execution: Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
  • Component Design: Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
  • Relationship & State Management: Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
  • Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
  • Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
  • Code Quality & Technical Standards: Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Team Growth: Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
  • Java Expertise: Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework.
  • Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
  • Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
  • API Design: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust RESTful APIs for enterprise integration.
  • Problem Solving & Ownership: Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
  • Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
  • Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
  • Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

Education and Training

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I, Agent Engineering (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smart Assist is Smartsheet s AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. Agent Engineering owns the runtime layer behind it: the orchestrator, core sub-agents, memory, context management, and the MCP integration that ties it together. We are accountable for how the agent thinks, acts, and remembers in production.

We build the agent harness as a reusable platform so other teams can build, integrate, and evaluate agents on a shared foundation. We work four ways: harness engineering (tuning the agent loop for quality, latency, and cost), capability expansion (core agents, skills, and tools), platformizing (shared components and patterns), and keeping it running (on-call, security, cost, and access controls).

The role. You will own a significant part of the Smart Assist runtime (for example orchestration and agent loops, memory and context, long-running execution, or model readiness) and shape how agents are built on our harness through design reviews and guilds. You will make architecture calls, raise the bar for the team, and make it possible for other teams to build agents on the platform without us in the critical path.

You Will:

  • Own the design and evolution of an area of the runtime, including trade-offs between model decisions at runtime and deterministic code, and between prompt/context fixes and structural ones.
  • Lead harness engineering at depth: long-running and durable execution, checkpoints and persistent plans, inline and multi-agent patterns, memory architecture, model swaps, and cost and latency control at scale.
  • Drive platformization: define the reusable components, shared libraries, intent routing, agent registry and integration patterns that let other teams build and integrate agents quickly, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Shape the multi-agent architecture and the convergence of existing and new agents into one experience.
  • Define how quality is measured and enforced: offline gating, online monitoring, and the prompt-analysis loop, working with AI Platform on the shared evals platform.
  • Own operational excellence for Smart Assist: on-call health, post-incident reviews, security posture (including prompt injection and permission-aware access), cost control, and entitlement and access correctness.
  • Lead through POCs and ambiguity: frame problems, run time-boxed experiments, write decisions down, and bring the team and partners along.
  • Mentor SE I and II engineers through design and code review; help hire and onboard. Use AI tools in incident and on-call work, and show teammates how.
  • Partner with the EM, PMs, AI Experiences, AI Platform, MCP, and external partners on roadmap and dependencies.

You Have: 

  • 5+ years building and operating production systems, with deep Python and strong system design (distributed systems, durable state and long-running workflows, APIs, data modeling).
  • 2+ years building LLM agent systems in production, with real opinions from experience on context engineering, subagents, memory, tool design, async or deferred tools, and failure recovery.
  • Track record of designing evals that gate releases and of attributing production failures to the right layer (model, prompt, tool contract, context, environment), using calibrated LLM judges and online behavioral signals.
  • Experience building shared platforms or libraries that other teams adopt, and of influencing without authority.
  • Experience with MCP and agent skills or tools at scale; familiarity with agent-to-agent and multi-agent patterns.
  • Experience operating AI systems in production: observability, cost management, security and safety patterns (prompt injection mitigation, output validation, grounding, permission-aware retrieval).
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development and a point of view on how it changes engineering practice.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to executives and to engineers.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.
  • Strong plus: model evaluation and swap tooling; Databricks or lakehouse data work; enterprise SaaS, permissions and entitlements; prior mentoring or tech-lead experience.

What success looks like:

  • First 90 days: understand the runtime and its failure modes, ship a meaningful improvement in your area, and publish a design or decision doc the team adopts.
  • First 6 months: deliver a measurable gain in reliability, latency, or cost per task in your area; land a reusable pattern or component adopted by at least one other team; and mentor at least one engineer to a visible growth step.

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io http://www.astronomer.io.


ABOUT THIS ROLE:

Astronomer is seeking a Renewals Manager to join our best-in-class Go-To-Market team. In this role, you will own end-to-end customer renewals across a portfolio of accounts, in addition to partnering with Account Executives on expansions. You will represent Astronomer during a pivotal period in the customer lifecycle, articulating Astronomer’s value proposition in an increasingly competitive and crowded market. In addition to securing renewals across the business, you will have significant influence in defining our strategy and operations for this role, helping build repeatable processes to be leveraged by future Renewals teammates down the road.




WHAT YOU GET TO DO:

 - Play a leading role in influencing one of core success metrics, our Renewal Rate.

 - Lead the commercial buying process for all customer renewals with the intent of securing their full retention.

 - Partner with Account Executives to understand customer priorities and challenges.

 - Create and maintain accurate forecasting reports for all renewals in your portfolio.

 - Identify and secure upsell opportunities where applicable, whether at renewal or mid-cycle.

 - Ensure on-time delivery of customer renewals without compromising the customer experience along the way.

 - Identify risks and develop resolution strategies.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE:

 - Client-facing experience in sales or SaaS-based customer success roles.

 - Experience negotiating with executives and procurement at Enterprise companies.

 - A demonstrable track record of exceeding goals.

 - Curiosity around or existing knowledge of technology companies and how companies use and operationalize data.

 - Hunger to grow in your career, in the context of a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

 - Written and oral communication skills that will enable you to demonstrate product expertise and knowledge of data orchestration during consultative conversations with customers.


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience in a pre or post-sales role (preferably in a SaaS environment).

 - Prior negotiating and closing experience.

 - Experience with related market products such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, Google, ETL Technologies or open-source software.

 - A desire to grow into an account executive, sales, or other customer-facing roles.

The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from 90,000-130,000, along with an equity component. This range is merely an estimate, and the width of the range reflects willingness to consider candidates with broad prior seniority. Actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

_______________________________________________________________________

ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join Supabase’s Interfaces group and help run the backend services behind our developer tools, starting with postgres-meta: the open-source service that runs SQL against customers’ Postgres databases on behalf of our dashboard, our MCP server, AI agents, and other platform tools. You’ll work closely with the engineers who build those tools, and with our Platform and SRE teams.

AI agents are the fastest-growing source of postgres-meta’s traffic, and it sits on the path between developers and their data, so when it struggles, people can’t reach their databases from the dashboard or their agents. The team’s first priority is making it reliable, observable, and fair between tenants at agent scale, and helping redesign it for that scale without breaking the tools that depend on it. Depending on your experience, you’ll own major parts of that work or lead it. Alongside it, the team builds the backend services that give every branch of a project the configuration and secrets it needs.

We want to be upfront: this role carries real operational load. Our on-call process and rotation are new and need a lot of maturing, and you’ll help build them into something sustainable from your first weeks. You’ll be on call for services on the critical path, and incidents come before planned work. Platform teams run the infrastructure underneath; you’ll own the services themselves, from their code to how they behave in production. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys that kind of ownership, thrives in async, fast-paced environments, and stays calm when the root cause turns out to be in someone else’s system.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

 - Help mature the team’s on-call from your first weeks: grow the rotation to cover every service the team runs, write runbooks, and agree when to declare an incident. Then build it, with our embedded SRE, into a sustainable follow-the-sun rotation as the team grows.

 - Set SLOs with the teams that call the service, and build the observability to hold them: metrics per tenant and per caller, alerts that catch failures wherever they start, and logs you can search across regions.

 - Make deploys routine with canary and staged rollouts, so dependency and security upgrades stop being risky.

 - Redesign how the service works with Postgres at scale: reusing connections, limiting or streaming large results, and isolating and rate-limiting tenants, so no single caller, human or agent, can degrade it for everyone else.

 - Help decide the service’s long-term architecture with our Platform teams, then evolve it without breaking the callers that depend on it.

 - Write down and agree the service’s contract with its callers, including the dashboard, MCP and AI, and platform workers: how transactions, multi-statement queries, timeouts, and errors behave.

 - Work through incidents with the networking, Kubernetes, pooler, and control-plane teams when a problem on the path to customers’ databases starts in their systems.

 - Build backend services for code-first workflows, starting with delivering each branch’s configuration and secrets to the services that need them.

 - Make small changes directly in the CLI, dashboard, or docs when a capability needs them, with the owning team reviewing.

 - Review code and designs, mentor other engineers, and grow into leading the team’s technical direction.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

Must have:

 - Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer, most of it building and running backend services in production.

 - Have run a high-traffic, multi-tenant service in production: been on call for it, worked incidents through to resolution, and followed through on postmortems.

 - Write strong TypeScript, and work confidently in a large Node.js backend codebase.

 - Understand Postgres from the client side: connection management and pooling, transactions, statement timeouts and cancellation, and large result sets.

 - Have built observability for a service you owned (metrics, tracing, logs, and alerts tied to SLOs), and used it to debug problems that span proxies, load balancers, or Kubernetes.

 - Have kept a service healthy under load with patterns such as rate limiting, timeouts, memory limits, and graceful degradation.

 - Have shipped changes to a live service safely, with canaries, staged rollouts, feature flags, or fast rollback.

 - Work calmly and constructively with other teams during incidents, including when the root cause is in a system you don’t own.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, from design docs to postmortems, thrive in async, globally distributed teams, and make progress when the path isn’t fully defined.

Nice to have, roughly in order of how much they’d help:

 - Have rebuilt or migrated a live, high-traffic service without breaking its callers, using techniques such as shadow traffic, contract tests, or incremental replacement.

 - Have led the design of reliability work, such as tenant isolation, load shedding, or a staged-deploy pipeline, or set technical direction that other engineers built on.

 - Have built or operated a database proxy or connection pooler (such as PgBouncer, Supavisor, or pgcat), or an API gateway such as Envoy.

 - Have secured a service that runs SQL on its callers’ behalf: handling credentials safely, and limiting how much damage any one caller can do.

 - Multi-region AWS experience.

 - Experience with Fastify.

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


THE ROLE

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead n8n’s Partnerships team across the Americas, and to own the partnership strategy for the region across all our Solution partners (Systems Integrators (SIs), Global System Integrators (GSIs) and international resellers) and Technology Partners (SAP, Hyperscalers…).

Our Global Partner Ecosystem is strategic to n8n’s success and we need you to build out our existing relations across regional SIs, GSIs such as Accenture and Capgemini and Technology companies such as SAP and Microsoft.

The Americas are a strategic growth region for us and partners are a key pillar to scale our expansion.

Our regional team is expanding quickly and you’ll be the leader of the partner managers in the region and turn strong early partner momentum into a repeatable, predictable source of pipeline and revenue. Reporting to our VP Partnerships, you’ll be based in the US, close to our hub in Boston would be a plus.

Here’s how you’ll make that happen:

🎯 Own the partnership strategy and number for the Americas

 - Define our partner strategy for the Americas as part of the regional leadership team, representing the partnership team internally and externally.

 - Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue targets for the region.

 - Build out and own the resell channel and number for LATAM.

 - Define which partners to invest in, with clear targets per partner and joint business plans with priority partners.

 - Bring visibility on partner performance, pipeline progression and revenue contribution to leadership.

 - Work alongside our Technology Partners team so that the full partner ecosystem contributes to the regional number.

👥 Build and lead a high-performing team

 - Lead, coach and grow a team of Partner Managers covering SIs, GSIs and international resellers across North America and LATAM.

 - Run a strong operating rhythm: forecasting, pipeline reviews, partner business reviews and 1:1s.

 - Raise the bar on how the team plans, prioritizes and executes with partners.

🤝 Scale our SI, GSI and reseller ecosystem

 - Shape and execute the regional strategy across GSIs, boutique SIs and international resellers.

 - Build executive relationships with partner leadership, from practice leads to alliance and sales leaders.

 - Help partners build n8n practices, service offerings and repeatable delivery capabilities.

 - Expand our reach into LATAM and Canada through the right partners.

📈 Drive co-selling with our Sales team

 - Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Marketing leadership in the Americas.

 - Make sure every Account Executive knows which partner to bring in, when and how.

 - Build co-sell motions, account mapping and joint campaigns that move enterprise deals forward.

🌀 Shape the partner program

 - You’ll be part of the global partnership leadership team and act as the voice of partners internally, sharing insights that shape programs, incentives and product priorities.

 - Help define what excellent partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale globally.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

 - 🚀 Partnerships leadership: You have 10+ years of experience in partnerships, alliances, channel or sales in B2B SaaS, including several years leading a team of partner or channel managers.

 - 🎯 SI and GSI track record: You have launched and scaled motions with GSIs and SIs (e.g. Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini) and can show the partner-sourced and influenced pipeline you drove.

 - 📈 Number ownership: You have owned a regional partner revenue or pipeline target and know how to forecast and deliver it.

 - 🌎 Americas network: You know the North American partner landscape and have an established network across SIs, GSIs or resellers.

 - 💼 Enterprise deals: You have supported partner-involved enterprise deals and complex sales cycles.

 - 💻 Technical depth: You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, automation and the AI landscape.

 - 🏗️ Builder’s mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, prioritize well in ambiguity and enjoy building programs and teams from early stages.

Nice-to-haves

 - 🌍 LATAM and Canada experience, and Spanish or Portuguese.

 - 🌐 International reseller or distribution experience.

 - 🔧 Industry knowledge: iPaaS, workflow automation, AI or developer tools.


LOCATION

US-based, close to our hub in Boston would be a plus. We’re also open to candidates in California, Virginia, New York, New Jersey, Florida, Texas, Georgia, Colorado, Washington, North Carolina, Pennsylvania and Illinois.
