We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. On-call is shared across the squad, and our working language is English – no German required. For us, AI is a structural shift in how software is built, not an add-on. Agentic development runs through our entire lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing and code review: AI agents do much of the work, while engineers set the direction, define the guardrails and own every merge. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. With us, you'll push this practice further across the squad and beyond. Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization ( OAuth2/OIDC ). Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL (or another relational database) and Redis (caching, queues, pub/sub). With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth. As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs. What You Will Do: Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises. Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog. Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate. Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model. Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity. Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting. Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments. Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes. Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance. Ability and/or willingness to use our product . Nice to Haves: Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems. Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem. Experience implementing IAM federation. Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications. Experience with L3 support/incident management. Experience working in a fully remote organization. This role is an existing vacancy #LI-SG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST #C1 What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. jobs.title: Senior Software Architect
jobs.description: Senior Software Architect – Computer Vision & Tracking Shape the technology behind some of the biggest moments in world sport. From goal-line technology and semi-automated offside in football to electronic line calling in tennis and automated ball-strike systems in baseball, Hawk-Eye's tracking technology plays a critical role in elite sport around the world. We're looking for an exceptional Senior Software Architect to shape the future of this technology. This is a unique opportunity to combine software architecture leadership with deep computer vision expertise, influencing the technical direction of products used across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby. Working across our Tracking and Automated Officiating (T&AO) value stream, you'll influence an engineering organisation of more than 100 people, setting architectural direction, driving innovation and helping solve some of the most complex tracking challenges in sport. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role. You'll have significant technical influence while remaining close to the engineering, research and problem-solving that make our technology possible. What you'll do Set the architectural direction Lead software architecture across our tracking, automated officiating and data delivery products. Define how new tracking challenges are approached and ensure consistency across products and sports. Shape our shared frameworks, libraries and core technology, making pragmatic decisions about reuse, scalability and performance. Represent Tracking within engineering architecture forums across Hawk-Eye and Sony Sports. Drive computer vision innovation Act as the senior technical authority for computer vision across Hawk-Eye's tracking technology. Set the direction for camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking and machine learning integration. Research and evaluate emerging technologies, building prototypes to turn promising ideas into practical solutions. Help resolve the most complex technical challenges and ensure our technology continues to evolve. Champion modern engineering Lead the adoption of AI-powered development tools, including agentic coding frameworks, LLM orchestration and automated code generation. Establish practical standards for using these technologies within our large C++ and Python codebases. Explore opportunities in generative AI and synthetic data to accelerate research and improve tracking capabilities. Develop engineering capability Coach and mentor Squad Tech Leads and emerging architects. Share expertise through technical talks, tutorials and knowledge-sharing sessions. Support recruitment and technical assessment for computer vision and machine learning roles. Help ensure our ML training and synthetic data infrastructure is operationally sustainable. What we're looking for We're looking for someone with exceptional expertise in multi-camera computer vision, combined with the software engineering and architectural experience to influence technology at scale. Computer vision expertise Deep knowledge of multi-camera calibration, including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Strong understanding of triangulation, 3D ball tracking, pose estimation and skeletal tracking. Experience with continuous-time modelling and inverse kinematics. Software engineering and architecture Expert cross-platform C++ development across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM. Strong experience with CMake, performance profiling and optimisation. Proven ability to architect complex, high-performance systems across multiple teams and products. Machine learning and infrastructure Experience with GPU inference technologies such as TensorRT and Triton. Strong knowledge of ML frameworks and pipelines, including PyTorch and ONNX. Experience deploying tracking systems across AWS, on-premise infrastructure and edge devices. Understanding of generative AI and synthetic data generation. Modern engineering practices Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and LLM orchestration. An interest in applying emerging AI technologies to accelerate algorithm research, development and refactoring. The person we're looking for You'll be a confident technical leader who can influence decisions across multiple engineering teams, communicate complex ideas clearly and make pragmatic architectural choices. You'll be comfortable working with senior stakeholders and external technology partners, including Sony, NVIDIA and AWS, as well as sports leagues and federations. Just as importantly, you'll know when to challenge existing approaches, balance technical ambition with commercial realities and make clear recommendations on priorities, risks and investment. Why join Hawk-Eye? Our technology is trusted across some of the world's biggest sporting competitions. You'll have the opportunity to: Shape the architecture behind internationally deployed sports technology. Influence the technical direction of more than 100 engineers. Work on fascinating challenges across computer vision, 3D tracking, machine learning and real-time processing. Explore and introduce emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools. Collaborate with world-leading technology partners and sporting organisations. Remain hands-on while operating at the highest level of technical influence. If you're passionate about computer vision, thrive on complex engineering challenges and want to help shape the future of technology in sport, we'd love to hear from you. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Everfield: Senior Data Engineer The Company Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth. Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients. Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia. The Position As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to: Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.) Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools Further developing Lakehouse Lumen , our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality. The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL . For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving. This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area. Responsibilities Adhere to the DevOps methodology by: Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks. Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git. Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude. Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control. Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows. Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users. Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices. Ideal Candidate Profile Hard Skills Required: 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer , and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields. Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing. Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics. Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema). Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data . Nice to have: Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills) Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization. Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps . Soft Skills Independent Worker : Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals. Business Acumen : Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context. Analytical Mindset : Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Collaborative : Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions. Quality-Focused : Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards. Strategic Planner : Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation. Purpose-Driven : Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives. What’s in it for you? Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization. Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform. Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies. Long term career opportunities. Working from home for up to 4 days per week. Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany). Continue the Conversation Interested? We would love to hear from you! Apply now with your CV, and if you are selected, our Talent Manager will contact you to schedule the first call and start our hiring process. jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we re interested in candidates based in the US or Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role.

Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Grafana Data Source Plugins

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in the Grafana Data Source Plugins squad, you will take a leading role in developing and enhancing a diverse portfolio of data source plugins that retrieve the data powering Grafana dashboards used by teams worldwide. 

Our team focuses on continuously improving data source plugins, ensuring seamless experience for human and agent users alike. A key aspect of this role is guaranteeing the smooth operation and reliability of our plugins in the Grafana Cloud, helping us deliver on our commitment to world-class observability tools. 

What You’ll Be Doing: 

  • Some data source plugins we own: 
    • Prometheus, Loki, Infinity, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Cloudwatch, and Clickhouse.  The full catalog is listed here.
  • A typical “day in the life” could include: 
    • Building or improving Grafana plugins to integrate third party services or databases into Grafana 
    • Supporting the operations and reliability of our plugins in Grafana Cloud
    • Coming up with suggestions for process improvements
    • Integrating data sources with agentic workflows such as Grafana Assistant
    • Providing technical support in customer escalations 
    • Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects.
  • You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward.
  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge
  • You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration
  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company

Requirements:

  • Solid experience with Golang & Typescript
  • Experience with Kubernetes & microservices
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks

Bonus Points For:

  • You have been a user of Grafana and Grafana Data Sources
  • You have expertise in one of the underlying databases we support
  • You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we re interested in candidates based in the US or Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role.

Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Grafana Data Source Plugins

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in the Grafana Data Source Plugins squad, you will take a leading role in developing and enhancing a diverse portfolio of data source plugins that retrieve the data powering Grafana dashboards used by teams worldwide. 

Our team focuses on continuously improving data source plugins, ensuring seamless experience for human and agent users alike. A key aspect of this role is guaranteeing the smooth operation and reliability of our plugins in the Grafana Cloud, helping us deliver on our commitment to world-class observability tools. 

What You’ll Be Doing: 

  • Some data source plugins we own: 
    • Prometheus, Loki, Infinity, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Cloudwatch, and Clickhouse.  The full catalog is listed here.
  • A typical “day in the life” could include: 
    • Building or improving Grafana plugins to integrate third party services or databases into Grafana 
    • Supporting the operations and reliability of our plugins in Grafana Cloud
    • Coming up with suggestions for process improvements
    • Integrating data sources with agentic workflows such as Grafana Assistant
    • Providing technical support in customer escalations 
    • Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects.
  • You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward.
  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge
  • You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration
  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company

Requirements:

  • Solid experience with Golang & Typescript
  • Experience with Kubernetes & microservices
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks

Bonus Points For:

  • You have been a user of Grafana and Grafana Data Sources
  • You have expertise in one of the underlying databases we support
  • You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Batch Compute
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Batch Compute Experience team owns the platform that Stripe engineers use to build, run, debug and optimize Apache Spark jobs. Those jobs handle large-scale data processing for analytics, machine learning, finance and core product data pipelines. Hundreds of engineers and thousands of production jobs driving critical business processes, such as payouts and reconciliations, run on this platform. 

Today, diagnosing and tuning a job means reasoning by hand across scattered telemetry, configuration, query plans and application code. Our goal is to make Spark at Stripe fast to iterate, reliable by default, and self-optimizing, so engineers can focus on business logic instead of Spark internals. We re doing this through three connected efforts: 

  • Modernization: keeping Stripe s Spark runtime and dependency stack current, including Spark 3.5 → Spark 4, Scala 2.13 and Apache Iceberg. We re building automated upgrade and validation tools so that upgrading the whole fleet becomes routine and low-risk instead of a multi-year manual effort
  • Agentic Spark and optimization: building trustworthy, AI-powered workflows that diagnose failed or underperforming jobs, recommend fixes based on evidence, and carry them safely into configuration changes, code PRs or escalations. We also want to optimize configuration, query plans and code across the whole fleet
  • Operational excellence: making the platform reliable, observable and compliant, and defining user-experience metrics that show whether we re succeeding

Over the longer term, we want to turn the platform into a Spark control plane that keeps learning. It should detect problems before users notice them, validate fixes safely and apply them through policy-controlled automation.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Engineer on Batch Compute Experience, you ll set the technical direction for one of Stripe s most widely used data platforms. You ll lead multi-quarter efforts across teams, make high-stakes architectural decisions affecting thousands of production workloads, and raise the engineering bar for the team and its partners.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Spark modernization across the fleet. Own the technical strategy for moving thousands of production jobs to newer Spark and Iceberg runtimes. This includes target selection, qualification, deciding the rollout unit (cluster, application or hybrid), and rollback planning, while coordinating dependencies with partner infrastructure teams
  • Make upgrades continuous and safe. Design and evolve automated upgrade and validation systems: shadow execution against production data, output-correctness comparison, sandboxed execution, and staged promotion. The goal is to make each new runtime upgrade cheaper than the last
  • Architect agentic Spark workflows. Build LLM-powered systems that diagnose failures, out-of-memory errors (OOMs), data skew and performance regressions. They should produce evidence-backed recommendations that are backtested and gated in CI, and you ll define the safety, provenance and human-approval requirements for every automated action
  • Build safe configuration and remediation paths. Design authorized, validated, reversible no-code configuration changes, along with pipelines that detect anti-patterns across the fleet and open code-fix PRs or tickets
  • Drive efficiency at scale. Identify, prove out and roll out the highest-value configuration and query-plan optimizations, such as shuffle and adaptive query execution (AQE) tuning, executor sizing, join strategy and partitioning. Turn the measured gains into real infrastructure savings without hurting correctness or reliability
  • Improve the developer experience. Shorten the inner dev loop, improve PySpark support and observability (including Python memory diagnostics), and unify how jobs are packaged and launched across schedulers such as Airflow and Flyte
  • Set the technical bar. Lead critical design reviews, define reliability standards (SLOs, observability, testing) for the services we own, mentor senior engineers, and steer the team away from structural and operational debt

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • This is a Staff Engineer role - that typically means you have 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building data infrastructure or distributed systems
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-quarter infrastructure projects from start to finish, especially migrations or upgrades that touch many consuming teams
  • Experience defining SLOs and running reliable platforms with on-call responsibilities
  • Experience designing safe rollouts for large fleets: staged rollout, reducing blast radius, validating correctness, and planning rollbacks
  • Strong product and developer-experience instincts: you build abstractions that are ergonomic, well documented and easy to adopt

jobs.title: Director FP&A
jobs.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io http://www.astronomer.io.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

Astronomer is on a mission to revolutionize orchestration for AI and data with Astro, the world's leading enterprise platform built on Apache Airflow™. To support our mission, we're searching for a Director of Financial Planning & Analysis to join our talented finance team and become a key architect of our financial future. In this role, you’ll partner directly with the executive team to help shape the future of the company




WHAT YOU GET TO DO:

● Use your brain and have an opinion, anchored in the data and analysis you produce

● Partner with CFO and executive team to turn financial analysis into business insight

● Provide timely and relevant financial reports highlighting key performance indicators and metrics

● Manage the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes

● Help drive our workforce strategy, in collaboration with the People & Talent Team

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect relevant data and insights for financial analysis

● Work with senior leadership on scenario planning and investment trade-offs

● Prepare presentations and reports for executive leadership, board meetings and external stakeholders




WHAT YOU MUST BRING TO THE ROLE:

● A highly entrepreneurial “roll up your sleeves” mentality with an intellectual curiosity to match

● Deep understanding of B2B SaaS financial modeling, forecasting, and data analysis

● Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate financial concepts to non-finance professionals

● Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights

● Proficiency using FP&A tools and ERP systems such as Workday, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment etc

● Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

● 7+ years of experience in FP&A in global high growth SaaS




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

● Real skills with AI tools that can deliver genius level insights and the horsepower of an army

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales (Migrations & AI)
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Solutions Architecture team is the technical bridge between sales and delivery: we shape services engagements before they're sold and hand them over to delivery once they are.  We are now building our presence in the Middle East, and this role will be our first Solutions Architect based in the region, working from our Dubai office (covering the Middle East, Turkey & Africa - META region) with around 40% travel to start.


You will work alongside our sellers to shape the deals that bring customers onto Snowflake. 

You will scope what customers need, design the solution, and build it hands-on up to proof of concept, then hand it over to our delivery teams. This is services pre-sales: you'll scope, estimate, and prove services engagements, working alongside the Sales Engineers who lead on the product. The work falls into two areas: migrations from legacy data platforms into Snowflake, and AI use cases built on Snowflake's AI products. You will sit in our Migrations pod, but in a new region you will need to be comfortable across both. You will advise everyone from engineers to Chief Data Officers, and you will often work on your own with little structure, so you will need to set your own direction and turn early conversations into results customers can see.

You will be part of our EMEA Solutions Architecture team and work closely with colleagues in Europe. Because you will be opening the market, you will have a real say in how our services grow in the region, and you will work closely with customers on their core data and AI plans.



AS A SNOWFLAKE SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT YOU WILL:


Pre-Sales Scoping & Solution Design



 - Partner with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and our services sales team to qualify and shape services opportunities across the META region

 - Help build a healthy services pipeline in the region, turning opportunities into signed engagements

 - Run discovery with business and technical stakeholders, up to CDO level, and turn their requirements into a well-architected solution and a services proposal

 - Scope, estimate and de-risk engagements, including effort, approach, assumptions and success criteria

 - Present solution approaches and roadmaps clearly to both executives and technical audiences

 - Write code and build working POCs and prototypes



Migrations



 - Assess customers' legacy data estates (e.g. Teradata, Oracle/Exadata, Netezza, Cloudera/Hadoop, SQL Server, Greenplum, SAS, SAP) and design migration strategies into Snowflake

 - Build migration approaches covering code conversion, data movement, validation and cutover, using Snowflake migration tooling (e.g. SnowConvert) and accelerators where appropriate

 - Build hands-on migration POCs that prove feasibility, performance and cost to customers



AI & Data Solutions



 - Design and prototype end-to-end AI solutions on Snowflake, including generative AI, LLM-based and agentic use cases as well as traditional ML

 - Drive adoption of Snowflake's AI products (e.g., Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence, Snowflake ML, Streamlit in Snowflake) in customer solutions

 - Advise on good practice for AI/ML workloads, including data readiness, governance, security and MLOps



Handover & Collaboration



 - Hand engagements over cleanly to delivery teams, with clear architecture, scope, and success criteria, and stay involved with periodic oversight as the engagements run

 - Work with partners in the region, build reusable assets, and represent Snowflake at customer and industry events

 - Collaborate with Snowflake Go-to-Market, partner and product teams, and bring field feedback from the region back to them
   


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:


 - At least 5 years in customer-facing technical roles (solutions architect, technical consultant, pre-sales architect, or similar), including real pre-sales experience such as scoping, solution design, proposals, and POCs alongside a sales team

 - Enough technical depth and presence to hold credible conversations with CDOs and senior technical leaders

 - A track record of working independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and following through to tangible results

 - Comfortable with the commercial side of services: estimates, pricing inputs, and statements of work

 - Deep hands-on experience on either data platform migrations (ideally into Snowflake, from a legacy warehouse or Hadoop) or AI use cases with customers (generative AI, RAG, agents, or ML in production), and working knowledge of the other

 - Strong hands-on SQL and Python skills (Spark or Java a plus)

 - A solid understanding of the modern data stack, from ingestion and ETL/ELT to data platform design, BI, analytics, and large-scale database technologies such as Snowflake, Teradata, Exadata, Netezza, and Greenplum

 - Knowledge of large-scale database technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, Exadata, Netezza, Greenplum)

 - BA/BS in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience




AS A BONUS, A STRONG CANDIDATE WILL ALSO HAVE:


 - Hands-on experience with Snowflake and its AI/ML features, or with a similar platform such as Databricks

 - Arabic language skills

 - Experience with customers in the META region, particularly the GC

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to take some of the world's largest organisations from their first n8n deployment to multi-year, seven-figure partnerships, and to help write the playbook for how n8n wins at the very top of the enterprise.

As one of n8n's first Strategic Account Executives, you will own a small portfolio of named accounts drawn from our global top 100. Your portfolio is a deliberate mix: existing customers with clear expansion potential, and greenfield logos where you open the relationship from scratch. This is account-led selling rather than opportunity-led. You run each account like a business, over years rather than quarters.

We are early. The strategic motion is new, and you will shape it alongside a small group of senior sellers and n8n leadership. If you are looking for a fully built territory and a playbook to follow, this is not it. If you want to be one of the people who builds it, read on:


OWN A NAMED PORTFOLIO

 - Build multi-year account plans that map business units, regions, executive sponsors and use cases across large, multi-company groups.

 - Find where n8n already runs inside your accounts and turn that bottom-up adoption into executive-sponsored, company-wide programmes.

 - Open greenfield accounts with research-led outbound to CIOs, CTOs, Heads of AI and platform engineering leaders.


SELL ON BUSINESS VALUE AT EXECUTIVE LEVEL

 - Connect n8n to the board agenda, from AI governance and auditability to efficiency and growth, and lead with outcomes rather than features.

 - Build business cases with real numbers that tie automation and AI agents to each customer's strategic priorities.

 - Multi-thread across engineering, IT, security, risk, finance, legal and procurement, and build champions who sell n8n when you are not in the room.


STRUCTURE, CLOSE AND EXPAND

 - Scope and negotiate multi-year, seven-figure agreements, including enterprise-wide licences, multi-region deployments and deals through system integrators and cloud marketplaces.

 - Run expansion cycles of six to twelve months and greenfield cycles that can stretch longer, through security, legal and global procurement.

 - Partner with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering and Partnerships on our biggest bets, and bring in n8n leadership at the moments that matter.


BUILD THE STRATEGIC MOTION

 - Help define how n8n sells to its largest customers, from deal structures to executive sponsor programmes and expansion playbooks.

 - Take what you learn in the field back to Product, Pricing and leadership.

 - Raise the bar for the AEs around you while staying closest to the customer.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🏛️ Strategic accounts: You have ten or more years of quota-carrying enterprise software sales experience, including at least three years owning a small named portfolio of strategic, Majors or Global 2000 accounts rather than a broad territory.

 - 💰 Seven-figure deals: You have closed and expanded deals worth €1M+ in total contract value, including multi-year and custom commercial structures, in cycles of six months or more.

 - 🧑‍💼 C-suite credibility: You build relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CFOs and the offices of the COO, and you can talk about their business as well as your product.

 - 📊 Value-based selling: You have built quantified business cases tied to a customer's strategic priorities, and you are ready to walk us through one in detail.

 - 🌱 Land and expand: You have turned one team's adoption into an enterprise-wide commitment and grown accounts across business units or regions.

 - 🎯 Still a hunter: Even with a named portfolio, you create your own pipeline through outbound and executive networking, and you are comfortable with greenfield cycles of 12 to 18 months.

 - 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past three years.

 - 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, security reviews, legal and global procurement.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Agents
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

An AI agent is only as useful as what it knows about your company. For many of the world's leading companies, that knowledge lives in Notion. The AI Knowledge & Capabilities team makes sure every agent working in Notion – built by Notion, by customers, or by other AI companies – finds the right answer, quickly and at a cost that makes sense.

We own the systems that make this work: search, knowledge, and memory. We also own the agent harness – the tools, context, and model choices that turn a model into a working agent. We decide what to build using evals, customer feedback, and product judgment. Our work reaches users directly, and other AI teams at Notion build on it.

We recently shipped Memories, so Notion AI, Custom Agents, and agents connected through MCP can learn and remember across platforms. We also shipped Auto, a model router that delivers frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Next, we're bringing memory, search, and the harness together into one system. Nobody has figured out how to package that yet – we want any company to get a great knowledge system for its agents with a click or a few questions.

You will be a technical leader for the team. You'll set direction across search, knowledge, and the harness, starting hands-on with making agents better and cheaper, and help define how Notion measures AI quality.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set technical direction for search, knowledge, and the agent harness – make the architecture calls, run design reviews, and decide what the team builds next.

 - Make Notion's agents better, faster, and cheaper – starting with the harness: which tools an agent can call, what context it gets, and which model handles each request.

 - Lead how we measure agent quality – evolve the metrics and evals that reflect real usage, and use them to choose what ships.

 - Turn company data into answers agents can use – build agentic search and memory that give every agent the context it needs, at the right latency and cost.

 - Work closely with research – partner with Notion's model research team on evals, model choice, and models trained for agentic work, and get what works into production. You'll also work with search platform and AI product teams on work that spans teams.

 - Grow the team – mentor engineers, review designs, and develop the next tech leads.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production applied AI: You've shipped and iterated on production LLM or agent systems used by real users. You owned how their quality was measured, and you changed course based on what you found.

 - Quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs: You've traded quality against latency and cost in a production system, measured the result, and can explain what you gave up and why.

 - Technical leadership: You've owned the technical direction of a complex system, often across teams, and kept it sound as it grew. You don't wait for a roadmap – you find the problems worth solving, make the case for them, and go deep on the hardest ones yourself.

 - Product sense: You've shipped quality improvements users noticed, and you've shaped new products from scratch – from the data model to what users see. You can explain why they mattered.

 - Shipping something new: You've taken an idea from nothing to a product people use. You try new models and tools early, form your own views, and turn them into product decisions.

 - Making other engineers better: You mentor engineers at every level, guide their designs, and share what you know so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Clear communication: You write clearly about tradeoffs, disagree directly, and change your mind when the evidence says to.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've improved LLM cost and quality directly – e.g. model routing, eval-driven harness or prompt tuning, or token efficiency in long-running agents.

 - You've founded a company or been an early engineer at a startup, and built systems that hold up at large scale.

 - Experience working closely with research or model training teams.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. recovery after failures API design: REST and OpenAPI, signed webhooks, versioning and backward compatibility with external suppliers MongoDB in depth: document modelling, schema versioning, indexing jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Telecom)
jobs.description: Für einen Kunden suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer mit fundiertem Python- und Telekommunikations-Know-how. Du entwickelst eine Plattform weiter, die die Bereitstellung und Inbetriebnahme von Telekommunikationsdiensten über mehrere Netzdomänen hinweg automatisiert. Als Stellvertretung des Technical Leads koordinierst du die technische Umsetzung im Team und begleitest Lösungen vom Architekturentscheid bis in den Betrieb. Den Multi-Domain Service Orchestrator (MDSO) auf Basis von HPE Telco Service Orchestrator und Python-Microservices weiterentwickeln. TM-Forum-basierte Servicemodelle, intent-basierte Orchestrierungslogik und wiederverwendbare Funktionen für Datennetze, Netzinventar, IP-Management, Mobilfunk inklusive FRMCS und Datacenter entwickeln. Asynchrone Python-Services, REST APIs mit OpenAPI-Spezifikationen sowie ereignisgesteuerte Integrationen mit Kafka und TM Forum APIs implementieren. Den Technical Lead vertreten, Architekturentscheidungen in technische Designs überführen und diese auf Teamebene verantworten und freigeben. Engineering-Standards definieren, Code- und Design-Reviews durchführen, Engineers coachen und Lösungen externer Lieferanten und Systemintegratoren technisch beurteilen. Automatisierte Tests entwickeln, an CI/CD-Pipelines mit Git, Tekton, Argo CD und OpenShift mitarbeiten und andere Telecom-Teams bei der Umsetzung von Automatisierungsvorhaben unterstützen. Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software Engineering auf Senior-Level mit ausgezeichneten Python-Kenntnissen und fundierter Praxis mit asynchronem Python, FastAPI, Pydantic und pytest. Fundierte Erfahrung mit REST und OpenAPI, verteilten Microservice-Architekturen, komplexen Systemintegrationen und ereignisgesteuerten Integrationen mit Kafka. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb containerisierter Services auf OpenShift oder Kubernetes sowie mit Git und CI/CD. Erfahrung mit intent-basierter und modellgetriebener Service-Orchestrierung, sehr gute Kenntnisse der TM Forum APIs und ein sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Produkte, Services und Ressourcen modelliert und zerlegt werden. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit technischen Designs, Code- und Design-Reviews, Engineering-Standards und Mentoring sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit System- oder Solution-Architekten. Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen von Lieferanten und Systemintegratoren kritisch zu beurteilen und Feedback konstruktiv zu vermitteln. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten. Fundierte Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und SAFe. Deutsch auf Niveau C1 und Englisch auf Niveau B2. Praxis mit HPE Telco Service Orchestrator oder vergleichbaren Plattformen wie Cisco NSO oder Ciena Blue Planet. (von Vorteil) Kenntnisse von TM Forum SID und ODA, Telecom-OSS-Architekturen und Multi-Vendor-Umgebungen. (von Vorteil) Verständnis von IP, VLANs, VRFs, Layer 2/3, Routing und MPLS sowie Erfahrung mit Network Inventory oder IPAM. (von Vorteil) Kenntnisse von YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF oder gNMI. (von Vorteil) Erfahrung mit Tekton, Argo CD, Helm, Ansible, API Management oder Java. (von Vorteil) Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung. Who we are We're Jobtome ( https://weare.jobtome.com/ ) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale. Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now. You'll design, build, and evolve the backend services that power our products, weigh in on architectural decisions, improve system reliability, and help shape how backend engineering is done across the company. Around it, you'll work with (and should be comfortable with): API design (GraphQL and/or REST) PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) BigQuery and other NoSQL databases Distributed systems and service-oriented architectures Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab pipelines preferred) A cloud-infrastructure mindset (GCP or other providers) Observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing) Testing (unit and/or integration) Kubernetes Nice to have: Working experience with Python Exposure to Protobuf and gRPC What "senior" means to us Titles vary — here's what we actually mean. A senior engineer at Jobtome can: Work independently without needing perfect specs Own complex features and systems Make informed architectural decisions and explain the trade-offs Write clean, maintainable, well-structured code Spot problems early and propose solutions Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people alike Raise the team's quality bar through example and reviews How we work Full remote — from anywhere within UTC−1 to UTC+3 (yes, we're repeating it on purpose) Core hours, with flexibility around them Daily working language: English Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Staff DevOps Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer, AI Security to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Director, DevOps - AI Security in the AI Guard department. This role owns and evolves the multi-region Kubernetes platform behind Zscaler’s AI Security products, which inspect LLM and agent traffic in real time using ML models on GPU infrastructure. As the senior platform engineer in EMEA, you will set technical direction for infrastructure, delivery, and tooling, and build the automation that lets a small team run a large, globally distributed fleet safely.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Own multi-region infrastructure and delivery, designing and maintaining OpenTofu/Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, Helm charts, and GitOps workflows to ensure repeatable, low-risk deployments
  • Keep EKS clusters healthy and cost-efficient across microservices, API gateways, Kafka-based event pipelines, and GPU model serving
  • Build observability and automation into the platform by setting up metrics, logging, tracing, and SLOs while writing Python and Go tooling to reduce operational toil
  • Deliver secure and compliant infrastructure meeting CIS, STIG, and FedRAMP-style controls with hardened minimal images and least-privilege IAM
  • Serve as the EMEA platform lead to improve incident response, mentor engineers, and partner globally on architecture and roadmap

Who You Are (Success Profile)

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Java Heavy + Front End)
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Position Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications — from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design and implementation of integration components end-to-end: REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication flows, user and group provisioning/sync jobs, and the retry and rate-limiting logic required to operate reliably against dozens of idiosyncratic third-party vendor APIs at scale. This is a backend-intensive role — the large majority of your time will be spent in Java/Spring Boot services — but you ll also need decent frontend experience in React and JSP to build and extend the screens that surface integration configuration to customers


Job Duties and Responsibilities
- Feature Execution: Drive technical design and implementation of integration features — new app connectors, provisioning/sync capabilities, authentication flows — primarily in backend Java services, extending into React/JSP configuration screens.
- Build and maintain REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication handlers , and vendor-specific exception/error-mapping layers for third-party SaaS and enterprise applications.
- Implement and extend user/group provisioning adapters built on shared contracts and scheduled sync/import jobs that keep identity data consistent between Okta and external systems.
- Resilience at Scale: Apply retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and pagination strategies to handle vendor API quirks, throttling, and intermittent failures gracefully across the dozens of concurrently supported integrations.
- Security & Compliance: Ensure credential/secret handling, token exchange, and audit logging for provisioning operations meet Okta s security and compliance standards.
- Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with PMs, support, and technical leads to prioritize new app integrations, resolve customer-reported connectivity issues, and participate in technical interviews/recruiting.
- Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues in integration pipelines, drive root-cause analyses, and improve observability/alerting for sync and provisioning jobs.
- Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, write thorough unit and functional tests, and maintain clear technical documentation.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating reliable, production-grade backend services.
- Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; comfortable owning services end-to-end from design through production support.
- Distributed Systems: Experience with asynchronous job processing, scheduled/batch sync jobs, and event-driven patterns.
- Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL) and caching layers (Redis or similar).
- Resilient Systems Design: Practical experience with retry/backoff strategies, rate-limiting, and handling pagination/throttling quirks from third-party APIs.
- API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including clients for third-party vendor systems with varying levels of API quality and documentation.
- Problem Solving & Ownership: Ability to break down ambiguous integration requirements and independently drive a feature from design to production.
- Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP — well enough to independently deliver the frontend without relying on a dedicated frontend engineer.
Nice to Haves
- Experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
-Integration & Auth Protocols: Working knowledge of REST/SOAP API integration patterns and authentication standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or WS-Federation.
- Exposure to legacy protocol support (SOAP-based provisioning services) alongside modern REST/OAuth integrations.
- Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures or specialized compliance environments (e.g., FedRAMP/GCC-High).
- Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for asynchronous processing.
- Exposure to HTTP mocking/test-server frameworks (e.g., WireMock or equivalent internal mock-server tooling) for API-level testing.
Education
B.E./M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The International Accelerator Engineering team is growing, and we re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us! We re a full-stack team located entirely in Europe within the same time zone, but culturally rooted in Silicon Valley. We directly improve the financial lives of over 20 million people shaping how Affirm builds Direct-to-Consumer products for Canada, the UK, and future international markets. We build and own various products used by our consumers, like the Affirm App and other Direct to Consumer products across international markets. We are here to make sure we reach and provide useful tools to our users so they can experience honest financial products at their fullest.

Our work is agile and fast-paced, shipping new code to production for millions to use across geographies and rigorously measuring the impact it has on them. This role rewards curiosity, ownership, ability to zoom in and out, switch contexts often, also in an open contribution model, and a builder s mindset. You ll know exactly what your objectives are, you ll have what you need to hit them, and you ll choose your own path to get there, while constantly looking for ways to get AI to increase productivity on a daily basis. You ll learn quickly from experienced teammates and grow your craft on problems that matter at scale.

If you want to build something new and operate it at scale – come join us!

· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. You will lead the architecture, development and delivery of B2B/B2C commerce solutions on Intershop ICM 14, while also contributing to broader technology initiatives involving microservices, event-driven architecture, API management and cloud-native applications.

  • You’ll own the technical architecture of our Intershop ICM solutions, working across B2B commerce, integrations and modern cloud-native applications.

    • Turn requirements into delivery: Translate business needs into technical designs, estimates, architecture documentation and implementation roadmaps.
    • Lead the technical conversation: Work directly with client architects, stakeholders, business analysts, engineers, Cloud and DevOps teams.
    • Keep us moving forward: Identify practical opportunities to use AI, automation and modern engineering practices.

 

What you bring

  • The most important thing for us is deep, hands-on Intershop experience combined with the ability to lead architecture at enterprise scale.

    • 10+ years in software engineering, including significant solution architecture experience.
    • 6+ years working hands-on with Intershop, with strong knowledge of ICM architecture, customisation, extensions and Intershop PWA.

    • Proven architecture experience across microservices, distributed systems and enterprise integrations.
    • Confidence leading technical discussions with clients and guiding distributed engineering teams.

Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Staff Platform Engineer with a dedicated focus on our Observability ecosystem for our Platform area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil. Wellhub runs at high scale, on many Kubernetes clusters. Our engineers need logs, metrics, traces and profiles they can trust, at a cost the business can sustain. We build and run this platform ourselves, on open source standards. This is not a "keep the lights on" role. You will help decide how a large platform is built, where it should stay simple, and what we should stop collecting. We value people who question the problem before they design the solution. What you will work on: A self-service platform . Observability as a Service for the whole engineering organization, balancing performance and cost. Golden Paths . Defaults that let a developer instrument code in minutes and get good signals without operating anything. The platform itself . Kubernetes and AWS foundations that stay reliable when the company grows. Our stack includes Kubernetes, AWS, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Crossplane, HashiCorp Vault, Kafka, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope. You will write code in Go, Ruby or Python to build our tools. YOUR IMPACT Our team does not run services for other teams. We build tools and abstractions so each team can own and run its own services end to end. Your work will rest on four things: stability, performance, cost and evolution of the platform. In this role you will: Review our current platform with fresh eyes. Say what is wrong, propose better solutions, and help the team evolve them. Your outside view is part of the job. Design and evolve cloud-native platform components on Kubernetes and AWS. Close the gap between complex infrastructure and developer experience. Build the abstractions (defaults, templates, CLIs, operators) that let teams manage their own observability. Find the root cause of cost, reliability and developer-experience problems, and fix it at the platform level. Set standards and guidelines, and write them down through RFCs. Work with the whole team day to day: pair on designs, review proposals and mentor engineers as a technical reference. Our stack is open source and we use AI tools every day, so you can contribute early. Our team learned observability on the job, and anyone on the team can help you. Live the mission: care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues'. Help build a team where people feel safe to take time off and keep a healthy work-life balance. WHO YOU ARE You have strong cloud and Kubernetes foundations, you like hard platform problems, and you do not need to be an observability expert yet. You like to remove friction. You want your work to help many engineers. You learn fast, and you tell us what you do not know. This role may fit if you have: Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and its ecosystem, from running real clusters. You possess excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese. Proficiency with AWS (or GCP or Azure) in production. Networking, IAM, cost and failure modes feel familiar. Strong software engineering skills. You write code to remove manual work and to build tools for other engineers. Experience in platform engineering, SRE or infrastructure, in a company where many teams depend on your work. Experience using observability in production (metrics, logs or traces), with any tool. We do not require our exact stack. A habit of questioning the problem before designing the solution. You sometimes fix a problem by removing something: a metric, a service, a step, a rule. The ability to compare real options and choose one with a reason, even when the popular tool is not the best fit. The ability to explain technical trade-offs to different audiences, and to share knowledge. Fluent English and Portuguese, spoken and written. You may come from platform engineering, SRE or infrastructure; from software engineering with a platform focus; or from a neighboring area such as data, networking or security. Bonus points if you have: Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo or similar open source tools. Built internal tools, CLIs or Kubernetes operators; Crossplane experience. Service mesh knowledge (Istio, Linkerd or similar). Cost optimization experience (FinOps). A strong sense of ownership, and joy in building tools that help other developers succeed. CNCF certifications (CKA, CKS, CKAD, PCA, OTCA). We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in AWS, Kubernetes, Software Engineering, and Observability Practices with open source solutions are mandatory requirements. jobs.description: Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital. Who we are Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital. Include the term "DiscoTech" on the resume The role, in a nutshell Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Senior Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, working in a small sub-team of two to four engineers that owns one project end to end. Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them. This is a product role. You will work directly with Product Managers and customers, make the trade-off calls on the features you own, and ship them. What the team owns Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard). The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure. Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore. Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly. What you'll do Design, build, and ship new features and services for Chainguard Containers, from a one-page design through production and the first week of customer use. Own the trade-offs on your work: scope, sequencing, what to cut, and when "good enough to ship" beats "complete". Say so clearly when a plan is at risk. Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and help the team raise the bar on how it uses them safely. Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, rather than stopping at the edge of your own repository. Keep the systems you touch healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back. Write clearly and often. Design notes, pull request descriptions, and status updates are how a remote team moves fast together. What we're looking for 3+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, preferably at a startup or a company in hyper-growth. High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you ask for help early when you are stuck. Judgment on trade-offs. You can explain why you chose speed here and rigor there, and you can change your mind when the data says to. A systems thinker. You reason about how a change moves through the build pipeline, the registry, and the customer's cluster, and you anticipate what breaks next. AI-native in how you work. You use agentic coding tools daily and can show what changed in your output because of them. Comfortable with ambiguity. You can pick up a half-defined problem, decide what to build, and pivot when priorities shift. Strong fundamentals in a systems language (Go preferred), API design, databases and caching, and cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS. Working knowledge of containers, container registries, the OCI image format (Open Container Initiative, the standard for container images and registries), and Kubernetes. Low ego. You do what you say and say what you do, and you communicate early when the news is bad. Excellent written English and experience working on a distributed, remote-first team. Nice to haves Software supply chain security background: SBOMs (software bill of materials), Sigstore signing, or SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for build integrity). Familiarity with Chainguard's open-source tools: Wolfi, apko, and melange. Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience. Author of or contributor to open-source projects.
